cats.mothers-ahlulbayt: Mothers of the Believers and the Prophet's Family

deen-0011: What religion did Allah approve for humanity and send Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) with?
Islam is the final religion that Allah approved for all humanity.
deen-0013: What is the highest level of the Islamic religion, which means complete awareness that Allah is watching?
Ihsan (excellence in worship) is: الإحسان أن تعبد الله كأنك تراه، فإن لم تكن تراه فإنه يراك. [It is to worship Allah as if you see Him, for if you do not see Him, He sees you.]
deen-0014: What is the firm belief that Allah alone creates, provides for, and governs the universe called?
Tawhid al-uluhiyyah (Allah's sole right to worship)
Tawhid al-asma wa-l-sifat (Allah's oneness in His names and attributes)
Tawhid al-rububiyyah (Allah's oneness in lordship) means affirming Allah alone in His acts, such as creating, providing, giving life, causing death, and governing.
deen-0017: What is believing in Allah's names and attributes as stated in the Quran and Sunnah (Prophetic teachings), without alteration or distortion, called?
Tawhid al-uluhiyyah (Allah's sole right to worship)
Tawhid al-asma wa-l-sifat (Allah's oneness in His names and attributes)
Tawhid al-asma wa-l-sifat (Allah's oneness in His names and attributes) means affirming the names and attributes that Allah affirmed for Himself in the manner befitting Him.
deen-0020: What is firm belief in Paradise and Hell, reckoning, and resurrection after death called?
Belief in the Last Day is the fifth pillar of iman (faith). It includes everything Allah has told us will happen after death.
deen-0026: What is firm belief that Allah knew, recorded, willed, and created everything that would happen called?
Tawhid al-asma wa-l-sifat (Allah's oneness in His names and attributes)
Belief in qadar (divine decree), its good and its evil, is the sixth pillar of iman (faith).
deen-0029: Which branch of tawhid (affirming Allah's oneness) means directing worship, such as supplication and prayer, to Allah alone without any partner?
Tawhid al-asma wa-l-sifat (Allah's oneness in His names and attributes)
Tawhid al-uluhiyyah (Allah's sole right to worship)
Tawhid al-uluhiyyah (Allah's sole right to worship) means dedicating people's acts of worship to Allah alone. It is the purpose for which the messengers were sent.
gemini-deen-b2-017: What is the first of the six pillars of iman (faith)?

The Hadith of Jibril states: «أن تؤمنَ بالله، وملائكتِه، وكتبِه، ورسلِه، واليومِ الآخر، وتؤمنَ بالقدرِ خيرِه وشرِّه» [It is to believe in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, and the Last Day, and believe in the divine decree, the pleasant and unpleasant aspects thereof.] It thus begins with belief in Allah.
deen-0016: Who is the Almighty Creator who created us and this universe, including its sun, moon, and stars?
Allah, glorified and exalted is He
Belief that Allah alone is the Creator and Provider who deserves worship is the foundation of the Islamic creed.
gemini-deen-b3-017: When we want to ask for forgiveness and mercy, whom do we supplicate to?
Dua (supplication) and istighfar (seeking forgiveness) are worship directed only to Allah, in whose hand is the dominion of everything.
gemini2-deen-006: Who is the Creator whom we worship alone without any partner?
Allah, glorified and exalted is He, alone deserves worship, to the exclusion of all others.
gemini2-deen-011: Which creatures did Allah create from light, and who always obey Him?
The angels are honored servants created from light. They do not disobey what Allah commands them.
deen-0018: Which angel is entrusted with bringing rain, directing winds, and making plants grow by Allah's command?
Mikail is one of the great angels. He is entrusted with rainfall and vegetation by Allah's permission.
gemini-deen-001: Which great angel is entrusted with bringing revelation from Allah to the prophets and messengers?
Jibril, peace be upon him, is the trustee of revelation, entrusted with conveying Allah's messages to His prophets.
gemini2-deen-016: What is the name of the angel entrusted with taking souls?

Allah says: ﴿قُلْ يَتَوَفَّاكُم مَّلَكُ الْمَوْتِ الَّذِي وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ﴾ [Say, "The angel of death who has been entrusted with you will take you. Then to your Lord you will be returned."] Jibril is entrusted with revelation, Mikail with rainfall, and Israfil with blowing the Trumpet.
deen-0022: What great revealed book did Allah send down to our Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) as guidance for all humanity?
The Noble Quran is Allah's final revealed word and the greatest miracle sent down to our Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him).
deen-0025: Which revealed book did Allah reveal to His prophet Musa, peace be upon him?
The Tawrah is the book Allah sent down to His prophet Musa, peace be upon him, to guide the Children of Israel.
deen-0028: Which revealed book did Allah send down to His prophet Dawud, peace be upon him?

Allah identified in the Noble Quran the book given to Dawud, peace be upon him: ﴿وَآتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ زَبُورًا﴾ [And your Lord is most knowing of whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And We have made some of the prophets exceed others [in various ways], and to David We gave the book [of Psalms].]
gemini2-deen-002: What does the Noble Quran call what was revealed to Ibrahim, peace be upon him?

Allah says: ﴿صُحُفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ﴾ [The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.] He thus calls what was revealed to Ibrahim scriptures. The Tawrah was for Musa, the Zabur for Dawud, and the Injil for Isa, peace be upon them.
gemini2-deen-007: Which revealed book was sent down to Isa, peace be upon him?
The Injil is Allah's book that He sent down to His prophet Isa, peace be upon him.
deen-0027: What true balance will be set up on the Day of Resurrection to weigh people's deeds with complete precision, so that no soul is wronged at all?
The balance is an established reality. People's good and bad deeds will be weighed on it on the Day of Resurrection.
gemini-deen-b2-009: Which angel is entrusted with blowing the Trumpet on the Day of Resurrection to raise all creatures?
Israfil, peace be upon him, is entrusted with blowing the Trumpet, according to the scholars' consensus.
gemini-deen-b3-012: The angel entrusted with bringing revelation from Allah to the prophets is:
Allah says: نزل به الروح الأمين * على قلبك. [The Trustworthy Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down / Upon your heart, [O Muḥammad] - that you may be of the warners]
deen-0001: How many pillars of Islam are there?
Five: the shahadatayn (two testimonies of faith), salah (prayer), zakah (obligatory alms), sawm (fasting), and hajj (pilgrimage).
deen-0002: How many pillars of iman (faith) are there?
Six: belief in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and qadar (divine decree).
deen-0003: What is the first pillar of Islam?
The shahadatayn (two testimonies of faith) are the first pillar.
deen-0006: Which pillar is obligatory once in a lifetime for someone able to undertake it?
Hajj (pilgrimage) is obligatory for someone able to undertake it.
deen-0008: What is the first thing for which a person will be held accountable on the Day of Resurrection, as reported?
«أوّلُ ما يُحاسَبُ به العبدُ الصلاة» [The first thing for which a person will be held accountable is salah (prayer).] (Hadith.)
deen-0012: How many pillars of iman (faith) did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) explain in the famous Hadith of Jibril?
The six pillars of iman (faith) are belief in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and qadar (divine decree).
deen-0019: Which blessed month must Muslims fast as one of the five pillars of Islam?
Fasting Ramadan is the fourth pillar of Islam. It is the month in which the Quran was sent down.
deen-0021: What are the two basic conditions for any act of worship to be accepted in Islam?
Sincerity to Allah and following the Sunnah (Prophetic teachings)
A righteous deed is accepted only when done sincerely for Allah's sake and in accordance with the guidance of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him).
deen-0023: From what did Allah create the honored angels who obey Him and never disobey Him?
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) stated that the angels were created from light, the jinn from fire, and Adam from what has been described to us: clay.
gemini-deen-002: What title does the Noble Quran give the angels entrusted with recording people's good and evil deeds?
Allah says: ﴿كِرَامًا كَاتِبِينَ ۝ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ﴾ [Noble and recording; / They know whatever you do.] They record what a person does.
gemini-deen-003: What is the correct and most precise meaning of the testimony of tawhid (Allah's oneness), 'La ilaha illa Allah'?
Allah is only the Creator and Provider
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah
The meaning of 'La ilaha illa Allah' (none has the right to be worshipped except Allah) is to deny true entitlement to worship to everything other than Allah and affirm it for Allah alone.
gemini-deen-004: What is the intervening stage of life that a person experiences after death and before the Day of Resurrection called?
Al-barzakh (the intermediate life) is the barrier and intervening stage between worldly life and the Day of Resurrection.
gemini-deen-005: What name did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) give to the minor shirk (associating partners with Allah) that he feared for his community and described as hidden shirk?
Riya (doing deeds to be seen by people)
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) called it riya (showing off): performing worship to earn people's praise. It invalidates the deed that accompanies it.
gemini-deen-b2-001: Submitting to Allah, affirming His oneness, and obeying Him
Islam means submitting to Allah through tawhid (affirming His oneness), yielding to Him in obedience, and disavowing shirk (associating partners with Allah).
gemini-deen-b2-002: What are the names of the two angels who question the deceased in the grave?

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) named them in the hadith: «يأتيه مَلَكانِ أسودانِ أزرقان، يُقالُ لأحدِهما المُنكَرُ وللآخرِ النَّكِير» [there come to him two black and blue angels; one of whom is called Munkar and the other Nakīr.]
gemini-deen-b2-003: Tawhid al-rububiyyah (Allah's oneness in lordship) means believing that Allah is:
The only one who deserves worship
The Creator, Provider, Governor, Giver of life, and Causer of death
The one possessing the most beautiful names
The one to whom nothing is comparable
Rububiyyah (lordship) concerns Allah's acts, such as creating and providing.
gemini-deen-b2-005: What is the definition of bidah (religious innovation) in Islam?
Any newly introduced act of worship through which a person seeks closeness to Allah, although neither Allah nor His Messenger prescribed it
Organizing new ways to collect zakah (obligatory alms)
Bidah (religious innovation) means introducing a practice that resembles a prescribed religious practice, intending worship through it without supporting evidence.
gemini-deen-b2-011: Where do Muslims throughout the world face when performing salah (prayer)?
The honored Kaaba is the Muslims' qiblah (direction of prayer).
gemini-deen-b2-012: What does Allah's name Ar-Razzaq mean?
The one who guarantees the sustenance and food of all creatures
The one who creates from nothing
The one who knows hidden thoughts
Ar-Razzaq is the one who delivers sustenance to all His creation.
gemini-deen-b2-013: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: خُلقت الملائكة من نور. [Angels were created from light]
gemini-deen-b2-015: What does Allah's name Al-Wadud mean?
The one who has no beginning
The one who loves His allies and is beloved to them
Al-Wadud derives from wudd, meaning pure love between Allah and His believing servants.
gemini-deen-b2-019: Belief in the Last Day includes belief in the Hawd (Prophetic pool). What is it?
A great pool belonging to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) on the Day of Resurrection, from which believers will drink
A river in Paradise for the angels
A sea of fire in which disbelievers are punished
A spring of water in this world
The water of the Prophet's pool is whiter than milk and sweeter than honey.
gemini-deen-b3-003: What does Allah's name As-Salam mean?
The one free from every deficiency, defect, and affliction
The one who created the heavens
As-Salam is the one free from defects and deficiencies. Peace and security are sought from Him.
gemini-deen-b3-005: For whom will the gate of Paradise first be opened on the Day of Resurrection?
The Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him)

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «آتي بابَ الجنّةِ يومَ القيامةِ فأستفتح، فيقولُ الخازن: مَن أنت؟ فأقول: محمّد، فيقول: بك أُمرتُ ألّا أفتحَ لأحدٍ قبلَك» [I will come to the gate of Paradise on the Day of Resurrection and ask for it to be opened. The keeper will say, 'Who are you?' I will say, 'Muhammad.' He will say, 'I was commanded concerning you not to open it for anyone before you.']
gemini-deen-b3-006: Which statement is considered the key to entering Islam?
Subhan Allahi wa bi-hamdih (glory and praise be to Allah)
La ilaha illa Allah, Muhammad rasul Allah (none has the right to be worshipped except Allah; Muhammad is Allah's Messenger)
Allahu akbaru kabira (Allah is supremely great)
الحمدُ للهِ ربِّ العالمين [[All] praise is [due] to Allāh, Lord[4] of the worlds -]
The shahadatayn (two testimonies of faith) are the first pillar and the foundation on which the religion is built.
gemini-deen-b3-008: Al-barzakh is one of the stages of human life. Which stage is it?
The intermediate life between death and resurrection
Al-barzakh (the intermediate life) is between death and resurrection. It includes bliss or punishment in the grave.
gemini-deen-b3-009: One of Allah's names is Al-Muhaymin. What does it mean?
The watcher, preserver, and witness over His creation
The one who forgives major sins
The distributor of His servants' sustenance
Al-Muhaymin is the one fully aware of hidden matters and in control of them.
gemini-deen-b3-010: How many gates does Paradise have, as stated in the hadith?

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «مَن أنفقَ زوجينِ في سبيلِ اللهِ نُوديَ من أبوابِ الجنّة، وللجنّةِ ثمانيةُ أبواب» [Whoever spends a pair in Allah's cause will be called from the gates of Paradise, and Paradise has eight gates.]
gemini-deen-b3-014: What does the Prophet's great shafaah (intercession) on the Day of Resurrection mean?
His intercession for judgment to be passed and the reckoning to begin
Saving the disbelievers from the Fire
The prophets decline it until the matter reaches the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him). He prostrates beneath the Throne and intercedes for the reckoning to begin.
gemini-deen-b3-016: In which Hijri month do pilgrims stand at Arafah?
Standing at Arafah takes place on the ninth of Dhu al-Hijjah. It is the greatest pillar of hajj (pilgrimage).
gemini-deen-b4-001: Who was the first messenger Allah sent to the people of the earth after they fell into shirk (associating partners with Allah)?
Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him)
Nuh, peace be upon him, was the first messenger sent to the people of the earth after shirk (associating partners with Allah) spread among his people.
gemini-deen-b4-003: What is the ruling on mocking any part of Allah's religion or His Messenger (peace and blessings be upon him)?
Kufr (disbelief) that takes a person outside Islam
A minor sin expiated by the five daily prayers

Mocking the religion or the Messenger is kufr (disbelief) that takes a person outside Islam, because Allah says: قل أبالله وآياته ورسوله كنتم تستهزئون. [And if you ask them, they will surely say, "We were only conversing and playing." Say, "Is it Allāh and His verses and His Messenger that you were mocking?"]
gemini2-deen-001: In which language was the Noble Quran revealed?
Allah says: ﴿إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا﴾ [Indeed, We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’ān[583] that you might understand.]
gemini2-deen-008: According to the Noble Quran, what is the main purpose of creating jinn and humans?
Allah says: وما خلقت الجن والإنس إلا ليعبدون. [And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.]
gemini2-deen-009: What does Allah's name Al-Basir mean?
The one able to do everything
Al-Basir is the one from whom nothing on earth or in heaven is hidden.
gemini2-deen-012: What is the name of the night Allah described as better than a thousand months?
Allah says: ﴿لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ﴾ [The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.] It occurs in the last ten nights of Ramadan.
gemini2-deen-014: What is the 'most trustworthy handhold' mentioned in the Noble Quran?
La ilaha illa Allah (none has the right to be worshipped except Allah)

The most trustworthy handhold is the statement of tawhid (Allah's oneness), 'La ilaha illa Allah' (none has the right to be worshipped except Allah). Allah says: ﴿فَقَدِ اسْتَمْسَكَ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَىٰ لَا انفِصَامَ لَهَا﴾ [There shall be no compulsion in [acceptance of] the religion. The right course has become distinct from the wrong. So whoever disbelieves in ṭāghūt[104] and believes in Allāh has grasped the most trustworthy handhold with no break in it. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.]
gemini2-deen-015: One condition of 'La ilaha illa Allah' (none has the right to be worshipped except Allah) is certainty: complete conviction in its meaning. Which fault contradicts certainty and invalidates this condition?

Certainty is the opposite of doubt and uncertainty. Saying this testimony while doubting its meaning does not benefit a person. Each condition has its opposite: knowledge opposes ignorance, sincerity opposes showing off, and tawhid (affirming Allah's oneness) opposes shirk (associating partners with Allah).
gemini2-deen-018: What is major nifaq (hypocrisy) that takes a person outside Islam?
Outwardly displaying Islam while concealing disbelief
Major nifaq (hypocrisy) means concealing disbelief and lacking faith in the heart while outwardly displaying Islam.
gemini2-deen-019: Major sins are grave acts of disobedience that do not take a person outside Islam. Yet scholars identify one act as invalidating Islam even if done jokingly. Which is it?
Mocking anything in the religion of the Messenger (peace and blessings be upon him)

Allah says: ﴿قُلْ أَبِاللَّهِ وَآيَاتِهِ وَرَسُولِهِ كُنتُمْ تَسْتَهْزِئُونَ * لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا قَدْ كَفَرْتُم بَعْدَ إِيمَانِكُمْ﴾ [And if you ask them, they will surely say, "We were only conversing and playing." Say, "Is it Allāh and His verses and His Messenger that you were mocking?" / Make no excuse; you have disbelieved [i.e., rejected faith] after your belief. If We pardon one faction of you - We will punish another faction because they were criminals.] Committing major sins, mistreating one's parents, and delaying prayer out of laziness are grave acts of disobedience that do not take a person outside Islam.
salah-0020: What phrase do we say while raising our hands to enter an obligatory prayer?
It is called takbirat al-ihram (the opening declaration of Allah's greatness). It is the key to entering prayer, which does not begin validly without it.
gemini-prayer-003: What is the second call, given immediately before prayer, to alert worshippers to form their rows and begin?
The iqamah (call to begin prayer) tells worshippers to stand up and start the prescribed prayer.
salah-0018: What is the call raised in mosques to inform Muslims that the time for an obligatory prayer has begun?
Tahlil (declaring Allah's sole right to worship)
The adhan (call announcing prayer time) announces the beginning of prayer time with specific words. It is given five times a day.
gemini-prayer-005: What is the prescribed prayer performed in a special manner during battles and confrontation with the enemy?
Allah prescribed salat al-khawf (fear prayer) so Muslims can perform the obligation while remaining vigilant and carrying weapons during war.
gemini-prayer-b3-008: What is the prayer performed on the first days of Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha called?
It is a confirmed Sunnah (Prophetic practice), performed in congregation in open prayer grounds on Eid morning.
gemini2-prayer-013: How many opening takbirs (declarations of Allah's greatness) are there in one prayer?
Takbirat al-ihram (the opening declaration of Allah's greatness) is only the first takbir. It is a pillar with which prayer begins.
gemini-prayer-b3-013: How many rakahs (prayer units) did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) usually pray in Ramadan for tarawih (night prayer), including witr (odd-numbered prayer)?

Aishah, may Allah be pleased with her, said: ما كان يزيد في رمضان ولا غيره على إحدى عشرة ركعة. [Neither in Ramadan, nor in any other month, did the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) exceed the eleven Rak‘ahs of prayer.] Praying more is permissible.
salah-0019: Which voluntary prayer did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) say is «خير من الدنيا وما فيها» [better than the world and everything in it]?
The two rakahs (prayer units) before Fajr

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) singled out the two rakahs (prayer units) before Fajr, the Sunnah (regular voluntary prayer) of Fajr, for this tremendous merit because of their high status.
salah-0032: What prayer do Muslims gather for in the morning to celebrate the end of Ramadan?
Salat al-Eid (the Eid al-Fitr prayer) is performed in gratitude to Allah and joy at completing the obligatory fast.
gemini-prayer-002: What is a Muslim prescribed to do to purify himself for prayer if water is unavailable or illness makes using it harmful?
Postpone prayer until the next day
Perform tayammum (dry purification) with clean earth
Allah prescribed tayammum (dry purification) with clean earth to ease matters for Muslims when water is unavailable or they cannot use it.
gemini-prayer-004: What concession has Allah allowed travelers to ease the performance of four-rakah prayers: Zuhr, Asr, and Isha?
Omit them and make them up after traveling
Qasr (shortening the prayer to two rakahs)
Qasr (shortening a four-rakah prayer to two rakahs) is a Sunnah (Prophetic practice) and a travel concession granted by Allah as an ease.
gemini-prayer-b2-001: A sick person prays lying on his back and cannot do otherwise. In which direction should he point his feet?
Point his feet toward the qiblah and raise his head slightly
Point his feet in any direction he wishes
Point his head toward the qiblah and his feet away from it
Do not pray until he can sit

A sick person lying on his back points his feet toward the qiblah (direction of prayer) and raises his head slightly to face it. He gestures for ruku (bowing) and sujud (prostration). Prayer is not waived for him under any circumstances.
gemini-prayer-b2-002: What should you do if prayer time comes and you cannot find water for wudu (ablution)?
Postpone the prayer until the next day
Perform tayammum (dry purification) with clean earth
Tayammum (dry purification) is a concession from Allah when water is unavailable.
gemini-prayer-b2-006: What is the ruling if a Muslim cannot perform some pillars of prayer because of illness or injury?
Perform what he can; what he cannot do is waived
Repeat the entire prayer after recovery
Appoint someone else to pray on his behalf

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «وإذا أمرتُكم بأمرٍ فأتوا منه ما استطعتم» [and if I command you with something, do as much of it as you can.] Inability to perform one pillar does not waive the rest of the prayer. Praying on behalf of a living person is not accepted.
gemini-prayer-b2-007: On how many bones does a Muslim rest when prostrating to Allah?
The forehead, together with the nose; the two hands; the two knees; and the tips of the two feet.
gemini-prayer-b2-008: What is the ruling on turning one's face during prayer without a need?
It is disliked but does not invalidate the prayer
It is recommended for checking the rows
It is permissible without any dislike

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) was asked about looking around during prayer and said: «هو اختلاسٌ يختلسُه الشيطانُ من صلاةِ العبد» [It is a way of stealing by which the devil steals a portion of a slave's prayer.] It is thus disliked but does not invalidate prayer. What invalidates prayer is turning the whole body away from the qiblah (direction of prayer).
gemini-prayer-b2-012: What is the brief two-rakah prayer performed upon entering the mosque before sitting called?
Salat al-istikharah (prayer for guidance in a decision)
The Prophet instructed anyone entering a mosque not to sit until praying two rakahs (prayer units).
gemini-prayer-b2-014: A worshipper absentmindedly adds a fifth rakah (prayer unit) to Zuhr and remembers only after the salam (closing salutation). What must he do?
Perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness and give salam; his prayer is valid
Repeat the prayer from the beginning
Add a sixth rakah to make the number even

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) prayed five rakahs (prayer units) for Zuhr. When told about it, he performed two prostrations after giving salam (the closing salutation). Sujud al-sahw (prostration for forgetfulness) remedies an inadvertent addition, which does not invalidate the prayer.
gemini-prayer-b2-018: A worshipper absentmindedly ends Zuhr after two rakahs (prayer units), then remembers shortly afterward without breaking his state of purification or leaving the mosque. What must he do?
Complete the rest of the prayer, then give salam and perform the prostrations of forgetfulness
Restart the prayer from the beginning
Only perform the prostrations of forgetfulness without completing the rakahs

In the Hadith of Dhu al-Yadayn, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) ended Zuhr after two rakahs (prayer units). When reminded, he completed the rest, gave salam (the closing salutation), performed two prostrations, and gave salam again. An inadvertent early salam is remedied by completing the prayer and then performing sujud al-sahw (prostration for forgetfulness).
gemini-prayer-b3-001: A sick person prays seated and cannot prostrate on the ground. What should he do for prostration?
Gesture with his head, lowering it more for prostration than for bowing
Raise an object to his forehead to prostrate on it
Perform a full prostration in the air

Someone unable to prostrate gestures with his head, lowering it more for sujud (prostration) than for ruku (bowing) to distinguish the two pillars. Raising an object to the forehead to prostrate on it is not prescribed.
gemini-prayer-b3-002: Before prayer, a Muslim washes specified parts of the body. What is this process called?
Wudu (ablution) is a condition for the validity of prayer. It includes washing the face and arms, wiping the head, and washing the feet.
gemini-prayer-b3-004: What is the specific purpose of salat al-istikharah (prayer for guidance in a decision)?
Asking Allah to choose what is best and grant success when uncertain about a permissible matter
When someone intends to do something, he should pray two rakahs (prayer units), then recite the dua al-istikharah (supplication for guidance in a decision), so Allah guides him to what is best.
gemini-prayer-b3-009: For what circumstance was shortening a four-rakah prayer to two rakahs prescribed?

Allah says: ﴿وَإِذَا ضَرَبْتُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَقْصُرُوا مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ﴾ [And when you travel throughout the land, there is no blame upon you for shortening the prayer,[215] [especially] if you fear that those who disbelieve may disrupt [or attack] you.[216] Indeed, the disbelievers are ever to you a clear enemy.] Qasr (shortening prayer) is restricted to travel alone. Illness and rain may permit jam (combining prayers), but not shortening them.
gemini-prayer-b3-015: What is sujud al-sahw (prostration for forgetfulness), and when is it performed?
Two prostrations for someone who forgets to recite Al-Fatihah
Two prostrations performed before or after salam to remedy an inadvertent omission, addition, or doubt in prayer
Two prostrations to erase major sins
Sujud al-sahw (prostration for forgetfulness) was prescribed to remedy inadvertent faults. It does not compensate for omitting pillars.
gemini-prayer-b3-019: A worshipper doubts whether he prayed three or four rakahs (prayer units), with neither number seeming more likely. According to the Hadith of Abu Said al-Khudri, what should he do?
Disregard doubt, build on certainty, which is the lower number, then perform the prostrations of forgetfulness
Use the higher number and end the prayer without prostrating
Restart the prayer from the beginning
Ask the person beside him and act on the answer

The Hadith of Abu Said states: «فليطرحِ الشكَّ وليَبْنِ على ما استيقن» [let him dispel the doubt and build upon what he is certain about,] This applies when neither possibility is more likely. The Hadith of Ibn Masud states: «فليتحرَّ الصوابَ فليُتِمَّ عليه» [he should follow what he thinks to be correct and complete his prayer accordingly,] According to the Hanafi and Hanbali schools, someone who considers one possibility more likely acts on it.
gemini-prayer-b4-003: What is the ruling on frequent, continuous movement during prayer without a need?
It invalidates prayer if frequent and continuous
It is disliked but never invalidates prayer, however frequent
It invalidates wudu but not prayer

Frequent, continuous action without necessity takes the prayer out of its proper form and invalidates it. Slight movement, or movement for a need, does no harm. The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) carried Umamah during prayer and put her down.
gemini2-prayer-002: A man deliberately engages in ordinary conversation during an obligatory prayer. What is the ruling on his prayer?
His prayer is invalid and he must repeat it
It is valid, but he performs the prostrations of forgetfulness
It is valid and nothing is required
It is valid if the conversation is brief and concerns religion

When Muawiyah ibn al-Hakam as-Sulami spoke during prayer, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) told him: «إنّ هذه الصلاةَ لا يصلُحُ فيها شيءٌ من كلامِ الناس» [In prayer, nothing of people's ordinary speech is allowed.] Deliberate speech invalidates prayer according to all four schools.
gemini2-prayer-004: When is a worshipper prescribed to perform sujud al-sahw (prostration for forgetfulness)?
When adding, omitting, or doubting an action in prayer
Sujud al-sahw (prostration for forgetfulness) was prescribed to remedy faults caused by forgetfulness in the actions of prayer.
gemini2-prayer-011: A sick person can neither stand nor sit. In what position should he pray?
Delay prayer until he can sit
Combine all prayers at the end of the day

The rest of the Hadith of Imran ibn Husayn states: «فإن لم تستطعْ فعلى جَنب» [and if you cannot, then while lying on your side.] Someone unable to pray in one position moves to the next and does not abandon prayer.
gemini2-prayer-018: During prayer, a worshipper deliberately turns his whole body away from the qiblah (direction of prayer), without an excuse. What is the ruling?
His prayer is invalid because the condition of facing the qiblah is no longer met
It is valid, but he performs the prostrations of forgetfulness
It is valid if he turns back quickly
It is valid and nothing is required

Facing the qiblah (direction of prayer) is a condition for a valid prayer. Allah says: ﴿فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ﴾ [We have certainly seen the turning of your face, [O Muḥammad], toward the heaven, and We will surely turn you to a qiblah with which you will be pleased. So turn your face [i.e., yourself] toward al-Masjid al-Ḥarām.[53] And wherever you [believers] are, turn your faces [i.e., yourselves] toward it [in prayer]. Indeed, those who have been given the Scripture [i.e., the Jews and the Christians] well know that it is the truth from their Lord. And Allāh is not unaware of what they do.] Deliberately turning the entire body away without an excuse invalidates prayer. Turning the face alone is disliked but does not invalidate it.
salah-0001: How many obligatory prayers are there in a day and night?
Five prayers: Fajr, Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha.
salah-0002: Which prayers may a traveler shorten, and which remain unchanged?
Only four-rakah prayers are shortened; Maghrib and Fajr remain unchanged
Only Maghrib and Fajr are shortened
Qasr (shortening prayer) applies only to the four-rakah prayers: Zuhr, Asr, and Isha, which are prayed as two rakahs (prayer units). Maghrib remains three and Fajr remains two; neither is shortened.
salah-0006: Which prayer has neither bowing nor prostration?
Salat al-janazah (funeral prayer) consists of four takbirs (declarations of Allah's greatness), standing, and dua (supplication).
salah-0008: What is the qiblah (direction of prayer) that Muslims face in prayer?

The honored Kaaba in Makkah al-Mukarramah is the Muslims' qiblah (direction of prayer), because Allah says: ﴿فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ﴾ [We have certainly seen the turning of your face, [O Muḥammad], toward the heaven, and We will surely turn you to a qiblah with which you will be pleased. So turn your face [i.e., yourself] toward al-Masjid al-Ḥarām.[53] And wherever you [believers] are, turn your faces [i.e., yourselves] toward it [in prayer]. Indeed, those who have been given the Scripture [i.e., the Jews and the Christians] well know that it is the truth from their Lord. And Allāh is not unaware of what they do.]
salah-0009: A sick person cannot stand during an obligatory prayer. How should he pray?
Prayer is waived while he is sick

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) told Imran ibn Husayn, who had hemorrhoids: «صَلِّ قائمًا، فإن لم تستطعْ فقاعدًا، فإن لم تستطعْ فعلى جَنب» [Pray while standing; if you cannot, then while sitting; and if you cannot, then while lying on your side.] Prayer is not waived for a sick person as long as he retains his mental faculties.
salah-0010: The Sunnah (Prophetic practice) of tahiyyat al-masjid (greeting the mosque) is two rakahs (prayer units) offered when...
«إذا دخلَ أحدُكم المسجدَ فلْيركعْ ركعتَينِ قبلَ أن يجلس» [When anyone of you enters the mosque, let him offer two Rak‘ahs before he sits down.]
salah-0011: How is an obligatory prayer concluded?
«مفتاح الصلاة الطهور... وتحليلُها التسليم» [The key to prayer is purification... and its release is taslim (the closing salutation).]
salah-0012: Which prayer is called at midday on Friday and preceded by a sermon?
Salat al-Jumuah (Friday prayer) is an individual obligation for legally accountable men. It is preceded by two sermons.
salah-0013: When is sujud al-sahw (prostration for forgetfulness) prescribed for a worshipper?
When reciting a verse containing a prostration
When adding, omitting, or doubting something in prayer
When thanking Allah for a blessing
Sujud al-sahw (prostration for forgetfulness) is prescribed to remedy an inadvertent fault in prayer.
salah-0015: When does the time for performing Fajr prayer end?
When the sun passes its zenith
The time of Fajr begins at true dawn and ends at sunrise.
salah-0017: A sick person cannot manage wudu (ablution) with water and has no one to help him perform it. Prayer time is running out. What must he do?
Perform tayammum and pray on time
Delay prayer until he can use water
Pray without purification and do not repeat it
Prayer is waived because he is unable

Inability to use water because of illness is a reason for tayammum (dry purification). Allah says: ﴿وَإِن كُنتُم مَّرْضَىٰ أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ … فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا﴾ [O you who have believed, when you rise to [perform] prayer, wash your faces and your forearms to the elbows and wipe over your heads and wash your feet to the ankles. And if you are in a state of janābah,[245] then purify yourselves. But if you are ill or on a journey or one of you comes from the place of relieving himself or you have contacted women[246] and do not find water, then seek clean earth and wipe over your faces and hands with it. Allāh does not intend to make difficulty for you, but He intends to purify you and complete His favor upon you that you may be grateful.] Praying on time takes priority over waiting for water.
salah-0025: During which pillar of prayer did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) say that a person is closest to his Lord, and instruct us to supplicate abundantly?
The final tashahhud (testimony recited while seated)
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «أقرب ما يكون العبد من ربه وهو ساجد، فأكثروا الدعاء» [The nearest a slave to his Lord is while he is prostrating, so increase supplication.]
salah-0028: What is the object, such as a wall or pillar, that a worshipper places in front of him to prevent people passing immediately before him during prayer called?
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) instructed the worshipper to use a sutrah (prayer barrier) in front of him and not let anyone pass between him and it.
gemini-quran-002: Which is the only surah (chapter) of the Quran named after a devout, righteous woman?
Surah Maryam is named after Maryam the virgin, daughter of Imran. Her story is related in detail in it.
gemini-quran-005: Which surah (chapter) has 200 verses and contains details of the events of the Battle of Uhud?
Surah Al Imran contains a detailed account of the events of the Battle of Uhud and the trials the Muslims suffered there.
gemini-quran-b2-001: The polytheists said: لولا نُزِّلَ عليه القرآنُ جملةً واحدة [Why was the Qur’ān not revealed to him all at once?] A verse was then revealed explaining the wisdom of revealing the Quran in stages to strengthen the Prophet's heart. In which surah (chapter)?

Allah says in Surah Al-Furqan: ﴿وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةً وَٰحِدَةً ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَـٰهُ تَرْتِيلًا﴾ [And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur’ān not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.[1023]] This answers their objection to its gradual revelation.
gemini-quran-b2-006: Which surah (chapter) tells the story of the young men who slept in a cave for many years?
Surah Al-Kahf tells their story to demonstrate Allah's power to resurrect.
gemini-quran-b2-016: Which surah (chapter) mentions an insect that produces honey beneficial to people?
In it Allah mentions bees and that a drink of varying colors comes from their bellies.
gemini-quran-b3-004: Which surah (chapter) mentions the story of the cow of the Children of Israel?
Surah Al-Baqarah is named for the story of the cow that the Children of Israel were commanded to slaughter.
gemini-quran-b3-006: Some Companions swore not to support those who had participated in the slander. A verse commanded pardon and forbearance, saying: أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغْفِرَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ [Would you not like that Allāh should forgive you?] In which surah (chapter) was it revealed?

It was revealed concerning Abu Bakr as-Siddiq, may Allah be pleased with him, when he swore not to support Mistah. Allah says: ﴿وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَٱلسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤْتُوٓا۟ أُو۟لِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينَ وَٱلْمُهَـٰجِرِينَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَلْيَعْفُوا۟ وَلْيَصْفَحُوٓا۟ ۗ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ﴾ [And let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of Allāh, and let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allāh should forgive you? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.]
gemini-quran-b3-008: The Jews asked the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) about the soul. A verse answered that the soul is of the Lord's affair and that people have been given only a little knowledge. In which surah (chapter)?

Allah says: ﴿وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلرُّوحِ ۖ قُلِ ٱلرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّى وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا﴾ [And they ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the soul. Say, "The soul is of the affair [i.e., concern] of my Lord. And you [i.e., mankind] have not been given of knowledge except a little."] It was revealed in answer to their question about the soul.
gemini-quran-b3-019: Which surah (chapter) is also called Surah Al-Qital because it frequently mentions the rulings of jihad (striving and fighting in Allah's cause)?
It is called Surah Muhammad and Surah Al-Qital.
gemini2-quran-008: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) stood on As-Safa calling Quraysh and asked: «أرأيتم لو أخبرتُكم أنّ خيلًا بالوادي تريدُ أن تُغيرَ عليكم، أكنتم مصدِّقيَّ؟» [If I told you that cavalry in the valley intended to raid you, would you believe me?] In which surah (chapter) were verses of warning revealed concerning his uncle Abu Lahab?

Surah Al-Masad was revealed concerning Abu Lahab when he said: «تبًّا لك سائرَ اليوم» [May you be ruined for the rest of the day!] It begins: ﴿تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ﴾ [May the hands of Abū Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.[2008]]
gemini2-quran-018: Which is the only surah (chapter) in which the basmalah (the formula beginning 'In Allah's name') occurs twice?

It appears at the beginning and in Sulayman's letter: (إنه من سليمان وإنه بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم) [Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it is [i.e., reads]: 'In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,]
quran-0019: What is the longest surah (chapter) of the Noble Quran?
Surah Al-Baqarah is the longest surah (chapter), with 286 verses.
quran-0020: Which is the only surah (chapter) of the Noble Quran that does not begin with بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم [In the name of Allāh,[2] the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.[3]]?
The basmalah (the formula beginning 'In Allah's name') is not written at the beginning of Surah At-Tawbah.
quran-0022: Which surah (chapter) of the Quran is named after an insect that Allah inspired to make honey?
Surah An-Nahl is named for its account of Allah inspiring bees to make honey.
quran-0023: Which surah (chapter) did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) encourage reading on Friday to give a Muslim light between the two Fridays?
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) encouraged reading Surah Al-Kahf on Friday because of the reward, light, and blessing it brings a Muslim.
quran-0025: Which surah (chapter) is called Umm al-Kitab and without which prayer is invalid?
Al-Fatihah is called Umm al-Kitab because it contains the Quran's fundamental purposes.
quran-0034: Which surah (chapter) did Allah reveal to exonerate the Mother of the Believers, Aishah, may Allah be pleased with her, in the incident of the slander?
Surah An-Nur contains verses declaring Aishah's innocence, may Allah be pleased with her, and clearing her of the accusations made against her.
quran-0035: Which surah (chapter) primarily addresses the details and rulings of the great Battle of Badr?
Surah Al-Anfal was revealed after the Battle of Badr to explain the rulings on spoils, the battle's events, and Allah's instructions to the believers.
quran-0036: Which surah (chapter) is named after our Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him)?
Surah Muhammad is named after the noble Prophet and is also known as Surah Al-Qital.
quran-0037: Which surah (chapter) is named after women and contains many rulings concerning them?
The surah (chapter) has this name because it contains many rulings on women, inheritance, and family rights.
quran-0038: Which surah (chapter) was formerly known among the Companions as Surah Bani Israil?
It was called Surah Bani Israil because its opening mentions them and describes their corruption. This name is reliably reported from Aishah and Ibn Masud.
gemini-quran-b4-006: Uthman ibn Affan, may Allah be pleased with him, ordered people to unite upon one mushaf (Quran codex) and had copies made. Which Companion headed the copying committee and had previously compiled the Quran under Abu Bakr?
Zayd ibn Thabit, may Allah be pleased with him
Ubayy ibn Kab, may Allah be pleased with him
Abdullah ibn Masud, may Allah be pleased with him
Abu ad-Darda, may Allah be pleased with him
Abu Bakr entrusted Zayd ibn Thabit with compiling the Quran. Uthman later appointed him to head the copying committee because he was one of the scribes of revelation.
quran-0029: Which noble Companion did Caliph Abu Bakr as-Siddiq entrust with collecting the Noble Quran from written sheets and people's memories?
Abdullah ibn Masud, may Allah be pleased with him
Ubayy ibn Kab, may Allah be pleased with him
Abdullah ibn Abbas, may Allah be pleased with him
Zayd ibn Thabit, may Allah be pleased with him
Abu Bakr chose him because he was a scribe of revelation, young, sound in judgment, and trustworthy.
quran-0021: Which surah (chapter) did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) say is equivalent to one-third of the Quran?
Surah Al-Ikhlas contains tawhid (affirmation of Allah's oneness). The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) stated that it is equivalent to one-third of the Quran.
quran-0026: What is the longest verse in the Noble Quran, revealed to explain the rulings on documenting financial transactions?
Ayat ad-Dayn is verse 282 of Surah Al-Baqarah. It details the rulings on recording debts and having them witnessed.
quran-0031: Which verse did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) describe as «أعظم آية في كتاب الله» [the greatest verse in Allah's Book]?

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) asked Ubayy ibn Kab about the greatest verse. He answered Ayat al-Kursi, and the Prophet affirmed his answer because of the tawhid (affirmation of Allah's oneness) it contains.
gemini-quran-003: Which is the only Companion explicitly mentioned by name in the verses of the Noble Quran?
Abu Bakr as-Siddiq, may Allah be pleased with him
Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him
Zayd ibn Harithah, may Allah be pleased with him
Bilal ibn Rabah, may Allah be pleased with him

Allah says: ﴿فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا﴾ [And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor,[1198] "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose.[1199] And you feared the people,[1200] while Allāh has more right that you fear Him.[1201] So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished.]
gemini-quran-004: What do tafsir (Quran exegesis) scholars call the surahs and verses revealed to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) before his migration to Madinah?
Scholars classify as Makki what was revealed before the Hijrah (migration) and as Madani what was revealed afterward.
gemini-quran-b2-009: With which verse does Surah Al-Maidah end?

وَكُلُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ حَلَـٰلًا طَيِّبًا ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنتُم بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنُونَ [And eat of what Allāh has provided for you [which is] lawful and good. And fear Allāh, in whom you are believers.]

وَإِذْ أَوْحَيْتُ إِلَى ٱلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ أَنْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِى وَبِرَسُولِى قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَٱشْهَدْ بِأَنَّنَا مُسْلِمُونَ [And [remember] when I inspired to the disciples, "Believe in Me and in My messenger [i.e., Jesus]." They said, "We have believed, so bear witness that indeed we are Muslims [in submission to Allāh]."]

لِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا فِيهِنَّ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌۢ [To Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is within them. And He is over all things competent.]

يُرِيدُونَ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمَا هُم بِخَـٰرِجِينَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ [They will wish to get out of the Fire, but never are they to emerge therefrom, and for them is an enduring punishment.]

The final verse of Surah Al-Maidah is: ﴿لِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا فِيهِنَّ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌۢ﴾ [To Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is within them. And He is over all things competent.]
gemini-quran-b2-010: What is the discipline that explains the meanings of the Noble Quran and clarifies its rulings and stories?
Al-jarh wa-l-tadil (criticism and accreditation of narrators)
Tafsir (Quran exegesis) explains the meanings of Quranic verses and clarifies what is meant by them.
gemini-quran-b2-012: With which verse does Surah Ya-Sin end?

وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّـٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَـٰبٍ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ [And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -]
وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ [And the Horn will be blown;[1274] and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.]
فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ [So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.]
قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ [It was said, "Enter Paradise."[1263] He said, "I wish my people could know]

The final verse of Surah Ya-Sin is: ﴿فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ﴾ [So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.]
gemini-quran-b2-014: How many mutawatir (mass-transmitted) Quran readings are established from the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) and covered in the book An-Nashr?
The ten mutawatir (mass-transmitted) readings are authentic and used for recitation.
gemini-quran-b2-015: What does Allah's statement ﴿شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ فِيهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ هُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ وَبَيِّنَـٰتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَٱلْفُرْقَانِ ۚ فَمَن شَهِدَ مِنكُمُ ٱلشَّهْرَ فَلْيَصُمْهُ ۖ وَمَن كَانَ مَرِيضًا أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ فَعِدَّةٌ مِّنْ أَيَّامٍ أُخَرَ ۗ يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ بِكُمُ ٱلْيُسْرَ وَلَا يُرِيدُ بِكُمُ ٱلْعُسْرَ وَلِتُكْمِلُوا۟ ٱلْعِدَّةَ وَلِتُكَبِّرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمْ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ﴾ [The month of Ramaḍān [is that] in which was revealed the Qur’ān, a guidance for the people and clear proofs of guidance and criterion. So whoever sights [the crescent of] the month,[66] let him fast it; and whoever is ill or on a journey - then an equal number of other days. Allāh intends for you ease and does not intend for you hardship and [wants] for you to complete the period and to glorify Allāh for that [to] which He has guided you; and perhaps you will be grateful.] mean regarding the merit of Ramadan?
That the Quran's revelation began in Ramadan
That the Quran is read only in Ramadan
That the whole Quran was revealed to the Prophet in one night of Ramadan
That Ramadan was named because the Quran was revealed in it
It means that its revelation to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) began in Ramadan, then continued in stages over twenty-three years.
gemini-quran-b2-018: With which verse does Surah Muhammad begin?
أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ أَمْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَآ [Then do they not reflect upon the Qur’ān, or are there locks upon [their] hearts?]
ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ [Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allāh - He will waste their deeds.[1492]]
وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ زَادَهُمْ هُدًى وَءَاتَىٰهُمْ تَقْوَىٰهُمْ [And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.[1500]]

وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَعْلَمَ ٱلْمُجَـٰهِدِينَ مِنكُمْ وَٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ وَنَبْلُوَا۟ أَخْبَارَكُمْ [And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of Allāh] and the patient, and We will test your affairs.]

The first verse of Surah Muhammad is: ﴿ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ﴾ [Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allāh - He will waste their deeds.[1492]]
gemini-quran-b3-009: With which verse does Surah Al-Ahzab begin?

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ ٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا [O Prophet, fear Allāh and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.]

سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِى ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا [[This is] the established way of Allāh with those who passed on before; and you will not find in the way of Allāh any change.]

إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتَهُۥ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِىِّ ۚ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ صَلُّوا۟ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا۟ تَسْلِيمًا [Indeed, Allāh confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]. O you who have believed, ask [Allāh to confer] blessing upon him and ask [Allāh to grant him] peace.]

وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْذُونَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ بِغَيْرِ مَا ٱكْتَسَبُوا۟ فَقَدِ ٱحْتَمَلُوا۟ بُهْتَـٰنًا وَإِثْمًا مُّبِينًا [And those who harm believing men and believing women for [something] other than what they have earned [i.e., deserved] have certainly borne upon themselves a slander and manifest sin.]

The first verse of Surah Al-Ahzab is: ﴿يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ ٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا﴾ [O Prophet, fear Allāh and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.]
gemini-quran-b3-010: What does Allah's statement ﴿لَّا يَأْتِيهِ ٱلْبَـٰطِلُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ ۖ تَنزِيلٌ مِّنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍ﴾ [Falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it; [it is] a revelation from a [Lord who is] Wise and Praiseworthy.] mean in describing the Noble Quran?
That falsehood cannot reach it from any direction, in either its wording or its meaning
That the Quran may only be read from a mushaf (Quran codex)
That the Quran cannot be translated into any language other than Arabic
That the Quran is preserved solely in the hearts of those who memorize it
It means that the Quran is protected against falsehood reaching it through addition, omission, or distortion in any way.
gemini-quran-b3-013: What does Allah's statement ﴿وَقُرْءَانًا فَرَقْنَـٰهُ لِتَقْرَأَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ مُكْثٍ وَنَزَّلْنَـٰهُ تَنزِيلًا﴾ [And [it is] a Qur’ān which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively.] mean regarding how the Quran was revealed?
That Allah revealed it in stages so the Prophet could recite it to people slowly and deliberately
That the Quran was revealed all at once in a single night
That the Quran was written on separate sheets
That the Quran was revealed in multiple languages

The verse explains that Allah revealed the Quran in stages so that the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) would recite it to people slowly and it would become firmly established in their hearts.
gemini-quran-b3-015: What does Allah's statement ﴿إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ﴾ [Indeed, it is We who sent down the message [i.e., the Qur’ān], and indeed, We will be its guardian.] mean?
That Allah has undertaken to preserve the Quran from alteration, addition, and omission
That the Companions undertook to preserve the Quran in their memories
That preservation concerns only written copies, not recitation
That preservation depends on people memorizing it
Allah attributes preservation to Himself, glorified is He. He has undertaken to safeguard the Quran from distortion and loss until the Hour.
gemini-quran-b3-016: Which surah (chapter) ends by mentioning the names of two noble prophets, صحف إبراهيم وموسى [The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.]?
The last verse of Surah Al-Ala is (صحف إبراهيم وموسى) [The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.].
gemini-quran-b4-003: What does naskh (abrogation) mean in the terminology of scholars of usul al-fiqh (principles of jurisprudence) and Quranic studies?
Removing an earlier religious ruling through later religious evidence
Explaining one verse through another verse
Writing the mushaf and making multiple copies
Arranging the surahs in the mushaf

Naskh (abrogation), as a technical term, is removing a religious ruling through subsequent religious evidence. Copying a mushaf (Quran codex) is a linguistic use of the word, rather than its technical meaning.
gemini-quran-b4-005: On which aspect does Al-Jami li-Ahkam al-Quran, commonly known as Tafsir al-Qurtubi, focus extensively?
Deriving fiqh (jurisprudential) rulings from the verses
Tafsir al-Qurtubi is among the most important and greatest works of fiqh-based tafsir (Quran exegesis), concerned with the Quran's rulings.
gemini2-quran-004: Which two surahs (chapters) are together called Al-Muawwidhatayn?
Both begin with (قل أعوذ) [Say, "I seek refuge] and are used to seek refuge from evil.
gemini2-quran-005: The reading of Nafi al-Madani is a well-known mutawatir (mass-transmitted) Quran reading. Who are its best-known transmitters?
Warsh and Qalun are the two famous transmitters of Imam Nafi's reading.
gemini2-quran-010: With which verse does Surah At-Tahrim begin?

وَلَا تَدْعُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكَ وَلَا يَضُرُّكَ ۖ فَإِن فَعَلْتَ فَإِنَّكَ إِذًا مِّنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ [And do not invoke[543] besides Allāh that which neither benefits you nor harms you, for if you did, then indeed you would be of the wrongdoers.'"[544]]

ٱتَّبِعْ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ [Follow, [O Muḥammad], what has been revealed to you from your Lord - there is no deity except Him - and turn away from those who associate others with Allāh.]

وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةً وَٰحِدَةً ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَـٰهُ تَرْتِيلًا [And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur’ān not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.[1023]]

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ ۖ تَبْتَغِى مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَٰجِكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ [O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what Allāh has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.]

The first verse of Surah At-Tahrim is: ﴿يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ ۖ تَبْتَغِى مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَٰجِكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ﴾ [O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what Allāh has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.]
gemini2-quran-019: With which verse does Surah An-Nahl end?
أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ فِى تَقَلُّبِهِمْ فَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ [Or that He would not seize them during their [usual] activity, and they could not cause failure [i.e., escape from Him]?]
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّٱلَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ [Indeed, Allāh is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.]

وَٱلْخَيْلَ وَٱلْبِغَالَ وَٱلْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةً ۚ وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ [And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. And He creates that which you do not know.]

أَتَىٰٓ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ [The command of Allāh is coming,[690] so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.]
The final verse of Surah An-Nahl is: ﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّٱلَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ﴾ [Indeed, Allāh is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.]
quran-0005: What does the name As-Samad mean?
The master to whom people turn for their needs
This is an established meaning in tafsir (Quran exegesis).
quran-0007: In which surah (chapter) does the basmalah (the formula beginning 'In Allah's name') appear within a verse, in the text of Sulayman's letter to Bilqis, in addition to the basmalah at the surah's opening?

Only in Surah An-Naml does the basmalah occur within the text: ﴿إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ﴾ [Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it is [i.e., reads]: 'In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,] This is in addition to the opening basmalah.
quran-0012: With which verse does Surah Az-Zukhruf end?
ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ [Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous]
فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ [So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.]
فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَـٰمٌ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ [So turn aside from them and say, "Peace."[1456] But they are going to know.]
فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ [So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.]
The final verse of Surah Az-Zukhruf is: ﴿فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَـٰمٌ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ [So turn aside from them and say, "Peace."[1456] But they are going to know.]
quran-0015: With which verse does Surat al-Jathiyah end?
وَلَهُ ٱلْكِبْرِيَآءُ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ [And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.]
فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْحَمْدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ [Then, to Allāh belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.]

وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ [And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.]

وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَخْسَرُ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ [And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.]

The last verse of Surat al-Jathiyah is ﴿وَلَهُ ٱلْكِبْرِيَآءُ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ﴾ [And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.].
quran-0024: In which language was the Noble Qur'an revealed?
Allah Almighty chose clear, expressive Arabic as the language of His final Book.
quran-0027: Which surah is named after a day of the week and is recited to worshippers during that day's prayer?
Surat al-Jumu'ah was so named because it includes rulings on Jumu'ah (Friday prayer) and the call to it.
quran-0028: Which surah is named after a strong metal that Allah says He sent down, containing great might and benefits for people?

Allah Almighty says in it: ﴿وَأَنزَلْنَا ٱلْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَنَـٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ﴾ [We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance that the people may maintain [their affairs] in justice. And We sent down iron, wherein is great military might and benefits for the people, and so that Allāh may make evident those who support Him and His messengers unseen. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.].
quran-0030: Over how many years was the Noble Qur'an revealed in separate portions to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him?
The Qur'an was revealed to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, in installments throughout his mission, which lasted 23 years.
quran-0033: Which insect mentioned in the Noble Qur'an has a surah named after it and spoke to its own kind, warning them about the army of Prophet Sulayman, peace be upon him?
Surat an-Naml was so named because it includes the story of the ant that warned its people about Sulayman's army, peace be upon him.
amma-0003: With which verse does Surat al-Layl end?
وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ [And he is going to be satisfied.]
إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ [Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.]
إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ [Indeed, your efforts are diverse.]
The last verse of Surat al-Layl is ﴿وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ﴾ [And he is going to be satisfied.].
gemini-juz-amma-b2-008: With which verse does Surat al-Layl begin?
وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ [And he is going to be satisfied.]
إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ [Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.]
وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ [By the night when it covers[1937]]
فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ [So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.]
The first verse of Surat al-Layl is ﴿وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ﴾ [By the night when it covers[1937]].
amma-0011: Which surah begins with Allah Almighty swearing by the morning brightness?
Allah swore by the morning brightness and by the night when it grows still.
amma-0012: In which surah of Juz 'Amma (the thirtieth part of the Qur'an) does Allah Almighty say: ﴿كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ﴾ [No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.]?
The surah explains where the record of the wicked is kept and what their fate will be.
amma-0013: Which surah of Juz 'Amma (the thirtieth part of the Qur'an) mentions a blessed night on which the Qur'an was sent down?
Surat al-Qadr speaks about the great Laylat al-Qadr (Night of Decree), when the revelation of the Noble Qur'an began.
amma-0014: Which surah of Juz 'Amma (the thirtieth part of the Qur'an) mentions the winter and summer journeys made by the people of Makkah?
Allah reminded Quraysh of the blessing of security and the ease of their trading journeys in winter and summer.
amma-0015: «يَوْمَ يَكُونُ النَّاسُ كَالْفَرَاشِ الْمَبْثُوثِ» [It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,[1975]] is a verse describing the terrors of the Day of Resurrection. In which surah does it appear?
This description in Surat al-Qari'ah shows how people will scatter in confusion on the Day of Resurrection, like dispersed moths.
amma-0016: At the beginning of which noble surah does Allah swear by two blessed trees and their fruits?
The surah begins with Allah Almighty's oath: ﴿وَالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ﴾ [By the fig and the olive[1947]].
amma-0018: Which surah of Juz 'Amma (the thirtieth part of the Qur'an) ends by mentioning the scriptures of two noble prophets, Ibrahim and Musa, peace be upon them?
The surah ends with Allah Almighty's words: ﴿صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ﴾ [The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.].
amma-0019: At the beginning of which surah does Allah swear by the sun and its brightness?
The surah begins with Allah Almighty's words: ﴿وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا﴾ [By the sun and its brightness].
amma-0020: Which surah mentions the opening of the Prophet's breast and the removal of his burden, and gives him the glad tidings that with hardship comes ease?

The surah begins with Allah Almighty's words: ﴿أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ﴾ [Did We not expand for you, [O Muḥammad], your breast?[1944]]. It reassures and strengthens the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him.
amma-0022: Which surah gives the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, glad tidings of the conquest of Makkah and people entering Allah's religion in crowds?

Surat an-Nasr, ﴿إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ﴾ [When the victory of Allāh has come and the conquest,[2005]], was revealed near the end of the Prophet's life as a sign that his mission was complete.
amma-0023: Which surah describes the terrors of the Day of Resurrection, when the earth shakes and brings forth its burdens?
It is called az-Zalzalah because it opens with Allah Almighty's words: ﴿إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا﴾ [When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake].
amma-0024: Which surah of Juz 'Amma (the thirtieth part of the Qur'an) ends with this address to the tranquil soul: ﴿فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَـٰدِى ۝ وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى﴾ [And enter among My [righteous] servants / And enter My Paradise."]?
These great glad tidings conclude Surat al-Fajr and are addressed to the believing soul at death and on the Day of Resurrection.
amma-0025: In which surah does Allah command us to seek refuge in Him from ﴿شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾ [And from the evil of an envier when he envies."]?
This surah ends by seeking refuge in Allah from the evil of envious people and other evils.
amma-0026: In which surah of Juz 'Amma (the thirtieth part of the Qur'an) does Allah Almighty swear by the piercing star that appears at night?
At-Tariq is the star that appears at night and pierces the darkness with its light. Allah swore by it at the beginning of the surah.
amma-0027: Which surah of Juz 'Amma (the thirtieth part of the Qur'an) mentions believers burned in a trench of fire for remaining steadfast in their religion, known as the People of the Trench?
Surat al-Buruj recounts the story of the People of the Trench and the torment they suffered, setting an example of steadfast faith.
amma-0029: In which noble surah does Allah swear by horses running in battle and striking sparks with their hooves?
Al-'Adiyat are horses running in Allah's cause: ﴿وَٱلْعَـٰدِيَـٰتِ ضَبْحًا ۝ فَٱلْمُورِيَـٰتِ قَدْحًا﴾ [By the racers, panting,[1967] / And the producers of sparks [when] striking[1968]].
amma-0030: Which noble surah describes righteous believers as «خَيْرُ الْبَرِيَّةِ» [Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.]?

Allah Almighty says near the end of Surat al-Bayyinah: ﴿إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ﴾ [Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.].
gemini-juz-amma-001: Which surah first had the following words of Allah Almighty revealed from it: ﴿اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ﴾ [Recite in the name of your Lord who created –]?
The first verses revealed to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, in the Cave of Hira were the opening of Surat al-'Alaq.
gemini-juz-amma-b2-017: In which surah is the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, reproached for being occupied with calling disbelievers to Islam rather than attending to a blind man, Ibn Umm Maktum?
Allah Almighty says: عبس وتولى * أن جاءه الأعمى [He [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ) ] frowned and turned away / Because there came to him the blind man,[1853] [interrupting].].
gemini-juz-amma-b2-019: Revelation ceased for a time, until the polytheists said, «ودَّعَ محمّدًا ربُّه» [Muhammad's Lord has forsaken him]. Allah then revealed a surah to reassure the Prophet and deny this. Which surah?

Surat ad-Duha was revealed after a pause in revelation. It includes ﴿مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ﴾ [Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muḥammad], nor has He detested [you].], refuting the polytheists' claim.
gemini2-juz-amma-006: Which short surah affirms that Allah is One, the Unique, neither begetting nor begotten?
Surat al-Ikhlas affirms tawhid (Allah's oneness) and declares Allah free of imperfections.
gemini2-juz-amma-007: Which surah swears by time and affirms that mankind is in loss except for the believers?
Allah Almighty says: والعصر إن الإنسان لفي خسر [By time,[1985] / Indeed, mankind is in loss,].
amma-0001: With which verse does Surat ash-Shams end?
قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا [He has succeeded who purifies it,]
وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا [And [by] the night when it covers [i.e., conceals] it]
وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا [And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].]
وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَـٰهَا [And He does not fear the consequence thereof.[1935]]
The last verse of Surat ash-Shams is ﴿وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَـٰهَا﴾ [And He does not fear the consequence thereof.[1935]].
amma-0002: With which surah does Juz 'Amma (the thirtieth part of the Qur'an) begin?
It begins with Surat an-Naba', «عمَّ يتساءلون» [About what are they asking one another?].
amma-0004: What is the last surah in the Qur'an?
Surat an-Nas is the last surah in the mushaf (written copy of the Qur'an).
amma-0005: «تبّت يدا أبي لهب» [May the hands of Abū Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.[2008]] is the opening of which surah?
amma-0008: «وَالْعَصْرِ» [By time,[1985]] is the opening of which surah?
amma-0009: With which verse does Surat al-Qadr end?
وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ [And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?]
إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ [Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.]
سَلَـٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ [Peace it is[1956] until the emergence of dawn.]
لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ [The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.]
The last verse of Surat al-Qadr is ﴿سَلَـٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ﴾ [Peace it is[1956] until the emergence of dawn.].
amma-0021: Who was the blind Companion concerning whom Allah Almighty revealed: ﴿عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ ۝ أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ﴾ [He [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ) ] frowned and turned away / Because there came to him the blind man,[1853] [interrupting].]?
Hassan ibn Thabit, may Allah be pleased with him
'Ammar ibn Yasir, may Allah be pleased with him
Bilal ibn Rabah, may Allah be pleased with him
'Abdullah ibn Umm Maktum, may Allah be pleased with him

Allah reproached His Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, when he was occupied with calling the leaders of Quraysh to Islam rather than attending to the blind Companion Ibn Umm Maktum, who had come seeking guidance.
gemini-juz-amma-002: In Surat al-Ma'un, who is the person who ﴿يَدُعُّ الْيَتِيمَ﴾ [For that is the one who drives away the orphan] (pushes the orphan away harshly) and does not urge feeding the poor?
The one who denies the Judgment (the Day of Reckoning)
The one who only accumulates wealth
The one who sleeps through prayer
The one who breaks a covenant

Allah Almighty says: ﴿أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ ۝ فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ﴾ [Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense? / For that is the one who drives away the orphan].
gemini-juz-amma-b2-004: What does the word Sijjin in Surat al-Mutaffifin mean?
The name of one of the angels' swords
The book recording evil and the deeds of the wicked, located in the lowest earth
Allah Almighty says: كلا إن كتاب الفجار لفي سجين [No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.].
gemini-juz-amma-b2-013: What is al-Bayyinah (the clear evidence) mentioned in Surat al-Bayyinah?
The Messenger Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, and the clear Qur'an

Allah Almighty says: حتى تأتيهم البينة * رسول من الله يتلو صحفا مطهرة [Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief][1958] until there came to them clear evidence – / A Messenger from Allāh, reciting purified[1959] scriptures].
gemini-juz-amma-b2-014: A surah in the Qur'an is called as-Samad. What does this name mean in Surat al-Ikhlas?
The one whom nobody knows about
The Master to whom people turn and seek refuge for their needs, while He has no need of His creation
As-Samad is the One to whom all creatures turn with their needs and desires.
gemini-juz-amma-b2-015: In Surat al-Ma'un, who is the one who (يَدُعُّ الْيَتِيمَ) [For that is the one who drives away the orphan]?
The one who strokes the orphan's head
The one who feeds the orphan
The one who denies the Judgment
The one who adopts the orphan
Da'' means pushing violently. This is a characteristic of those who deny the Judgment.
gemini-juz-amma-b3-003: In Surat an-Nasr, when Allah's victory and the conquest come, how do people enter Allah's religion?
Allah Almighty says: ورأيت الناس يدخلون في دين الله أفواجاً [And you see the people entering into the religion of Allāh in multitudes,].
gemini-juz-amma-b3-007: What was the first word revealed in the Noble Qur'an, found in Surat al-'Alaq?
Allah Almighty says: اقرأ باسم ربك الذي خلق [Recite in the name of your Lord who created –].
gemini-juz-amma-b3-010: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, climbed as-Safa and called Quraysh to tawhid (Allah's oneness). His uncle Abu Lahab said to him: «تبًّا لك، ألهذا جمعتَنا؟» [May you perish! Is this why you gathered us?]. A surah was then revealed concerning him. Which surah?

Surat al-Masad was revealed concerning Abu Lahab and his wife following this incident. It begins: ﴿تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ﴾ [May the hands of Abū Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.[2008]].
gemini-juz-amma-b3-011: According to Ibn Kathir's explanation, what is meant by Allah Almighty's words in Surat al-Kawthar: ﴿فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ﴾ [So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice [to Him alone].]?
To pray to his Lord alone and offer sacrifice to Him alone
To pray and then slaughter his enemies in war
To fast and pray at the same time
To raise his hands when saying the takbir (Allah is Greatest)

Ibn Kathir explained that this means devoting prayer and sacrifice exclusively to Allah, unlike the polytheists who sacrificed to idols. The early generations also gave other explanations, which is why the question specifies this commentary.
gemini-juz-amma-b3-013: Which group is described as (خَيْرُ الْبَرِيَّةِ) [Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.] in Surat al-Bayyinah?
The angels brought near to Allah
Those who believe and do righteous deeds
Allah Almighty says: إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات أولئك هم خير البرية [Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.].
gemini-juz-amma-b3-016: What does the word Tariq in Surat at-Tariq mean, according to the verses?
Allah Almighty says: وما أدراك ما الطارق * النجم الثاقب [And what can make you know what is the knocker? / It is the piercing star[1901].].
gemini-juz-amma-b3-017: In Surat al-Mutaffifin, the record of the righteous is in ﴿عِلِّيِّينَ﴾ ['Illiyyun]. Who witnesses it?
Those brought near to Allah (the angels)
Allah Almighty says: كتاب مرقوم * يشهده المقربون [It is [their destination[1882] recorded in] a register inscribed / Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allāh].].
gemini-juz-amma-b3-018: According to as-Sa'di's explanation, what is meant by Allah Almighty's words in Surat at-Takathur: ﴿أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ﴾ [Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you] ﴿حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ﴾ [Until you visit the graveyards.[1980]]?
Boasting of abundant wealth and children distracted them from the Hereafter until they died
They visited graves to reflect and learn a lesson
As-Sa'di explained that this means being distracted by rivalry in accumulation and boasting until death overtakes them and they end up in their graves.
gemini2-juz-amma-003: In Surat Quraysh, which two trading journeys are mentioned?
Allah Almighty says: إيلافهم رحلة الشتاء والصيف [Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer[1997] -].
gemini2-juz-amma-005: What is meant by at-Tariq in Surat at-Tariq?
The angel who knocks on the door
Allah explains it in the following verse: وما أدراك ما الطارق * النجم الثاقب [And what can make you know what is the knocker? / It is the piercing star[1901].].
gemini2-juz-amma-008: By which two blessed trees does Allah swear at the beginning of Surat at-Tin?
Allah Almighty says: والتين والزيتون [By the fig and the olive[1947]].
