gemini2-juz-amma-009: In Surat ash-Shams, who was the prophet whose people rejected him and hamstrung the she-camel?
The people of Thamud rejected Allah's prophet Salih and hamstrung the she-camel mentioned in the surah.
gemini2-juz-amma-010: What is meant by al-mutaffifin in Allah Almighty's words: ﴿وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ﴾ [Woe to those who give less [than due],[1878]]?
Those who cheat people by giving less than the due measure and weight
Tatfif (giving short measure) is cheating in weights and measures by taking more and giving less.
gemini2-juz-amma-012: What is al-Kawthar, which Allah gave to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, in Surat al-Kawthar?
Al-Kawthar is a great river that Allah gave His Prophet in Paradise.
gemini-juz-tabarak-002: Which prophet patiently called his people night and day for a very long time, as described in a surah named after him?
Surat Nuh describes how Prophet Nuh, peace be upon him, called his people for a long time, night and day.
tabarak-0025: In Surat al-Qalam, Allah commands His Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, to be patient and not be like the Man of the Fish. Who is the Man of the Fish?
The Man of the Fish is Prophet Yunus, peace be upon him, whom the fish swallowed and who glorified his Lord in the darkness.
gemini-juz-tabarak-004: How did Allah Almighty destroy the tribe of Thamud, the people of Salih, peace be upon him, as stated in the fifth verse of Surat al-Haqqah?
By making the earth swallow them

Allah Almighty says: ﴿فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِالطَّاغِيَةِ﴾ [So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].]. It was the tremendous, overwhelming blast that destroyed them.
gemini-juz-tabarak-b2-018: How did Allah destroy the people of 'Ad, as mentioned in Surat al-Haqqah?
By making the earth swallow them
Allah Almighty says: وأما عاد فأهلكوا بريح صرصر عاتية [And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming,[1737] violent wind].
gemini-juz-tabarak-b2-007: Which surah was revealed commanding the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, to stand in prayer at night: ﴿قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا﴾ [Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -]?
The surah is called al-Muzzammil because the Prophet is addressed by this description.
gemini-juz-tabarak-b3-003: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, went out to the market of 'Ukaz. A group of jinn (unseen beings) heard his recitation at Batn Nakhlah and believed. Which surah was revealed recounting their story?

Surat al-Jinn was revealed concerning this incident. It begins: ﴿قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا﴾ [Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].].
gemini-juz-tabarak-b3-020: After a pause in revelation, the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, saw Jibril, peace be upon him, on a chair between heaven and earth. He returned saying: «زمِّلوني» [Cover me!]. A call was then revealed commanding him to rise and warn. In which surah?
The opening of Surat al-Muddaththir was revealed after a pause in revelation: ﴿يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ﴾ [O you who covers himself [with a garment],[1788]] ﴿قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ﴾ [Arise and warn].
gemini2-juz-tabarak-001: Which surah begins the twenty-ninth part of the Qur'an, Juz Tabarak?
This part is called Juz Tabarak after the opening of Surat al-Mulk.
gemini2-juz-tabarak-002: Which surah begins by addressing the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him: (يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ) [O you who covers himself [with a garment],[1788]]?
Surat al-Muddaththir begins with this address to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, calling him to rise and convey the message.
gemini2-juz-tabarak-017: In which surah does this verse appear: ﴿وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا﴾ [And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees][1766] has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.]?
This is verse ٤ of Surat al-Jinn.
tabarak-0007: Which surah did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, say intercedes for its reciter and protects against the punishment of the grave?
Surat al-Mulk is called the protector from the punishment of the grave for those who recite it regularly.
tabarak-0008: Which surah in Juz Tabarak (the twenty-ninth part of the Qur'an) is named after one of the messengers of firm resolve?
Surat Nuh recounts Prophet Nuh's call to his people, peace be upon him.
tabarak-0009: Which surah begins with a disjointed letter and an oath by writing: ﴿ن وَالْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ﴾ [Nūn.[1724] By the pen and what they inscribe,]?
Surat al-Qalam is so named because it opens with an oath by the pen.
tabarak-0010: Which surah in Juz Tabarak (the twenty-ninth part of the Qur'an) is named after nonhuman beings who listened to the Qur'an and believed in it?
Surat al-Jinn speaks of a group of jinn (unseen beings) who listened to the Qur'an, believed, submitted to Allah, and called their people to faith.
tabarak-0011: Which surah begins with a question about a punishment bound to befall the disbelievers: ﴿سَأَلَ سَائِلٌ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ﴾ [A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen[1748]]?
The opening of Surat al-Ma'arij threatens the disbelievers with an inevitable punishment that none can avert. It also mentions the angels' ascent to Allah.
tabarak-0013: Which surah in Juz Tabarak (the twenty-ninth part of the Qur'an) is named after the great day when people will be raised for judgment and begins with an oath by it?
The surah begins with Allah Almighty's oath: ﴿لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ﴾ [I swear by the Day of Resurrection].
tabarak-0014: Which surah begins with Allah addressing His Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, while he is wrapped in his clothes: ﴿يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ﴾ [O you who wraps himself [in clothing],[1778]]?
Allah called His Prophet to stand in prayer at night and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation in preparation for bearing the message.
tabarak-0015: In which surah does this verse appear: ﴿يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا﴾ [On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.]?
This is verse ١٤ of Surat al-Muzzammil.
tabarak-0017: In which surah is the verse ﴿وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ﴾ [Woe,[1819] that Day, to the deniers.] repeated ten times to warn of the punishment of the Resurrection?
This verse is repeated in Surat al-Mursalat to emphasize the warning against denying Allah's signs and the Day of Reckoning.
tabarak-0018: In which surah does Allah give the righteous glad tidings that in Paradise they will drink from a cup mixed with ginger?
Allah Almighty describes the bliss of the righteous and their drink flavored with ginger in Paradise.
tabarak-0020: In which surah does Allah give the example of the Owners of the Garden, who withheld its fruits and whose garden was burned?
Surat al-Qalam recounts the story of the garden owners who withheld the poor people's due, so Allah punished them by destroying their garden.
gemini-juz-tabarak-b2-013: In Surat al-Haqqah, how does the believer receive his record on the Day of Resurrection?
It is thrown to him on the ground
Allah Almighty says: فأما من أوتي كتابه بيمينه فيقول هاؤم اقرءوا كتابيه [So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!].
gemini-juz-tabarak-b3-012: How does the disbeliever receive his record on the Day of Resurrection, as stated in Surat al-Haqqah?
Allah Almighty says: وأما من أوتي كتابه بشماله [But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record]...
gemini-juz-tabarak-b3-013: With which verse does Surat al-Jinn end?

لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا [That he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] may know[1776] that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.]

حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا [[The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.]
قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا [Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."]

قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا [Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allāh anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.]

The last verse of Surat al-Jinn is ﴿لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا﴾ [That he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] may know[1776] that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.].
gemini-juz-tabarak-001: In Surat al-Mulk, Allah tells us He created death and life for a great purpose. What is it?
So that we become sad and cry
To test which of you is best in deeds
Only so that we develop and build up the earth
So that we know the number of years and calculation
Allah created death and life as a test for people, to reveal who obeys Him and does good deeds, so that He may reward that person with Paradise.
gemini-juz-tabarak-003: What command concerning recitation of the Qur'an did Allah give His Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, in Surat al-Muzzammil?
وَرَتِّلِ الْقُرْآنَ تَرْتِيلًا [Or add to it, and recite the Qur’ān with measured recitation.]
To memorize it in one day
To read it only during the day
Allah commanded him to recite the Qur'an slowly and reflectively so as to understand its meanings. This is called tartil (measured recitation).
gemini-juz-tabarak-b2-003: In Surat al-Ma'arij, how long is the day on which the angels ascend to Allah on the Day of Resurrection?
Allah Almighty says: في يوم كان مقداره خمسين ألف سنة [The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.].
gemini-juz-tabarak-b2-004: In Surat Nuh, Allah's prophet Nuh called his people night and day. Whom did he describe as persisting and behaving with great arrogance?
His people whom he called to tawhid (Allah's oneness)
The angels brought near to Allah
Those with him in the Ark

Nuh complained about his people: ﴿وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا﴾ [And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments,[1761] persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.]. This refers to his people who turned away from his call.
gemini-juz-tabarak-b2-010: With which verse does Surat al-Muddaththir end?

وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ [And they will not remember except that Allāh wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.]
قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ [He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allāh that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?]

وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ [And no mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.]

إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تُسْـَٔلُ عَنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ [Indeed, We have sent you, [O Muḥammad], with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner, and you will not be asked about the companions of Hellfire.]

The last verse of Surat al-Muddaththir is ﴿وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ﴾ [And they will not remember except that Allāh wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.].
gemini-juz-tabarak-b2-015: In Surat al-Insan, Allah mentions righteous people who give food to three groups despite loving and needing it themselves. Who are these groups?
The orphan, the widow, and the traveler
The needy, the orphan, and the captive
The poor, the sick, and the fighter in Allah's cause
The neighbor, the friend, and the relative
Allah Almighty says: ويطعمون الطعام على حبه مسكينا ويتيما وأسيرا [And they give food in spite of love for it[1813] to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,].
gemini-juz-tabarak-b3-006: With which verse does Surat al-Mursalat begin?
وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ [Woe,[1819] that Day, to the deniers.]
فَٱلْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًا [And the winds that blow violently]
ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ [Then We will follow them with the later ones.]
وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا [By those [winds] sent forth in gusts]
The first verse of Surat al-Mursalat is ﴿وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا﴾ [By those [winds] sent forth in gusts].
gemini-juz-tabarak-b3-007: With which verse does Surat al-Mulk end?
قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ [Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."]
وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ [And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.]

قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ [Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"]
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ [Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.]

The last verse of Surat al-Mulk is ﴿قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ﴾ [Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"].
gemini-juz-tabarak-b3-009: In Surat al-Muddaththir, what did the evildoers answer when asked: ﴿مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِي سَقَرَ﴾ [[And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"]?
They said they were not among those who prayed
They said they were not among those who fasted
They said they disobeyed their parents
قالوا لم نك من المصلين * ولم نك نطعم المسكين [They will say, "We were not of those who prayed, / Nor did we used to feed the poor.].
gemini-juz-tabarak-b3-010: With which verse does Surat al-Haqqah end?
وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ [And had not known what is my account.]
فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ [Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,]
فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ [So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.]
وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ [And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.]
The last verse of Surat al-Haqqah is ﴿فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ﴾ [So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.].
gemini-juz-tabarak-b3-011: In Surat al-Ma'arij, how is the sky on the Day of Resurrection described in ﴿يَوْمَ تَكُونُ السَّمَاءُ...﴾ [On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,[1749]]?
Allah Almighty says: يوم تكون السماء كالمهل [On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,[1749]].
gemini-juz-tabarak-b3-019: Surat al-Ma'arij explains that mankind was created anxious. Who is exempted from this blameworthy trait?
Those who pray and remain constant in their prayers
Allah Almighty says: إلا المصلين * الذين هم على صلاتهم دائمون [Except the observers of prayer - / Those who are constant in their prayer].
gemini-juz-tabarak-b4-003: Who said ﴿إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا﴾ [Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].], as stated in Surat al-Jinn?
A group of jinn (unseen beings) who listened to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him
A group of jinn heard the Qur'an during the Prophet's prayer, believed, and went to warn their people.
gemini-juz-tabarak-b4-006: With which verse does Surat al-Ma'arij end?

يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ [They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children]
خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ [Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.]
يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ [The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.[1759]]
عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ [To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.]

The last verse of Surat al-Ma'arij is ﴿خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ﴾ [Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.].
gemini2-juz-tabarak-004: With which verse does Surat al-Qiyamah begin?
لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ [Move not your tongue with it, [O Muḥammad], to hasten with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān].]
أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ [Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?]
يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ [He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"]
لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ [I swear by the Day of Resurrection]
The first verse of Surat al-Qiyamah is ﴿لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ﴾ [I swear by the Day of Resurrection].
gemini2-juz-tabarak-006: In Surat al-Mulk, what is meant by Allah Almighty's words: ﴿ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ﴾ [[He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -]?
Allah created death and life to test which of His servants is best in deeds
Life was created solely for enjoyment
Death is sheer nonexistence with no wisdom behind it
The test concerns the quantity of deeds rather than their quality
The verse explains that death and life were created as a test, and the criterion is doing deeds well rather than doing many of them.
gemini2-juz-tabarak-008: With which verse does Surat al-Qiyamah end?
أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ [Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?]
أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ [Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?]
أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ [Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?]
يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ [Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"]
The last verse of Surat al-Qiyamah is ﴿أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ﴾ [Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?].
gemini2-juz-tabarak-009: With which verse does Surat al-Insan end?

يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا [He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.]
هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا [Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?]

مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا [[They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.]

۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا [There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.]

The last verse of Surat al-Insan is ﴿يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا﴾ [He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.].
tabarak-0002: With which surah does Juz Tabarak (the twenty-ninth part of the Qur'an) begin?
It begins with Surat al-Mulk, «تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ» [Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -].
tabarak-0003: In which part of the Qur'an is Surat al-Haqqah?
Surat al-Haqqah is in Juz Tabarak (٢٩).
tabarak-0006: Which surah in Juz Tabarak (the twenty-ninth part of the Qur'an) bears a prophet's name?
Surat Nuh is in Juz Tabarak.
tabarak-0012: With what punishment did Allah destroy the people of 'Ad, as stated in Surat al-Haqqah?
The surah explains that the people of 'Ad were destroyed by an extremely cold, powerful wind that lasted seven nights and eight days.
tabarak-0016: In Surat al-Mulk, what did Allah Almighty place in the lowest heaven to adorn it?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَـٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَـٰطِينِ﴾ [And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars] and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils[1714] and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.].
tabarak-0019: In Surat al-Mulk, what did Allah Almighty create in layers, one above another, in which we see no inconsistency or flaw?

Allah Almighty says in it: ﴿ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا﴾ [[And] who created seven heavens in layers.[1712] You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?].
tabarak-0021: In Surat al-Ma'arij, Allah says the Day of Resurrection is long and difficult. How long is it compared with earthly years?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ﴾ [The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.].
tabarak-0022: What did Prophet Nuh, peace be upon him, tell his people Allah would send upon them from the sky if they sought His forgiveness and repented to Him?
Allah Almighty relates Nuh's words: ﴿يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا﴾ [He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers], meaning continuous rain that brings good.
tabarak-0023: How did the jinn (unseen beings) describe the Noble Qur'an when they first heard it, as stated in Surat al-Jinn?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا ۝ يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ﴾ [Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation]. / It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.], expressing their admiration for its eloquence and guidance.
tabarak-0027: In Surat al-Haqqah, how many angels carry the Throne of ar-Rahman (the Most Merciful) on the Day of Resurrection?

Allah Almighty says when describing the terrors of the Day of Resurrection: ﴿وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ﴾ [And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].].
azkar-0017: Which dhikr (remembrance of Allah), when said by a Muslim one hundred times a day, causes their sins to be erased even if they are like the foam of the sea?
La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah (There is no might or power except through Allah)
Astaghfirullaha al-'azima wa atubu ilayh (I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Almighty and repent to Him)
Subhanallahi wa bihamdih (Glory and praise be to Allah)
Al-hamdu lillahi rabbi al-'alamin (Praise be to Allah, Lord of all worlds)
The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, explained the merit of this simple dhikr in erasing and expiating minor sins.
azkar-0016: What did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and his Companions say when climbing to higher ground during travel?
La ilaha illallah (There is no god but Allah)
The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and his Companions would say Allahu akbar when ascending to higher ground, and Subhanallah when descending into valleys.
azkar-0024: What does a Muslim say after finishing a meal to praise Allah for the blessing of being satisfied?
Thanking Allah for the blessing of food and drink by saying «الحمد لله» [Al-hamdu lillah: Praise be to Allah] brings Allah's pleasure with His servant.
gemini-adhkar-b3-001: Which dhikr (remembrance of Allah) did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, describe as heavy on the scale and dear to ar-Rahman (the Most Merciful)?
Subhanallahi wa bihamdih, subhanallahi al-'azim (Glory and praise be to Allah; glory be to Allah the Almighty)
La ilaha illallah (There is no god but Allah)
Allahu akbaru kabira (Allah is supremely Great)
Al-hamdu lillahi rabbi al-'alamin (Praise be to Allah, Lord of all worlds)

The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: «كلمتانِ خفيفتانِ على اللسان، ثقيلتانِ في الميزان، حبيبتانِ إلى الرحمن: سبحانَ اللهِ وبحمدِه، سبحانَ اللهِ العظيم» [Two phrases are light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, and dear to the Most Merciful: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih (Glory and praise be to Allah), Subhanallahi al-'azim (Glory be to Allah the Almighty)].
gemini-adhkar-b3-020: Which dhikr (remembrance of Allah), if said one hundred times a day, earns a reward equivalent to freeing ten slaves?
Subhanallahi wa bihamdih, subhanallahi al-'azim (Glory and praise be to Allah; glory be to Allah the Almighty)

La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir (There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things)
Astaghfirullaha al-'azima alladhi la ilaha illa huwa wa atubu ilayh (I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Almighty, besides whom there is no god, and repent to Him)
Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammadin kama sallayta 'ala Ibrahim (O Allah, bestow Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You bestowed them upon Ibrahim)

The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: «مَن قال ذلك في يومٍ مئةَ مرّة، كانت له عَدْلَ عشرِ رقاب، وكُتبتْ له مئةُ حسنة، ومُحيتْ عنه مئةُ سيّئة» [Whoever says a hundred times in a day: "La ilāha illallāhu wahdahu la sharīka lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-hamdu wa huwa ‘ala kulli shay’in qadīr" (There is no god but Allah. He is One, and He has no partner with Him; to Him belong the sovereignty and praise, and He is competent over all things); he will have a reward equivalent to that of emancipating ten slaves; a hundred good deeds will be added to his record; a hundred of his sins will be erased; and he will be shielded against the devil on that day till the evening; and no one will exceed him in doing good deeds except someone who says more than that.].
gemini2-adhkar-006: Which dhikr (remembrance of Allah) is said in sujud (prostration), during which one hopes for supplications to be answered?
Subhana rabbiya al-a'la (Glory be to my Lord, the Most High)
Subhana rabbiya al-'azim (Glory be to my Lord, the Almighty)

The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: «أقربُ ما يكونُ العبدُ من ربِّه وهو ساجد، فأكثِروا الدعاء» [The nearest a slave to his Lord is while he is prostrating, so increase supplication.]. The prescribed dhikr in prostration is «سبحانَ ربّيَ الأعلى» [Subhana rabbiya al-a'la: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High].
azkar-0020: Which du'a (supplication) is recommended before entering the toilet to seek protection from the harm of devils?
Al-hamdu lillahi alladhi adh-haba 'anni al-adha (Praise be to Allah who removed harm from me)
Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'alallah (In Allah's name; I place my trust in Allah)
A'udhu bikalimatillahi at-tammati min sharri ma khalaq (I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil of what He created)
Allahumma inni a'udhu bika mina al-khubthi wa al-khaba'ith (O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female devils)
This dhikr (remembrance of Allah) protects the Muslim from the harm of devils upon entering the place for relieving oneself.
gemini-adhkar-b2-003: Which dhikr (remembrance of Allah) did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, say would protect a person who says it upon stopping somewhere from harm until they leave?
Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'alallah (In Allah's name; I place my trust in Allah)
A'udhu bikalimatillahi at-tammati min sharri ma khalaq (I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil of what He created)
Allahumma barik lana fima razaqtana (O Allah, bless for us what You have provided us)
Hasbiyallahu wa ni'ma al-wakil (Allah is sufficient for me, and He is the best Disposer of affairs)

The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: «مَن نزلَ منزلًا ثمّ قال: أعوذُ بكلماتِ اللهِ التامّاتِ من شرِّ ما خلق، لم يضرَّه شيءٌ حتّى يرتحلَ من منزلِه ذلك» [Whoever alights somewhere and then says: '‘A‘ūdhu bi kalimātillāh at-tāmmāti min sharri ma khalaq (I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created)', nothing will harm him until he leaves that place.].
gemini-adhkar-b3-014: Which du'a (supplication), if said three times in the morning and evening, protects a Muslim from harm?
Hasbunallahu wa ni'ma al-wakil (Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs)

Bismillahi alladhi la yadurru ma'a ismihi shay'un fi al-ardi wa la fi as-sama'i wa huwa as-sami'u al-'alim (In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing)
A'udhu bikalimatillahi at-tammati min sharri ma khalaq (I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil of what He created)
Allahumma inni as'aluka al-'afwa wa al-'afiyah (O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being)
This is among the greatest daily adhkar (remembrances of Allah) for protection.
azkar-0027: Which du'a (supplication) is recommended for a Muslim to say as soon as rain falls?
Allahumma isqina (O Allah, give us rain)
Allahumma sayyiban nafi'a (O Allah, make it beneficial rain)
Subhana alladhi yusabbihu ar-ra'du bihamdih (Glory be to Him whom thunder glorifies with praise)
When the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, saw rain, he would say this supplication, asking Allah to make it good, blessed rain that benefits the earth.
gemini-adhkar-004: What did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, say in supplication when strong winds blew?
Allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha wa a'udhu bika min sharriha (O Allah, I ask You for its good and seek refuge in You from its evil)
Allahumma sayyiban nafi'a (O Allah, make it beneficial rain)
Subhana alladhi yusabbihu ar-ra'du bihamdih (Glory be to Him whom thunder glorifies with praise)
Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'alallah (In Allah's name; I place my trust in Allah)
The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, would ask Allah for the good of the wind and what it was sent with, and seek refuge from its evil and the evil of what it was sent with.
azkar-0001: What is recommended for a Muslim to say before beginning to eat?
«يا غلامُ، سَمِّ اللهَ، وكُلْ بيمينِك» [O boy, mention Allah's name, eat with your right hand].
azkar-0002: What does a Muslim say upon sneezing?
Yarhamukallah (May Allah have mercy on you)
«إذا عَطَسَ أحدُكم فليقل: الحمدُ لله» [When one of you sneezes, he should say 'alhamdu-lillāh' (praise be to Allah)].
azkar-0003: Complete the du'a (supplication) for leaving home: «بسمِ الله، توكّلتُ على الله، ولا حولَ ولا قوّةَ إلّا» [Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa: In Allah's name; I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might or power except]...
This is the dhikr (remembrance of Allah) for leaving home.
azkar-0005: Which verse is recommended to recite before sleeping to protect you by Allah's permission?
Whoever recites it when going to sleep will remain under Allah's protection, and no devil will approach them.
azkar-0006: Which du'a (supplication) is called Sayyid al-Istighfar (the foremost supplication for forgiveness), and how does it begin?
Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdik (Glory and praise be to You, O Allah)
Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa ant (O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You)...
Astaghfirullaha al-'azim (I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Almighty)
The hadith of Shaddad ibn Aws about Sayyid al-Istighfar.
azkar-0007: What is said after completing wudu (ablution)?
Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh (I testify that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger)
Ghufranak, al-hamdu lillahi alladhi adh-haba 'anni al-adha wa 'afani (I ask Your forgiveness; praise be to Allah who removed harm from me and granted me well-being)
Al-hamdu lillahi alladhi at'amana wa saqana wa ja'alana muslimin (Praise be to Allah who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims)
This is the reported dhikr (remembrance of Allah) after completing wudu.
azkar-0008: What expression did Allah command us to begin with before reciting the Noble Qur'an?
Al-hamdu lillahi rabbi al-'alamina hamdan kathiran tayyiba (Abundant, good praise be to Allah, Lord of all worlds)
A'udhu billahi mina ash-shaytani ar-rajim (I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed)
Allahu akbaru kabiran wa al-hamdu lillahi kathira (Allah is supremely Great, and abundant praise be to Allah)

Allah Almighty says: ﴿فَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ﴾ [So when you recite the Qur’ān, [first] seek refuge in Allāh from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].].
azkar-0012: What is recommended for a Muslim to say when feeling intense anger?
A'udhu billahi mina ash-shaytani ar-rajim (I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed)
La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah (There is no might or power except through Allah)

«إنّي لأعلَمُ كلمةً لو قالها لذهبَ عنه ما يَجِد: أعوذُ باللهِ من الشيطانِ الرجيم» [Verily, I know a word; if he said it, his rage would go away. If he said: I seek refuge with Allah from the devil, his rage would go away.].
azkar-0013: Which dhikr (remembrance of Allah) did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, describe as «كَنْزٌ من كنوزِ الجنّة» [a treasure among the treasures of Paradise]?
Subhanallahi al-'azim (Glory be to Allah the Almighty)
La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah (There is no might or power except through Allah)
Al-hamdu lillahi rabbi al-'alamin (Praise be to Allah, Lord of all worlds)

«يا عبدَ اللهِ بنَ قيس، قلْ: لا حولَ ولا قوّةَ إلّا بالله، فإنّها كنزٌ من كنوزِ الجنّة» [O 'Abdullah ibn Qays, say: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah (There is no might or power except through Allah), for it is a treasure among the treasures of Paradise].
azkar-0018: Which dhikr (remembrance of Allah) did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, say when lying down in bed to sleep?
Al-hamdu lillahi alladhi ahyana (Praise be to Allah who gave us life)
Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'alallah (In Allah's name; I place my trust in Allah)
Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya (In Your name, O Allah, I die and live)
This is one of the established prophetic adhkar recommended before sleeping.
azkar-0019: What is recommended for a Muslim to say when putting on a new garment?
Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi 'adada khalqihi wa rida nafsih (Glory and praise be to Allah, as numerous as His creation and as much as pleases Him)
Ghufranak, al-hamdu lillahi alladhi adh-haba 'anni al-adha (I ask Your forgiveness; praise be to Allah who removed harm from me)
Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'alallah wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah (In Allah's name; I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might or power except through Allah)
Al-hamdu lillahi alladhi kasani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah (Praise be to Allah who clothed me with this and provided it to me without any might or power of my own)
This dhikr (remembrance of Allah) acknowledges Allah's favor and thanks Him for the blessing of clothing and provision.
azkar-0021: What is recommended for a Muslim who forgot to mention Allah's name before eating and remembers during the meal?
Bismillahi wa al-hamdu lillah (In Allah's name, and praise be to Allah)
Al-hamdu lillahi alladhi at'amana (Praise be to Allah who fed us)
Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirah (In Allah's name at its beginning and its end)
This is the reported dhikr (remembrance of Allah) for someone who forgot to mention Allah's name at the beginning of a meal, so that Satan does not share their food.
azkar-0022: Which dhikr (remembrance of Allah) is said when boarding a car, plane, or riding animal for travel?
Allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha (O Allah, I ask You for its good)
A'udhu bikalimatillahi at-tammat (I seek refuge in Allah's perfect words)
La ilaha illallahu al-'azimu al-halim (There is no god but Allah, the Almighty, the Forbearing)

سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ [That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.[1433]] (Subhana alladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin)
This reported Qur'anic supplication is recommended when a Muslim settles onto their means of transport to begin a journey.
azkar-0025: Which dhikr (remembrance of Allah) is called Kaffarat al-Majlis (expiation for a gathering) and is said before leaving to erase any idle talk during it?
Astaghfirullaha al-'azima wa atubu ilayh (I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Almighty and repent to Him)
La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah (There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner)

Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdik, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa ant, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk (Glory and praise be to You, O Allah. I testify that there is no god but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You)
Al-hamdu lillahi rabbi al-'alamin (Praise be to Allah, Lord of all worlds)
The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, taught us this dhikr to expiate errors and idle talk that may occur in gatherings.
azkar-0026: Which three surahs did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, recite every night before sleeping, after cupping his hands and blowing lightly into them, then wiping his body with them?
Al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq, and an-Nas (al-Mu'awwidhat, the surahs of refuge)
This is an established Sunnah (prophetic practice) for protecting oneself when going to sleep.
azkar-0028: Which special du'a (supplication) did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, teach his Companions to say when uncertain about a decision or choosing between two matters?
Du'a al-Istikharah (supplication for guidance in choosing)
Istikharah means asking Allah to choose what is best. It is an emphasized Sunnah (prophetic practice) when resolving to do something, seeking Allah's guidance to success.
gemini-adhkar-002: What is recommended for a Muslim to do and say on hearing the mu'adhdhin (caller to prayer) make the adhan (call to prayer)?
The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: «إذا سمعتم النداء، فقولوا مثل ما يقول المؤذن» [When you hear the Adhan (call to prayer), repeat what the Muezzin says.].
gemini-adhkar-003: What is recommended for a Muslim to say upon hearing of a calamity or someone's death, known as istirja' (affirming our return to Allah)?
Hasbunallahu wa ni'ma al-wakil (Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs)
La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah (There is no might or power except through Allah)
إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ [Who, when disaster strikes them, say, "Indeed we belong to Allāh, and indeed to Him we will return."] (Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un)
Astaghfirullaha al-'azim (I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Almighty)
The Noble Qur'an directs believers to say this phrase during calamities, acknowledging that everything belongs to Allah and that the return is to Him.
gemini-adhkar-b2-004: Which du'a (supplication) did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, frequently say between ar-Rukn al-Yamani (the Yemeni Corner of the Ka'bah) and al-Hajar al-Aswad (the Black Stone)?
Subhanallahi wa al-hamdu lillahi wa la ilaha illallah (Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, and there is no god but Allah)

ربَّنا آتِنا في الدنيا حسنةً وفي الآخرةِ حسنةً وقِنا عذابَ النار [But among them is he who says, "Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire."] (Rabbana atina fi ad-dunya hasanatan wa fi al-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaba an-nar)
Allahumma inni as'aluka al-jannata wa a'udhu bika mina an-nar (O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire)

لا إلهَ إلّا أنتَ سبحانَكَ إنّي كنتُ من الظالمين [And [mention] the man of the fish [i.e., Jonah], when he went off in anger[899] and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him.[900] And he called out within the darknesses,[901] "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."] (La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu mina az-zalimin)
It is established that 'Abdullah ibn as-Sa'ib heard the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, recite this verse between the two corners.
gemini-adhkar-b2-013: Which dhikr (remembrance of Allah) is said after the mu'adhdhin (caller to prayer) finishes the adhan (call to prayer), to obtain the Prophet's intercession?
Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammad (O Allah, bestow Your blessings upon Muhammad)

Allahumma rabba hadhihi ad-da'wati at-tammati wa as-salati al-qa'imah, ati Muhammadan al-wasilata wa al-fadilah (O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the prayer to be established, grant Muhammad al-Wasilah, the special rank, and al-Fadilah, excellence)
Al-hamdu lillahi alladhi hadani (Praise be to Allah who guided me)
Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah (I testify that there is no god but Allah)

The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: «مَن قال حينَ يسمعُ النداء… حلَّتْ له شفاعتي يومَ القيامة» [Whoever says upon hearing the call... he will be granted my intercession on the Day of Judgment.].
gemini-adhkar-b2-014: How many times a day is it recommended for a Muslim to seek forgiveness, following the Prophet's example?

The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: «واللهِ إنّي لأستغفرُ اللهَ وأتوبُ إليه في اليومِ أكثرَ من سبعينَ مرّة» [By Allah! I ask Allah for forgiveness and repent to Him more than seventy times a day.].
gemini-adhkar-b2-016: Which words did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, describe as the plantings of Paradise, meaning that they plant trees there for you?
Astaghfirullaha al-'azima wa atubu ilayh (I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Almighty and repent to Him)
Subhanallah, wa al-hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wa Allahu akbar (Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is Greatest)
La hawla wa la quwwata illa billahi al-'aliyyi al-'azim (There is no might or power except through Allah, the Most High, the Almighty)
Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala nabiyyina Muhammad (O Allah, bestow blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad)
This was Ibrahim's counsel, peace be upon him, to Muhammad's community during al-Isra' (the Night Journey).
gemini-adhkar-b2-017: If you hear a dog barking or a donkey braying at night, what is recommended for you to do?
Seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed
Say Allahu akbar (Allah is Greatest) aloud
Because they see what you do not see: devils.
gemini-adhkar-b2-020: Which du'a (supplication) did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, advise 'A'ishah to say if she encountered Laylat al-Qadr (the Night of Decree)?
Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbu al-'afwa fa'fu 'anni (O Allah, You are Pardoning and love to pardon, so pardon me)
Allahumma inni as'aluka al-jannata wa a'udhu bika mina an-nar (O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire)
Allahumma a'tiq raqabati mina an-nar (O Allah, free me from the Fire)

ربنا آتنا في الدنيا حسنة [But among them is he who says, "Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire."] (Rabbana atina fi ad-dunya hasanah)
Pardoning means overlooking and erasing sins. It is the greatest thing to seek on this night.
gemini-adhkar-b3-004: The reported supplication for waking and turning over at night includes tahlil (affirming that there is no god but Allah) and takbir (declaring Allah's greatness). What is its merit?
One's supplication is answered, and if one prays, the prayer is accepted

The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: من تعار من الليل فقال... ثم دعا استجيب له، وإن توضأ وصلى قبلت صلاته [Whoever wakes at night and says... then supplicates, his supplication is answered; and if he performs wudu (ablution) and prays, his prayer is accepted].
gemini-adhkar-b3-005: (سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ) [Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi 'adada khalqihi wa rida nafsihi wa zinata 'arshihi wa midada kalimatih: Glory and praise be to Allah, as numerous as His creation, as much as pleases Him, as weighty as His Throne, and as abundant as the ink of His words]. When is this dhikr (remembrance of Allah) said, and how was it described?
After the 'Isha' prayer to expiate the day's sins
In the morning; it was described as outweighing many words of remembrance and multiplying reward
When setting off on a journey
The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, taught it to Juwayriyah, may Allah be pleased with her, explaining that it equaled her long time spent remembering Allah.
gemini-adhkar-b3-007: Complete the du'a al-Istikharah (supplication for guidance in choosing): «اللهمّ إنّي أستخيرُكَ بعِلمِك، وأستقدِرُكَ بـ» [Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmika wa astaqdiruka bi: O Allah, I seek Your choice through Your knowledge, and seek ability through Your]...

It continues: «وأسألُكَ من فضلِكَ العظيم، فإنّكَ تقدِرُ ولا أقدِر، وتعلمُ ولا أعلم، وأنتَ علّامُ الغيوب» [Wa as'aluka min fadlika al-'azim, fa innaka taqdiru wa la aqdir, wa ta'lamu wa la a'lam, wa anta 'allamu al-ghuyub: and I ask You of Your great bounty. Indeed, You are capable and I am not, and You know and I do not, and You are the All-Knower of the unseen.].
gemini-adhkar-b3-010: When is this additional dhikr (remembrance of Allah) said: (سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسٌ، رَبُّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ) [Subbuhun quddusun rabbu al-mala'ikati wa ar-ruh: Most Glorious, Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the Spirit]?
Generally in sujud (prostration) and ruku' (bowing); it is a recommended supplication
Only during sujud at-tilawah (prostration upon reciting certain verses)
The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said it in his bowing and prostration. It is one of the great established supplications.
gemini-adhkar-b3-011: What did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, say when he saw the first fruit of the season?
Al-hamdu lillahi alladhi at'amana (Praise be to Allah who fed us)
Allahumma barik lana fi thamarina wa barik lana fi madinatina (O Allah, bless our fruit for us and bless our city for us)
Bismillahi wa al-hamdu lillah (In Allah's name, and praise be to Allah)
Allahumma ij'alhu rizqan hani'a (O Allah, make it wholesome provision)

When the first fruit was brought to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, he prayed for blessings in the fruit, Madinah, the sa' and the mudd (measures of volume). Then he gave it to the youngest child present.
gemini-adhkar-b3-013: Which du'a (supplication) did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, teach someone experiencing pain in the body?
Place a hand on the painful spot and recite al-Fatihah seven times

Place a hand there and say Bismillah (In Allah's name) three times, then A'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir (I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and fear) seven times
Say Allahumma ishfini wa'fu 'anni (O Allah, heal me and pardon me) once
This is an established prophetic ruqyah (recitation for healing) to relieve and soothe physical pain.
gemini2-adhkar-001: How many times after each obligatory prayer does the Sunnah (prophetic practice) prescribe saying Subhanallah (Glory be to Allah), Al-hamdu lillah (Praise be to Allah), and Allahu akbar (Allah is Greatest)?

Say Subhanallah thirty-three times, Al-hamdu lillah thirty-three times, and Allahu akbar thirty-three times, completing one hundred with «لا إلهَ إلّا اللهُ وحدَه لا شريكَ له...» [La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner]...
gemini2-adhkar-002: What does a person who sneezes say to someone who responds with «يرحمُك الله» [Yarhamukallah: May Allah have mercy on you]?
Wa anta fajazakallahu khayra (And may Allah reward you with good)
Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum (May Allah guide you and set your affairs right)
Barakallahu fika wa 'alayk (May Allah bless you and bestow blessings upon you)
Shakarallahu laka sani'ak (May Allah reward your kind deed)

The hadith states that if one of you sneezes and praises Allah, respond with a prayer for mercy, and the sneezer should say to you: «يهديكمُ اللهُ ويُصلِحُ بالَكم» [yahdīkum Allah wa yuslih bālakum!' (may Allah guide you and grant you well being)].
gemini2-adhkar-003: Which Companion did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, teach to say at bedtime: «اللهمّ أسلمتُ نفسي إليك» [Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk: O Allah, I surrender myself to You]?

The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, told al-Bara', may Allah be pleased with him: «إذا أتيتَ مضجعَكَ فتوضّأْ وضوءَكَ للصلاة، ثمّ اضطجعْ على شقِّكَ الأيمنِ وقل…» [When you go to bed, perform wudu (ablution) as you do for prayer, then lie on your right side and say...]. He concluded by saying that if he died, he would die upon the fitrah (natural faith).
gemini2-adhkar-004: What is the recommended way to congratulate newlyweds after their marriage contract?
Bil-rifa'i wa al-banin (With harmony and sons), as people said in the pre-Islamic period
Barakallahu laka wa baraka 'alayka wa jama'a baynakuma fi khayr (May Allah bless you, bestow blessings upon you, and unite you both in goodness)
Our warmest congratulations and a thousand blessings to you both
May Allah make your days happy and complete your joy
This is the reported prophetic congratulation. The pre-Islamic expression «بالرفاءِ والبنين» [Bil-rifa'i wa al-banin: With harmony and sons] was considered disliked.
gemini2-adhkar-005: How many times did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, say «سبحانَ اللهِ» [Subhanallah: Glory be to Allah], «الحمدُ للهِ» [Al-hamdu lillah: Praise be to Allah], and «اللهُ أكبرُ» [Allahu akbar: Allah is Greatest] at bedtime, as he taught Fatimah and 'Ali?

He taught them to say Subhanallah thirty-three times, Al-hamdu lillah thirty-three times, and Allahu akbar thirty-four times at bedtime, and said: «هو خيرٌ لكما من خادم» [This is better for you than a servant.].
gemini2-adhkar-009: What is recommended for a Muslim to say when bidding farewell to a traveler?
Astawdi'ullaha dinaka wa amanataka wa khawatima 'amalik (I entrust to Allah your religion, what you hold in trust, and the final deeds of your life)
Allahumma ij'al safarahu qariba (O Allah, make his journey short)

Ibn 'Umar, may Allah be pleased with him and his father, would say this to someone intending to travel and mention that the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, used to bid them farewell with it.
gemini2-adhkar-010: Which du'a (supplication) did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, teach al-Hasan ibn 'Ali, may Allah be pleased with them both, to say in qunut al-Witr (supplication in the odd-numbered night prayer)?
Allahumma ihdini fiman hadayt (O Allah, guide me among those You have guided)
Allahumma anta as-salamu wa minka as-salam (O Allah, You are as-Salam, the Source of Peace, and from You is peace)
Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrik (O Allah, help me to remember You and thank You)
Allahumma ba'id bayni wa bayna khatayaya (O Allah, distance me from my sins)

It continues: «وعافني فيمن عافيت، وتولّني فيمن تولّيت، وباركْ لي فيما أعطيت، وقِني شرَّ ما قضيت» [Wa 'afini fiman 'afayt, wa tawallani fiman tawallayt, wa barik li fima a'tayt, wa qini sharra ma qadayt: Grant me well-being among those You have granted well-being, care for me among those You have cared for, bless for me what You have given, and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed].
gemini2-adhkar-012: What is recommended for a Muslim to say when leaving the mosque?
Allahumma iftah li abwaba rahmatik (O Allah, open the doors of Your mercy for me)
Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik (O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty)
Allahumma taqabbal minni salati (O Allah, accept my prayer from me)
Allahumma ighfir li warhamni (O Allah, forgive me and have mercy on me)
On entering, one asks Allah for mercy because it is the aim of worship. On leaving, one asks for bounty because it is the aim of seeking one's livelihood on earth.
gemini2-adhkar-017: What is recommended for someone who sees a disliked dream?
Tell their family so they can interpret it
Spit lightly to the left three times, seek refuge in Allah, and tell nobody about it
Give charity and keep silent about it

The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: «فإذا رأى أحدُكم ما يكره، فليتفلْ عن يسارِه ثلاثًا، وليستعذْ باللهِ من شرِّها، ولا يُحدِّثْ بها أحدًا، فإنّها لن تضرَّه» [If one of you sees something he dislikes, let him spit lightly to his left three times, seek refuge in Allah from its evil, and tell nobody about it, for it will not harm him].
gemini2-adhkar-019: Complete the du'a (supplication) of someone distressed and worried: (لا إله إلا الله العظيم الحليم، لا إله إلا الله رب ... العظيم) [La ilaha illallahu al-'azimu al-halim, la ilaha illallahu rabbu ... al-'azim: There is no god but Allah, the Almighty, the Forbearing; there is no god but Allah, Lord of the great ...].
Part of the supplication for distress is: ...Rabbi al-'arshi al-'azim (Lord of the Great Throne).
gemini-prophets-002: Which prophet did Allah grant the ability to interpret dreams accurately, and who planned to save Egypt from a seven-year famine?
Yusuf, peace be upon him, interpreted the Egyptian king's dream and devised a plan to store wheat to save the country from the expected famine.
gemini-prophets-004: Which prophet prayed to his Lord in old age for good offspring, and was given glad tidings by the angels of a son named Yahya?
Zakariyya asked his Lord to grant him an heir. Allah answered him and gave him Yahya despite his old age and his wife's infertility.
gemini-prophets-b2-010: Who was the man Allah gave treasures, who then oppressed Musa's people and was swallowed by the earth along with his home?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ [And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves.].
gemini-prophets-b2-017: Beneath which prophet's feet did the Zamzam spring emerge when he was an infant and his mother was searching for water?
Allah honored Hajar and her son Isma'il with the blessed water of Zamzam.
gemini-prophets-b2-019: Which prophet was announced to Zakariyya, peace be upon him, in his old age and was given judgment by Allah while still a child?
Allah Almighty says: يا يحيى خذ الكتاب بقوة وآتيناه الحكم صبيا [[Allāh said], "O John, take the Scripture [i.e., adhere to it] with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy].
gemini-prophets-b2-020: Which prophet used to fast on alternate days, a practice the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, described as the fasting most beloved to Allah?
Dawud's fasting, peace be upon him, is the most balanced fasting and the most beloved to Allah Almighty.
gemini-prophets-b3-008: Which prophet was called Isra'il and is the ancestor after whom the Children of Israel are named?
Ya'qub is Isra'il, and his twelve sons are the ancestors of the tribes of the Children of Israel.
gemini-prophets-b3-015: Which prophet asked Allah to show him how He gives life to the dead, to reassure his heart, and was commanded to slaughter four birds?

Allah Almighty says: وإذ قال إبراهيم رب أرني كيف تحيي الموتى [And [mention] when Abraham said, "My Lord, show me how You give life to the dead." [Allāh] said, "Have you not believed?" He said, "Yes, but [I ask] only that my heart may be satisfied." [Allāh] said, "Take four birds and commit them to yourself.[107] Then [after slaughtering them] put on each hill a portion of them; then call them - they will come [flying] to you in haste. And know that Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise."]...
gemini-prophets-b3-017: Which king led the Children of Israel and told them Allah would test them with a river on their way to battle?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِالْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍ﴾ [And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient."].
gemini2-prophets-003: Who led the Children of Israel astray with a calf during Musa's absence, peace be upon him?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِن بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ السَّامِرِيُّ﴾ [[Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī[847] has led them astray."].
gemini2-prophets-005: Which righteous man has a surah named after him in the Qur'an and advised his son not to associate partners with Allah?
The believing man from Fir'awn's family

Allah Almighty says: ﴿وَإِذْ قَالَ لُقْمَانُ لِابْنِهِ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُ يَا بُنَيَّ لَا تُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ الشِّرْكَ لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ﴾ [And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Luqmān said to his son while he was instructing him, "O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allāh. Indeed, association [with Him] is great injustice."]. Most commentators hold that he was a righteous wise man rather than a prophet.
gemini2-prophets-010: Which prophet's name appears in the Noble Qur'an more often than any other prophet's?
Musa's name, peace be upon him, is the most frequently mentioned prophet's name in the Qur'an, followed by Ibrahim's name, peace be upon him.
prophets-0040: Which prophet did the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, say worked as a carpenter?
It is established in the Sunnah (prophetic tradition) that Allah's prophet Zakariyya, peace be upon him, was a carpenter.
prophets-0041: Which prophet had brothers who plotted against him and threw him into a well when he was young?
Yusuf's brothers threw him into the well out of envy for his standing with their father. Thus his journey to Egypt began.
prophets-0043: Which prophet did Allah Almighty miraculously create without a father, and who spoke to people while a baby in the cradle?
Allah created 'Isa, peace be upon him, by a word from Him, from his mother Maryam the Virgin, without a father.
prophets-0044: Which young prophet distinguished himself in battle by killing the tyrannical king Jalut?
The Noble Qur'an states that Dawud, peace be upon him, killed Jalut in battle, and Allah granted him kingship and wisdom.
prophets-0045: Which prophet became Maryam's guardian, peace be upon her, and cared for her in the sanctuary?

Allah Almighty says that He made Zakariyya, peace be upon him, Maryam's guardian and caretaker: ﴿وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا﴾ [So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account."].
prophets-0047: Which prophet was sent to the people of Madyan and called them to tawhid (Allah's oneness) and to give full measure and weight?
Shu'ayb, peace be upon him, was a prophet who called his people to stop cheating in trade and to devote worship sincerely to Allah.
prophets-0050: Which prophet prayed to his Lord saying: ﴿رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَّا يَنبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِّن بَعْدِي﴾ [He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."]?
Allah answered Sulayman's prayer, subjected the wind and jinn (unseen beings) to him, taught him the language of birds, and granted him a great kingdom.
prophets-0051: Which prophet asked to see Allah Almighty and fell unconscious when Allah manifested Himself to the mountain and reduced it to dust?
Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him
When Allah spoke to Musa, he longed to see Him. Allah showed him that the mountain could not withstand His manifestation, so how could a human?
prophets-0053: Which righteous servant did Prophet Musa, peace be upon him, accompany to learn from, and who damaged a ship and built a wall?
Allah commanded Musa to travel to meet al-Khidr and learn from him unseen matters that Allah had disclosed to him. The events of Surat al-Kahf took place between them.
prophets-0055: Which prophet struck the sea with his staff so that it split into two by Allah's command, allowing him to escape Fir'awn's army?
Allah commanded Musa to strike the sea. It split, each part becoming like a great mountain, so that the Children of Israel could pass through safely.
prophets-0056: Which prophet did Allah grant the miracles of healing the blind and the leper, and bringing the dead to life by His permission?
Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him
Among 'Isa's miracles, peace be upon him, were healing those born blind and lepers, and bringing the dead to life by Allah's permission.
prophets-0057: Which prophet was sent to the people of Ninawa in Iraq, who all believed, so Allah removed their punishment?
Allah sent Yunus, peace be upon him, to the people of Ninawa. They initially rejected him, then repented, and Allah removed their punishment.
gemini-prophets-b2-004: Which prophet did Allah mention alongside Isma'il and Dhu al-Kifl, describing them as among the outstanding?
Allah Almighty says: ﴿وَاذْكُرْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ الْأَخْيَارِ﴾ [And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.].
gemini-prophets-b3-005: Which prophet called his people to stop worshipping an idol named Ba'l?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ الْخَالِقِينَ﴾ [Do you call upon Baʿl[1300] and leave the best of creators -]. These were Ilyas's words to his people, peace be upon him.
gemini2-prophets-020: Which prophet did Allah mention alongside Isma'il and Idris, describing them all as patient?
Allah Almighty says: ﴿وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّ مِّنَ الصَّابِرِينَ﴾ [And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.].
gemini-prophets-b2-011: Who was the mother of 'Isa, peace be upon him?
Maryam, daughter of 'Imran, peace be upon her. Allah named an entire surah of the Qur'an after her.
gemini-prophets-b3-009: Which woman, the wife of Fir'awn, did Allah set forth as an example for the believers?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا امْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ﴾ [And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."]. According to the commentators, her name was Asiyah.
gemini2-prophets-001: What was the name of Adam's wife, peace be upon him?
Hawwa' was Adam's wife, peace be upon him, and the mother of mankind. The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, named her in the hadith.
gemini-prophets-b3-014: What is the name of the mountain from whose right side Allah called Musa, peace be upon him?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿وَنَادَيْنَاهُ مِن جَانِبِ الطُّورِ الْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَاهُ نَجِيًّا﴾ [And We called him from the side of the mount[818] at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].].
prophets-0033: What is the name of the mountain on which Nuh's Ark came to rest, peace be upon him?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿وَقِيلَ يَا أَرْضُ ابْلَعِي مَاءَكِ وَيَا سَمَاءُ أَقْلِعِي … وَاسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْجُودِيِّ﴾ [And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people."].
gemini-prophets-b2-001: What is the name of the stone Ibrahim, peace be upon him, stood on while raising the foundations of the Sacred House?
Hijr Isma'il (the enclosure beside the Ka'bah)

Allah Almighty says: ﴿وَاتَّخِذُوا مِن مَّقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى﴾ [And [mention] when We made the House [i.e., the Kaʿbah] a place of return for the people and [a place of] security. And take, [O believers], from the standing place of Abraham a place of prayer. And We charged Abraham and Ishmael, [saying], "Purify My House for those who perform ṭawāf[41] and those who are staying [there] for worship and those who bow and prostrate [in prayer]."]. It is the stone on which he stood as the building grew higher.
gemini-prophets-b2-002: Which tangible miracle was Salih, peace be upon him, given as a sign to his people?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿هَٰذِهِ نَاقَةُ اللَّهِ لَكُمْ آيَةً فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِي أَرْضِ اللَّهِ﴾ [And to the Thamūd [We sent] their brother Ṣāliḥ. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. There has come to you clear evidence from your Lord. This is the she-camel of Allāh [sent] to you as a sign. So leave her to eat within Allāh's land and do not touch her with harm, lest there seize you a painful punishment.]. They hamstrung her, and punishment overtook them.
gemini-prophets-b2-003: How did Allah Almighty praise Ayyub, peace be upon him, after his patience through affliction?

﴿نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ﴾ [[We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath."[1329] Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].]
﴿إِنَّهُ كَانَ صَادِقَ الْوَعْدِ﴾ [And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.]
﴿وَرَفَعْنَاهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا﴾ [And We raised him to a high station.]
﴿إِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا﴾ [And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.]

Allah Almighty says: ﴿إِنَّا وَجَدْنَاهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ الْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ﴾ [[We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath."[1329] Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].]. The one true to his promise was Isma'il, and the one raised to a high station was Idris.
gemini-prophets-b2-005: How long did Prophet Nuh, peace be upon him, call his people, as explicitly stated in the Noble Qur'an?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا﴾ [And We certainly sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers.], meaning nine hundred and fifty years.
gemini-prophets-b2-016: How does the Qur'an describe Musa's hand when he brought it out from inside his garment as a sign, peace be upon him?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿وَاضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ آيَةً أُخْرَىٰ﴾ [And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,]. The expression «من غيرِ سوء» [And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,] means without leprosy or illness.
gemini-prophets-b2-018: How did Allah destroy Fir'awn and his soldiers when they pursued Musa, peace be upon him?
By being swallowed by the earth
By a blast from the sky
Allah closed the sea over them and they drowned, as a lesson for people.
gemini-prophets-b3-003: For how many years did the Children of Israel wander on earth after refusing to enter the Holy Land?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿فَإِنَّهَا مُحَرَّمَةٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ۛ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً ۛ يَتِيهُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ [[Allāh] said, "Then indeed, it is forbidden to them for forty years [in which] they will wander throughout the land. So do not grieve over the defiantly disobedient people."].
gemini-prophets-b3-006: In which valley did Ibrahim, peace be upon him, settle his wife and his son Isma'il, peace be upon him?
The sacred valley of Tuwa beside at-Tur
The valley of Makkah by the Sacred House
The valley of the ants through which Sulayman passed

Allah Almighty relates his words: ﴿رَّبَّنَا إِنِّي أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِي بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِي زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ الْمُحَرَّمِ﴾ [Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House, our Lord, that they may establish prayer. So make hearts among the people incline toward them and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful.].
gemini-prophets-b3-011: How were the prophets Musa and Harun related, peace be upon them both?
Harun was Musa's brother, and Musa asked Allah to make him his helper.
gemini-prophets-b3-018: How many years did the People of the Cave remain asleep in their cave, as stated in the Qur'an?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿وَلَبِثُوا فِي كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَاثَ مِائَةٍ سِنِينَ وَازْدَادُوا تِسْعًا﴾ [And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine.[786]]. The three hundred are solar years; the additional nine complete the equivalent in lunar years.
gemini2-prophets-002: Through what did Ya'qub, peace be upon him, regain his sight after his eyes had turned white?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿فَلَمَّا أَن جَاءَ الْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَاهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِ فَارْتَدَّ بَصِيرًا﴾ [And when the bearer of good tidings[617] arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?"], meaning that he placed Yusuf's shirt over his face.
gemini2-prophets-004: Allah gave Zakariyya, peace be upon him, glad tidings of a son named Yahya despite his old age. What sign was he given?
Not to speak to people for three days except by gestures
To fast for an entire month
To remain secluded in worship in the sanctuary for a year
To have a cloud shade him

قال آيتك ألا تكلم الناس ثلاثة أيام إلا رمزا [He said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not [be able to] speak to the people for three days except by gesture. And remember your Lord much and exalt [Him with praise] in the evening and the morning."].
gemini2-prophets-006: How many signs (miracles) was Musa, peace be upon him, given to take to Fir'awn?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ آيَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ﴾ [And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic."]. These included the staff, the hand, the flood, the locusts, and the lice.
gemini2-prophets-007: In which country did Yusuf, peace be upon him, become responsible for the storehouses of the land?

Yusuf, peace be upon him, said to the 'Aziz of Egypt: ﴿اجْعَلْنِي عَلَىٰ خَزَائِنِ الْأَرْضِ﴾ [[Joseph] said, "Appoint me over the storehouses of the land. Indeed, I will be a knowing guardian."]. This took place in Egypt.
gemini2-prophets-008: What is the name of the sacred valley where Allah first spoke to Musa, peace be upon him?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿إِنِّي أَنَا رَبُّكَ فَاخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى﴾ [Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the blessed valley of Ṭuwā.].
gemini2-prophets-009: How does the Noble Qur'an describe the sincere followers of 'Isa, peace be upon him, who supported him?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ اللَّهِ﴾ [O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant.]. They were his closest and choicest companions.
gemini2-prophets-016: Which prophet's miracle was a staff that turned into a real serpent?
Allah sent Musa, peace be upon him, to Fir'awn and supported him with this miracle.
gemini2-prophets-017: What food did Allah send down to the Children of Israel during their wandering?

Allah Almighty says: ﴿وَظَلَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ الْغَمَامَ وَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَنَّ وَالسَّلْوَىٰ﴾ [And We shaded you with clouds and sent down to you manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not - but they were [only] wronging themselves.].
prophets-0005: Which prophet was sent to the people of Thamud?
Salih, peace and blessings be upon him
Hud, peace and blessings be upon him
Lut, peace and blessings be upon him
Salih, peace and blessings be upon him, was sent to Thamud, and Allah's she-camel was his sign.
prophets-0007: Which prophet had the wind and jinn (unseen beings) subjected to him?
Sulayman, peace and blessings be upon him
Dawud, peace and blessings be upon him
Yusuf, peace and blessings be upon him
The wind and jinn were subjected to Sulayman, peace and blessings be upon him.
prophets-0010: Who is the final prophet and messenger?
'Isa, peace and blessings be upon him
Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him
Ibrahim, peace and blessings be upon him
Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, is the Seal of the Prophets.
prophets-0013: Which prophet built the Ka'bah with his son Isma'il?
Ibrahim, peace and blessings be upon him
Nuh, peace and blessings be upon him
Musa, peace and blessings be upon him
Ibrahim, peace and blessings be upon him, raised the foundations with his son Isma'il.
prophets-0016: Who was Musa's brother, peace and blessings be upon him, who was a prophet and his helper?
Harun, peace and blessings be upon him
Shu'ayb, peace and blessings be upon him
Yusha', peace and blessings be upon him
Harun, peace and blessings be upon him, was Musa's brother and helper.
prophets-0017: Which prophet was thrown into the fire by his people, but it became cool and safe for him?
Ibrahim (peace and blessings be upon him)
Salih (peace and blessings be upon him)
Hud (peace and blessings be upon him)
Ibrahim (peace and blessings be upon him); «قلنا يا نارُ كوني بردًا وسلامًا» [We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."].
prophets-0019: Which prophet did Allah give the Zabur (Psalms)?
Dawud (peace and blessings be upon him)
Sulayman (peace and blessings be upon him)
Musa (peace and blessings be upon him)

«وآتينا داودَ زبورًا» [Indeed, We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], as We revealed to Noah and the prophets after him. And We revealed to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, the Descendants,[235] Jesus, Job, Jonah, Aaron, and Solomon; and to David We gave the book [of Psalms].].
prophets-0020: For which prophet did Allah soften iron so that he could make armor from it?
Dawud (peace and blessings be upon him)
Sulayman (peace and blessings be upon him)
Dhul-Kifl (peace and blessings be upon him)

Dawud (peace and blessings be upon him); «وألنّا له الحديد» [And We certainly gave David from Us bounty. [We said], "O mountains, repeat [Our] praises with him, and the birds [as well]." And We made pliable for him iron,].
prophets-0021: Which prophet was taught the language of birds?
Sulayman (peace and blessings be upon him)
Dawud (peace and blessings be upon him)
Yunus (peace and blessings be upon him)

Sulayman (peace and blessings be upon him); «عُلّمنا منطقَ الطير» [And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."].
prophets-0023: Which prophet is called Dhun-Nun in the Qur'an?
Yunus (peace and blessings be upon him)
Ilyas (peace and blessings be upon him)
Al-Yasa (peace and blessings be upon him)

«وذا النونِ إذ ذهبَ مغاضبًا» [And [mention] the man of the fish [i.e., Jonah], when he went off in anger[899] and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him.[900] And he called out within the darknesses,[901] "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."] refers to Yunus (peace and blessings be upon him).
prophets-0024: Which prophet's eyes turned white with grief over his son Yusuf?
Yaqub (peace and blessings be upon him)
Ishaq (peace and blessings be upon him)
Ibrahim (peace and blessings be upon him)

Yaqub (peace and blessings be upon him); «وابيضّت عيناهُ من الحزن» [And he turned away from them and said, "Oh, my sorrow over Joseph," and his eyes became white[614] from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor.[615]].
prophets-0026: About which prophet did Allah say «ورفعناهُ مكانًا عليًّا» [And We raised him to a high station.]?
Idris (peace and blessings be upon him)
Ilyas (peace and blessings be upon him)
Dhul-Kifl (peace and blessings be upon him)
Idris (peace and blessings be upon him).
prophets-0027: Which prophet dreamed of eleven stars, the sun and the moon prostrating to him?
Yusuf (peace and blessings be upon him)
Yaqub (peace and blessings be upon him)
Yahya (peace and blessings be upon him)
Yusuf (peace and blessings be upon him), at the beginning of his surah (Qur'an chapter).
prophets-0034: To which prophet was Ishaq born in his old age?
Ibrahim (peace and blessings be upon him)
Yaqub (peace and blessings be upon him)
Zakariyya (peace and blessings be upon him)
Ibrahim (peace and blessings be upon him) received the good news of Ishaq in his old age.
prophets-0035: Who was the first messenger sent to the people of the earth, according to the report?
Adam (peace and blessings be upon him)
Nuh (peace and blessings be upon him)
Idris (peace and blessings be upon him)
Nuh (peace and blessings be upon him) was the first messenger sent to the people of the earth, as stated in the hadith (Prophetic report) about intercession.
prophets-0037: Which prophet did Allah describe as «كان صادقَ الوعدِ وكان رسولًا نبيًّا» [And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.]?
Ismail (peace and blessings be upon him)
Ishaq (peace and blessings be upon him)
Yaqub (peace and blessings be upon him)
Ismail (peace and blessings be upon him).
