prophets-0038: With what did Allah Almighty ransom the boy whom Ibrahim (peace be upon him) was commanded to sacrifice?
Allah Almighty said: ﴿وَفَدَيْنَاهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ﴾ [And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,[1298]]. This was the ram brought by Jibril (peace be upon him).
prophets-0046: Who was Ismail's mother (peace be upon him), who ran between As-Safa and Al-Marwah looking for water for her infant?
Hajar was Ismail's mother. Her running between As-Safa and Al-Marwah became a rite of hajj (major pilgrimage) and umrah (minor pilgrimage).
prophets-0049: What great miracle did Allah grant Musa (peace be upon him) when he threw his staff onto the ground?
It turned into a moving snake
Allah supported Musa with his staff, which turned into a real snake with which he challenged Pharaoh's magicians.
prophets-0052: Which clever bird brought Prophet Sulayman (peace be upon him) news of the kingdom of Saba and its queen?
Sulayman (peace be upon him) inspected the birds and could not find the hoopoe. It later returned with news of the queen of Saba and her polytheistic people.
prophets-0054: Which woman did Allah cite alongside Nuh's wife as an example of disbelief, as she betrayed her prophet husband's mission and supported his unjust people?
Surah At-Tahrim ends by citing Nuh's wife and Lut's wife as examples of disbelief despite their marriage to righteous prophets.
gemini-seerah-001: To which Arab tribe did Halimah As-Sadiyyah belong, the woman who nursed the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) and cared for him in childhood?
The people of Makkah customarily sent their children to be nursed in the desert to strengthen their bodies and learn Arabic. The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) was nursed among Banu Sad.
seerah-0045: To which well-known Arab tribe in Makkah does our Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) belong?
Allah chose the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) from Banu Hashim of Quraysh, one of the noblest Arab tribes.
gemini-seerah-b2-004: What was the first destination to which the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) told the Muslims to migrate to escape persecution by Quraysh, because its king allowed no one to be wronged?
Migration to Abyssinia provided the first refuge for the oppressed Muslims of Makkah.
seerah-0051: In which city is Al-Masjid An-Nabawi (the Prophet's Mosque), which the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) built and where his noble grave is located?
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) built his mosque in Al-Madinah Al-Munawwarah after migrating there, and he was buried there after his death.
gemini-seerah-b3-007: Which uncle of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) embraced Islam and witnessed the conquest of Makkah, and was the father of Abdullah, the great scholar of the Muslim community?
Al-Abbas (may Allah be pleased with him) was the Prophet's uncle and the father of Abdullah ibn Abbas, the interpreter of the Qur'an.
seerah-0052: Who was the brave uncle of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) who was martyred at the Battle of Uhud and was called the Lion of Allah and His Messenger?
Hamzah (may Allah be pleased with him) made great contributions to supporting Islam, and the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) grieved deeply over his martyrdom.
gemini2-seerah-008: In which battle did some archers disobey the Prophet's command and leave their positions, causing the Muslims to retreat?
The archers came down from the archers' hill to collect spoils, allowing the polytheists to outflank them.
gemini2-seerah-018: What battle took place in the eighth year after the hijrah (migration to Madinah), in which Zayd ibn Harithah and Jafar ibn Abi Talib (may Allah be pleased with them both) were martyred?
Mutah is in southern Jordan. Zayd was appointed commander, followed by Jafar, then Abdullah ibn Rawahah. All were martyred, after which Khalid ibn Al-Walid took the banner.
seerah-0044: In which battle was the Prophet's face wounded and his lateral incisor broken, while the Companions defended him valiantly?
The Muslims faced severe trials at Uhud. The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) was wounded, and some Companions stood firm with him, ready to sacrifice their lives for him.
seerah-0041: Who was the expert guide whom the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) hired to show him the migration route to Madinah?
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) and Abu Bakr hired Abdullah ibn Urayqit for his expertise, although he followed the religion of Quraysh.
gemini-seerah-b3-017: Which Companion was a scribe of revelation and undertook the compilation of the Qur'an during Abu Bakr's rule (may Allah be pleased with him)?

Abu Bakr chose him to compile the Qur'an because he was a sensible young man whose integrity was beyond suspicion, and he used to write down revelation for the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him).
gemini2-seerah-016: Which Companion was known as the beloved of the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him)?

Usamah ibn Zayd ibn Harithah (may Allah be pleased with him and his father). Ibn Umar said about him: «كان أحبَّ الناسِ إلى رسولِ اللهِ ﷺ» [He was the person most beloved to the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him)].
seerah-0046: Where did the Muslims first migrate to escape the oppression of Quraysh and seek safety?
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) told them to migrate to Abyssinia because it had a just king under whom no one was wronged.
seerah-0056: Where did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) travel on business with his uncle Abu Talib while he was still a young boy?
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) accompanied his uncle Abu Talib on a trading journey to Ash-Sham, where they met the monk Bahira.
seerah-0054: What was the name of the swift white mount that the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) rode during Al-Isra wal-Miraj (the Night Journey and Ascension)?
Al-Buraq was a mount brought to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) on the night of Al-Isra; it placed its hoof as far as its sight reached.
gemini-seerah-002: What is the name of the blessed well in Makkah Al-Mukarramah, near the Kabah, from which the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) drank?
Zamzam is a blessed well that sprang up beneath Ismail's feet (peace be upon him). Its water provides nourishment and cures illness.
gemini-seerah-004: How many times did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) perform the obligatory hajj (pilgrimage) after migrating and settling in Al-Madinah Al-Munawwarah?
After the hijrah (migration), the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) performed hajj once, in the tenth year after the hijrah. It became known as the Farewell Hajj.
gemini-seerah-005: Which young Companion did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) send to Al-Madinah Al-Munawwarah as the first ambassador and teacher of Islam before the hijrah (migration)?
Sad ibn Muadh (may Allah be pleased with him)
Musab ibn Umayr (may Allah be pleased with him)
Asad ibn Zurarah (may Allah be pleased with him)
Abdullah ibn Umm Maktum (may Allah be pleased with him)
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) sent Musab ibn Umayr after the first pledge at Al-Aqabah to teach the people of Yathrib the Qur'an and instruct them in their religion.
gemini-seerah-b2-001: Who nursed the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) before Halimah As-Sadiyyah (may Allah be pleased with her)?
Thuwaybah, Abu Lahab's freed slave woman, nursed him for a few days before he was entrusted to Halimah among Banu Sad.
gemini-seerah-b2-002: What was the name of the Prophet's son by Mariyah Al-Qibtiyyah who died as a young child?

Ibrahim died at about a year and a half old. A solar eclipse occurred on the day he died, and the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «إنّ الشمسَ والقمرَ آيتانِ من آياتِ اللهِ لا ينكسفانِ لموتِ أحدٍ ولا لحياتِه» [The sun and the moon are two of the signs of Allah; they do not eclipse on the death or life of anyone.].
gemini-seerah-b2-003: What is the name of the valley where Quraysh boycotted Banu Hashim and besieged them for three full years?
The Muslims and Banu Hashim were subjected to an economic and social siege to pressure them into handing over the Prophet.
gemini-seerah-b2-005: Which pact did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) witness before Islam at Abdullah ibn Judan's house, pledging to support the oppressed, about which he said that if invited to it in Islam, he would respond?
Hilf Al-Fudul reflected noble human values that Islam later affirmed.
gemini-seerah-b2-008: Why was one year in the Prophet's biography called the Year of Sorrow?
Because the Muslims lost at Uhud
Because Khadijah and Abu Talib died in the same year
Because all the Prophet's sons died that year
Because he left Makkah for At-Taif
Their deaths were a great blow: he lost protection and comfort.
gemini-seerah-b2-010: Which Companion was called the keeper of the Messenger of Allah's secret because he knew the hypocrites' names?
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) entrusted him with the hypocrites' names, so Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) would ask him about himself.
gemini-seerah-b2-012: How many sons did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) have, and did they grow up or die in childhood?
Three sons, all of whom died in childhood
Two sons who lived to adulthood
One son who inherited the caliphate
His sons Al-Qasim, Abdullah and Ibrahim all died as young children.
gemini-seerah-b2-014: During the expedition of Al-Hudaybiyah, the Companions pledged to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) not to flee, or to fight to the death. What was this great pledge called?
Bayat Ar-Ridwan (the Pledge of Divine Pleasure)
The Second Pledge of the Tree

Allah Almighty said: لقد رضي الله عن المؤمنين إذ يبايعونك تحت الشجرة [Certainly was Allāh pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you, [O Muḥammad], under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquility upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest[1514]].
gemini-seerah-b2-015: In the seventh year after the hijrah (migration), the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) besieged and conquered which important strategic Jewish stronghold to safeguard against their treachery?
Khaybar was a center of Jewish conspiracies, and its conquest was a major political and economic victory for the Muslims.
gemini-seerah-b2-016: How many nights did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) and Abu Bakr (may Allah be pleased with him) stay in the cave before departing?
They stayed for three nights until the search for them subsided, then departed with their guide.
gemini-seerah-b2-017: What was the name of the Prophet's famous sword?
Dhul-Fiqar was a sword that came to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) among the spoils of Badr. It was named for the grooves along its blade.
gemini-seerah-b2-018: In the early days of Islam in Madinah, which direction did the Muslims face in prayer before the qiblah (prayer direction) was changed to the Kabah?
They prayed toward Bayt Al-Maqdis for more than ten months before the command came to face the Kabah.
gemini-seerah-b3-002: Which Companion accompanied the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) on the migration to Madinah and slept with him in the cave?
Abu Bakr was the loyal companion on the Muslims' most difficult journey.
gemini-seerah-b3-005: The expedition of Bir Maunah was a tragedy that deeply grieved the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him). What happened?
The Companions drowned in the valley
Tribes from Najd betrayed and killed seventy Qur'an reciters among the Companions
The army was defeated by the Byzantines
A disagreement arose among the Companions
The tribes of Ril and Dhakwan betrayed them. Because of the enormity of the tragedy, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) performed qunut (supplication in prayer) against them for a month.
gemini-seerah-b3-013: Which wife of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) was known as Umm Al-Masakin (Mother of the Poor) for frequently feeding them and showing them compassion, and died during his lifetime?
She lived with him for a very short time, only months, and was known by this beautiful title.
gemini-seerah-b4-001: Over how many years was the Noble Qur'an revealed to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
It was revealed in stages over twenty-three years: thirteen in Makkah and ten in Madinah.
gemini-seerah-b4-005: In which Hijri year was Makkah Al-Mukarramah conquered, when the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) entered victoriously and pardoned its people?
The great conquest took place in Ramadan of the eighth year after the hijrah (migration).
gemini2-seerah-002: How many wives survived the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
He died leaving nine wives, the Mothers of the Believers. He married eleven women during his lifetime.
gemini2-seerah-004: What was the great miracle in which the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) was taken by night to Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa and then ascended to heaven?
Al-Isra wal-Miraj (the Night Journey and Ascension)

Allah Almighty said: سبحان الذي أسرى بعبده ليلا [Exalted[722] is He who took His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] by night from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām to al-Masjid al-Aqṣā,[723] whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs. Indeed, He is the Hearing,[724] the Seeing.[725]]... The obligatory prayers were prescribed during this journey.
gemini2-seerah-006: How old was the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) when his mother Aminah (may Allah be pleased with her) died?
Aminah died at Al-Abwa when he was six. His grandfather Abdul-Muttalib cared for him, followed by his uncle Abu Talib.
gemini2-seerah-007: In whose house did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) stay when he first arrived in Madinah, until the mosque was built?

The she-camel knelt near the house of Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari (may Allah be pleased with him). The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) stayed with him for about seven months until the mosque and his houses were built.
gemini2-seerah-017: What was the name of the document the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) wrote to regulate relations among the Muhajirun (Emigrants), the Ansar (Helpers) and the Jews of Madinah?
Also known as the Constitution of Madinah, it regulated the communities' rights and duties and their joint defense of Madinah.
gemini2-seerah-020: Who were the three commanders martyred successively at the Battle of Mutah, in the order set by the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
Zayd ibn Harithah, Jafar ibn Abi Talib, Abdullah ibn Rawahah
Khalid ibn Al-Walid, Zayd ibn Harithah, Jafar ibn Abi Talib
Abu Ubaydah, Jafar ibn Abi Talib, Abdullah ibn Rawahah
Hamzah ibn Abdul-Muttalib, Musab ibn Umayr, Sad ibn Muadh
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) appointed them in this order. All were martyred in a heroic battle against the Byzantines.
seerah-0001: In which city was Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) born?
He was born in Makkah Al-Mukarramah.
seerah-0003: What was the name of the Prophet's father?
seerah-0005: Which Companion was known as the Interpreter of the Qur'an?
Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with him and his father) was called the Interpreter of the Qur'an.
seerah-0006: Which Companion was known as Al-Faruq (the one who distinguishes truth from falsehood)?
Umar ibn Al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him).
seerah-0007: Which Companion was known as As-Siddiq (the one who affirms the truth)?
Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (may Allah be pleased with him).
seerah-0008: Which Companion was known as Dhun-Nurayn (the possessor of two lights)?
Uthman (may Allah be pleased with him), because he married two of the Prophet's daughters.
seerah-0009: Which Companion was known as the Drawn Sword of Allah?
Khalid ibn Al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him).
seerah-0011: Who was the first man to believe in the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
Abu Bakr (may Allah be pleased with him) was the first man to believe.
seerah-0012: Who was the first woman to believe in the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
Khadijah (may Allah be pleased with her) was the first to believe.
seerah-0013: Who was the first boy to believe in the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) was the first boy to believe.
seerah-0014: For how many years did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) call people to Islam in Makkah before the hijrah (migration)?
seerah-0015: Who was the Prophet's muadhdhin (caller to prayer)?
Bilal ibn Rabah (may Allah be pleased with him).
seerah-0016: What was the name of the Prophet's mother?
His mother was Aminah bint Wahb.
seerah-0017: Which grandfather of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) took care of him after his parents died?
seerah-0018: Which uncle of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) cared for him after his grandfather died?
seerah-0020: In which cave did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) worship and first receive revelation?
The Cave of Hira on Jabal An-Nur.
seerah-0021: Which angel brought revelation to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
Jibril (peace be upon him), entrusted with revelation.
seerah-0022: What was the first passage of the Qur'an revealed to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
«اقرأ» [Recite in the name of your Lord who created –] (the opening of Surah Al-Alaq)
«يا أيّها المدّثّر» [O you who covers himself [with a garment],[1788]]
«اقرأ باسمِ ربّك» [Recite in the name of your Lord who created –] was the first revelation.
seerah-0024: In which cave did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) and Abu Bakr hide during the hijrah (migration)?
The Cave of Thawr, south of Makkah.
seerah-0025: What was the name of the Prophet's wet nurse among the desert dwellers of Banu Sad?
seerah-0026: By what name was Madinah known before Islam?
seerah-0027: What is the name of the Prophet's journey by night from Al-Masjid Al-Haram to Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa?
Al-Isra was the journey from Al-Masjid Al-Haram to Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa.
seerah-0028: What is the name of the Prophet's ascent to the highest heavens?
Al-Miraj is the ascent to the heavens.
seerah-0029: How many daily prayers became obligatory for Muslims after Al-Isra wal-Miraj (the Night Journey and Ascension)?
seerah-0032: Which daughter of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) married Ali ibn Abi Talib (may Allah be pleased with him)?
Fatimah Az-Zahra (may Allah be pleased with her).
seerah-0033: When Quraysh disagreed over who should place the Black Stone, whom did they choose as arbitrator and accept his decision?
Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him)
They chose the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him), before his mission began, because of his honesty and trustworthiness.
seerah-0035: According to the well-known account, how many years did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) live in Madinah after the hijrah (migration)?
seerah-0036: In which city did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) die and receive burial?
He died and was buried in Madinah.
seerah-0037: On which day of the week was the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) born, according to the report?
«ذاك يومٌ وُلدتُ فيه» [That is the day on which I was born] refers to Monday.
seerah-0039: Who was the Prophet's first wife, who supported him when revelation first came?
Khadijah (may Allah be pleased with her).
seerah-0042: In which Hijri year was the Treaty of Al-Hudaybiyah concluded between the Muslims and Quraysh?
The fifth year after the hijrah
The sixth year after the hijrah
The seventh year after the hijrah
The eighth year after the hijrah
The treaty was concluded in the sixth year and was a great victory for the Muslims.
seerah-0043: What work did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) do in childhood and early youth?
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) herded sheep for the people of Makkah, and said that every prophet had herded sheep.
seerah-0047: Which Companion slept in the Prophet's bed on the night of the hijrah (migration), to return entrusted property and delay pursuit by Quraysh?
Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (may Allah be pleased with him)
Zayd ibn Harithah (may Allah be pleased with him)
Ammar ibn Yasir (may Allah be pleased with him)
Ali ibn Abi Talib (may Allah be pleased with him)
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) chose his cousin Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) for this task, to return entrusted property to its owners.
seerah-0048: What title did Quraysh give Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) before his mission because of his honesty and trustworthiness?
The Wise Man of the Arabs
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) was known among his people for never lying and for safeguarding entrusted property, so he was called As-Sadiq Al-Amin.
seerah-0053: What was the name of the Christian monk in Busra, Ash-Sham, who recognized signs of prophethood in the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) as a boy and warned his uncle Abu Talib about the Jews?
The monk Bahira met the caravan carrying the young Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) and saw the seal of prophethood between his shoulders.
seerah-0055: Which Companion did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) instruct to write the Treaty of Al-Hudaybiyah between the Muslims and Quraysh?
Zayd ibn Thabit (may Allah be pleased with him)
Muawiyah ibn Abi Sufyan (may Allah be pleased with him)
Abdullah ibn Masud (may Allah be pleased with him)
Ali ibn Abi Talib (may Allah be pleased with him)

Imam Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) wrote the treaty. Out of respect, he refused to erase the words 'Messenger of Allah', so the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) erased them with his own hand.
seerah-0057: Which Companion dreamed of the words of the adhan (call to prayer), which the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) approved and told him to teach to Bilal?
Umar ibn Al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him)
Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (may Allah be pleased with him)
Abdullah ibn Zayd (may Allah be pleased with him)
Hamzah ibn Abdul-Muttalib (may Allah be pleased with him)
Abdullah ibn Zayd saw the adhan in a dream. Umar ibn Al-Khattab had the same dream, and the adhan was prescribed at that time.
seerah-0058: Which Jewish tribe broke its covenant with the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) and conspired with the confederates during the siege of Madinah at the Battle of Al-Khandaq?
Banu Qurayzah betrayed the Muslims during the darkest circumstances of the siege of Al-Khandaq, so the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) besieged them after the battle.
adab-0026: Explaining the wisdom of asking permission before entering houses, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الِاسْتِئْذَانُ مِنْ أَجْلِ...» [Asking permission was prescribed only because of...]?
Asking permission was prescribed to protect the privacy of homes, so a visitor would not see what the household would dislike being seen.
gemini2-manners-006: To increase love among Muslims, what did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) command us to spread?
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: أفشوا السلام بينكم [Spread the greeting of peace among yourselves.].
adab-0029: What great virtue means preferring another person to oneself and giving them what they need, even when one needs it oneself?

Allah praised the Ansar (Helpers) for this virtue, saying: ﴿وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ﴾ [And [also for] those who were settled in the Home [i.e.,al-Madīnah] and [adopted] the faith before them.[1656] They love those who emigrated to them and find not any want in their breasts of what they [i.e., the emigrants] were given but give [them] preference over themselves, even though they are in privation. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.].
gemini-manners-b2-008: What virtue means willingly giving people money and food without reminding them of one's favors or causing hurt?
Generosity means openhanded giving. The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) was the most generous of people, and he was at his most generous in Ramadan when Jibril met him.
gemini2-manners-002: What virtue means controlling oneself when angry and bearing harm from others?

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said to Al-Ashajj of Abdul-Qays: «إنّ فيكَ خصلتينِ يحبُّهما الله: الحِلمُ والأناة» [Indeed you possess two traits that Allah loves: prudence and deliberation.].
adab-0002: With which hand did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) tell us to eat and drink?
«ولا يأكلَنَّ أحدُكم بشمالِه، ولا يشربَنَّ بها» [None of you should eat with his left hand or drink with it].
adab-0005: Which virtue did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) say «يَهْدي إلى البِرِّ» [leads to righteousness]?
«إنّ الصدقَ يَهْدي إلى البِرِّ، وإنّ البِرَّ يَهْدي إلى الجنّة» [truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise.].
adab-0006: What is the heaviest thing in a believer's scales on the Day of Resurrection?
«ما مِن شيءٍ أثقلُ في ميزانِ المؤمنِ يومَ القيامةِ من حُسنِ الخُلق» [There is nothing heavier on the believer's scale on the Day of Judgment than good morals.].
adab-0008: What must a Muslim do when speaking to people?
Tell the truth and not lie
«عليكم بالصِّدق... وإيّاكم والكذب، فإن الكذب يهدي إلى الفجور» [Adhere to truthfulness... Beware of lying, for lying leads to wickedness].
adab-0010: Complete this etiquette for asking permission before entering homes: «الاستئذانُ ... مرّات، فإن أُذِنَ لك وإلّا فارجع» [Permission should be sought ... times. If you are given permission, enter; otherwise, go back].
«الاستئذانُ ثلاثٌ، فإن أُذِنَ لكَ وإلّا فارجِعْ» [Permission should be sought three times. If you are given permission, enter; otherwise, go back].
adab-0012: Who did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) say would not enter Paradise because he causes discord by carrying people's words between them to turn them against one another?
«لا يدخلُ الجنّةَ نَمَّام» [A talebearer will not enter Paradise]; another version says «قَتَّات» [A scandalmonger will not enter Paradise.].
adab-0013: About whom did Jibril (peace be upon him) repeatedly advise the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him), until he thought that person would be made an heir?
«ما زال جبريلُ يوصيني بالجارِ حتّى ظننتُ أنّه سيُورِّثُه» [Jibrīl kept enjoining me regarding the good treatment of the neighbor to the extent that I thought he would inherit him.].
adab-0016: According to the noble hadith (Prophetic report), what right does a Muslim have over his fellow Muslim when he falls ill?
To give charity on his behalf
To invite him to a feast
Visiting the sick is an emphatic right of one Muslim over another, strengthening the bonds of love.
adab-0017: When the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) warned the Companions against sitting along roads, what was the first right of the road he mentioned?
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) listed the rights of the road, beginning with lowering the gaze to respect the privacy of passersby.
adab-0018: Which word does the Noble Qur'an forbid us from saying to our parents because it expresses irritation and disrespect?

Allah Almighty said: ﴿فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَا أُفٍّ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا﴾ [And your Lord has decreed that you worship not except Him, and to parents, good treatment. Whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], "uff,"[735] and do not repel them but speak to them a noble word.], emphasizing the duty to treat parents with kindness.
adab-0019: What great advice did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) repeat to the man who asked him for comprehensive guidance?
Anger brings together all kinds of evil, so the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) repeated his advice to avoid anger.
adab-0020: How did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) define the forbidden practice of ghibah (backbiting)?
Carrying words between people to cause discord
Insulting your brother to his face
Mentioning your brother in his absence in a way he dislikes
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) explained that backbiting means mentioning a fellow Muslim in his absence in a way he dislikes, even if it is true.
adab-0021: How does Islam command us to treat animals, birds and cats?
Show them mercy, feed them and avoid harming them
Islam is a religion of mercy. The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) told of a woman who entered Hellfire for confining a cat, and a man who was forgiven for giving water to a thirsty dog.
adab-0022: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said to a boy eating with him whose hand wandered around the platter: «يَا غُلَامُ، سَمِّ اللَّهَ، وَكُلْ بِيَمِينِكَ...» [O boy, mention Allah's name, eat with your right hand...] Complete the advice:
And eat from the middle of the platter
And eat from what is nearer to you
Eating etiquette includes not reaching for other people's food. A Muslim should eat what is directly in front of him.
adab-0024: If your fellow Muslim sneezes and praises Allah Almighty, what should you say to him?
Afaka Allah (May Allah grant you well-being)
Yarhamuka Allah (May Allah have mercy on you)
Responding to a sneezer with Yarhamuka Allah (May Allah have mercy on you) is one of a Muslim's rights over his fellow Muslim.
adab-0025: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) forbade two people from speaking privately and leaving a third person alone. Why?
Because it saddens and hurts the third person
Because their voices might become loud
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) explained that speaking privately while excluding a third person makes him feel left out and saddens him, which conflicts with brotherhood.
adab-0027: What good supplication did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) teach us to say to someone who does us a favor or helps us?
Jazaka Allahu khayran (May Allah reward you with good)
Salimat yadak (May your hands be kept safe)

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «من صُنع إليه معروف فقال لفاعله: جزاك الله خيراً، فقد أبلغ في الثناء» [Whoever has a favor done for him and says to its doer, 'May Allah reward you with good,' has offered the fullest praise].
adab-0028: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ...» [Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should honor...] Complete the statement:
Honoring guests, welcoming them well and meeting them with a cheerful face are signs of complete faith in Islam and noble character.
adab-0031: What blameworthy behavior did Allah forbid in Surah Al-Hujurat by saying: ﴿لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌ مِّن قَوْمٍ﴾ [O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name [i.e., mention] of disobedience after [one's] faith. And whoever does not repent - then it is those who are the wrongdoers.]?
Allah forbade ridiculing and mocking others because His measure is taqwa (God-consciousness), rather than appearances.
adab-0032: How did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) define kibr (arrogance) in the noble hadith (Prophetic report)?
Rejecting the truth and looking down on people
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) explained that dressing well is not arrogance. Arrogance is rejecting and denying the truth, and despising and belittling people.
gemini-manners-002: How does Allah Almighty command us in the Noble Qur'an to speak to our parents, especially in their old age?
Speak to them respectfully and politely

Allah Almighty said: ﴿وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًا كَرِيمًا﴾ [And your Lord has decreed that you worship not except Him, and to parents, good treatment. Whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], "uff,"[735] and do not repel them but speak to them a noble word.]. One of the greatest ways to honor parents is to speak to them with courtesy and full respect.
gemini-manners-003: How many times did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) pause to breathe outside the vessel while drinking, taking that many draughts?
Three draughts, breathing outside the vessel
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) paused three times to breathe outside the vessel while drinking, and explained that this was more thirst-quenching and wholesome.
gemini-manners-004: What does the Noble Qur'an command us to do if an unreliable person brings news about someone else?
Verify the accuracy of the news

Allah Almighty said: ﴿إِن جَاءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوا أَن تُصِيبُوا قَوْمًا بِجَهَالَةٍ﴾ [O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.], to avoid wronging people through rumors.
gemini-manners-b2-002: If you share a platter of food with others, from where should you eat?
From the middle of the platter
From what is nearest to me
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said to the boy: سم الله وكل بيمينك وكل مما يليك [mention Allah's name, eat with your right hand, and eat from what is nearer to you.].
gemini-manners-b2-014: Tracking people's faults and investigating secrets they keep hidden is called what in Islam?

Allah forbade it by saying: (ولا تجسسوا) [O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Merciful.].
gemini-manners-b2-015: What is mira (disputatious argument), which we are forbidden to engage in even when we are right?
Pointless argument aimed at overpowering an opponent without benefit
Scholarly discussion with courtesy and gentleness

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: أنا زعيم ببيت في ربض الجنة لمن ترك المراء وإن كان محقاً [I guarantee a house on the outskirts of Paradise for the one who refrains from arguing even if he is right].
gemini-manners-b2-016: What etiquette is required before entering a closed room containing people?
Ask permission, and leave if it is not granted after three attempts
Asking permission was prescribed to preserve privacy and protect against looking at what should not be seen.
gemini-manners-b2-017: When speaking to others, good manners require one's voice to be:
Loud so that people fear you
So quiet it cannot be heard
Moderate and calm, disturbing no one
Luqman advised his son: واغضض من صوتك إن أنكر الأصوات لصوت الحمير [And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys."].
gemini-manners-b2-018: What is the correct Islamic response to hearing a rumor or strange report about someone?
Check its accuracy before believing or spreading it
Quickly spread it on social media
Believe it if it is interesting

Allah Almighty said: إن جاءكم فاسق بنبأ فتبينوا [O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.].
gemini-manners-b3-002: According to the Sunnah (Prophetic practice), who should greet first when a rider and a pedestrian meet?

The hadith (Prophetic report) states: «يُسلِّمُ الراكبُ على الماشي، والماشي على القاعد، والقليلُ على الكثير» [The one who is riding should greet the one walking, the one who is walking should greet the one sitting, and the small group of people should greet the large one.].
gemini-manners-b3-003: How should you treat someone who wronged you if you want the highest levels of reward, described in the Qur'an as responding with what is best?
Repay his wrongdoing in exactly the same way
Insult him publicly and expose him
Pardon him and treat him kindly
Cut ties and avoid him forever

Allah Almighty said: ﴿ادْفَعْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ فَإِذَا الَّذِي بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهُ عَدَاوَةٌ كَأَنَّهُ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمٌ﴾ [And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon, the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.].
gemini-manners-b3-004: Rifq (gentleness) means being gentle and deliberate in matters. What did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) say about its merit?
It is a sign of weakness and incapacity
It adorns everything in which it is found

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «إنّ الرفقَ لا يكونُ في شيءٍ إلّا زانَه، ولا يُنزَعُ من شيءٍ إلّا شانَه» [Verily, lenience is not found in anything but it adorns it, and it is not removed from anything but it makes it defective.].
gemini-manners-b3-005: The humility praised in Islam is humility before Allah and the truth. How should a Muslim show humility toward people?
Deal with them gently, avoid arrogance and acknowledge their merits
Humility is not weakness. It means gentleness, modesty and avoiding haughtiness toward Allah's servants.
gemini-manners-b3-008: Silat ar-rahim (maintaining kinship ties) includes visiting relatives and treating them well. What is its greatest reward in this world?
Expanded provision and a prolonged lifespan

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «مَن أحبَّ أن يُبسَطَ له في رزقِه ويُنسأَ له في أثرِه فليصلْ رحمَه» [Whoever loves to have his sustenance expanded and his term of life prolonged should maintain his kinship ties.], meaning an increase in provision and a prolonging of life.
gemini-manners-b3-012: What does removing harm from the road mean, which the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) counted as charity and a branch of faith?
Removing things that harm people from their path, such as broken glass and thorns
Paving roads at the public treasury's expense
Avoiding narrow roads so as not to crowd people
Lighting roads at night so passersby can travel safely
Removing things that harm passersby is a branch of faith.
gemini-manners-b3-015: What is the Islamic ruling on Muslims shunning and quarreling with each other over worldly problems?
Forbidden; a Muslim may not be shunned for more than three days
Shunning is recommended to discipline the other person
After three days, the person who continues shunning incurs sin. Deeds are presented to Allah, and forgiveness for those quarreling is withheld until they reconcile.
gemini-manners-b3-017: If you promise to visit your friend at a set time, a sign of a truthful Muslim is that he:
Keeps his promise and arrives on time, unless prevented by a compelling excuse
Completely forgets the appointment and switches off his phone
Lies and says he is ill
Breaking promises is a characteristic of hypocrites: (وإذا وعد أخلف) [when he makes a promise, he breaks it].
gemini2-manners-001: What did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) teach someone drinking water about the number of pauses for breathing?
Drink in three draughts, breathing outside the vessel
He paused three times to breathe outside the vessel while drinking, and forbade breathing into the vessel itself.
gemini2-manners-003: How should you treat your parents according to Islamic teachings?

Allah commanded kindness to parents: وبالوالدين إحسانا [And your Lord has decreed that you worship not except Him, and to parents, good treatment. Whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], "uff,"[735] and do not repel them but speak to them a noble word.].
gemini2-manners-004: When three people are sitting together, what did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) forbid?
Two conversing privately while excluding the third
One leaving before the other two

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «إذا كانوا ثلاثةً فلا يتناجى اثنانِ دونَ الثالث، فإنّ ذلك يُحزِنُه» [If there are three, two should not converse privately while excluding the third, because that would grieve him].
gemini2-manners-005: What etiquette did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) require of people sitting along a road?
Lowering the gaze, refraining from harm, returning greetings and enjoining good

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «فإذا أبيتم إلّا المجلسَ فأعطوا الطريقَ حقَّه» [If you insist on sitting there, then give the road its due rights.]. They asked what its rights were. He said: «غضُّ البصر، وكفُّ الأذى، وردُّ السلام، والأمرُ بالمعروفِ والنهيُ عن المنكر» [Lowering the gaze, refraining from doing harm (to others), returning the greeting, enjoining what is good, and forbidding what is evil.].
gemini2-manners-007: How did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) describe removing harmful things from the road in terms of its reward?
Charity for which we are rewarded
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «وتُميطُ الأذى عن الطريقِ صدقة» [removing a harmful object from the road is a charity.]. It is also the lowest branch of faith.
gemini2-manners-008: In Islam, a good word is considered:
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: والكلمة الطيبة صدقة [Saying a good word is a charity.].
gemini2-manners-009: What action is described by the term silat ar-rahim (maintaining kinship ties)?
Keeping in touch with relatives, treating them well and visiting them
Giving charity to poor people in the street
Maintaining kinship ties is obligatory and is a means of increased provision and a longer life.
gemini2-manners-010: What is the precise difference between ghibah (backbiting) and namimah (talebearing)?
Backbiting is false, while talebearing is true
Talebearing carries words to cause discord; backbiting mentions someone in his absence in a way he dislikes
There is no difference; both are lies
Backbiting is to someone's face, and talebearing is behind his back
Talebearing aims to cause discord and set people against one another by carrying their words between them.
gemini2-manners-016: What should you do if you promise your friend something?
Keep the promise and not break it
Keeping commitments is a characteristic of sincere believers.
gemini2-manners-017: How does Islam command us to treat our neighbors?
Treat them kindly and help them
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: من كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر فليكرم جاره [Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should honor his neighbor.].
gemini2-manners-018: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) defined kibr (arrogance) as «بَطَرُ الحقِّ وغَمْطُ الناس» [to reject the truth and look down on people]. According to this definition, what is the praiseworthy humility that is its opposite?
Avoiding arrogance, accepting the truth and treating people gently
Keeping silent about the truth to avoid problems
Weakness of character and accepting injustice

Arrogance is «بَطَرُ الحقِّ وغَمْطُ الناس» [to reject the truth and look down on people]. Its opposite, humility, is accepting the truth from whoever brings it and treating people gently. Humility does not mean humiliating oneself or keeping silent about the truth.
gemini2-manners-019: What does lowering the gaze, commanded in the Noble Qur'an, mean?
Closing one's eyes completely while on the road
Turning one's gaze away and not looking at what Allah has forbidden

Allah Almighty said: قل للمؤمنين يغضوا من أبصارهم [Tell the believing men to reduce [some] of their vision[988] and guard their private parts.[989] That is purer for them. Indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of what they do.].
gemini-islamic-history-b2-001: Which Companion did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) call the Drawn Sword of Allah for his bravery?
He took the banner at Mutah and saved the army, so the Prophet gave him this title.
ihist-0008: Which Muslim commander led the Muslim army in the conquest of Al-Andalus?
Tariq ibn Ziyad crossed the sea in 92 AH to conquer Al-Andalus.
ihist-0013: Which Companion led the Muslim army in the conquest of Egypt during the caliphate of Umar ibn Al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him)?
Amr ibn Al-As led the Muslim armies to conquer Egypt and free it from Byzantine rule.
ihist-0015: Who was the envoy of Quraysh who negotiated with the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) to draw up the Treaty of Al-Hudaybiyah?
Quraysh sent Suhayl ibn Amr to conclude the treaty. He negotiated its terms with the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) until it was signed.
gemini-islamic-history-b2-018: Which physician discovered pulmonary circulation, preceding Western scholars by centuries?
He discovered the movement of blood between the heart and lungs and described it accurately.
gemini-islamic-history-b3-013: Which city was a world center for translating ancient Greek books into Arabic during the Abbasid era?
Baghdad, specifically Bayt Al-Hikmah (the House of Wisdom), was the heart of the scholarly translation movement.
gemini2-islamic-history-008: Which great city did Caliph Abu Jafar Al-Mansur build to serve as the Abbasid capital?
Al-Mansur ordered the building of Baghdad, Madinat As-Salam (the City of Peace), as a fortified seat of his caliphate.
gemini2-islamic-history-009: Which Andalusian city was famous for its great mosque and libraries and served as the capital of the Umayyad caliphate there?
Cordoba was a jewel of the world in its time and a center of cultural influence.
gemini2-islamic-history-003: What was the first major naval battle in which the Muslims defeated the Byzantines during the caliphate of Uthman ibn Affan?
Dhat As-Sawari took place in 31 AH in the Mediterranean, near the Anatolian coast. It was named for the large number of ships' masts.
ihist-0012: In which battle did the Muslim army first face the Byzantines and the three commanders Zayd, Jafar and Abdullah fall as martyrs?
Khalid ibn Al-Walid took the banner at Mutah after the three commanders were martyred and managed to withdraw the army safely.
ihist-0018: In which decisive battle did the Muslims, led by Khalid ibn Al-Walid, defeat the armies of the Byzantine Empire in Ash-Sham?
Al-Yarmuk was one of the most important battles that broke Byzantine power and paved the way for the conquest of Ash-Sham.
ihist-0022: In which major battle did the Seljuk commander Alp Arslan defeat the Byzantine armies, opening Anatolia to the Muslims?
The battle took place in 463 AH and was a major turning point that broke the power of the Byzantine Empire in Asia Minor.
ihist-0011: Which month begins the Islamic Hijri year?
During Umar ibn Al-Khattab's caliphate, the Companions agreed to make Al-Muharram the first month of the Hijri year.
ihist-0020: Which Hijri month comes immediately after Ramadan and includes the celebration of Eid Al-Fitr (the festival ending the fast)?
Eid Al-Fitr begins on the first day of Shawwal, marking the end of the obligatory Ramadan fast.
ihist-0023: In which blessed Hijri month do Muslims go to perform the obligatory hajj (pilgrimage) in Makkah Al-Mukarramah?
Dhul-Hijjah is the twelfth month of the Hijri calendar, during which the great hajj rites are performed.
ihist-0024: Which city became the first capital of the Islamic state after the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) migrated there?

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) established the Muslim community and its first state in Al-Madinah Al-Munawwarah (Yathrib), which continued as the capital for the Rightly Guided Caliphs.
gemini-islamic-history-001: What is the second month in the established order of the Hijri year?
The first Hijri months are Al-Muharram followed by Safar.
gemini-islamic-history-005: Which city did the commander Amr ibn Al-As (may Allah be pleased with him) found as Egypt's first Islamic capital?
Amr ibn Al-As built Al-Fustat after the conquest and built his famous mosque there, making it a new center and administrative capital.
gemini-islamic-history-b2-002: Which dynasty built Cairo and made it its capital?
The commander Jawhar As-Siqilli built it in 358 AH for the Fatimid caliph Al-Muizz li-Din Allah and named it Al-Qahirah.
gemini-islamic-history-b2-003: What were the schools founded by the vizier Nizam Al-Mulk in Baghdad and Nishapur to teach fiqh (Islamic jurisprudence) called?
Nizam Al-Mulk, the Seljuk vizier, founded them in the fifth Hijri century. Abu Hamid Al-Ghazali taught at the Nizamiyyah in Baghdad.
gemini-islamic-history-b2-004: What was the silver currency used by Muslims alongside the gold dinar?
The dinar was gold, the dirham silver and the fals copper. Abd Al-Malik ibn Marwan Arabized the minting of the dinar and dirham.
gemini-islamic-history-b2-011: Which Companion was known for his melodious voice and was Islam's first muadhdhin (caller to prayer)?
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) instructed him to make the adhan (call to prayer) because of the beauty and strength of his voice.
gemini-islamic-history-b3-001: Which city was the capital of the Persian empire of the Khosrows and was conquered by the Muslims?
Al-Madain was the capital of the Sasanian Persians and contained the Iwan of Khosrow. The Muslims conquered it in 16 AH after Al-Qadisiyyah.
gemini-islamic-history-b3-002: Which caliph built Kufa and Basra in Iraq as permanent garrisons for the Muslim armies?
He ordered the founding of garrison cities as military bases and settlements for the conquering soldiers.
gemini-islamic-history-b3-007: The Ottoman sultan Mehmed Al-Fatih (the Conqueror) received this title for conquering which great city?
He fulfilled the Prophetic glad tidings by conquering Constantinople (Istanbul) in 1453 CE.
gemini-islamic-history-b4-005: Which army did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) prepare before his death, and Abu Bakr dispatch to Ash-Sham?
The Army of Usamah ibn Zayd
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) appointed Usamah as commander while he was young. After the Prophet died, Abu Bakr insisted on dispatching the army despite the wars of apostasy.
gemini2-islamic-history-001: What was the first qiblah (prayer direction) toward which Muslims prayed before the noble Kabah?
The Muslims prayed toward Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa in Jerusalem for a time before the qiblah was changed.
gemini2-islamic-history-002: Which great event marks the starting point of the Muslims' Hijri calendar?
Caliph Umar ibn Al-Khattab adopted the hijrah as the starting point of Islamic dating.
gemini2-islamic-history-004: In which Hijri year did Granada, the Muslims' last stronghold in Al-Andalus, fall?
Granada fell in 897 AH, corresponding to 1492 CE, when Abu Abdullah As-Saghir surrendered, ending Islamic rule in Al-Andalus.
gemini2-islamic-history-005: Which great region did the commander Muhammad ibn Al-Qasim Ath-Thaqafi famously conquer as a young man?
He conquered Sindh, now in Pakistan, during the Umayyad era.
gemini2-islamic-history-006: Which two prophets raised the foundations of the noble Kabah in Makkah?

Allah Almighty said: وإذ يرفع إبراهيم القواعد من البيت وإسماعيل [And [mention] when Abraham was raising the foundations of the House and [with him] Ishmael, [saying], "Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing,[42] the Knowing.[43]].
gemini2-islamic-history-007: What was the name of the year in which Abrahah Al-Ashram attempted to demolish the noble Kabah?
The year was named for the huge elephants in his army.
gemini2-islamic-history-018: Which Mamluk sultan led the army that defeated the Mongols at the Battle of Ayn Jalut?
Qutuz united the ranks and led the Muslim army to stop the Mongol advance.
gemini2-islamic-history-019: Which people destroyed Baghdad and brought down the Abbasid caliphate there?
Hulagu and his Mongol army overran Baghdad in 656 AH.
gemini2-islamic-history-020: In which Hijri year did Baghdad, the seat of the Abbasid caliphate, fall to the Mongols?
That was the year the city was sacked and Caliph Al-Mustasim was killed.
ihist-0002: How many months are in the Hijri year?
ihist-0003: Which caliph brought the people together to pray tarawih (Ramadan night prayers) in congregation in the mosque?
Umar ibn Al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him).
ihist-0004: According to the well-known account, what was the first mosque built by the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
Masjid Quba was the first mosque the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) built during the hijrah (migration).
ihist-0005: In which city was Al-Masjid An-Nabawi (the Prophet's Mosque) built?
ihist-0006: What was the first major battle in which the Muslims were victorious?
ihist-0007: In which Hijri year did the Battle of Badr take place?
The second year after the hijrah (migration).
ihist-0010: In which Hijri year did the great conquest of Makkah take place, returning it to the Muslims?
The fifth year after the hijrah
The sixth year after the hijrah
The seventh year after the hijrah
The eighth year after the hijrah
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) entered Makkah as a conqueror in Ramadan of the eighth year after the hijrah (migration) and destroyed the idols around the Kabah.
ihist-0017: Which Islamic festival do Muslims celebrate immediately after completing the Ramadan fast?
It is called Eid Al-Fitr (the festival of breaking the fast) because it celebrates the completion of the blessing of fasting and the breaking of the fast on the first of Shawwal.
a1-geography-0001: In a false-color composite that assigns near-infrared to the red channel, how does active vegetation usually appear?
Necessarily in dark shades of blue
Healthy vegetation reflects a large amount of near-infrared radiation, so it appears red when that band is assigned to red.
a1-geography-0002: Which high-altitude city is the capital of Ecuador?
Quito is Ecuador's capital and lies high in the Andes.
a1-geography-0003: Which traditional boat is famous in Venice's canals?
The gondola is a long, narrow traditional boat used in Venice's canals.
a1-geography-0004: In which country is Sidi Bou Said, the village known for its white houses?
The blue-and-white village of Sidi Bou Said is near Tunis.
a1-geography-0005: In a slab avalanche, what first breaks away from the slope?
A cohesive layer that fractures above a weak layer
A cumulus cloud descending beneath the snow
A molten rock freezing in the air
A fracture propagates through a buried weak layer, causing the overlying slab to lose support and slide down the slope.
a1-geography-0006: Which reference system primarily underlies GPS coordinates?
The system's orbits and coordinates are expressed in the reference frame associated with the World Geodetic System 1984.
a1-geography-0007: What effect does Malaysia's Limbang district have on Brunei's territory?
It divides it into two disconnected parts
It gives it a land corridor to Thailand
It turns it entirely into an island
It gives it a direct border with the Philippines
Limbang lies between Brunei's larger western part and its eastern Temburong district, separating them by land.
a1-geography-0008: Which conditions favor radiation fog forming near the ground at night?
Clear skies, light winds and air close to saturation
Strong solar heating and violent winds
Dry air rapidly descending a mountain
Cloudy skies, violent winds and dry air
Nighttime radiation cools the ground under clear skies, while light winds limit mixing. If the air is moist, it reaches saturation and fog forms.
a1-geography-0012: How do multiple returns from a laser pulse help when surveying a forest?
They distinguish canopy and branch reflections from ground reflections
They make all trees the same height
They turn the laser into a thermal image
They remove the need to record pulse timing
Parts of a pulse may reflect from different levels within vegetation. Multiple returns therefore distinguish the upper structure from the ground.
a1-geography-0014: What produces auroral lights near the poles?
Desert dust burning over the sea
Solar particles guided by the magnetic field
City lights reflected by the Moon
The particles collide with atmospheric atoms and gases, exciting them. The gases then emit light in different colors.
a1-geography-0015: What does declination mean in navigation and mapping data?
The angle between a slope and the horizontal plane
The angle between true north and grid north
The angle between the Moon's path and the equator
The angle between true north and magnetic north
A compass needle points toward magnetic north, while a map is usually oriented toward true north. The angular difference between these directions is magnetic declination.
a1-geography-0018: Which Pacific island is famous for its moai statues?
The famous stone moai statues stand on Easter Island, also known as Rapa Nui.
a1-geography-0019: Which bilateral body coordinates the conservation of Lake Geneva between Switzerland and France?
The International Commission for the Protection of Lake Geneva's Waters
The International Commission for the Protection of Lake Geneva's Waters brings together the Swiss and French parties to monitor water quality in the lake and its basin.
a1-geography-0020: Why can a Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF display part of a huge image before the entire file is downloaded?
It allows requests for only the necessary tiles and byte ranges
It converts every pixel into a point feature
It removes georeferencing from the file
The format organizes tiles and resolution levels and supports requests for file ranges, so the client retrieves only the required area and resolution.
a1-geography-0021: When publishing a map using OpenStreetMap data, what visible obligation must be met?
Prevent any changes to the open data
Attribute the data to the project and its contributors and identify the database license
Attribute every feature solely to the map publisher
Remove contributors' names from all notices
The license permits copying and modification provided that attribution to the project and contributors is displayed and the availability of the data under the Open Database License is made clear.
a1-geography-0022: Which phenomenon usually causes population growth to continue for a time after fertility falls to replacement level?
Population momentum arises when young generations are large, keeping the number of people entering reproductive age high.
a1-geography-0023: Between which two landmasses does the Strait of Malacca lie?
The Arabian Peninsula and the Horn of Africa
The strait extends between the western coast of the Malay Peninsula and the eastern coast of Sumatra.
a1-geography-0025: The Yellow River's name is associated with which material carried abundantly in its waters?
Tributaries carry fine yellow loess sediments, giving the water its distinctive muddy color.
a1-geography-0026: Which London park contains the famous Serpentine lake?
The famous Serpentine lake is in London's Hyde Park.
a1-geography-0027: In a raster dataset, what does a cell marked NoData mean?
Its numerical value is necessarily zero
It contains the smallest valid value in the grid
No valid value is available at that location
It contains the arithmetic mean of neighboring cells
NoData means the value is missing or undefined at that location. Zero, however, can be a valid, intentional value.
a1-geography-0030: In Malaysia, what role was Putrajaya created to serve while Kuala Lumpur remained the national capital?
A legislative center independent of the federation
Putrajaya was planned to bring together federal ministries and administrative agencies, while Kuala Lumpur remained the national capital.
a1-geography-0031: Which two landmasses does the Strait of Georgia separate in western Canada?
Vancouver Island and mainland British Columbia
The Strait of Georgia lies between Vancouver Island's eastern coast and mainland British Columbia.
a1-geography-0033: Nine hundred and sixty of twelve hundred eligible units responded to a survey. What is the response rate?
The response rate equals the number of responding units divided by the number of eligible units, multiplied by one hundred. Nine hundred and sixty divided by twelve hundred equals eighty percent.
a1-geography-0034: Which large lake do ships traverse in the Panama Canal?
Ships cross Lake Gatun in the central section of the Panama Canal.
a1-geography-0035: Which inland city did Myanmar choose as its new capital?
Naypyidaw replaced Yangon as Myanmar's capital.
a1-geography-0036: In which city is the headquarters of the East African Community?
The East African Community states in its official information that its headquarters is in Arusha, Tanzania.
a1-geography-0038: Which basis for spatial assignment records a person where they usually live rather than where they are on census night?
The usual-residence approach records a person where they normally live, even if they are temporarily elsewhere.
a1-geography-0039: Which European capital does the Dnieper pass through before reaching the Black Sea?
The Dnieper passes through Ukraine's capital, Kyiv, then continues south to the Black Sea.
a1-geography-0040: Why might the number of conventional dwellings exceed the number of resident households in a region?
Some occupied dwellings contain more than one household
Some dwellings are vacant or seasonal
The number of households equals the number of separate rooms
The dwelling stock includes units that may be vacant or intended for seasonal or secondary use, whereas the resident-household count includes only groups that usually live there.
a1-geography-0041: The Torres Strait lies between northern Australia and which large island?
The Torres Strait lies between northern Australia and the island of New Guinea.
a1-geography-0042: Which term describes people moving from villages to cities?
Rural-to-urban migration is the movement of residence from rural areas toward towns and cities.
a1-geography-0046: Which river flows beside the Kasbah of the Udayas in Rabat?
The Kasbah of the Udayas stands at the mouth of the Bou Regreg in Rabat.
a1-geography-0047: A ring of light with an angular radius of about twenty-two degrees surrounds the Sun in a sky containing ice crystals. What is this phenomenon?
Ice crystals refract light at an angle of about twenty-two degrees, producing the most common ring around the Sun.
a1-geography-0048: When is a north arrow particularly important in map layout?
When the map has no colors
When city names are printed in small type
When the top of the page does not correspond to north
When its length and width are equal
The arrow explicitly indicates north. It is especially necessary when the map is rotated, so the top of the page does not automatically indicate north.
a1-geography-0049: Which language does Catalonia's Statute of Autonomy identify as the language of the Aran Valley, with official status in Catalonia?
Aranese is the name for the Occitan language in the Aran Valley. The Catalan legal framework recognizes it as an official language in Catalonia.
a1-geography-0050: During the polar summer, daylight may last twenty-four hours. Why?
Earth stops rotating on its axis
The Moon moves closer to the pole
City lights reflect off the ice
Earth's axial tilt as it orbits the Sun
The axial tilt points one pole toward the Sun during its summer, keeping the Sun's paths above the horizon for days or months.
a1-geography-0051: Which river flows out of Lake Baikal?
The Angara is the only river that flows out of Lake Baikal.
a1-geography-0053: Which weather phenomenon obscures visibility with sand in the desert?
A sandstorm carries large amounts of dust and sand that obscure visibility.
a1-geography-0054: In a map tile system, why is a separate grid defined for each scale level?
To convert coordinates into place names
To force each tile to represent a whole continent
To change feature locations with every zoom
To divide the area into regular cells whose tiles can be indexed
A tile matrix set divides the area into defined regular grids at multiple scales, allowing each tile to be identified and indexed.
a1-geography-0055: Why is the center of a tropical cyclone's eye relatively calmer than the eyewall?
Air descends in the eye, while the strongest updrafts and winds surround it
The eye has no air pressure at all
The eye is characterized by relatively descending, warmer air, while convection and the strongest winds are concentrated in the eyewall.
a1-geography-0056: Which ancient geographical term denotes the inhabited part of Earth's surface?
The ecumene means the parts of the world permanently inhabited by humans.
a1-geography-0057: Which strait separates Tierra del Fuego from mainland South America?
The Strait of Magellan separates the Tierra del Fuego archipelago from mainland South America.
a1-geography-0058: What is the main climatic reason tall trees are naturally absent from the tundra?
A short growing season, cold and permafrost
Heavy tropical rainfall throughout the year
Cold, frozen soil and a short summer limit root depth and tree growth.
a1-geography-0059: Why does the Okavango form an inland delta rather than a marine delta?
It freezes at its mouth in the Arctic Ocean
It becomes a glacier before reaching the coast
It flows directly into a deep ocean trench
Its waters spread through the Kalahari Basin without reaching the sea
The Okavango branches within the closed Kalahari Basin, spreading its waters through wetlands rather than reaching a sea coast.
a1-geography-0060: Which Parisian island contains Notre-Dame Cathedral?
Notre-Dame Cathedral stands on the Ile de la Cite in the heart of old Paris.
a1-geography-0061: Into how many longitudinal zones is the world divided in the Universal Transverse Mercator system?
The system divides Earth into 60 zones, each spanning six degrees of longitude.
a1-geography-0062: Which river separates northern Portugal from Galicia?
The Minho forms part of the northern border between Portugal and Spain.
a1-geography-0065: Why is the American Global Positioning System not a synonym for all satellite navigation systems?
Because satellite navigation does not use satellites
Because the American system only measures altitude
Because it is one constellation among several national constellations worldwide
Because all countries operate the same American constellation
The American system is a specific constellation, whereas the general global term includes American, European, Chinese, Russian and other constellations.
a1-geography-0066: What is the common name for Cappadocia's conical rock pillars?
Cappadocia's conical rock pillars are known as fairy chimneys.
a1-geography-0068: In which year did Gerardus Mercator publish his world map with its famous projection?
Mercator's world navigation map was published in 1569, popularizing the projection that bears his name.
a1-geography-0069: Why do lahars usually follow valleys and river channels?
Because upper winds push them against gravity toward summits
Because the mixture of water and volcanic debris flows downhill into low areas
Because their components evaporate before reaching any low area
Because the magnetic field confines them above ridges
A lahar is a dense mixture of water and volcanic material that moves under gravity, so the terrain channels it into valleys and drainage channels.
a1-geography-0071: Nine hundred deaths were recorded among three hundred thousand people in one year. What is the crude death rate?
Divide nine hundred by three hundred thousand, then multiply by one thousand: the result is three deaths per thousand people.
a1-geography-0072: What distinguishes seasonal pastoral transhumance from permanent migration?
Crossing international borders on every journey
Severing ties with the place of departure
Returning periodically between pastures associated with the seasons
Pastoral transhumance follows a recurring cycle between seasonal pastures, unlike a permanent change of residence.
a1-geography-0073: In a dispute over the location of a property boundary, what information should be consulted on a cadastral map?
Only the color of underground rocks
The average rainfall over the parcel
The parcel's boundaries and its identifier linked to the land register
A cadastral map documents the division of land into parcels, each parcel's boundaries and its identifier linked to the property rights register.
a1-geography-0074: Which cold current contributes to the extreme aridity of the Atacama Desert along Chile?
The Humboldt Current cools coastal air and promotes atmospheric stability and temperature inversions, reducing rainfall despite the fog.
a1-geography-0075: Which two major rivers meet near the Australian town of Wentworth?
The Darling River meets the Murray River at Wentworth.
a1-geography-0076: Why add a spot height to a summit already shown by contour lines?
To eliminate the need for a map scale
To show north at the summit
To identify the rock type from the line color
To give the summit's elevation as a direct number rather than an approximate range
A spot height records the value at a specific location, whereas a summit without a direct number is read within the intervals between contour lines.
a1-geography-0077: A street is closed in an ambulance network model. What is the expected result when the fastest route is recalculated?
The longest route is chosen regardless of time
The closed route remains mandatory in every result
An alternative route is selected based on the costs of available links
Network analysis searches again among available links and their costs, avoiding the closed link and selecting a suitable alternative.
a1-geography-0078: What is a city called when it far surpasses the country's other cities in population and functions?
A primate city dominates the national urban system in size and influence, clearly exceeding the next largest city.
a1-geography-0079: Basel, Weil am Rhein and Huningue coordinate planning in a project linking Swiss, German and French cities. What pattern does this represent?
The Dreiland project brings together neighboring cities in Switzerland, Germany and France to coordinate urban development, transport and open spaces across borders.
a1-geography-0080: Which large rectangular park stretches through the middle of Manhattan Island?
Central Park extends as a large green space through the middle of Manhattan.
a1-geography-0082: When is the tidal range usually greatest during the lunar month?
When the directions of the Sun and Moon form a right angle at a quarter moon
When a distant planet passes behind the Sun
When the Sun, Earth and Moon align at a full or new moon
The gravitational pulls of the Sun and Moon combine when aligned, producing spring tides with the greatest range.
a1-geography-0083: Which extensive Kenyan park is known for its herds of red-colored elephants?
Tsavo's elephants look red when they cover their bodies with the area's red soil.
a1-geography-0084: Why is air temperature alone insufficient to explain the formation of a tropical cyclone over the sea?
Because it depends on towering mountains in the middle of the ocean
Because it requires the Earth to stop rotating
Because it also needs deep warm water, moisture and weak wind shear
Because it forms only over frozen water
Warm water supplies latent energy, while moisture and low wind shear help organize deep circulation.
a1-geography-0085: Which river is named after a color and passes through Vietnam's capital?
Hanoi lies on the bank of the Red River in northern Vietnam.
a1-geography-0086: Which desert animal appears on Namibia's coat of arms?
A gemsbok stands on each side of Namibia's coat of arms.
a1-geography-0087: Which Alpine animal has long horns curving backward?
The Alpine ibex has long curved horns and lives in the mountains.
a1-geography-0088: What is the main objective of the Tehran Convention concerning the Caspian Sea?
Protecting its environment from pollution and conserving its living resources
Abolishing land borders between its parties
Creating a common currency for the coastal states
The convention provides for protecting the Caspian Sea environment from all sources of pollution, while conserving, restoring and sustainably using its living resources.
a1-geography-0090: Which country is Qatar's only land neighbor?
Qatar occupies a peninsula in the Gulf and is connected by land only to Saudi Arabia along its southern border.
a1-geography-0091: What agricultural role does the Indus Basin system play in Pakistan?
It confines farming to a coastal strip dependent on tides
It supplies saline water used only for navigation
It feeds an extensive contiguous irrigation network supporting most food production
It prevents water transfer from rivers to agricultural plains
The Indus Basin contains the world's largest contiguous irrigation network, supporting the agriculture that provides most of Pakistan's food.
a1-geography-0092: How does the Tibetan Plateau's elevation affect Asia's climate on a broad scale?
It stops the cycle of night and day over the continent
It isolates the Atlantic Ocean from the Mediterranean Sea
It turns all Asian rivers into closed basins
Heating of its elevated surface helps modify monsoon circulation
The plateau's great elevation and the heating of its vast surface influence pressure gradients and seasonal circulation over Asia.
a1-geography-0093: Which small Brazilian monkey has orange fur around its face like a mane?
The golden lion tamarin has orange fur surrounding its face like a mane.
a1-geography-0094: Why was the binational Lake Titicaca authority established between Peru and Bolivia?
To abolish navigation on all rivers in the basin
To move the border to the ocean coast
To coordinate joint management of the basin's waters
To place the lake under a third country's administration
The binational authority coordinates management of the Titicaca, Desaguadero, Poopo and Salar de Coipasa system and its shared water resources.
a1-geography-0097: Why did James Cook's team time the transit of Venus from Tahiti in seventeen sixty-nine?
To help calculate the distance between Earth and the Sun
To determine how long the Sun takes to rotate on its axis
To measure the Moon's diameter from its shadow on Earth
To discover new moons around Venus
Comparing transit timings from widely separated locations on Earth makes it possible to calculate the distance between Earth and the Sun. Cook attempted the measurement from Tahiti.
a1-geography-0098: What measure paved the way for the forced removal of District Six residents in Cape Town?
Expanding it through a participatory housing program
Declaring it a whites-only area under the Group Areas Act
Incorporating it into a new commercial port
Voluntarily converting it into a rural reserve
District Six was declared a whites-only area in 1966 under the Group Areas Act during apartheid, after which tens of thousands of its residents were forcibly removed.
a1-geography-0099: Why does calm water often look dark in a radar image?
Because calm waves emit weak visible light
Because water prevents the satellite from sending any pulse
Because its smooth surface reflects most energy away from the antenna
Because radar records the color blue as black
A smooth surface produces specular reflection away from the sensor, weakening the return signal and making the water appear dark.
a1-geography-0100: When does a volcanic caldera usually form?
When a breeze blows over a dune
When the roof collapses after much of the magma chamber has emptied
When a river builds a silt dam
When rain dissolves a small cave
After a massive eruption and magma withdrawal, the overlying rocks may no longer remain supported and collapse inward.
a1-geography-0101: Which biogeographical boundary passes between Bali and Lombok through the Lombok Strait?
The Wallace Line passes between Bali and Lombok, marking a prominent boundary between predominantly Asian and predominantly Australian animal groups.
a1-geography-0102: Sapporo is on Hokkaido in northern Japan.
a1-geography-0104: Which observation did Eratosthenes use to estimate the Earth's circumference?
The number of stars visible in one night
The difference in sea color between two ports
The difference in the angle of the Sun's shadow between two cities
He compared the Sun's angle in Alexandria with its known overhead position in Syene, then related the difference to the distance between them.
a1-geography-0105: If the center of population moves west between two censuses, what does that indicate?
A change in the direction of lines of longitude
The movement of all residents westward
A reduction in the country's area from the east
Relatively stronger growth west of the previous center
The center of population is a weighted balance point, so it moves toward the side whose relative population weight increases. This does not mean everyone has moved there.
a1-geography-0106: Which Turkish lake contains Akdamar Island with its ancient church?
Akdamar Island and its stone church are in Lake Van in eastern Turkey.
a1-geography-0107: Which American island contains Mauna Loa volcano?
Mauna Loa volcano is on the Big Island of Hawaii.
a1-geography-0108: What is the spatial relationship between Iguazu and Iguacu national parks?
Two reserves within one country that do not touch
Two agricultural areas without legal protection
Two adjacent reserves on opposite sides of the Argentine-Brazilian border
Two commercial ports on opposite riverbanks
Argentina's Iguazu National Park and Brazil's Iguacu National Park adjoin across the border, forming a continuous area of protected forest around the waterfalls.
a1-geography-0109: What is a rocky peak rising above an ice sheet, with ice surrounding it on all sides, called?
A nunatak is a mountain peak or rocky outcrop that projects through the ice cover and remains exposed above it.
a1-geography-0110: What urban use was designated for Berlin's Tempelhof Airport grounds after flights ceased?
A large public park for recreation and sport
Tempelhof Airport closed in 2008, and its grounds and runways opened to the public in 2010 as a large park for sport and recreation.
a1-geography-0111: What do closely spaced contour lines on a slope indicate?
When contour lines are close together, elevation changes rapidly over a short horizontal distance.
a1-geography-0113: Which river separates Russia's Ivangorod from its Estonian neighbor?
Narva and Ivangorod stand on opposite banks of the Narva River.
a1-geography-0114: A sensor records four thousand and ninety-six intensity levels instead of two hundred and fifty-six. What is the benefit?
Always reducing the ground cell area
Distinguishing smaller differences in recorded energy
Necessarily increasing the number of spectral bands
More recording levels provide finer intensity gradations, improving radiometric discrimination between similar signals.
a1-geography-0115: What is a group of people who experienced the same demographic event during the same period called?
A population cohort shares an event and its timing, such as everyone born in a particular year.
a1-geography-0116: What is the delta region built by the Rhone before it enters the Mediterranean Sea called?
In southern France, the Rhone branches around the Camargue wetlands before entering the Mediterranean.
a1-geography-0117: Which strait connects the Aegean Sea to the Sea of Marmara?
The Dardanelles Strait connects the Aegean Sea to the Sea of Marmara.
a1-geography-0119: Over which surface do large hurricanes form near hot regions?
Large tropical cyclones form over warm ocean waters.
a1-geography-0120: Which two land areas are separated by the Menai Strait?
The Isle of Wight and mainland England
The Isle of Man and mainland Ireland
