Al-Dhahabi says that his name was al-Hubab, after whom his father took his kunya (name beginning with Abu). The Prophet changed his name to Abd Allah.
sahaba-0129: Which son of Abu Jahl, when swearing a solemn oath, would say: «لا والذي نجّاني يوم بدر» [No, by the One who saved me on the day of Badr]?
Al-Dhahabi quotes Ibn Abi Mulayka saying that when Ikrima swore a solemn oath, he would say: «لا والذي نجاني يوم بدر» [No, by the One who saved me on the day of Badr].
sahaba-0130: Which Companion was called Yazid al-Khayr (Yazid the Good) and was the brother of Umm al-Muminin (Mother of the Believers) Umm Habiba?
Al-Dhahabi says that Yazid ibn Abi Sufyan was also called Yazid al-Khayr (Yazid the Good) and was the brother of Umm al-Muminin (Mother of the Believers) Umm Habiba.
sahaba-0131: By which epithet was Abu al-As ibn al-Rabi, the Prophet's son-in-law, known?
Dhu al-Shimalayn (the man of two left hands)
Al-Dhahabi says that Abu al-As was called Jarw al-Batha (Young Lion of al-Batha).
sahaba-0132: Which Companion who fought at Badr had his staff light up one night while returning home from the Messenger of Allah, and had embraced Islam through Musab ibn Umayr?
Al-Dhahabi says of Abbad ibn Bishr that his staff lit up one night as he returned home ... and that he embraced Islam through Musab ibn Umayr.
sahaba-0133: The father of one of the representatives at al-Aqaba was a respected leader whom people obeyed, called Hudayr al-Kataib. Who was his Companion son?
Usayd ibn al-Hudayr's biography states that his father was a respected leader whom people obeyed, called Hudayr al-Kataib.
sahaba-0134: By which epithet was al-Tufayl ibn Amr al-Dawsi known?
Dhu al-Yadayn (the man of two hands)
Dhu al-Shahadatayn (the man whose testimony counts as two)
Dhu al-Janahayn (the man of two wings)
Al-Dhahabi says that al-Tufayl was called Dhu al-Nur (the man of light) and embraced Islam in Mecca before the Hijra (migration).
sahaba-0135: Which blind Companion was among the early Muhajirun (Emigrants) and served alongside Bilal as a muezzin (caller to prayer) for the Messenger of Allah?
Al-Dhahabi describes Ibn Umm Maktum as one of the early Muhajirun (Emigrants), a blind man who served alongside Bilal as a muezzin (caller to prayer) for the Messenger of Allah.
sahaba-0136: Khalid ibn al-Walid was the son of the sister of which Mother of the Believers?
Al-Dhahabi identifies him as Abu Sulayman al-Qurashi al-Makhzumi al-Makki, the son of the sister of Umm al-Muminin (Mother of the Believers) Maymuna bint al-Harith.
sahaba-0137: Why was al-Miqdad ibn Amr called al-Miqdad ibn al-Aswad?
Because his father Amr was nicknamed al-Aswad
Because he belonged to a tribe called Banu al-Aswad
Because al-Aswad ibn Abd Yaghuth raised and adopted him
Because the Prophet gave him that name at Badr
Al-Dhahabi says that he was called al-Miqdad ibn al-Aswad because he was raised in the care of al-Aswad ibn Abd Yaghuth al-Zuhri, who adopted him.
sahaba-0138: By which title is Ubayy ibn Kab described in Siyar Alam al-Nubala?
Al-Dhahabi identifies him as Ubayy ibn Kab ... Sayyid al-Qurra (Master of Quran Reciters), Abu Mundhir al-Ansari al-Najjari.
sahaba-0139: To which Arab tribe did the Companion Abd Allah ibn Masud belong?
Al-Dhahabi describes him as the imam, learned scholar and jurist of the community, Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Hudhali al-Makki, an Emigrant and participant at Badr, allied to Banu Zuhra.
sahaba-0140: What was the kunya (name beginning with Abu) of Muadh ibn Jabal, may Allah be pleased with him?
Al-Dhahabi identifies him as the leader and imam Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Ansari al-Khazraji al-Madani, a participant at Badr.
sahaba-0141: Muadh ibn Jabal witnessed the pledge of al-Aqaba at a young age. How did al-Dhahabi describe him at that time?
A married man with a child
A middle-aged man whose hair had turned gray
Al-Dhahabi says that Muadh witnessed al-Aqaba as a beardless young man.
sahaba-0142: When one of his brothers died, Ibn Masud wept and said: «أخي وصاحبي مع رسول الله ﷺ» [My brother and my companion with the Messenger of Allah]. Who was he?
Al-Siyar states that Utba ibn Masud al-Hudhali migrated to Abyssinia. His son Abd Allah said: When my father died, Ibn Masud wept and said: «أخي وصاحبي» [My brother and my companion].
sahaba-0143: Which Companion who fought at Badr settled in Jerusalem, was one of the representatives on the night of al-Aqaba, and had the kunya (name beginning with Abu) Abu al-Walid?
Al-Dhahabi identifies him as Ubada ibn al-Samit ... Abu al-Walid al-Ansari, one of the representatives on the night of al-Aqaba and a prominent participant at Badr, who settled in Jerusalem.
sahaba-0144: Which Companion did the Prophet send as his envoy with a letter to Kisra (the Persian emperor)?
Al-Dhahabi says that Abd Allah ibn Hudhafa was one of the early Muslims, migrated to Abyssinia, and was sent by the Prophet as an envoy to Kisra (the Persian emperor).
sahaba-0146: Which freedman of the Messenger of Allah was a Copt from Egypt, had been a slave of al-Abbas who gave him to the Prophet, and was freed after bringing the Prophet news of al-Abbas's acceptance of Islam?

Al-Dhahabi identifies him as Abu Rafi, freedman of the Messenger of Allah, a Copt from Egypt ... He had been a slave of al-Abbas, who gave him to the Prophet. When he brought the Prophet news that al-Abbas had embraced Islam, the Prophet freed him.
sahaba-0147: Why was Suhayb ibn Sinan known as al-Rumi?
Because he took part in the conquest of Byzantine lands
Because he embraced Islam through a Byzantine monk
Because he lived in Byzantine territory for a time
Al-Dhahabi says that Suhayb was known as al-Rumi because he lived in Byzantine territory for a time, although he was from al-Jazira (Upper Mesopotamia).
sahaba-0148: To which Arab tribe did Suhayb ibn Sinan, known as al-Rumi, belong?
Al-Dhahabi identifies him as Suhayb ibn Sinan, Abu Yahya al-Namiri, from al-Namir ibn Qasit.
sahaba-0149: What was the name of Abu Talha al-Ansari, Umm Sulaym's husband?
Al-Dhahabi says that Abu Talha's name was Zayd ibn Sahl ibn al-Aswad ibn Haram ... al-Khazraji al-Najjari.
sahaba-0150: Abu Burda ibn Niyar, who fought at Badr, was the maternal uncle of which famous Companion?
Al-Dhahabi says that Abu Burda ibn Niyar's name was Hani and that he was al-Bara ibn Azib's maternal uncle.
sahaba-0151: Al-Ash'ath ibn Qays al-Kindi's name was Ma'di Karib. Why was he called al-Ash'ath?
Because he had abundant facial hair
Because his hair was always disheveled
Because his father bore that nickname
Because he suffered a head wound at al-Yarmuk
Al-Dhahabi said that al-Ash'ath's name was Ma'di Karib, and that his hair was always disheveled, so this nickname became predominant.
sahaba-0152: Which Companion who fought at Badr was the Prophet's envoy to al-Muqawqis, ruler of Egypt, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?

Al-Dhahabi described Hatib as a famous Muhajir (emigrant) who attended Badr and the other campaigns, and was the Prophet's envoy to al-Muqawqis, ruler of Egypt, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet.
sahaba-0153: What was Abu Dharr al-Ghifari's name, according to the well-known view adopted by al-Dhahabi?
Al-Dhahabi identified him as Abu Dharr Jundub ibn Junadah al-Ghifari, also said to be Jundub ibn Sakan, and cited al-Dimyati's identification of him as Jundub ibn Junadah.
sahaba-0154: Which ascetic Ansari Companion governed Damascus and Homs for Umar and was called 'one of a kind'?
Al-Dhahabi described Umayr ibn Sa'd al-Ansari al-Awsi as an ascetic, one of a kind, who witnessed the conquest of al-Sham and governed Damascus and Homs for Umar.
sahaba-0155: What was the name of Umm Ayman, the Prophet's nurse and freedwoman, peace and blessings be upon him?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Umm Ayman al-Habashiyyah, the Messenger of Allah's freedwoman and nurse, was named Barakah, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0156: Zayd ibn Harithah married Umm Ayman, the Prophet's nurse, and she bore him which famous Companion, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?
Siyar states that Zayd ibn Harithah married her around the time the Prophet was commissioned, and she bore him Usamah ibn Zayd, beloved of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0157: Which paternal aunt of the Prophet is unanimously agreed by scholars to have accepted Islam, peace and blessings be upon him?
There is agreement that Safiyyah bint Abd al-Muttalib accepted Islam and emigrated. Whether Atikah and Arwa accepted Islam is disputed.
sahaba-0158: Which female Companion participated at al-Aqabah, Uhud, al-Hudaybiyah, Hunayn and al-Yamamah, and lost her hand in jihad (fighting in Allah's cause)?
Al-Dhahabi said that Umm Umarah Nusaybah bint Ka'b attended the night of al-Aqabah, Uhud, al-Hudaybiyah, Hunayn and al-Yamamah, and that her hand was cut off in jihad (fighting in Allah's cause).
sahaba-0159: Which female Companion emigrated with her husband Ja'far al-Tayyar to Abyssinia and bore him Abdullah, Muhammad and Awn there?
Al-Dhahabi said that Asma bint Umays emigrated with her husband Ja'far al-Tayyar to Abyssinia, where she bore him Abdullah, Muhammad and Awn.
sahaba-0160: In what respect did al-Dhahabi describe Asma bint Abi Bakr as 'the last'?
The last of Banu Taym to accept Islam
The last female emigrant to die
The last to narrate from the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him
The last to pledge allegiance beneath the tree
Siyar describes Asma as the mother of the caliph Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr, sister of Aishah, Mother of the Believers, and the last female emigrant to die.
sahaba-0162: On the day of the conquest, the Prophet entered a female cousin's home and prayed eight rak'ahs (prayer units) of Duha there. Who was she, peace and blessings be upon him?
Al-Dhahabi said that the Prophet entered Umm Hani's home on the day of the conquest and prayed eight rak'ahs (prayer units) of Duha (forenoon prayer) there, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0163: What was the name of Umm al-Fadl, wife of al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Umm al-Fadl bint al-Harith al-Hilaliyyah, wife of al-Abbas, was named Lubabah.
sahaba-0164: Which female Companion was Anas ibn Malik's maternal aunt and Ubadah ibn al-Samit's wife?
Al-Dhahabi described Umm Haram bint Milhan as Umm Sulaym's sister, Anas ibn Malik's maternal aunt and Ubadah ibn al-Samit's wife.
sahaba-0165: Which female Companion, a scholar of fiqh (Islamic jurisprudence), washed Zaynab, daughter of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him?

Al-Dhahabi described Umm Atiyyah al-Ansariyyah as one of the Companions versed in fiqh (Islamic jurisprudence), and as the woman who washed Zaynab, the Prophet's daughter, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0166: Which female emigrant Companion narrated the hadith on housing and maintenance for an irrevocably divorced woman and the account of al-Jassasah?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Fatimah bint Qays al-Fihriyyah narrated the hadith on housing and maintenance for an irrevocably divorced woman, as well as the account of al-Jassasah.
sahaba-0167: Which Ansari Companion did Umar ibn al-Khattab appoint over the kharaj (land tax) of al-Sawad and order to survey its land?
Siyar cites Abu Mijlaz's report that Umar assigned Uthman ibn Hunayf to the kharaj (land tax) of al-Sawad and ordered him to survey the land.
sahaba-0168: To which tribe did Khabbab ibn al-Aratt belong, may Allah be pleased with him?
Al-Dhahabi identified Khabbab ibn al-Aratt ibn Jandalah as belonging to Tamim, with the kunyah (parental byname) Abu Yahya al-Tamimi.
sahaba-0169: Who commanded the archers at Uhud?
Al-Dhahabi said that the Messenger of Allah appointed Abdullah ibn Jubayr over the fifty archers that day, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0170: How many archers did the Prophet place under Abdullah ibn Jubayr's command at Uhud, peace and blessings be upon him?
Abdullah ibn Jubayr's biography in Siyar states that he commanded the archers, who numbered fifty men.
sahaba-0172: Qatadah ibn al-Nu'man al-Zafari, a veteran of Badr, was the maternal half-brother of which famous Companion?
Al-Dhahabi said that Qatadah ibn al-Nu'man was Abu Sa'id al-Khudri's maternal half-brother.
sahaba-0173: What is the well-known name of Abu al-Darda al-Ansari?
Al-Dhahabi identified him as Abu al-Darda Uwaymir ibn Zayd ibn Qays, also said to be Uwaymir ibn Amir.
sahaba-0174: Which Companion did al-Dhahabi call 'the sage of this ummah (Muslim community)' and identify as the judge of Damascus?
Siyar describes Abu al-Darda as the judge of Damascus, the sage of this ummah (Muslim community), and the leading Quran reciter in Damascus.
sahaba-0175: Which Companion conquered al-Jazirah by treaty and was appointed by Abu Ubaydah to succeed him over al-Sham as he lay dying?
Al-Dhahabi said that Iyad ibn Ghanm was appointed over al-Sham by his relative Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah as the latter lay dying, and that he conquered al-Jazirah by treaty.
sahaba-0176: What was the name of al-Yaman, Hudhayfah's father, may Allah be pleased with them both?
Al-Dhahabi stated that al-Yaman's name was Hisl, also given as Husayl, ibn Jabir al-Absi.
sahaba-0177: Who arrived with the Thaqif delegation in year nine as its youngest member, and was appointed its leader by the Prophet for his intelligence and eagerness for good, peace and blessings be upon him?

Al-Dhahabi said that Uthman ibn Abi al-As al-Thaqafi came with the Thaqif delegation, whose members accepted Islam. He was appointed their leader because of his evident intelligence, although he was the youngest delegate.
sahaba-0180: What was Abu Musa al-Ash'ari's name, may Allah be pleased with him?
Al-Dhahabi identified him as Abu Musa al-Ash'ari Abdullah ibn Qays ibn Sulaym ibn Huddar.
sahaba-0181: What was the name of Abu Ayyub al-Ansari, with whom the Prophet stayed among Banu al-Najjar, peace and blessings be upon him?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Abu Ayyub al-Ansari's name was Khalid ibn Zayd ibn Kulayb, of Banu al-Najjar.
sahaba-0182: Al-Dhahabi described Zayd ibn Thabit as 'the leading authority among Quran reciters and ...', as well as Madinah's mufti and a scribe of revelation. What completes the description?
Al-Dhahabi described him as a great imam, the leading authority among Quran reciters and scholars of inheritance shares, Madinah's mufti (scholar issuing legal opinions), and a scribe of revelation.
sahaba-0183: From which Companion did the Prophet relate the account of al-Jassasah concerning al-Dajjal from the pulpit, peace and blessings be upon him?
Al-Dhahabi said that Tamim al-Dari came in year nine and accepted Islam, and that the Prophet related his account of al-Jassasah from the pulpit, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0184: Which Companion was known as 'the horseman of the Messenger of Allah', peace and blessings be upon him?
Al-Dhahabi described Abu Qatadah al-Ansari al-Sulami as the horseman of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0186: Shaddad ibn Aws al-Ansari was the nephew of which Companion poet?
Al-Dhahabi said that Shaddad was the nephew of Hassan ibn Thabit, poet of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0187: Which Companion settled in Marw in Khurasan and spread knowledge there, and carried Usamah's standard during the expedition to al-Balqa?
Al-Dhahabi said that Buraydah ibn al-Husayb carried commander Usamah's standard when he campaigned in al-Balqa, and that he settled in Marw and spread knowledge.
sahaba-0188: Who was Abu Bakr al-Siddiq's eldest son and killed seven of the enemy's leading men at al-Yamamah?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakr was al-Siddiq's eldest child and killed seven of their leading men at al-Yamamah.
sahaba-0189: Which early Companion and veteran of Badr sheltered the Prophet in his house near al-Safa, peace and blessings be upon him?
Al-Dhahabi said that the Prophet concealed himself in al-Arqam ibn Abi al-Arqam's house near al-Safa, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0190: Which Companion versed in fiqh (Islamic jurisprudence) narrated a famous hadith describing the Prophet's prayer, and whose name is variously given as Abd al-Rahman or al-Mundhir ibn Sa'd, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?
Al-Dhahabi said that Abu Humayd al-Sa'idi narrated a hadith describing how the Messenger of Allah prayed, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0191: Which Companion scribe wrote for the Prophet, then Abu Bakr and Umar, and was appointed by Umar over the bayt al-mal (public treasury), peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?

Al-Dhahabi said that Abdullah ibn al-Arqam al-Zuhri, the scribe, wrote for the Prophet, then for Abu Bakr and Umar, who appointed him over the bayt al-mal (public treasury), peace and blessings be upon the Prophet.
sahaba-0193: By what title was Khuzaymah ibn Thabit al-Ansari known?
Al-Dhahabi identified Khuzaymah ibn Thabit, Abu Umarah al-Ansari al-Khatmi al-Madani, as Dhu al-Shahadatayn (the man whose testimony counted as that of two).
sahaba-0194: Which Companion kept the Prophet's seal and later administered the bayt al-mal (public treasury) for Umar, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?
Al-Dhahabi said that Mu'ayqib was entrusted with the Prophet's seal and administered the bayt al-mal (public treasury) for Umar, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet.
sahaba-0196: Which Companion, known by the kunyah (parental byname) Abu Nujayd, served as judge of Basra after Umar sent him there to teach its people fiqh (Islamic jurisprudence)?
Al-Dhahabi said that Imran ibn Husayn served as judge of Basra, and that Umar had sent him to its people to teach them fiqh (Islamic jurisprudence).
sahaba-0197: Of which poet of the Messenger of Allah did Ibn Sa'd say that he lived sixty years in the Jahiliyyah (pre-Islamic era) and sixty in Islam, peace and blessings be upon the Messenger?
Hassan ibn Thabit's biography cites Ibn Sa'd as saying that he lived sixty years in the Jahiliyyah (pre-Islamic era) and sixty in Islam.
sahaba-0198: Which poet and Companion of the Messenger of Allah was one of the three left behind whose repentance Allah accepted, peace and blessings be upon the Messenger?
Al-Dhahabi described Ka'b ibn Malik as the Messenger of Allah's poet and Companion, and one of the three left behind whose repentance Allah accepted, peace and blessings be upon the Messenger.
sahaba-0199: Which Companion who fought at Badr captured al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib there?
Al-Dhahabi identified Abu al-Yasar Ka'b ibn Amr al-Ansari as a participant at Badr and al-Aqabah who captured al-Abbas at Badr.
sahaba-0200: Which Companion did the Prophet send with his letter to the ruler of Busra to forward to Heraclius, peace and blessings be upon him?
Al-Dhahabi described Dihyah al-Kalbi as the Prophet's Companion and envoy with his letter to the ruler of Busra to forward to Heraclius, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet.
sahaba-0201: To which Companion did the Prophet say «يا عبد الرحمن، لا تسأل الإمارة» [O Abd al-Rahman, do not ask for a position of authority], who accepted Islam on the day of the conquest and led a campaign in Sijistan, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?

Al-Dhahabi said that Abd al-Rahman ibn Samurah campaigned in Sijistan as army commander, and was the one to whom the Messenger of Allah said «يا عبد الرحمن، لا تسأل الإمارة» [O Abd al-Rahman, do not ask for a position of authority], peace and blessings be upon him. The prohibition's English wording is from (HadeethEnc); the source shortens the name in the quotation.
sahaba-0202: Of whom did Ibn Sa'd say: We know of no other Companion with the kunyah (parental byname) Abu Ali?
In Ma'qil ibn Yasar's biography, al-Dhahabi cited Muhammad ibn Sa'd as saying that he knew of no other Companion with the kunyah (parental byname) Abu Ali.
sahaba-0203: Which name for Abu Hurayrah did al-Dhahabi consider the strongest view, may Allah be pleased with him?
Al-Dhahabi said that there were many views concerning his name, the strongest being Abd al-Rahman ibn Sakhr.
sahaba-0204: Which Companion lowered himself from al-Ta'if's fortress using a pulley, fled to the Prophet and accepted Islam, acquiring his kunyah (parental byname) from this event, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?

Al-Dhahabi stated that Abu Bakrah al-Thaqafi's name was Nufay' ibn al-Harith, and that during the siege of al-Ta'if he lowered himself using a pulley and fled to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0205: To which Companion from Banu Abd al-Dar did the Prophet hand the Ka'bah's key on the day of the conquest, peace and blessings be upon him?
Al-Dhahabi said that the Prophet handed Uthman ibn Talhah, custodian of the House, the Ka'bah's key on the day of the conquest, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0206: Who pledged to the Messenger of Allah never to ask anyone for anything in return for a guarantee of Paradise, and thereafter asked no one for anything, peace and blessings be upon the Messenger?
Abu Rafi', freedman of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him
Thawban, freedman of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him
Safinah, freedman of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him
Anas ibn Malik, servant of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him

Thawban's biography quotes: «من تكفل لي أن لا يسأل أحدًا شيئًا وأتكفل له بالجنة؟» [Who can guarantee for me that he will never ask people for something, and I will guarantee Paradise for him?] Thawban answered that he would, and thereafter asked no one for anything (HadeethEnc).
sahaba-0207: Which Companion and commander conquered Khurasan, and whose father Amir was a son of the Messenger of Allah's paternal aunt, peace and blessings be upon the Messenger?
Al-Dhahabi identified Abdullah ibn Amir ibn Kurayz as the commander who conquered Khurasan.
sahaba-0208: Of whom did Ibn Mandah say that he was born inside the Ka'bah and lived 120 years, and who was Khadijah's nephew?
Hakim ibn Hizam's biography cites Ibn Mandah as saying that Hakim was born inside the Ka'bah and lived 120 years. Khadijah was his paternal aunt.
sahaba-0209: When Umar saw wrongdoing, he would say: 'As long as I and ... live, this shall not happen.' Which Companion did he name alongside himself?

Al-Dhahabi cited al-Zuhri as saying that Hisham ibn Hakim enjoined right and forbade wrong, and that when Umar saw wrongdoing he would say that it would not happen as long as he and Hisham ibn Hakim lived.
sahaba-0210: Who was in ihram (ritual consecration) at al-Hudaybiyah when lice fell onto his face, occasioning revelation of the verse on fidyah (compensation)?

Siyar quotes Ka'b ibn Ujrah: «كنت مع النبي ﷺ بالحديبية ونحن محرمون ... فجعلت الهوام تساقط على وجهي» [I was with the Prophet at al-Hudaybiyah while we were in ihram (ritual consecration) ... and lice began falling onto my face, peace and blessings be upon him.].
sahaba-0211: Who were the two men who accompanied Amr ibn al-As when he emigrated to the Prophet as a Muslim early in year eight, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?
Khalid ibn al-Walid and Ikrimah ibn Abi Jahl
Ikrimah ibn Abi Jahl and Safwan ibn Umayyah
Uthman ibn Talhah and Shaybah ibn Uthman
Khalid ibn al-Walid and Uthman ibn Talhah

Al-Dhahabi said that he emigrated to the Messenger of Allah as a Muslim early in year eight, accompanied by Khalid ibn al-Walid and Uthman ibn Talhah, custodian of the Ka'bah, peace and blessings be upon the Messenger.
sahaba-0212: The Prophet said «ابنا العاص مؤمنان» [The two sons of al-‘Ās are believers]. Who was the other son besides Amr ibn al-As, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?

Siyar describes his brother Hisham ibn al-As al-Sahmi as a righteous man and recalls the Prophet's saying «ابنا العاص مؤمنان» [The two sons of al-‘Ās are believers], peace and blessings be upon him (HadeethEnc).
sahaba-0213: Approximately how much older was Amr ibn al-As than his son Abdullah, according to al-Dhahabi?
Al-Dhahabi said that Abdullah ibn Amr's father was only about eleven years older than him.
sahaba-0214: Which cousin of the Prophet, one of the tulaqa (those granted freedom at the conquest), came to Madinah to ransom his people's captives, and whose father had worked to overturn the boycott document, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?
Al-Dhahabi said that Jubayr ibn Mut'im came to Madinah to ransom his people's captives, and that his father had worked to overturn the boycott document.
sahaba-0215: How many years older was Aqil ibn Abi Talib than his brother Ali, according to al-Dhahabi?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Aqil was twenty years older than Ali and ten years older than Ja'far al-Tayyar.
sahaba-0217: Which Companion who took part in Bay'at al-Ridwan (the pledge of divine pleasure) became judge of Damascus and acted as deputy governor when its governor was absent?
Al-Dhahabi described Fadalah ibn Ubayd as a participant in Bay'at al-Ridwan (the pledge of divine pleasure) who was appointed judge of Damascus.
sahaba-0218: Which mu'adhdhin (caller to prayer) of al-Masjid al-Haram had one of the most resonant and beautiful voices?
Al-Dhahabi described Abu Mahdhurah al-Jumahi as the mu'adhdhin (caller to prayer) of al-Masjid al-Haram, with one of the most resonant and beautiful voices.
sahaba-0219: Al-Dhahabi listed two kunyahs (parental bynames) for Adi ibn Hatim al-Ta'i, one being Abu Wahb. What was the other?
Al-Dhahabi described Adi ibn Hatim as a noble commander known as Abu Wahb and Abu Tarif al-Ta'i.
sahaba-0220: What was Abu Sa'id al-Khudri's name, may Allah be pleased with him?
Al-Dhahabi identified Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, the imam, fighter and mufti (scholar issuing legal opinions) of Madinah, as Sa'd ibn Malik ibn Sinan.
sahaba-0221: What is the well-known name of the Messenger of Allah's freedman nicknamed Safinah, peace and blessings be upon the Messenger?
Al-Dhahabi said that Safinah was his nickname, and his name was Mihran, also given as Ruman or Qays.
sahaba-0222: Which freedman of the Messenger of Allah had belonged to Umm Salamah, who freed him on condition that he serve the Prophet for life, peace and blessings be upon him?

Al-Dhahabi said that Safinah, freedman of the Messenger of Allah, had been Umm Salamah's slave. She freed him on condition that he serve the Messenger of Allah for life, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0223: Which Companion did the Messenger of Allah send as an envoy to al-Najashi, and also send alone on a military mission, peace and blessings be upon him?
Al-Dhahabi said that the Messenger of Allah sent Amr ibn Umayyah alone on a military mission and as an envoy to al-Najashi, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0224: Which Companion, knowledgeable about muzara'ah (sharecropping), pulled out an arrow that struck him at Uhud, leaving its head in his flesh until he died?

Al-Dhahabi said that Rafi' ibn Khadij was struck by an arrow at Uhud. He pulled it out, but its head remained in his flesh until his death. He lived in the countryside and knew about muzara'ah (sharecropping).
sahaba-0225: According to al-Dhahabi, who was the last survivor of those present on the night of the second al-Aqabah pledge?
Al-Dhahabi said that Jabir ibn Abdullah participated in Bay'at al-Ridwan (the pledge of divine pleasure) and was the last survivor of those present on the night of the second al-Aqabah pledge.
sahaba-0226: Who was considered too young to fight at Badr and said: 'I and Ibn Umar were the same age'?
Al-Dhahabi said that al-Bara ibn Azib was considered too young at Badr and reported that he and Ibn Umar were the same age.
sahaba-0227: Which Ansari female Companion, whose father was a leading veteran of Badr, did the Prophet visit on the morning of her wedding to maintain kinship ties, peace and blessings be upon him?
Al-Dhahabi said that the Prophet visited al-Rubayyi' bint Mu'awwidh on the morning of her wedding to maintain kinship ties, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0229: When Umar asked whom Nafi' had left in charge of Makkah, he was told it was a freedman versed in inheritance shares and the Book of Allah. Umar said «إن هذا القرآن يرفع الله به أقوامًا» [Allah raises some people through this Quran]. Who was that freedman?

Siyar names Ibn Abza and describes him as versed in fara'id (inheritance shares) and the Book of Allah. Umar recalled the Prophet's saying «إن هذا القرآن يرفع الله به أقوامًا» [Allah raises some people through this Quran], peace and blessings be upon him (HadeethEnc) has a related version using 'this Book' and an additional clause.
sahaba-0230: What was Abdullah ibn Umar's first campaign after being considered too young to fight at Uhud?
Al-Dhahabi said that Ibn Umar was considered too young at Uhud, so his first campaign was al-Khandaq.
sahaba-0231: What was the name of al-Akwa', the grandfather after whom Salamah ibn al-Akwa' was known?
Al-Dhahabi identified him as Salamah ibn Amr ibn al-Akwa', and stated that al-Akwa' was named Sinan ibn Abdullah.
sahaba-0232: Where was Abdullah ibn Abbas born, may Allah be pleased with them both?
In Dar al-Arqam at the start of the call to Islam
In Shi'b Bani Hashim three years before the Hijrah
In al-Ta'if with his maternal relatives
In Madinah one year after the Hijrah
Al-Dhahabi said that Ibn Abbas was born in Shi'b Bani Hashim three years before the Hijrah (emigration to Madinah).
sahaba-0233: Approximately how long was Abdullah ibn Abbas a companion of the Prophet, according to al-Dhahabi, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?
Al-Dhahabi said that he accompanied the Prophet for about thirty months, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0234: What was the name of Abu Umamah al-Bahili, who settled in Homs?
Al-Dhahabi cited Khalifah as listing Sudayy ibn Ajlan among Qays Aylan, specifically Banu A'sur.
sahaba-0235: Which long-lived Companion from Ahl al-Suffah (the poor residents of the mosque's shelter) accepted Islam in year nine, attended Tabuk and was among the poor Muslims?

Al-Dhahabi said that Wathilah ibn al-Asqa' belonged to Ahl al-Suffah (the poor residents of the mosque's shelter), accepted Islam in year nine, attended the Tabuk campaign and was among the poor Muslims.
sahaba-0236: Who was the last Companion to die in Egypt, according to al-Dhahabi?
Abdullah ibn al-Harith ibn Jaz' al-Zubaydi
Al-Dhahabi said that Abdullah ibn al-Harith ibn Jaz' took part in the conquest of Egypt and settled there, becoming the last Companion there to die.
sahaba-0237: Which Quran teacher of Makkah, one of the younger Companions, studied under Ubayy ibn Ka'b, and whose father was the Prophet's business partner before his prophethood, peace and blessings be upon him?

Al-Dhahabi described Abdullah ibn al-Sa'ib al-Makhzumi as Makkah's Quran teacher. His father was the Prophet's business partner before prophethood, and Abdullah studied Quran with Ubayy ibn Ka'b, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet.
sahaba-0239: Which prominent Companion from Ahl al-Suffah (the poor residents of the mosque's shelter) settled in Homs and was among those concerning whom this was revealed: ﴿ولا على الذين إذا ما أتوك لتحملهم﴾ [Nor [is there blame] upon those who, when they came to you for you to take them along]?

Al-Dhahabi described al-Irbad ibn Sariyah as a prominent member of Ahl al-Suffah (the poor residents of the mosque's shelter) who settled in Homs, and one of those concerning whom was revealed: «ولا على الذين إذا ما أتوك لتحملهم» [Nor [is there blame] upon those who, when they came to you for you to take them along]. English excerpt: Quran 9:92 (QuranEnc).
sahaba-0240: Whom did al-Dhahabi describe as the last Companion to die in Madinah, having lived to around one hundred?
Al-Dhahabi said that Sahl ibn Sa'd was the last Companion to die in Madinah and was around one hundred years old.
sahaba-0241: Which Companion who participated in Bay'at al-Ridwan (the pledge of divine pleasure) was the last Companion to die in Kufa?
Al-Dhahabi said that Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa participated in Bay'at al-Ridwan (the pledge of divine pleasure) and was the last Companion to die in Kufa.
sahaba-0242: According to al-Waqidi, who was the last Companion to die in al-Sham, in year eighty-eight?
Abdullah ibn Busr's biography cites al-Waqidi as saying that he died in year eighty-eight and was the last Companion to die in al-Sham.
sahaba-0243: Which young Companion said «حجّ بي أبي مع النبي ﷺ وأنا ابن سبع سنين» [My father took me for Hajj (pilgrimage) with the Prophet when I was seven years old, peace and blessings be upon him]?

Al-Dhahabi quotes al-Sa'ib: «حج بي أبي مع النبي ﷺ وأنا ابن سبع سنين» [My father took me for Hajj (pilgrimage) with the Prophet when I was seven years old, peace and blessings be upon him] (HadeethEnc) has a related version with different wording.
sahaba-0244: Which Companion did al-Dhahabi describe as 'the last person in the world to have seen the Messenger of Allah', peace and blessings be upon him?
Al-Dhahabi described Abu al-Tufayl as the last person in the world to have seen the Messenger of Allah, and stated that his name was Amir ibn Wathilah, peace and blessings be upon the Messenger.
sahaba-0245: Who was martyred at Uhud and washed by the angels because he was in janabah (major ritual impurity)?
In the biography of his son Abdullah ibn Hanzalah, al-Dhahabi said that his father was martyred at Uhud and the angels washed him because he was in janabah (major ritual impurity).
sahaba-0246: What was the kunyah (parental byname) of Anas ibn Malik, servant of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him?
Al-Dhahabi identified Anas ibn Malik, a great narrator of Islam, as Abu Hamzah al-Ansari al-Khazraji al-Najjari al-Madani.
sahaba-0247: In which land was Umar ibn Abi Salamah, the Prophet's stepson, born, as stated by al-Dhahabi, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?
Al-Dhahabi identified Umar ibn Abi Salamah as Abu Hafs al-Qurashi al-Makhzumi al-Madani, born in Abyssinia.
sahaba-0248: Which Ansari Companion threw away the dates in his hand at Badr and fought until he was killed?
Among the martyrs of Badr, al-Dhahabi listed Umayr ibn al-Humam ibn al-Jamuh al-Ansari, who threw away his dates and fought until he was killed.
sahaba-0250: Which nephew of Hamzah ibn Abd al-Muttalib was buried with him in one grave at Uhud?
Among Uhud's martyrs, al-Dhahabi listed Hamzah and Abdullah ibn Jahsh al-Asadi, Hamzah's sister's son, stating that they were buried in one grave.
sahaba-0251: Where in Makkah did the polytheists crucify Khubayb ibn Adi and Zayd ibn al-Dathinnah?
Al-Dhahabi said that they were sold in Makkah, killed in retaliation for their people's men killed by the Prophet, and crucified at al-Tan'im, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet.
sahaba-0253: Where was Ukkashah ibn Mihsan killed during Abu Bakr al-Siddiq's caliphate?
Al-Dhahabi said that Ukkashah was killed a year later at Buzakhah during Abu Bakr al-Siddiq's caliphate.
sahaba-0254: Two Companions used to smash the idols of Banu Harithah. One was Abu Burdah ibn Niyar; who was the other?
Al-Dhahabi said that Abu Abs and Abu Burdah ibn Niyar used to smash the idols of Banu Harithah.
sahaba-0256: Which Persian Companion did Ibn Asakir identify by his affiliation to Islam, calling him '... ibn al-Islam'?
Siyar cites the hadith scholar Abu al-Qasim ibn Asakir as identifying him as Salman ibn al-Islam (son of Islam), Abu Abdullah al-Farisi.
sahaba-0257: Which Companion of Banu al-Najjar, a veteran of Badr, did al-Dhahabi describe as devout, virtuous and dutiful to his mother?
Al-Dhahabi said that Harithah ibn al-Nu'man attended Badr and the other campaigns, and was devout, virtuous and dutiful to his mother.
sahaba-0258: The Prophet said «اذهبوا بهذه الخميصة وائتوني بأنبجانية ...» [Take away this khamisah (patterned garment) and bring me the anbijaniyyah (plain garment) of ...]. Whose plain garment did he request, peace and blessings be upon him?

Siyar identifies Abu Jahm ibn Hudhayfah al-Qurashi al-Adawi as the man mentioned in the Prophet's saying «اذهبوا بهذه الخميصة وائتوني بأنبجانية أبي جهم» [Take this garment of mine to Abu Jahm and bring me his plain garment], peace and blessings be upon him (HadeethEnc).
sahaba-0259: Which noble Companion from Hadramawt, a leader of his people, had the kunyah (parental byname) Abu Hunaydah?
Al-Dhahabi described Wa'il ibn Hujr ibn Sa'd, Abu Hunaydah al-Hadrami, as one of the nobles and a leader of his people.
sahaba-0260: What name did al-Bukhari and others give Abu Waqid al-Laythi?
Al-Dhahabi stated that al-Bukhari and others named Abu Waqid al-Laythi, a Companion of the Prophet, al-Harith ibn Awf, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet.
sahaba-0261: From which Companion do the Ka'bah's custodians, known as Banu Shaybah, descend?
Al-Dhahabi said that Banu Shaybah, the House's custodians, descend from Shaybah ibn Uthman.
sahaba-0262: Which name for Abu Barzah al-Aslami did al-Dhahabi consider most correct?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Abu Barzah al-Aslami, Companion of the Prophet, was Nadlah ibn Ubayd according to the most correct view, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet.
sahaba-0264: By what name was Qays ibn Abdullah, a poet of Banu Ja'dah who was a Companion, delegate and narrator, famous?
Al-Dhahabi described al-Nabighah al-Ja'di, Abu Layla, as his era's poet, a Companion, delegate and narrator, and cited Muhammad ibn Sallam as naming him Qays ibn Abdullah.
sahaba-0265: How old was Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Khatmi when he took part in Bay'at al-Ridwan (the pledge of divine pleasure)?
Al-Dhahabi said that Abdullah ibn Yazid al-Khatmi participated in Bay'at al-Ridwan (the pledge of divine pleasure) at the age of seventeen.
sahaba-0266: By what name was Abu Juhayfah al-Suwa'i, whose name was Wahb ibn Abdullah, known?
Al-Dhahabi said that Abu Juhayfah al-Suwa'i was named Wahb ibn Abdullah and was called Wahb al-Khayr (Wahb of goodness).
sahaba-0267: Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr had two kunyahs (parental bynames), Abu Bakr and which other?
Al-Dhahabi identified Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr al-Qurashi al-Asadi al-Makki as Abu Bakr and Abu Khubayb.
sahaba-0268: Al-Dhahabi said that Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf was among a group who hastened to accept Islam. How many were in that group?
Al-Dhahabi said that Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf was one of the eight who hastened to accept Islam.
sahaba-0269: To which branch of al-Aws did their leader Sa'd ibn Mu'adh belong?
Al-Dhahabi traced Sa'd ibn Mu'adh ibn al-Nu'man's lineage to Abd al-Ashhal and described him as the great leader and martyr Abu Amr al-Ansari al-Awsi al-Ashhali.
sahaba-0270: To which tribe did Amir ibn Rabi'ah, ally of the family of al-Khattab, belong?
Al-Dhahabi identified Amir ibn Rabi'ah as Abu Abdullah al-Anazi, of Anz ibn Wa'il, an ally of Umar ibn al-Khattab's family.
sahaba-0271: With which kunyah (parental byname) did al-Dhahabi begin the biography of Hamzah ibn Abd al-Muttalib, the Prophet's uncle, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?
Al-Dhahabi described him as the heroic imam, the valiant lion, Lion of Allah, Abu Umarah and Abu Ya'la al-Qurashi al-Hashimi.
sahaba-0274: Who fought at Badr with the polytheists, was captured and ransomed by his uncle al-Abbas, was older than al-Abbas, and later emigrated in the year of al-Khandaq?

Al-Dhahabi said that Nawfal ibn al-Harith was older than his uncle al-Abbas. He attended Badr with the polytheists, was captured and ransomed by al-Abbas, then accepted Islam and emigrated in the year of al-Khandaq.
sahaba-0275: At the Farewell Hajj (pilgrimage), the Prophet said «وإن أول دم أضع من دمائنا دم ابن ...» [The first blood claim of ours that I abolish is that for the son of ...]. Which Companion's son had been killed as a child in the Jahiliyyah (pre-Islamic era), peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?

Rabi'ah ibn al-Harith's biography quotes the Prophet: «وأول دم أضعه دم ابن ربيعة بن الحارث» [The first blood claim I abolish is that for the son of Rabi'ah ibn al-Harith], peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0276: Who was named Abd Shams until the Prophet renamed him Abdullah when he emigrated shortly before the conquest, and who was a brother of Rabi'ah and Nawfal, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?
Abdullah ibn al-Harith ibn Abd al-Muttalib
Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr ibn Abd al-Muttalib
Al-Dhahabi said that Abdullah ibn al-Harith ibn Abd al-Muttalib was originally named Abd Shams, which the Prophet changed to Abdullah, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0278: Which Companion granted protection to his cousin Uthman ibn Affan at al-Hudaybiyah when the Prophet sent him as an envoy to Makkah, and later accepted Islam, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?
Al-Dhahabi said that Aban ibn Sa'id protected his cousin Uthman ibn Affan at al-Hudaybiyah when the Prophet sent him as an envoy to Makkah, peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0279: Which Umayyad Companion emigrated to Abyssinia and then Madinah, and was martyred in al-Sham with his brothers Khalid and Aban?
Al-Dhahabi said that their brother Amr ibn Sa'id al-Umawi emigrated to Abyssinia and then Madinah, and was martyred at al-Yarmuk, or according to another account at Ajnadayn, with his two brothers.
sahaba-0280: Which Ansari naqib (appointed representative) of al-Aws, one of the twelve, was paired in brotherhood by the Prophet with Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Asad, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?

Al-Dhahabi said that the Prophet paired Sa'd ibn Khaythamah al-Awsi, the naqib (appointed representative), in brotherhood with Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Asad, and that he was one of the twelve representatives, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet.
sahaba-0282: According to Sahih al-Bukhari, approximately how many masters did Salman al-Farisi say he passed between before being freed?
Sahih al-Bukhari reports from Salman al-Farisi «أنه تداوله بضعة عشر من رب إلى رب» [that he passed from one master to another, between thirteen and nineteen in all].
sahaba-0283: Which town did Salman al-Farisi say he came from in Sahih al-Bukhari?
Al-Bukhari narrated from Abu Uthman that he heard Salman, may Allah be pleased with him, say «أنا من رام هرمز» [I am from Ramhurmuz].
sahaba-0284: When the Prophet said «من لكعب بن الأشرف فإنه قد آذى الله ورسوله» [Who will deal with Ka'b ibn al-Ashraf? He has harmed Allah and His Messenger], who stood and asked whether he wished him to kill Ka'b, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Jabir: «فقام محمد بن مسلمة فقال: يا رسول الله أتحب أن أقتله؟ قال: نعم» [Muhammad ibn Maslamah stood and said: O Messenger of Allah, would you like me to kill him? He said: Yes].
sahaba-0286: When Umar distributed wraps and one fine wrap remained, which Ansari female Companion did he favor with it because she had carried waterskins at Uhud?

Sahih al-Bukhari quotes Umar: «أم سليط أحق به، وأم سليط من نساء الأنصار ممن بايع رسول الله ﷺ ... فإنها كانت تزفر لنا القرب يوم أحد» [Umm Sulayt is more entitled to it. Umm Sulayt is one of the Ansari women who pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ... she used to carry waterskins for us at Uhud, peace and blessings be upon him].
sahaba-0287: Anas said they knew of no Arab clan with more martyrs honored on the Day of Resurrection than the Ansar (Madinan supporters). How many of them were killed at Uhud?
Al-Bukhari narrates from Anas: «أنه قتل منهم يوم أحد سبعون، ويوم بئر معونة سبعون، ويوم اليمامة سبعون» [Seventy of them were killed at Uhud, seventy at Bi'r Ma'unah, and seventy at al-Yamamah].
sahaba-0288: The Prophet sent a reconnaissance expedition led by a Companion who was the grandfather of Asim ibn Umar ibn al-Khattab. Banu Lihyan pursued them. Who was the commander, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?
Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Abu Hurayrah: «وأمّر عليهم عاصم بن ثابت، وهو جد عاصم بن عمر بن الخطاب» [He appointed Asim ibn Thabit over them; he was the grandfather of Asim ibn Umar ibn al-Khattab].
sahaba-0289: Which Companion, stabbed at Bi'r Ma'unah, splashed blood onto his face and said «فزت ورب الكعبة» [By the Lord of the Ka‘bah, I have won!]?

Al-Bukhari narrates from Anas that when his maternal uncle Haram ibn Milhan was stabbed at Bi'r Ma'unah, he splashed blood onto his face and head and said «فزت ورب الكعبة» [By the Lord of the Ka‘bah, I have won!] (HadeethEnc).
sahaba-0290: When Ghatafan seized the Messenger of Allah's milk camels at Dhu Qarad, which Companion shouted 'Ya sabahah!' (an alarm call) three times, audible between Madinah's two lava fields, peace and blessings be upon the Messenger?

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Salamah ibn al-Akwa': «فصرخت ثلاث صرخات: يا صباحاه، فأسمعت ما بين لابتي المدينة» [I cried out three times: Ya sabahah! (an alarm call), making myself heard between Madinah's two lava fields].
sahaba-0291: On the way to Khaybar, which Companion poet was asked to recite some of his verses, then dismounted and chanted «اللهم لولا أنت ما اهتدينا» [O Allah, without You we would not have been guided]?

Sahih al-Bukhari states: «فقال رجل من القوم لعامر: يا عامر ألا تسمعنا من هنيهاتك، وكان عامر رجلًا شاعرًا، فنزل يحدو» [One of the men said to Amir: Amir, will you recite some of your verses for us? Amir was a poet, so he dismounted and chanted to urge on the camels].
sahaba-0292: When Ibn Umar stood over Ja'far ibn Abi Talib's body at Mu'tah and counted his stab and sword wounds, what did he notice?
Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Ibn Umar: «فعددت به خمسين بين طعنة وضربة ليس منها شيء في دبره، يعني في ظهره» [I counted fifty stab and sword wounds on him, none on his rear, meaning his back].
sahaba-0293: Whom did the Prophet initially appoint commander at Mu'tah, saying «إن قُتل فجعفر، وإن قُتل جعفر فعبد الله بن رواحة» [If he is killed, then Ja'far; if Ja'far is killed, then Abdullah ibn Rawahah], peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Ibn Umar that the Messenger of Allah appointed Zayd ibn Harithah to command at Mu'tah and said «إن قتل زيد فجعفر، وإن قتل جعفر فعبد الله بن رواحة» [If Zayd is killed, then Ja'far; if Ja'far is killed, then Abdullah ibn Rawahah], peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0294: Khalid ibn al-Walid said «لقد انقطعت في يدي يوم مؤتة ... أسياف، فما بقي في يدي إلا صفيحة يمانية» [During the battle of Mu'tah, ... swords were broken in my hand, and all that remained with me was a Yemeni sword]. How many swords?

Al-Bukhari narrates from Khalid ibn al-Walid: «لقد انقطعت في يدي يوم مؤتة تسعة أسياف، فما بقي في يدي إلا صفيحة يمانية» [During the battle of Mu'tah, nine swords were broken in my hand, and all that remained with me was a Yemeni sword] (HadeethEnc). The question preserves the source's missing number.
sahaba-0295: The Prophet sent Usamah ibn Zayd to al-Huraqah, where he killed a man after he had said 'La ilaha illa Allah' (there is no god but Allah). What did the Prophet say to him, peace and blessings be upon him?
Repeat the campaign, then return to Madinah
Pay his blood money to his family; you bear no further liability
«أقتلته بعد ما قال لا إله إلا الله؟» [You killed him after he had said there is no god but Allah?]
You did well, for he was a polytheist

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Usamah: «يا أسامة، أقتلته بعد ما قال لا إله إلا الله؟» [O Usamah, You killed him after he had said there is no god but Allah?]. The question's English wording after the name is from (HadeethEnc); the source includes his name.
sahaba-0296: To which two men did the Prophet say, when sending them to Yemen, «يسّرا ولا تعسّرا، وبشّرا ولا تنفّرا» [Make things easy, not difficult; give glad tidings and do not drive people away], peace and blessings be upon him?
Ali ibn Abi Talib and Khalid ibn al-Walid
Abu Musa and Mu'adh ibn Jabal
Jarir ibn Abdullah and al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah
Amr ibn al-As and Abu Ubaydah

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Abu Burdah that the Messenger of Allah sent Abu Musa and Mu'adh ibn Jabal to Yemen and said «يسّرا ولا تعسّرا، وبشّرا ولا تنفّرا» [Make things easy, not difficult; give glad tidings and do not drive people away], peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0297: Who commanded Jaysh al-Khabat (the leaf-eating army), for whom the sea cast up an animal called al-Anbar, from which they ate for half a month?

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Jabir: «بعثنا رسول الله ﷺ ثلاثمائة راكب أميرنا أبو عبيدة بن الجراح ... فألقى لنا البحر دابة يقال لها العنبر» [The Messenger of Allah sent us, three hundred riders commanded by Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah ... and the sea cast up for us an animal called al-Anbar, peace and blessings be upon him].
sahaba-0298: Whom did the Prophet's cavalry capture from Banu Hanifah and tie to a mosque pillar before he later accepted Islam, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?

Sahih al-Bukhari states: «فجاءت برجل من بني حنيفة يقال له ثمامة بن أثال، فربطوه بسارية من سواري المسجد» [They captured a man from the tribe of Banu Hanīfah called Thumāmah ibn Uthāl, and tied him to one of the pillars of the mosque] (HadeethEnc).
sahaba-0299: Which Companion, the Ansar's orator, accompanied the Prophet when he approached Musaylimah among his followers, holding a piece of palm stalk, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Ibn Abbas: «فأقبل إليه رسول الله ﷺ ومعه ثابت بن قيس بن شماس، وفي يد رسول الله ﷺ قطعة جريد» [The Messenger of Allah approached him with Thabit ibn Qays ibn Shammas, holding a piece of palm stalk, peace and blessings be upon him].
sahaba-0300: Which Companion said at Badr: «يا رسول الله، إنا لا نقول لك كما قالت بنو إسرائيل لموسى: فاذهب أنت وربك فقاتلا» [O Messenger of Allah, we will not say to you as the Children of Israel said to Musa: so go, you and your Lord, and fight]?

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Ibn Mas'ud: «قال المقداد يوم بدر: يا رسول الله إنا لا نقول لك كما قالت بنو إسرائيل لموسى» [Al-Miqdad said at Badr: O Messenger of Allah, we will not say to you as the Children of Israel said to Musa]. Quranic wording in the question: Quran 5:24 (QuranEnc).
sahaba-0301: Anas said that they believed Allah's words ﴿من المؤمنين رجال صدقوا ما عاهدوا الله عليه﴾ [Among the believers are men true to what they promised Allāh.] were revealed concerning which Companion?

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Anas that they believed this verse was revealed concerning Anas ibn al-Nadr: «من المؤمنين رجال صدقوا ما عاهدوا الله عليه» [Among the believers are men true to what they promised Allāh.] English excerpt: Quran 33:23 (QuranEnc).
sahaba-0302: Zayd ibn Thabit said he could find a missing verse of Surah al-Ahzab in writing only with a Companion whose testimony the Prophet counted as that of two men. Who was he, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Zayd ibn Thabit: «لم أجدها مع أحد إلا مع خزيمة الأنصاري الذي جعل رسول الله ﷺ شهادته شهادة رجلين» [I found it with no one except Khuzaymah al-Ansari, whose testimony the Messenger of Allah had made equivalent to that of two men, peace and blessings be upon him].
sahaba-0303: After the Prophet forbade speaking to Ka'b ibn Malik and his two companions, how long did they remain in that state before Allah accepted their repentance, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?
Ka'b ibn Malik's hadith in Sahih al-Bukhari states: «فلبثنا على ذلك خمسين ليلة» [We remained in that state for the length of fifty nights] (HadeethEnc).
sahaba-0304: Two righteous veterans of Badr stayed behind from Tabuk with Ka'b ibn Malik. One was Murarah ibn al-Rabi'; who was the other?

Ka'b ibn Malik's hadith in Sahih al-Bukhari says: «قالوا: مرارة بن الربيع العمري وهلال بن أمية الواقفي، فذكروا لي رجلين صالحين قد شهدا بدرًا» [They said: Murarah ibn al-Rabi' al-Amri and Hilal ibn Umayyah al-Waqifi; they named two righteous men who had attended Badr].
sahaba-0305: When the Prophet sent Mu'adh to Yemen, Mu'adh recited Surah al-Nisa in Fajr (dawn prayer). On reaching ﴿واتخذ الله إبراهيم خليلًا﴾ [And Allāh took Abraham as an intimate friend.], what did a man behind him say, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?
Subhana Rabbi al-Azim (Glory be to my Lord, the Magnificent)
Qarrat aynu ummi Ibrahim (May Ibrahim's mother rejoice)
Amanna billahi wa rasulih (We believe in Allah and His Messenger)
Sadaqa Allahu al-Azim (Allah the Magnificent has spoken the truth)

Sahih al-Bukhari says Mu'adh recited Surah al-Nisa in Fajr (dawn prayer). At «واتخذ الله إبراهيم خليلًا» [And Allāh took Abraham as an intimate friend.], a man behind him said «قرّت عين أم إبراهيم» [May Ibrahim's mother rejoice]. Quran excerpt: 4:125 (QuranEnc).
sahaba-0306: The Prophet said «إن بلالًا يؤذن بليل فكلوا واشربوا حتى ينادي ...» [Bilāl calls the Adhān at night; so, eat and drink until you hear the Adhān called by ...]. Who was the second mu'adhdhin (caller to prayer), peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?

Sahih al-Bukhari quotes: «إن بلالًا يؤذن بليل، فكلوا واشربوا حتى ينادي ابن أم مكتوم» [Bilāl calls the Adhān at night; so, eat and drink until you hear the Adhān called by Ibn Umm Maktūm]. He was blind (HadeethEnc). Adhan means the call to prayer; the question retains the missing name.
sahaba-0307: When compiling the Quran, Zayd ibn Thabit found the last two verses of Surah al-Tawbah in writing with only one Companion, although the Companions had memorized them. Who was he?

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Zayd ibn Thabit: «حتى وجدت آخر سورة التوبة آيتين مع أبي خزيمة الأنصاري لم أجدهما مع أحد غيره» [Until I found the final two verses of Surah al-Tawbah with Abu Khuzaymah al-Ansari; I had not found them with anyone else].
sahaba-0308: When ﴿لا يستوي القاعدون من المؤمنين﴾ [Not equal are those believers remaining [at home]] was revealed, which blind Companion described his situation, after which ﴿غير أولي الضرر﴾ [other than the disabled] was revealed?

Sahih al-Bukhari states: «وخلف ظهر النبي ﷺ عمرو بن أم مكتوم الأعمى، قال: يا رسول الله فما تأمرني فإني رجل ضرير البصر، فنزلت مكانها» [Behind the Prophet was the blind Amr ibn Umm Maktum, who said: O Messenger of Allah, what do you command me to do, for I am blind? Then the revised wording was revealed in its place, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet]. Quran 4:95 excerpts in the question are from (QuranEnc).
sahaba-0310: Which surah did al-Bara ibn Azib say he learned before the Prophet arrived in Madinah, peace and blessings be upon him?

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from al-Bara that he learned Surah Sabbih isma Rabbika al-A'la before the Prophet arrived, peace and blessings be upon him. Surah names and identifying opening words are transliterated.
sahaba-0311: Of surahs including Banu Isra'il, al-Kahf and Maryam, Ibn Mas'ud said: 'They are among the earliest venerable surahs, and they are part of my ...'. What completes his statement?

Sahih al-Bukhari reports Ibn Mas'ud's words about Banu Isra'il, al-Kahf, Maryam, Ta-Ha and al-Anbiya: «إنهن من العتاق الأول، وهن من تلادي» [They are among the earliest venerable surahs, and part of my early store].
sahaba-0312: Which surah did Ibn Mas'ud recite in Homs, prompting a man to say it had not been revealed that way, to which he replied that he had recited it to the Messenger of Allah, who approved it, peace and blessings be upon him?

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Alqamah: «كنا بحمص فقرأ ابن مسعود سورة يوسف، فقال رجل: ما هكذا أنزلت» [We were in Homs when Ibn Mas'ud recited Surah Yusuf, and a man said: It was not revealed like that].
sahaba-0313: Which Companion did the Prophet miss and find sitting at home with bowed head, fearing his deeds were nullified because he raised his voice, prompting the Prophet to say «بل هو من أهل الجنة» [Rather, he is among the people of Paradise], peace and blessings be upon him?

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Anas that the Prophet noticed Thabit ibn Qays's absence, and that Thabit described his situation as evil because he used to raise his voice above the Prophet's, peace and blessings be upon him (HadeethEnc) has a related longer reply addressed to Thabit.
sahaba-0314: Which Companion reported hearing Abdullah ibn Ubayy say «لا تنفقوا على من عند رسول الله حتى ينفضوا» [Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allāh until they disband.]?

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Zayd ibn Arqam that on an expedition he heard Abdullah ibn Ubayy say «لا تنفقوا على من عند رسول الله حتى ينفضوا» [Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allāh until they disband.] The saying is also quoted in Quran 63:7; English excerpt from (QuranEnc).
sahaba-0315: Uthman ordered four men to copy the sheets into Quran codices: Zayd ibn Thabit, Sa'id ibn al-As, Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr and whom?
Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Harith ibn Hisham

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Anas: «فأمر عثمان زيد بن ثابت وسعيد بن العاص وعبد الله بن الزبير وعبد الرحمن بن الحارث بن هشام أن ينسخوها في المصاحف» [Uthman ordered Zayd ibn Thabit, Sa'id ibn al-As, Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr and Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Harith ibn Hisham to copy them into Quran codices].
sahaba-0316: Al-Miswar ibn Makhramah al-Zuhri's mother Atikah was the sister of one of the ten promised Paradise. Who was his maternal uncle?
Al-Dhahabi said that al-Miswar ibn Makhramah's mother was Atikah, sister of Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, and that she too belonged to Banu Zuhrah.
sahaba-0320: What was the kunyah (parental byname) of Talhah ibn Ubaydullah, one of the ten promised Paradise?
Al-Dhahabi identified Talhah ibn Ubaydullah al-Qurashi al-Taymi al-Makki as Abu Muhammad, one of the ten testified to be destined for Paradise.
sahaba-0322: What was the kunyah (parental byname) of Tamim al-Dari, Companion of the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him?
Al-Dhahabi identified Tamim al-Dari, Companion of the Messenger of Allah, as Abu Ruqayyah Tamim ibn Aws ibn Kharijah, peace and blessings be upon the Messenger.
sahaba-0324: What was Khalid ibn al-Walid's kunyah (parental byname), may Allah be pleased with him?
Al-Dhahabi identified Khalid ibn al-Walid, Sayf Allah (Sword of Allah), as Abu Sulayman al-Qurashi al-Makhzumi al-Makki.
sahaba-0325: Abu Tha'labah al-Khushani's name is disputed. Which name was given by Ahmad ibn Hanbal and Ibn Ma'in for this Companion of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him?
Al-Dhahabi said that Abu Tha'labah al-Khushani's name was disputed, and that Ahmad ibn Hanbal and Ibn Ma'in gave it as Jurhum ibn Nashim.
sahaba-0326: Which daughter of Milhan did the Prophet visit, laugh and tell of people of his ummah (Muslim community) sailing like kings on couches, prompting her to ask him to pray that she be among them, peace and blessings be upon him?

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Anas that the Messenger of Allah visited Milhan's daughter, who said «يا رسول الله ادع الله أن يجعلني منهم» [O Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah to make me one of them], peace and blessings be upon him. Another narration states that Umm Haram related the account to him.
sahaba-0327: At Uhud, Anas saw Aishah and another female Companion with their garments tucked up, carrying waterskins on their backs and pouring water into the men's mouths. Who was the other woman?

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Anas: «ولقد رأيت عائشة بنت أبي بكر وأم سليم وإنهما لمشمرتان ... تنقزان القرب» [I saw Aishah bint Abi Bakr and Umm Sulaym with their garments tucked up ... carrying waterskins briskly].
sahaba-0328: Which female Companion said «كنا مع النبي ﷺ نسقي ونداوي الجرحى ونرد القتلى إلى المدينة» [We accompanied the Prophet, supplying water, treating the wounded and taking the dead back to Madinah, peace and blessings be upon him]?

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from al-Rubayyi' bint Mu'awwidh: «كنا مع النبي ﷺ نسقي ونداوي الجرحى ونرد القتلى إلى المدينة» [We accompanied the Prophet, supplying water, treating the wounded and taking the dead back to Madinah, peace and blessings be upon him].
sahaba-0329: To whom did the Prophet say «التمس غلامًا من غلمانكم يخدمني حتى أخرج إلى خيبر» [Find a boy from among your boys to serve me until I set out for Khaybar], who then took Anas riding behind him, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?

Sahih al-Bukhari narrates from Anas that the Prophet said to Abu Talhah «التمس غلامًا من غلمانكم يخدمني حتى أخرج إلى خيبر» [Find a boy from among your boys to serve me until I set out for Khaybar], peace and blessings be upon him. Abu Talhah then took Anas riding behind him.
sahaba-0330: Which Ansari Companion did Tha'labah al-Qurazi describe as 'the standard-bearer of the Messenger of Allah', peace and blessings be upon him?

Sahih al-Bukhari states: «أن قيس بن سعد الأنصاري رضي الله عنه، وكان صاحب لواء رسول الله ﷺ، أراد الحج فرجّل» [Qays ibn Sa'd al-Ansari, may Allah be pleased with him, who was the standard-bearer of the Messenger of Allah, intended to perform Hajj (pilgrimage), so he combed his hair, peace and blessings be upon the Messenger].
sahaba-0332: Abu Dharr said he stayed in Makkah for thirty days and nights with only one thing as nourishment, yet gained weight. What was it?

Sahih Muslim narrates from Abu Dharr: «ولقد لبثت يا ابن أخي ثلاثين بين ليلة ويوم ما كان لي طعام إلا ماء زمزم فسمنت» [My nephew, I stayed thirty days and nights with no nourishment except Zamzam water, yet gained weight].
sahaba-0333: Which female Companion reported hearing the Prophet say in Hafsah's presence «لا يدخل النار إن شاء الله من أصحاب الشجرة أحد» [Allah willing, none of those who pledged allegiance beneath the tree will enter the Fire], peace and blessings be upon him?

Sahih Muslim narrates from Jabir that Umm Mubashshir told him she heard the Prophet say in Hafsah's presence «لا يدخل النار إن شاء الله من أصحاب الشجرة أحد» [Allah willing, none of those who pledged allegiance beneath the tree will enter the Fire], peace and blessings be upon him.
sahaba-0334: Whose verse «ألا كل شيء ما خلا الله باطل» [Indeed, everything apart from Allah is perishing] did the Prophet describe as the truest words ever spoken by a poet, peace and blessings be upon him?
Sahih al-Bukhari quotes: «أصدق كلمة قالها الشاعر كلمة لبيد: ألا كل شيء ما خلا الله باطل» [The truest words spoken by a poet are Labid's words: Indeed, everything apart from Allah is perishing].
sahaba-0335: Which Companion carried a water vessel for the Prophet's wudu (ablution) and cleansing, and was asked to bring stones for cleaning himself, peace and blessings be upon the Prophet?

Sahih al-Bukhari relates that Abu Hurayrah carried a water vessel for the Prophet's wudu (ablution) and cleansing. He identified himself as Abu Hurayrah, and the Prophet said «ابغني أحجارًا أستنفض بها» [Bring me stones so that I may cleanse (my private parts) therewith], peace and blessings be upon him (HadeethEnc).
sahaba-0336: Which Companion said they used to greet the Prophet during prayer and receive a reply, but after returning from al-Najashi he did not reply and said «إن في الصلاة شغلًا» [Prayer requires one's full attention], peace and blessings be upon him?
Al-Bukhari narrated the hadith from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud in the chapter on the emigration to Abyssinia.
sahaba-0337: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) gave glad tidings to the people of the ship who arrived from Abyssinia in the year of Khaybar, saying: «لكم أنتم يا أهل السفينة ...» [For you, people of the ship, there are ...]. How does the statement end?
Sahih al-Bukhari reports from Abu Musa: «فقال النبي ﷺ: لكم أنتم يا أهل السفينة هجرتان» [The Prophet said: For you, people of the ship, there are two migrations].
sahaba-0338: Jabir ibn Abd Allah said that his two maternal uncles brought him to witness al-Aqabah. Ibn Uyaynah named one of them. Who was he?
Sahih al-Bukhari reports that Jabir's two maternal uncles brought him to witness al-Aqabah; Ibn Uyaynah identified one as al-Bara ibn Marur.
sahaba-0339: Which Companion would become angry when told that he had migrated before his father?
In Sahih al-Bukhari, Abu Uthman reports hearing Ibn Umar become angry when told that he had migrated before his father.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0001: To which clan of Quraysh did the Mother of the Believers Khadijah bint Khuwaylid belong?
She was Khadijah bint Khuwaylid ibn Asad ibn Abd al-Uzza ibn Qusayy, of the Asad clan of Quraysh.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0002: By which kunyah (parental honorific) did al-Dhahabi introduce the Mother of the Believers Khadijah in her biography?
Al-Dhahabi introduced her as Umm al-Qasim, daughter of Khuwaylid ibn Asad. Al-Qasim was her eldest child by the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him).
mothers-ahlulbayt-0003: Who was the mother of Khadijah bint Khuwaylid?
Al-Zubayr ibn Bakkar stated that her mother was Fatimah bint Zaidah al-Amiriyyah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0004: By what title was Khadijah known during the Jahiliyyah (pre-Islamic period)?
Dhat al-Nitaqayn (the woman of the two waistbands)
Al-Zubayr ibn Bakkar stated that Khadijah was called al-Tahirah (the pure) during the Jahiliyyah (pre-Islamic period).
mothers-ahlulbayt-0006: According to al-Dhahabi, how old was the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) when he consummated his marriage to Khadijah?
Al-Dhahabi stated that he consummated the marriage when he was twenty-five.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0007: Ibn Ishaq mentioned the mahr (bridal gift) that the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) gave Khadijah. How much was it?
Ibn Ishaq stated that he married her and gave her twenty young she-camels as the mahr (bridal gift).
mothers-ahlulbayt-0008: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) traveled to al-Sham to trade on Khadijah's behalf with her servant. What was his name?
She offered him a trading journey to al-Sham with her wealth, and he traveled with her servant Maysarah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0009: Jibril gave Khadijah glad tidings of a house in Paradise with neither noise nor fatigue. Of what was the house described as being made?
The hadith says: «وبشرها ببيت في الجنة من قصب لا صخب فيه ولا نصب» [of a house in Paradise built of Qasab wherein there will be neither any noise nor any fatigue.] (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0011: According to Aishah, how many years elapsed between Khadijah's death and the Prophet's marriage to Aishah?
Aishah reported that he married her three years after Khadijah's death.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0012: Which wife of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) had no co-wife during her lifetime?
Aishah said: «لم يتزوج النبي ﷺ على خديجة حتى ماتت» [The Prophet did not marry another woman alongside Khadijah until she died].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0013: Out of loyalty to which wife would the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) cut up a slaughtered sheep and send portions to her friends?
Aishah reported that he would sometimes slaughter a sheep, cut it into portions, and send them to Khadijah's friends.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0015: Ibn al-Athir reported consensus that the first person of this community to believe in the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) was:
Izz al-Din ibn al-Athir stated that, by Muslim consensus, Khadijah was the first person to embrace Islam.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0016: Urwah narrated from Aishah that Khadijah died before which act of worship became obligatory?

Urwah narrated from Aishah that Khadijah died before salah (prayer) became obligatory. This refers to the five daily prayers prescribed on the night of the Miraj (Ascension); the Prophet and his Companions prayed before then.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0018: How did Ibn Ishaq describe Khadijah's support for the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
Ibn Ishaq described Khadijah as a faithful supporter.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0020: Who was the father of the Mother of the Believers Sawdah?
She was Sawdah bint Zamah ibn Qays al-Qurashiyyah al-Amiriyyah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0021: Who was Sawdah bint Zamah's husband before the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
She was previously married to al-Sakran ibn Amr, brother of Suhayl ibn Amr al-Amiri.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0023: Sawdah bint Zamah gave her allotted day with the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) to which co-wife?
Sawdah gave her day to Aishah, so the Prophet allotted Aishah both her own day and Sawdah's day.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0024: Where did Sawdah bint Zamah migrate with her first husband before marrying the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
Ibn Sad stated that Sawdah and her husband embraced Islam and migrated to Abyssinia.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0025: Which Mother of the Believers sought permission on the night at Muzdalifah to leave before the crowds because she was heavy-bodied?
Aishah reported that Sawdah asked to leave Muzdalifah before the rush of people; she was slow-moving because of her build, and he permitted her.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0026: Which Mother of the Believers went out to relieve herself after hijab (covering) was prescribed and was recognized by Umar because of her large build?
Aishah reported that Sawdah went out to relieve herself after hijab (covering) was prescribed. Her large build made her recognizable to those who knew her, and Umar saw her.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0027: Of whom did Aishah say that she had never seen a woman whose ways she would more like to adopt?
Hisham narrated from his father that Aishah said she had never seen a woman whose ways she would more like to adopt than Sawdah's.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0028: Who was the mother of the Mother of the Believers Aishah?
Her mother was Umm Ruman bint Amir ibn Uwaymir al-Kinaniyyah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0029: In which month did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) consummate his marriage to Aishah?
Aishah said: «تزوجني رسول الله ﷺ في شوال، وبنى بي في شوال» [The Messenger of Allah married me in Shawwal and consummated the marriage with me in Shawwal]. Narrated by Muslim.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0030: Which was the only wife whom the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) married as a virgin?
Al-Dhahabi stated that the Prophet did not marry any virgin other than her.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0031: Before marrying Aishah, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) saw her in a dream. On what did he see her image?
He said: «أُريتُكِ في المنام مرتين، أرى أنك في سَرَقة من حرير، ويقال: هذه امرأتك» [I was shown you in a dream twice. I saw you in a piece of silk, and it was said: This is your wife].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0032: Which Companion asked the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) whom he loved most, and received the reply «عائشة» [Aishah]?
The Prophet placed Amr ibn al-As in command of the army of Dhat al-Salasil. When Amr asked whom he loved most, he answered «عائشة» [Aishah]. When asked which man, he replied «أبوها» [Her father].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0033: To whom did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) say: «لا تؤذيني في عائشة، فإن الوحي لم يأتني وأنا في ثوب امرأةٍ إلا عائشة» [Do not hurt me concerning Aishah, for revelation has not come to me while I was under a woman's garment except Aishah's]?
Aishah's co-wives gathered with Umm Salamah, who spoke to the Prophet about gifts. He then said this to her.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0036: During which campaign did the incident of al-Ifk (the false accusation against Aishah) occur?
Al-Dhahabi stated that the incident of al-Ifk (the false accusation) occurred during the campaign of al-Muraysi, also called Banu al-Mustaliq, in year five.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0037: Which Companion found Aishah after she had been left behind by the army during the false accusation incident and made his mount kneel for her?
Aishah reported that Safwan ibn al-Muattal al-Sulami, of the Dhakwan clan, was behind the army and reached her resting place in the morning.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0038: How many verses did Allah reveal exonerating Aishah, beginning with «إنّ الذين جاءوا بالإفك عصبة منكم» [Indeed, those who came with falsehood[978] are a group among you.]?

Aishah reported that Allah revealed the ten verses beginning «إن الذين جاءوا بالإفك» [Indeed, those who came with falsehood[978]]. Quran 24:11 (QuranEnc) [978] Referring to the incident when the Prophet's wife ʿĀ’ishah was falsely accused by the hypocrites.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0039: From whom had Aishah borrowed the necklace that was lost on a journey, occasioning the revelation of the verse on tayammum (dry purification)?
Aishah narrated that she borrowed a necklace from Asma and it was lost, leading to the revelation of the verse on tayammum (dry purification).
mothers-ahlulbayt-0040: Which Companion told Aishah, when the verse on tayammum (dry purification) was revealed: May Allah reward you; whenever something happens to you, Allah provides you a way out?
Usayd ibn Hudayr prayed that Allah reward her and said that whenever anything happened to her, Allah provided her a way out and made it a blessing for the Muslims.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0041: According to al-Dhahabi, how many hadiths are in Musnad Aishah?
Two thousand two hundred and ten
Al-Dhahabi stated that Musnad Aishah contains two thousand two hundred and ten hadiths.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0042: During his final illness, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) asked «أين أنا غدًا؟» [Where will I be tomorrow?], eager to be in which wife's home?
He would ask «أين أنا غدًا؟» [Where will I be tomorrow?], eager to be at Aishah's home; when her day came he stopped asking (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0043: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) compared Aishah's superiority over other women to the superiority of which food over other foods?
He said: «فضل عائشة على النساء كفضل الثريد على سائر الطعام» [the superiority of ‘Ā'ishah to other women is like the superiority of Tharīd to other meals.] (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0045: Which Tabi (Successor) said that Aishah was the most knowledgeable in jurisprudence and had the best judgment in public affairs?
Al-Dhahabi quoted this statement by Ata ibn Abi Rabah in Aishah's biography.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0046: Who said that if Aishah's knowledge were combined with that of all other women, her knowledge would be greater?
Al-Dhahabi quoted this statement by al-Zuhri in her biography.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0047: When Aishah was angry, she would swear by the Lord of which prophet other than Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him)?

He told her: «إذا كنتِ عني راضية قلت: لا ورب محمد، وإذا كنت غضبى قلت: لا ورب إبراهيم» [When you are pleased with me, you say: 'No, by the Lord of Muhammad,' but when you are angry with me, you say: 'No, by the Lord of Ibrahīm.'] (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0048: How old was Aishah when the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) consummated their marriage?
Aishah reported that he married her when she was six, and she was brought to him when she was nine.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0049: Where was the Mother of the Believers Aishah buried?
In her chamber beside the Prophet
At the foot of Mount Uhud
She requested burial with the Prophet's wives and was buried in al-Baqi. Al-Dhahabi confirmed that she is buried there.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0050: Complete the Prophet's statement: «فاطمة بَضعةٌ مني، فمن أغضبها ...» [Fātimah is a piece of me, so whoever makes her angry ...].
He said: «فاطمة بضعة مني، فمن أغضبها أغضبني» [Fātimah is a piece of me, so whoever makes her angry makes me angry.] (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0051: Ali ibn Abi Talib sought to marry the daughter of which Qurayshi man while married to Fatimah, angering the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?

Ali proposed to Abu Jahl's daughter. The Prophet stood and said: «لا تجتمع بنت رسول الله وبنت عدو الله عند رجل واحد» [The daughter of the Messenger of Allah and the daughter of Allah's enemy shall not be married to the same man]. Ali abandoned the proposal.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0052: In his address concerning Fatimah, which son-in-law did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) praise, saying «حدّثني فصدقني» [He spoke to me truthfully]?
He said: «أما بعد، فإني أنكحت أبا العاص بن الربيع فحدثني وصدقني» [To proceed: I gave my daughter in marriage to Abu al-As ibn al-Rabi, and he spoke to me truthfully].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0053: During his final illness, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) whispered to Fatimah and she wept, then whispered again and she laughed. What made her laugh in this narration of al-Bukhari?
That her son would reconcile two groups
That she would be the first of his household to follow him in death
That Allah would grant her another child
She reported that he told her he would die from that illness, so she wept. Then he told her she would be the first of his household to follow him, so she laughed.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0056: Aishah described Fatimah as resembling the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) exactly in which respect?
Aishah reported that Fatimah approached walking, and her walk did not differ at all from the Messenger of Allah's walk.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0057: Who removed the camel's afterbirth from the Prophet's back while he was prostrating at the Kabah?
Fatimah came, removed it from his back, and prayed against those who had done that.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0059: Zaynab, the daughter of Ali ibn Abi Talib and Fatimah, married which member of Banu Hashim?
Al-Dhahabi identified Zaynab as the wife of Abd Allah ibn Jafar ibn Abi Talib.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0061: Which kunyah (parental honorific) did al-Dhahabi use at the beginning of his account of Fatimah?
Al-Dhahabi introduced Fatimah, the Messenger of Allah's daughter and a part of him, with the honorific Umm Abiha.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0062: Through which daughter alone did the Prophet's descendants continue?
Al-Dhahabi stated that the Prophet's line of descent ceased except through Fatimah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0063: Who said at the Prophet's death: O my father, we announce your death to Jibril?
When he died, Fatimah lamented that her father had answered his Lord's call, that al-Firdaws was his abode, and that they announced his death to Jibril.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0064: To which Companion did Fatimah say after the Prophet's burial: Could you bear to heap earth over the Messenger of Allah?
After the burial, Fatimah addressed Anas, asking whether they had been able to bear heaping earth over the Messenger of Allah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0065: Who was Hafsah bint Umar's husband before the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
Hafsah was widowed by Khunays ibn Hudhafah al-Sahmi, a participant at Badr who died in Madinah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0066: After Hafsah was widowed, her father Umar offered her in marriage to which two Companions before the Prophet proposed to her?
Talhah and Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf
Umar offered her to Uthman, who declined, then to Abu Bakr, who remained silent. The Prophet then proposed to her.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0067: How did Abu Bakr explain his silence when Umar offered Hafsah in marriage?
He had already proposed to another woman
He knew the Prophet had mentioned her and would not disclose his secret
He was away trading in al-Sham
He considered their age difference too great
Abu Bakr explained that he knew the Messenger of Allah had mentioned her, and he would not disclose the Messenger's secret.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0068: In which year did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) marry Hafsah bint Umar?
He married her after her iddah (waiting period) following Khunays's death had ended, in 3 AH.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0070: According to al-Dhahabi, how many years older was Hafsah than her brother Abd Allah ibn Umar?
Al-Dhahabi stated that her brother Ibn Umar narrated from her, and that she was six years older than him.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0071: Ibn Umar narrated from his sister Hafsah that the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «إنّ عبد الله رجلٌ ...» [Abd Allah is a ... man].
Ibn Umar narrated from Hafsah that the Prophet told her: «إن عبد الله رجل صالح» [Abd Allah is a righteous man].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0072: When the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said «لا يدخل النارَ أحدٌ من أصحاب الشجرة» [None of those who pledged beneath the tree will enter the Fire], which wife recited «وإن منكم إلا واردها» [And there is none of you except he will come to it.[823]]?
