Umm Mubashshir reported hearing him say that in Hafsah's presence. Hafsah recited «وإن منكم إلا واردها» [And there is none of you except he will come to it.[823]] Quran 19:71 (QuranEnc) [823] i.e., be exposed to it. However, the people of Paradise will not be harmed thereby.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0073: Who kept the sheets on which the Quran had been collected under Abu Bakr after Umar died?
The sheets remained with Abu Bakr until Allah took his soul, then with Umar during his lifetime, then with Hafsah bint Umar.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0075: The Mother of the Believers Zaynab bint Khuzaymah was the maternal half-sister of which Mother of the Believers?
Al-Dhahabi stated that she was Maymunah's maternal half-sister.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0076: To which tribe did the Mother of the Believers Zaynab bint Khuzaymah belong?
She was Zaynab bint Khuzaymah ibn al-Harith ibn Abd Allah al-Hilaliyyah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0077: What was the personal name of the Mother of the Believers Umm Salamah?
She was Hind bint Abi Umayyah al-Makhzumiyyah. Calling her Ramlah is an error; that was Umm Habibah's name.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0078: Umm Salamah was the paternal first cousin of which Companion?
Al-Dhahabi described her as a Makhzumi woman and a paternal cousin of Khalid ibn al-Walid, Sayf Allah (the Sword of Allah), and of Abu Jahl.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0079: Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Asad, Umm Salamah's first husband, was the Prophet's brother through which relationship?
Before the Prophet, she was married to his foster brother through breastfeeding, Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Asad.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0081: By what title was Abu Umayyah ibn al-Mughirah, Umm Salamah's father, known for his generosity?
Al-Dhahabi identified her father as Zad al-Rakib (provision for the rider), one of the famously generous men.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0082: Complete the supplication Umm Salamah said when Abu Salamah died: «اللهم أجُرني في مصيبتي، و...» [O Allah, reward me in my calamity and ...].
Grant me patience to bear it
Make it an expiation for my sin
Replace it for me with something better
She reported that she said it, and Allah gave her the Messenger of Allah in place of her loss (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0083: According to Sahih Muslim, which Companion did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) send to propose marriage to Umm Salamah on his behalf?
Umm Salamah reported that the Messenger of Allah sent Hatib ibn Abi Baltaah to propose to her on his behalf.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0084: How many nights did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) stay with Umm Salamah after marrying her before resuming his visits to his other wives?

After marrying her he stayed three nights and said: «إن شئتِ سبّعتُ لك، وإن سبّعت لك سبّعت لنسائي» [If you wish, I can stay seven (nights) with you, but if I stay seven with you, I will also stay seven with my (other) wives.] (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0085: In which year did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) marry Umm Salamah?
Al-Dhahabi stated that he married her once her waiting period ended, in Shawwal of 4 AH.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0086: According to al-Dhahabi, how many hadiths are in Umm Salamah's Musnad?
Two thousand two hundred and ten
Al-Dhahabi stated that her Musnad contains three hundred and seventy-eight hadiths.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0087: Which of these was a child of Umm Salamah and her husband Abu Salamah?
Al-Dhahabi listed her children who were Companions: Umar, Salamah, and Zaynab.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0088: Which Mother of the Believers did Musab al-Zubayri describe as the first woman traveling in a litter to enter Madinah as a migrant?
Musab al-Zubayri described Umm Salamah as the first woman traveling in a litter to enter Madinah as a migrant.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0089: At al-Hudaybiyah, which Mother of the Believers advised the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) to go out, slaughter his sacrificial camels, and shave his head without speaking to anyone?
He entered Umm Salamah's quarters and told her what he had encountered from the people. She gave him that advice; he acted on it, and the people rose and slaughtered their sacrificial animals.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0090: According to Sahih Muslim, which Mother of the Believers saw Jibril speaking to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) and thought he was Dihyah al-Kalbi?
Jibril came to the Prophet while Umm Salamah was present. She thought he was Dihyah until she heard the Prophet's address recounting Jibril's visit.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0092: When he married Umm Salamah, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «إنه ليس بكِ على أهلكِ ...» [In the sight of your family, you are not held in ...].
He said: «إنه ليس بك على أهلك هوان، إن شئت سبعت لك» [Indeed, you are not inferior in the sight of your family. If you wish, I can stay seven (nights) with you] (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0093: Zaynab bint Jahsh's mother was the Prophet's paternal aunt. What was her name?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Zaynab bint Jahsh was the daughter of the Messenger of Allah's paternal aunt, Umaymah bint Abd al-Muttalib ibn Hashim.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0094: Which Mother of the Believers would proudly tell her co-wives that their families had married them off, whereas Allah had married her from above seven heavens?
Zaynab would proudly tell the Prophet's wives that their families had married them off, whereas Allah Most High had married her from above seven heavens.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0095: Who was Zaynab bint Jahsh's husband before she married the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?

She was married to Zayd, the Prophet's freedman. Concerning her, the verse was revealed: «فلما قضى زيد منها وطرا زوجناكها» [So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you]. Quran 33:37 (QuranEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0096: In which surah was the verse revealed that mentions Allah marrying His Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) to Zaynab bint Jahsh?
It is the verse: «فلما قضى زيد منها وطرا زوجناكها» [So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you]. Al-Ahzab: 37 (QuranEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0097: Which caliph led the funeral prayer for the Mother of the Believers Zaynab bint Jahsh?
Al-Dhahabi stated that she died in 20 AH and Umar led her funeral prayer.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0098: In which Hijri year did the Mother of the Believers Zaynab bint Jahsh die?
Al-Dhahabi stated that she died in 20 AH and Umar led her funeral prayer.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0099: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) told his wives: «أسرعكنّ لحاقًا بي أطولكنّ يدًا» [The first of you to join me will be the one with the longest hand]. According to Sahih Muslim, who had the longest hand?
Aishah explained that Zaynab had the longest hand because she worked with her hands and gave charity.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0100: What did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) mean when he described one of his wives as «أطولكنّ يدًا» [the one with the longest hand]?
Giving much charity and working with her hands
Aishah explained that Zaynab had the longest hand because she worked with her hands and gave charity.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0101: In Ubayd ibn Umayr's narration from Aishah in Sahih al-Bukhari, at which wife's home did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) drink honey, after which the opening of Surat al-Tahrim was revealed?
Aishah reported that the Messenger of Allah used to drink honey at Zaynab bint Jahsh's home and spend time there.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0102: The verse on hijab (screening) was revealed after the Prophet's wedding feast for which wife, when some guests stayed talking too long?
Anas narrated that when the Messenger of Allah married Zaynab bint Jahsh, he invited people to eat. They then remained talking, and the verse on hijab (screening) was revealed.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0103: Which Mother of the Believers was originally named Barrah before the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) renamed her Zaynab?
Zaynab bint Umm Salamah reported that Zaynab bint Jahsh came to him with the name Barrah, and he renamed her Zaynab.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0104: Al-Dhahabi described Zaynab bint Jahsh as skilled with her hands. What work did she do, giving charity from its proceeds?
Al-Dhahabi stated that she was skilled with her hands, tanning hides, stitching leather, and giving charity.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0105: What was the personal name of the Mother of the Believers Umm Habibah?
She was Umm Habibah Ramlah bint Abi Sufyan Sakhr ibn Harb al-Umawiyyah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0106: The Mother of the Believers Umm Habibah was the daughter of which leader of Quraysh?
She was Ramlah bint Abi Sufyan Sakhr ibn Harb ibn Umayyah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0109: Who was Umm Habibah's first husband, who took her with him when he migrated to Abyssinia?
Her first husband was Ubayd Allah ibn Jahsh. He migrated with her to Abyssinia and died there; she later married the Prophet.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0110: In which land was the Prophet's marriage contract with Umm Habibah bint Abi Sufyan concluded?
Al-Dhahabi stated that the marriage contract was concluded on his behalf in Abyssinia.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0111: Which Mother of the Believers did al-Dhahabi describe as having received the largest mahr (bridal gift) among the Prophet's wives?
Al-Dhahabi stated of Umm Habibah that no other wife had a larger mahr (bridal gift), and none lived farther away when he married her.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0113: Which Mother of the Believers narrated: «من صلّى اثنتي عشرة ركعة في يوم وليلة بُني له بهنّ بيت في الجنة» [Whoever prays twelve rakahs (units of prayer) in a day and night will have a house built for him in Paradise because of them]?
The hadith is in Sahih Muslim, narrated by Umm Habibah, the Prophet's wife. She said she had never omitted them since hearing it.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0114: Who was the father of the Mother of the Believers Safiyyah?
She was Safiyyah bint Huyayy ibn Akhtab ibn Sayah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0115: According to al-Dhahabi, Safiyyah bint Huyayy descended from which prophet?
Al-Dhahabi stated that she was of the tribe of Levi and descended from Allah's Messenger Harun, peace be upon him.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0117: To which Companion's share did Safiyyah bint Huyayy initially fall at Khaybar?
She fell to Dihyah al-Kalbi's share. The Prophet took her from him and compensated him with seven enslaved people.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0118: What did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) make Safiyyah bint Huyayy's mahr (bridal gift)?
The Messenger of Allah freed Safiyyah and made her emancipation her mahr (bridal gift).
mothers-ahlulbayt-0119: Which female Companion prepared Safiyyah bint Huyayy for marriage to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
The Prophet took Safiyyah and entrusted her to Umm Sulaym to prepare her and have her observe her iddah (waiting period) in her care.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0120: What food was served at the Prophet's wedding feast for Safiyyah bint Huyayy?
Tharid (bread soaked in broth) and milk
Dates, dried curd, and clarified butter
Anas reported that the feast consisted of clarified butter, dried curd, and dates.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0121: What compensation did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) give Dihyah al-Kalbi when he took Safiyyah from him?
Al-Dhahabi stated that he took her from Dihyah and compensated him with seven enslaved people.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0123: When the Prophet's camel stumbled with Safiyyah riding behind him and both fell, which Companion covered his own face with his garment, screened Safiyyah, and set the mount right?
Abu Talhah dismounted quickly. The Prophet said: «عليك المرأة» [Attend to the woman]. Abu Talhah covered his own face with a garment, approached her, and put it over her.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0124: The Mother of the Believers Maymunah was the sister of the wife of one of the Prophet's uncles. Who was her sister?
Umm al-Fadl Lubabah, wife of al-Abbas
Fatimah bint Asad, wife of Abu Talib
Umm Jamil, wife of Abu Lahab
Al-Dhahabi described Maymunah as the Prophet's wife and the sister of Umm al-Fadl, wife of al-Abbas.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0125: Maymunah bint al-Harith was the maternal aunt of which Companion?
Al-Dhahabi stated that she was the maternal aunt of Khalid ibn al-Walid and of Ibn Abbas.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0126: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) married Maymunah bint al-Harith upon completing which event?
He married her upon completing Umrat al-Qada (the make-up lesser pilgrimage), in Dhu al-Qadah of 7 AH.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0127: At which place did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) consummate his marriage to Maymunah, where she was later buried?
He consummated the marriage at Sarif. Yazid ibn al-Asamm stated that they buried Maymunah there, in the shelter where the marriage had been consummated.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0128: After which co-wife's death did Aishah say that she had been among the most mindful of Allah and most attentive to kinship ties?
Aishah told Maymunah's nephew Yazid ibn al-Asamm that Maymunah had passed away and had been among the most mindful of Allah and most attentive to kinship ties.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0129: At whose funeral in Sarif did Ibn Abbas tell the bearers not to shake or jolt her bier when lifting it?
Ata reported that they attended Maymunah's funeral at Sarif with Ibn Abbas, who gave that instruction.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0131: Which Mother of the Believers described the Prophet's ghusl (ritual bath) and said she offered him a cloth to dry himself, but he did not take it?
Maymunah reported offering him a cloth, which he did not take; he went away shaking the water from his hands.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0133: To which people did the Mother of the Believers Juwayriyah bint al-Harith belong?
Ibn Sad and others stated that Banu al-Mustaliq belonged to Khuzaah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0134: What was Juwayriyah bint al-Harith's name before the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) changed it?
Ibn Abbas reported that Juwayriyah was originally named Barrah and the Messenger of Allah changed her name to Juwayriyah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0135: Why did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) change the name Barrah to Juwayriyah?
It was the name of a pre-Islamic idol
He disliked it being said that he had left Barrah (piety)
She requested it after embracing Islam
Her father had named her that out of hatred of Islam
He disliked it being said that he had left Barrah (piety).
mothers-ahlulbayt-0136: Of whom did Aishah say that they had never seen a woman who brought greater blessing to her people?
When the Prophet married her, people released the captives of Banu al-Mustaliq they held. One hundred households were freed because of her.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0137: How many households of Banu al-Mustaliq were freed because the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) married Juwayriyah?
Aishah reported that his marriage to her led to the emancipation of one hundred households of Banu al-Mustaliq.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0138: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) left which wife early in the morning in her prayer place, returned later to find her still sitting, and taught her «سبحان الله وبحمده عدد خلقه...» [Glory be to Allah and all praise is due to Him by the number of His creation ...]?
The hadith is in Sahih Muslim, narrated by Juwayriyah (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0139: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) visited which wife on a Friday while she was fasting, and told her to break her fast after learning she had not fasted the day before and did not intend to fast the day after?
Juwayriyah bint al-Harith narrated that he visited her on Friday while she was fasting and asked «أصمت أمس؟» [Did you fast yesterday?] ... then said «فأفطري» [Then break your fast].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0140: Who was the father of the Mother of the Believers Juwayriyah?
She was Juwayriyah bint al-Harith ibn Abi Dirar al-Mustaliqiyyah. Her father was an obeyed chief.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0141: When the verse giving the Prophet's wives a choice was revealed, with which wife did he begin, saying «لا عليك أن تعجلي حتى تستأمري أبويك» [You need not hurry before consulting your parents]?
Aishah reported that the Messenger of Allah came to her when Allah commanded him to give his wives a choice, and began with her.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0142: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) swore not to visit his wives for a month. After how many days did he come down to them?
He swore to stay away from his wives for a month, then came down after twenty-nine days and said: «إن الشهر تسع وعشرون» [The month is twenty-nine days].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0143: Where did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) withdraw when he swore to stay away from his wives for a month?
Anas reported that the Messenger of Allah swore to stay away from his wives for a month and remained in an upper room of his.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0144: Who was the mother of the Commander of the Believers Ali ibn Abi Talib?
His mother was Fatimah bint Asad ibn Hashim ibn Abd Manaf al-Hashimiyyah, Abu Talib's paternal cousin.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0145: Which kunyah (parental honorific) did al-Dhahabi use to begin Ali ibn Abi Talib's biography?
Al-Dhahabi introduced Ali ibn Abi Talib as the Commander of the Believers, Abu al-Hasan al-Qurashi al-Hashimi.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0146: During which campaign, when leaving Ali behind, did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) say: «أما ترضى أن تكون مني بمنزلة هارون من موسى» [Are you not pleased to stand in relation to me as Harun did to Musa]?
The Messenger of Allah left Ali ibn Abi Talib behind during the Tabuk campaign. Ali asked whether he was leaving him with the women and children, and he gave that reply.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0147: What ailment did Ali ibn Abi Talib have at Khaybar when the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) summoned him to receive the banner?
He was said to be suffering from his eyes. The Messenger of Allah put his saliva in Ali's eyes and supplicated for him; he recovered, and the Prophet gave him the banner.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0148: Which Companion said at Khaybar that he had never desired command except on that day, hoping to receive the banner later given to Ali?
Umar ibn al-Khattab said that he had never desired command except that day, and he made himself conspicuous in the hope of being called.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0149: When Muhammad ibn al-Hanafiyyah asked his father Ali who was best after the Messenger of Allah, what did he answer?
Ali answered Abu Bakr. When asked who came next, he answered Umar.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0150: For which deceased caliph, lying on his bier, did Ali pray for mercy and say that no one left behind had deeds he would more wish to meet Allah with?
Ibn Abbas reported that Ali came, prayed for mercy for Umar, and made that statement.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0151: During Abu Bakr's Hajj (pilgrimage) in year nine, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) sent Ali to proclaim which surah to the people?
Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman reported that the Messenger of Allah then sent Ali after them and instructed him to proclaim Baraah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0152: Ali said: «إنه لعهدُ النبي الأمي ﷺ إليّ أن لا يحبني إلا ... ولا يبغضني إلا منافق» [The unlettered Prophet assured me that none but a ... would love me, and none but a hypocrite would hate me].

Ali said: «والذي فلق الحبة وبرأ النسمة، إنه لعهد النبي الأمي ﷺ إلي أن لا يحبني إلا مؤمن ولا يبغضني إلا منافق» [By the One who split the seed and created the soul, the unlettered Prophet assured me that none but a believer would love me, and none but a hypocrite would hate me].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0156: After Fatimah's death, Ali married which granddaughter of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
Umamah, daughter of Zaynab, the Messenger of Allah's daughter, married Ali ibn Abi Talib after Fatimah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0157: Who was the mother of Muhammad ibn al-Hanafiyyah, son of Ali ibn Abi Talib?
Al-Dhahabi stated that his mother, Khawlah bint Jafar al-Hanafiyyah, was among those taken captive at al-Yamamah in Abu Bakr al-Siddiq's time.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0158: Who wrote the treaty between the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) and Quraysh at al-Hudaybiyah?
Al-Bara reported that when the Messenger of Allah concluded peace with the people at al-Hudaybiyah, Ali ibn Abi Talib wrote the agreement.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0159: When Ali married Fatimah, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) told him «أعطها شيئًا» [Give her something]. When Ali said he had nothing, about what did the Prophet ask?
He asked: «أين درعك الحطمية؟» [where is your Hutami armor?] (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0160: When Shurayh ibn Hani asked Aishah about wiping over the khuffayn (leather socks), to which Companion who traveled with the Prophet did she direct him?
Aishah directed him to ask Ibn Abi Talib because he used to travel with the Messenger of Allah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0162: Which Companion narrated «إنّ ابني هذا سيّد» [This son of mine is a master] after seeing al-Hasan beside the Prophet on the pulpit?
The hadith is in Sahih al-Bukhari, narrated by Abu Bakrah (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0164: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) would hold al-Hasan and which other young Companion, saying «اللهم أحبّهما فإني أحبّهما» [O Allah, love them both, for I love them both]?
Usamah ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet would hold him and al-Hasan and say: «اللهم إني أحبهما فأحبهما» [O Allah, I love them both, so love them both].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0166: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) described al-Hasan and al-Husayn as his two ... in this world.
Ibn Umar heard the Prophet say: «هما ريحانتاي من الدنيا» [They [his two grandsons] are my two flowers in this world.] (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0167: Complete the hadith: «الحسن والحسين سيّدا ...» [Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn are the masters of ...].
He said: «الحسن والحسين سيدا شباب أهل الجنة» [Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn are the masters of the youth of Paradise.] Al-Tirmidhi graded it authentic (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0169: According to the more accurate account, in which year was al-Hasan ibn Ali born?
Al-Dhahabi stated that he was born in Shaban of 3 AH.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0170: What was al-Hasan ibn Ali's kunyah (parental honorific)?
Al-Dhahabi identified al-Hasan ibn Ali as Abu Muhammad al-Qurashi al-Hashimi al-Madani.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0171: What was al-Husayn ibn Ali's kunyah (parental honorific)?
Al-Dhahabi identified the martyr al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib as Abu Abd Allah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0172: According to al-Zubayr ibn Bakkar, in which year was al-Husayn ibn Ali born?
Al-Zubayr stated that he was born on the fifth of Shaban in 4 AH.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0174: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) went to the market of Banu Qaynuqa, then came to Fatimah's tent and asked «أثَمّ لُكَع؟ أثَمّ لُكَع؟» [Is the little fellow there? Is the little fellow there?]. Whom did he mean?
Abu Hurayrah reported that he asked «أثم لكع، أثم لكع؟» [Is the little fellow there? Is the little fellow there?], meaning al-Hasan.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0175: Which Companion led the Prophet's gray mule while the Prophet, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn rode it, taking them into his chamber?
Iyas ibn Salamah narrated from his father that he led the gray mule carrying Allah's Prophet, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn until he took them into the Prophet's chamber.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0176: In Muslim's Hadith al-Kisa (the cloak narration), whom did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) first bring under his cloak?
Aishah reported that al-Hasan ibn Ali came and he brought him under it, then al-Husayn joined him, then Fatimah, then Ali.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0177: Of what was the cloak made under which the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) gathered Ali, Fatimah, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn?
Aishah reported that he went out one morning wearing a patterned cloak made of black hair.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0178: Which verse did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) recite after bringing Ali, Fatimah, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn under his cloak?
«قل لا أسألكم عليه أجرًا إلا المودة في القربى» [Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., this message] any payment [but] only good will through [i.e., due to] kinship."]
«إن الله وملائكته يصلون على النبي» [Indeed, Allāh confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so].]
«إنما يريد الله ليذهب عنكم الرجس أهل البيت» [Allāh intends only to remove from you the impurity [of sin], O people of the [Prophet's] household]
«وأنذر عشيرتك الأقربين» [And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.]

He then recited: «إنما يريد الله ليذهب عنكم الرجس أهل البيت ويطهركم تطهيرا» [Allāh intends only to remove from you the impurity [of sin], O people of the [Prophet's] household, and to purify you with [extensive] purification.] Unchanged Quran excerpts: 42:23, 33:56, 33:33, 26:214 (QuranEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0179: At which watering place between Makkah and Madinah did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) address the people and say three times: «أذكّركم الله في أهل بيتي» [I remind you of Allah with regard to members of my family.]?
Zayd ibn Arqam reported that the Messenger of Allah once stood to address them at a watering place called Khumm between Makkah and Madinah (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0180: In Zayd ibn Arqam's hadith, complete «وأنا تاركٌ فيكم ثقلين: أوّلهما ...» [I am leaving with you two weighty things; the first is ...].

He said: «وأنا تارك فيكم ثقلين: أولهما كتاب الله فيه الهدى والنور... وأهل بيتي» [I am leaving with you two weighty things; the first is the Book of Allah, in which there is right guidance and light. ... And members of my family.] (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0181: Zayd ibn Arqam listed the Prophet's family members for whom charity was forbidden after him: the households of Ali, Aqil, Jafar, and ...
Zayd identified them as the households of Ali, Aqil, Jafar, and al-Abbas.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0183: How did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) explain why charity was forbidden to the family of Muhammad?
It was wealth of the Bedouins
It was exclusively the poor's entitlement
It was the impurities of people's wealth
He said: «إن الصدقة لا تنبغي لآل محمد، إنما هي أوساخ الناس» [Charity is not appropriate for the family of Muhammad; it is the impurities of people's wealth].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0184: Which clan did Allah choose from Quraysh and then choose His Prophet from it?
He said: «واصطفى من قريش بني هاشم، واصطفاني من بني هاشم» [the children of Hāshim from Quraysh, and me from the children of Hāshim.] (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0185: Who said that people should honor Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) by respecting his household?
Ibn Umar narrated this instruction from Abu Bakr.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0186: Which Companion asked Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla whether he could give him a gift, then taught him how to invoke blessings upon the Prophet and his family?
Kab ibn Ujrah met him and offered a gift he had heard from the Prophet, then related the invocation of blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0187: In Abu Humayd al-Saidi's narration of invoking blessings upon the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him), complete «اللهم صلّ على محمد و...» [O Allah, bestow blessings upon Muhammad and ...].

He said: «قولوا: اللهم صل على محمد وأزواجه وذريته كما صليت على آل إبراهيم» [Say: O Allah, bestow blessings upon Muhammad, his wives, and his descendants as You bestowed blessings upon the family of Ibrahim].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0190: The verse «هذان خصمان اختصموا في ربهم» [These[921] are two adversaries who have disputed over their Lord.] was revealed about those who fought individual duels at Badr. Who were the Muslims among them?
Hamzah, Ali, and Ubaydah ibn al-Harith
Umar, Ali, and Sad ibn Muadh
Hamzah, Jafar, and Zayd ibn Harithah
Qays ibn Ubad named the duelists at Badr as Hamzah, Ali, and Ubaydah ibn al-Harith, and Shaybah, Utbah, and al-Walid. Quran 22:19 (QuranEnc) [921] i.e., the believers and the disbelievers.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0191: After the Prophet's death, through whose supplication did Umar ibn al-Khattab seek rain when the people suffered drought?

During drought Umar would seek rain through al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib, saying: «اللهم إنا كنا نتوسل إليك بنبينا... وإنا نتوسل إليك بعم نبينا فاسقنا» [O Allah, we used to seek a means to You through our Prophet ... and now we seek a means to You through our Prophet's uncle, so grant us rain].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0192: Concerning al-Abbas, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) told Umar: «يا عمر، أما شعرتَ أنّ عمّ الرجل ...» [O Umar, do you not know that a man's paternal uncle is ...]?
He said: «يا عمر أما شعرت أن عم الرجل صنو أبيه» [O ‘Umar, do you not know that a man’s uncle is like his father?] (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0193: At Hunayn, al-Abbas held the bridle of the Prophet's mule. Who held its stirrup?
Al-Abbas reported holding the bridle of the Messenger of Allah's mule to restrain it while Abu Sufyan held its stirrup.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0194: Which uncle did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) command at Hunayn to call out to the people who pledged beneath the samurah tree?
He said: «أي عباس، ناد أصحاب السمرة» [O Abbas, call out to those who pledged beneath the samurah tree]. Al-Abbas had a loud voice.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0195: Which uncle carried stones with the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) when Quraysh rebuilt the Kabah?
Jabir reported that when the Kabah was being built, the Prophet and al-Abbas went to carry stones.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0198: Which caliph led the funeral prayer for al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib?
Al-Dhahabi stated that al-Abbas died in 32 AH and Uthman led his funeral prayer.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0199: In the Farewell Hajj (pilgrimage) address, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «وأوّل ربًا أضع ربانا ربا ...» [The first riba (interest) I abolish is our own, that of ...].
He said: «وأول ربا أضع ربانا ربا عباس بن عبد المطلب فإنه موضوع كله» [The first riba (interest) I abolish is our own, the riba of Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib; it is abolished in its entirety].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0200: In the Farewell Hajj (pilgrimage), the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «وإنّ أول دمٍ أضع من دمائنا دمُ ابنِ ...» [The first blood claim of ours that I abolish is that for the son of ...].

He said: «وإن أول دم أضع من دمائنا دم ابن ربيعة بن الحارث، كان مسترضعًا في بني سعد» [The first blood claim of ours that I abolish is that for the son of Rabiah ibn al-Harith, who was being nursed among Banu Sad].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0201: Which kunyah (parental honorific) did al-Dhahabi mention first for Hamzah ibn Abd al-Muttalib?
Al-Dhahabi described him as Asad Allah (the Lion of Allah), Abu Umarah and Abu Yala al-Qurashi al-Hashimi.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0202: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) declined to marry Hamzah's daughter because Hamzah was his brother through which relationship?
He said: «إنها ابنة أخي من الرضاعة» [She is the daughter of my brother through breastfeeding].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0203: After Umrat al-Qada (the make-up lesser pilgrimage), Ali, Jafar, and Zayd disputed custody of Hamzah's daughter. To whom did the Prophet award her?
Ali, because he was her cousin
Al-Abbas, because he was her uncle
Zayd, because he was Hamzah's brother
The Prophet awarded her to her maternal aunt, saying: «الخالة بمنزلة الأم» [The maternal aunt has the standing of the mother].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0204: To which cousin did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) say: «أشبهتَ خَلقي وخُلقي» [You resemble me in appearance and character]?
He told Ali: «أنت مني وأنا منك» [You are of me and I am of you], and Jafar: «أشبهت خلقي وخلقي» [You resemble me in appearance and character].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0205: In the case of Hamzah's daughter, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) told Ali: «أنت مني و...» [You are of me and ...].
You are my brother in this world
You are the ally of every believer
You are this community's trusted one
He told Ali: «أنت مني وأنا منك» [You are of me and I am of you].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0206: When Ibn Umar greeted Abd Allah ibn Jafar, he would address him as the son of which title?
When greeting Ibn Jafar, Ibn Umar would say: Peace be upon you, son of Dhu al-Janahayn (possessor of two wings).
mothers-ahlulbayt-0208: How many years older was Jafar ibn Abi Talib than his brother Ali?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Jafar was ten years older than his brother Ali ibn Abi Talib.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0209: When did Jafar ibn Abi Talib return from Abyssinia to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
When the Muslims were at Khaybar just after its conquest
In the year of the conquest of Makkah
He migrated from Abyssinia to Madinah, meeting the Muslims at Khaybar just after they had taken it.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0210: Who told the migrants that he would be their spokesman when al-Najashi summoned them?
Ibn Masud reported that Jafar said he would be their spokesman, and they followed him.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0211: According to al-Dhahabi, Mutah, where Jafar ibn Abi Talib was martyred, lay in which region?
The Messenger of Allah appointed him to command the army for the Mutah campaign in the region of al-Karak, and he was martyred there.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0212: What was Aqil ibn Abi Talib's kunyah (parental honorific)?
Al-Dhahabi listed his sons Muslim and Yazid, explaining that his kunyah (parental honorific) was taken from Yazid.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0213: Aqil ibn Abi Talib was captured at Badr and had no wealth. Who ransomed him?
He attended Badr as a polytheist under compulsion and was captured. Having no wealth, he was ransomed by his uncle al-Abbas.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0214: In al-Bukhari's narration concerning Ibn Abbas's virtues, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) embraced him and said: «اللهم علّمه ...» [O Allah, teach him ...].
Ibn Abbas said that the Prophet embraced him and said: «اللهم علمه الحكمة» [O Allah, teach him wisdom].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0215: Ibn Abbas set out water for the Prophet's wudu (ablution). When the Prophet learned this, what supplication did he make for him in Muslim's narration?
He said: «اللهم فقهه» [O Allah, grant him understanding].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0216: Which Companion called Ibn Abbas an excellent interpreter of the Quran?
Abd Allah ibn Masud described Ibn Abbas as an excellent interpreter of the Quran.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0217: In which city did Abd Allah ibn Abbas die?
Bujayr ibn Abi Ubayd stated that Ibn Abbas died in al-Taif.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0218: Where was Abd Allah ibn Abbas born?
Al-Dhahabi stated that he was born in the valley of Banu Hashim three years before the Hijrah (migration).
mothers-ahlulbayt-0219: Umar included Ibn Abbas with the elders who had fought at Badr. About which surah did Ibn Abbas say that it foretold the approaching death of the Messenger of Allah?

Umar asked about «إذا جاء نصر الله والفتح» [When the victory of Allāh has come and the conquest,[2005]]. Ibn Abbas explained that it informed the Messenger of Allah of his approaching death. Quran 110:1 (QuranEnc) [2005] The conquest of Makkah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0220: Whom did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) seat behind him from Muzdalifah to Mina during the Farewell Hajj (pilgrimage)?
Ibn Abbas reported that Usamah rode behind the Prophet from Arafah to Muzdalifah, then al-Fadl rode behind him from Muzdalifah to Mina.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0223: In which land was Abd Allah ibn Jafar ibn Abi Talib born?
Al-Dhahabi described him as Abu Jafar al-Qurashi al-Hashimi, born in Abyssinia and resident in Madinah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0224: Who took Abd Allah ibn Jafar into his care after his father's martyrdom at Mutah and brought him up?
His uncle Ali ibn Abi Talib
Al-Dhahabi stated that after his father was martyred at Mutah, the Prophet took him into his care and brought him up.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0225: Whom did al-Dhahabi describe as the last member of Banu Hashim to have seen and accompanied the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Abd Allah ibn Jafar was the last of Banu Hashim who had seen and accompanied the Prophet.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0226: Safiyyah bint Abd al-Muttalib, the Prophet's paternal aunt, was the mother of which Companion?
Al-Dhahabi stated that she was Hamzah's full sister and the mother of al-Zubayr, the Prophet's devoted supporter.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0227: Safiyyah bint Abd al-Muttalib was the full sister of which uncle of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
Al-Dhahabi stated that she was Hamzah's full sister and that her mother belonged to Banu Zuhrah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0230: Who was Umm Hani bint Abi Talib's husband, who fled to Najran on the day of the conquest of Makkah?
Al-Dhahabi stated that she was married to Hubayrah ibn Amr ibn Aidh al-Makhzumi, who fled to Najran on the day of the conquest.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0231: On the day of the conquest of Makkah, to which cousin did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) say: «قد أجرنا من أجرتِ» [We grant protection to the person you have protected]?
Umm Hani said that her brother intended to kill a man she had protected. The Prophet replied: «قد أجرنا من أجرت يا أم هانئ» [We grant protection to the person you have protected, Umm Hani].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0232: When Umm Hani visited the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) in the year of the conquest, she found him bathing while which female relative screened him?
Umm Hani reported visiting the Messenger of Allah in the year of the conquest and finding him bathing while his daughter Fatimah screened him.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0233: After Jafar ibn Abi Talib's martyrdom, which senior Companion did Asma bint Umays marry?
Al-Dhahabi stated that after Jafar was martyred at Mutah, she married Abu Bakr al-Siddiq and later Ali ibn Abi Talib.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0235: Which member of the Prophet's household visited Jabir and narrated Jabir's long account of the Prophet's Hajj (pilgrimage), recorded by Muslim?
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn described visiting Jabir and introducing himself as Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0236: Why was Abu Jafar Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn called al-Baqir?
He lived in a place called al-Baqir
He wept often out of fear of Allah
He opened up knowledge, probing its foundations
He tended cattle as a child
Al-Dhahabi explained that Abu Jafar became known as al-Baqir because he opened up knowledge, grasping its foundations and hidden aspects.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0237: Who said that he had never seen a man of Quraysh superior to Ali ibn al-Husayn Zayn al-Abidin?
Ibn Uyaynah narrated this statement from al-Zuhri.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0239: According to al-Dhahabi, al-Husayn's descendants survived only through which son?
Al-Dhahabi stated that his grave is in al-Baqi and that al-Husayn's line continued only through his son Zayn al-Abidin.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0241: Who was the eldest daughter of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Zaynab was the Messenger of Allah's eldest daughter.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0242: How was Abu al-As ibn al-Rabi related to his wife Zaynab, the Messenger of Allah's daughter, before their marriage?
Al-Dhahabi stated that her maternal aunt's son Abu al-As married her during her mother's lifetime.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0243: In which year did Zaynab, daughter of the Messenger of Allah, die?
Al-Dhahabi stated that she died in 8 AH and Umm Atiyyah washed her body.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0245: Which granddaughter did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) carry while praying, putting her down when prostrating and lifting her when standing?
The Messenger of Allah prayed while carrying Umamah, daughter of Zaynab, his own daughter.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0247: Who married Ruqayyah, the Messenger of Allah's daughter, before Uthman but separated from her before consummation?
Ibn Sad stated that Utbah ibn Abi Lahab married her, then separated from her before consummation when «تبت يدا أبي لهب» [May the hands of Abū Lahab be ruined] was revealed. Quran 111:1 (QuranEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0248: What was the name of Uthman's son by Ruqayyah, the Messenger of Allah's daughter, from whom his kunyah (parental honorific) was taken?
She bore Uthman a son named Abd Allah, from whom he took his kunyah (parental honorific).
mothers-ahlulbayt-0249: By the Prophet's instruction, Uthman stayed behind from Badr to nurse which wife, a daughter of the Messenger of Allah?
Ruqayyah became ill shortly before Badr, so the Prophet left Uthman with her. She died while the Muslims were at Badr.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0250: In which year did Uthman marry Umm Kulthum, daughter of the Messenger of Allah, after her sister's death?
After her sister Ruqayyah died, Uthman married Umm Kulthum, who was a virgin, in Rabi al-Awwal of year three.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0251: Which daughter of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) married Uthman but bore him no children?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Uthman married Umm Kulthum, a virgin, in Rabi al-Awwal of year three, and she bore him no children.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0252: In which year did Umm Kulthum, daughter of the Messenger of Allah, die?
Al-Dhahabi stated that she died in Shaban of year nine.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0253: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) sat by a daughter's grave with tears in his eyes, then instructed which Companion to descend into it?

He asked: «هل فيكم من أحد لم يقارف الليلة؟» [Is there anyone among you who has not had intercourse tonight?] Abu Talhah answered that he had not, and the Prophet said: «فانزل في قبرها» [Then descend into her grave].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0254: After whom did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) name his son Ibrahim?
His forefather Ibrahim, peace be upon him
He said: «ولد لي الليلة غلام فسميته باسم أبي إبراهيم» [A boy was born to me tonight, and I named him after my forefather Ibrahim].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0257: During the Prophet's lifetime, the sun was eclipsed on the day which son died, leading people to say the eclipse was because of his death?
Al-Mughirah reported that the sun was eclipsed on the day Ibrahim died, and people said it was because of his death.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0258: When the Prophet's eyes filled with tears at his son Ibrahim's death, which Companion asked whether he too was weeping?
Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf asked whether he too was weeping. He replied: «يا ابن عوف إنها رحمة» [O Ibn ‘Awf, this is a mercy.] (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0259: When his son Ibrahim died, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said that he had what in Paradise?
Al-Bara reported that when Ibrahim died the Messenger of Allah said: «إن له مرضعًا في الجنة» [There is a wet nurse for him in Paradise.] (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0260: Who was the mother of Ibrahim, the Prophet's son?
Hatib ibn Abi Baltaah returned from al-Muqawqis with a gift for the Prophet: Mariyah al-Qibtiyyah, mother of his son Ibrahim.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0261: Which Companion returned from al-Muqawqis with his gifts for the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him), including Mariyah al-Qibtiyyah?
In year seven, Hatib ibn Abi Baltaah returned from his mission to al-Muqawqis, bringing Mariyah al-Qibtiyyah as a gift for the Prophet.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0263: From which son was the Prophet's widely attested kunyah (parental honorific) taken?
Al-Dhahabi stated that his kunyah (parental honorific), Abu al-Qasim, is established by numerous reports.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0264: During the Prophet's final illness, which brother of Aishah entered carrying a siwak (tooth-cleaning stick), which she took and softened for him?
Aishah reported that Abd al-Rahman entered with a siwak (tooth-cleaning stick) while she was supporting the Messenger of Allah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0265: Aishah said that among Allah's favors to her was that the Messenger of Allah died in her house, on her day, and ...
While she was reciting over him
She reported that he died in her house, on her day, between her chest and neck, and that Allah brought their saliva together at his death.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0266: By which kunyah (parental honorific) was the Mother of the Believers Aishah known?
The Prophet told her: «فاكتني بابنك عبد الله» [Take your kunyah from your son Abd Allah], meaning her nephew Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr. She was therefore called Umm Abd Allah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0268: With what did Aishah and her friends play in the Prophet's presence?
Aishah reported playing with dolls in the Prophet's presence, with female friends who played with her.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0269: Whom did Aishah watch playing with spears in the mosque while the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) screened her with his cloak?
Aishah reported seeing the Messenger of Allah at her chamber's doorway while the Abyssinians played in the mosque and he screened her with his cloak.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0270: Aishah raced the Prophet and beat him. After she gained weight, he beat her in another race. What did he say?
This makes up for that earlier race
The wise person calls himself to account
A person will be with those he loves
He said: «هذه بتلك السبقة» [This makes up for that earlier race].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0271: Which Mother of the Believers narrated that whenever the Prophet left her house, he looked to the sky and said: «اللهم إني أعوذ بك أن أَضِلّ أو أُضَلّ...» [O Allah, I seek refuge in You from going astray or being led astray ...]?
Umm Salamah reported that whenever the Prophet left her house he looked to the sky and said this.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0272: Who narrated the account of the beginning of revelation: «أوّل ما بُدئ به رسول الله ﷺ من الوحي الرؤيا الصالحة في النوم» [The first thing the Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) started to experience from the revelation was the good vision in his sleep.]?
The hadith is in Sahih al-Bukhari, from Urwah ibn al-Zubayr, from the Mother of the Believers Aishah (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0273: Sawdah bint Zamah reported that a sheep of theirs died and they tanned its hide. What did they then use it for?
Steeping fruit for drinks until it became worn out
Sawdah reported that a sheep died, so they tanned its hide and kept steeping fruit for drinks in it until the skin became worn out.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0274: When news of Abu Sufyan's death arrived from al-Sham, why did his daughter, a Mother of the Believers, apply a yellow fragrance on the third day?
She was about to leave for Hajj (pilgrimage)
The Prophet had instructed her to do so before his death
Mourning for anyone other than a husband is not permitted beyond three days

Umm Habibah heard the Prophet say: «لا يحل لامرأة تؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر أن تحد على ميت فوق ثلاث إلا على زوج» [A woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day may not mourn a deceased person for more than three days, except for a husband].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0275: To which young stepson did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) say: «يا غلام، سمّ الله، وكُل بيمينك، وكُل مما يليك» [O boy, mention Allah's name, eat with your right hand, and eat from what is nearer to you.]?
Umar ibn Abi Salamah reported that he was a boy under the Messenger of Allah's care and his hand wandered over the food platter, so the Prophet said this (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0277: Umm Habibah suggested that the Prophet marry her sister, another daughter of Abu Sufyan. Why did he decline?
Her sister had not yet embraced Islam
It was not lawful while he was married to Umm Habibah
She suggested marriage to her sister, Abu Sufyan's daughter. He replied: «إن ذلك لا يحل لي» [That is not lawful for me].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0279: When news of Jafar ibn Abi Talib's death arrived, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «اصنعوا لآل جعفر ...، فإنه قد أتاهم أمرٌ شغلهم» [Prepare ... for Jafar's family, for something has happened that has occupied them].
He said: «اصنعوا لآل جعفر طعامًا فإنه قد أتاهم أمر شغلهم» [Prepare food for Jafar's family, for something has happened that has occupied them].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0280: Umar ibn al-Khattab said: Ubayy is our best Quran reciter, and our best judge is ...
Umar stated that Ubayy was their best Quran reciter and Ali their best judge.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0281: Where did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) send Ali as a judge while he was still young?
Ali reported that the Messenger of Allah sent him to Yemen as a judge, and he asked whether he was sending him despite his youth.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0282: When «وأنذر عشيرتك الأقربين» [And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.] was revealed, which paternal aunt did the Prophet address, saying «لا أغني عنك من الله شيئًا» [I cannot protect you at all against Allah]?

He said: «ويا صفية عمة رسول الله لا أغني عنك من الله شيئًا، ويا فاطمة بنت محمد سليني ما شئت» [Safiyyah, aunt of the Messenger of Allah, I cannot protect you at all against Allah. Fatimah daughter of Muhammad, ask me for whatever you wish]. Quran 26:214 (QuranEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0283: To which cousin did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) say: «حُجّي واشترطي، قولي: اللهم مَحِلّي حيث حبستني» [Perform Hajj and stipulate a condition, saying: O Allah, my place of release from ihram (consecration) is wherever You prevent me from proceeding]?
The Messenger of Allah visited Dubaah bint al-Zubayr and asked whether she intended Hajj (pilgrimage), then told her: «حجي واشترطي» [Perform Hajj and stipulate a condition].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0284: When people disputed whether the Prophet was fasting on the day of Arafah, which wife of al-Abbas sent him milk, which he drank?
Umm al-Fadl reported that people disputed whether he was fasting on Arafah, so she sent a cup of milk while he was stationary on his camel, and he drank it.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0285: Which member of Banu Hashim was riding behind the Prophet when a woman of Khatham approached, and the Prophet turned his face away as he looked at her?
Ibn Abbas reported that al-Fadl was riding behind the Messenger of Allah when a woman of Khatham came, and al-Fadl began looking at her.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0286: When al-Fadl ibn al-Abbas and Abd al-Muttalib ibn Rabiah asked the Prophet to employ them as charity collectors, what did he order?
That they be married and their bridal gifts paid from the khums (one-fifth share)
That they receive the collectors' share of charity
That they be sent with Muadh to Yemen
That they be employed to collect jizyah (tribute)
He said: «إن الصدقة لا تنبغي لآل محمد» [Charity is not appropriate for the family of Muhammad] ... then ordered that they be married and their bridal gifts paid from the khums (one-fifth share).
mothers-ahlulbayt-0287: Hafsah, Zaynab bint Jahsh, and others set up tents in the mosque for itikaf (devotional seclusion). What did the Prophet say when he saw them?
«بارك الله لكن فيها» [May Allah bless them for you]
«آلبرَّ تُرَون بهن؟» [Do you think they seek righteousness by this?]
«هذا أحب إليّ من غيره» [This is dearer to me than anything else]
«اعتكفن في بيوتكن أجرًا» [Observe seclusion in your houses for reward]
Seeing the tents, he asked what they were. When informed, he said: «آلبر ترون بهن؟» [Do you think they seek righteousness by this?] He then gave up itikaf (devotional seclusion) that month.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0288: On Umar's final Hajj (pilgrimage), he allowed the Prophet's wives to perform Hajj and sent which two Companions with them?
Uthman and Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf
On his last Hajj (pilgrimage), Umar allowed the Prophet's wives to go and sent Uthman ibn Affan and Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf with them.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0289: Umar told the Prophet's wives that if he divorced them, his Lord might replace them with better wives. A verse with that wording was then revealed in which surah?

Umar reported that Allah revealed: «عسى ربه إن طلقكن أن يبدله أزواجا خيرا منكن مسلمات» [Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to Allāh]]. Quran 66:5 in Surat al-Tahrim (QuranEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0291: Allah promised any of the Prophet's wives who devoutly obeyed Allah and His Messenger and did righteousness that her reward would be given how many times?

Allah says: «ومن يقنت منكن لله ورسوله وتعمل صالحا نؤتها أجرها مرتين» [And whoever of you devoutly obeys Allāh and His Messenger and does righteousness - We will give her her reward twice]. Al-Ahzab: 31 (QuranEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0292: Which verse explicitly forbids marrying the Prophet's wives after him?
«وقرن في بيوتكن ولا تبرجن» [And abide in your houses and do not display yourselves]
«يدنين عليهن من جلابيبهن» [to bring down over themselves [part] of their outer garments.[1209]]
«يا نساء النبي لستن كأحد من النساء» [O wives of the Prophet, you are not like anyone among women.]
«ولا أن تنكحوا أزواجه من بعده أبدًا» [or to marry his wives after him, ever.]

Allah says: «وما كان لكم أن تؤذوا رسول الله ولا أن تنكحوا أزواجه من بعده أبدا» [And it is not [conceivable or lawful] for you to harm the Messenger of Allāh or to marry his wives after him, ever.] Quran 33:53; choices from 33:33, 33:59, 33:32, 33:53 (QuranEnc) [1209] The jilbāb, which is defined as a cloak covering the head and reaching to the ground, thereby covering the woman's entire body.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0293: Al-Bayda Umm Hakim bint Abd al-Muttalib, the Prophet's paternal aunt, was the maternal grandmother of which Rightly Guided Caliph?
She married Kurayz ibn Rabiah and bore him Amir and Arwa, the mother of the martyr Uthman.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0294: Asma bint Umays bore Jafar ibn Abi Talib three sons in Abyssinia. Which of these was one of them?
Her husband Jafar al-Tayyar migrated with her to Abyssinia, where she bore Abd Allah, Muhammad, and Awn.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0296: Muhammad ibn al-Hanafiyyah was born in the year of whose death?
Fatimah, the Messenger of Allah's daughter
Al-Dhahabi stated that he was born in the year Abu Bakr died.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0299: During the false accusation against Aishah, which wife told the Prophet that she guarded her hearing and sight and knew only good of Aishah?
Aishah reported that the Messenger of Allah asked Zaynab bint Jahsh about her and Zaynab gave that answer. Although Zaynab rivaled her in standing, Allah protected her through piety.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0300: For which wife did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) give a finer wedding feast than for his other wives, slaughtering a sheep?
Anas reported that the Prophet never gave a wedding feast for any wife like the one he gave for Zaynab, for which he slaughtered a sheep.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0302: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) visited Ali and Fatimah at night and asked «ألا تصلّيان؟» [Will you not pray?]. After Ali's reply, he left striking his thigh and reciting which words?
«وكان الإنسان أكثر شيء جدلًا» [but man has ever been, most of anything, [prone to] dispute.]
«وخلق الإنسان ضعيفًا» [and mankind was created weak.]
«إن الإنسان لربه لكنود» [Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.]
«إن الإنسان خلق هلوعًا» [Indeed, mankind was created anxious:]

Ali replied that their souls were in Allah's hands. The Prophet left striking his thigh and reciting «وكان الإنسان أكثر شيء جدلا» [but man has ever been, most of anything, [prone to] dispute.]. Unchanged Quran excerpts: 18:54, 4:28, 100:6, 70:19 (QuranEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0303: Who narrated the hadith in Sahih al-Bukhari: «خير نسائها مريم ابنة عمران، وخير نسائها خديجة» [The best of its women is Maryam daughter of Imran, and the best of its women is Khadijah]?
The hadith is in Sahih al-Bukhari, narrated by Ali ibn Abi Talib.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0304: Who narrated «دع ما يريبك إلى ما لا يريبك» [Leave what you doubt for what you do not doubt.] in al-Tirmidhi, saying that he memorized it from the Messenger of Allah?
Al-Hasan ibn Ali said that he memorized from the Messenger of Allah: «دع ما يريبك إلى ما لا يريبك» [Leave what you doubt for what you do not doubt.] Al-Tirmidhi graded it authentic (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0305: Which young member of Banu Hashim was riding behind the Prophet when he said: «يا غلام، إني أعلّمك كلمات: احفظ الله يحفظك» [O boy, I shall teach you some words: Be mindful of Allah, and Allah will protect you.]?

Ibn Abbas reported riding behind the Messenger of Allah one day, when he said «يا غلام إني أعلمك كلمات» [O boy, I shall teach you some words] ... Al-Tirmidhi graded it sound and authentic (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0306: Which boy of Banu Hashim did the Prophet seat behind him and tell a secret that he said he would never reveal to anyone?
Abd Allah ibn Jafar reported that the Messenger of Allah seated him behind him one day and told him a secret he would never reveal to anyone.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0307: Which uncle of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) granted protection to Abu Sufyan ibn Harb shortly before the conquest of Makkah?

Al-Dhahabi stated that al-Abbas was not counted among al-Tulaqa (those pardoned at Makkah's conquest), since he had joined the Prophet before the conquest, as shown by his granting protection to Abu Sufyan ibn Harb.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0308: What was the personal name of Abd al-Muttalib, the Prophet's grandfather?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Abd al-Muttalib's name was Shaybah, Hashim's was Amr, Abd Manaf's was al-Mughirah, and Qusayy's was Zayd.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0309: What was the personal name of Hashim ibn Abd Manaf, after whom Banu Hashim are named?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Hashim's name was Amr and Abd Manaf's was al-Mughirah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0310: What was the personal name of Abu Talib, the Prophet's uncle and Ali's father?
Al-Dhahabi gave Ali's lineage as Ali ibn Abi Talib Abd Manaf ibn Abd al-Muttalib ibn Hashim.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0311: Which member of Banu Hashim supported the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) with three thousand spears at Hunayn and stood firm beside him?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Nawfal witnessed Bayat al-Ridwan (the Pledge of Divine Pleasure), supported the Messenger of Allah at Hunayn with three thousand spears, and stood firm beside him that day.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0312: Nawfal ibn al-Harith ibn Abd al-Muttalib was the brother of which member of Banu Hashim?
Al-Dhahabi identified Nawfal ibn al-Harith, Abu al-Harith, as the brother of Abu Sufyan ibn al-Harith.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0317: What was the name of the Prophet's stepdaughter Zaynab bint Abi Salamah before he renamed her Zaynab?
Zaynab bint Umm Salamah reported that her name was Barrah and the Messenger of Allah renamed her Zaynab.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0318: Which Mother of the Believers did al-Dhahabi describe as having been born after the advent of Islam?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Aishah was born after the advent of Islam and was eight years younger than Fatimah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0319: According to al-Dhahabi, how many years younger was Aishah than Fatimah, the Messenger of Allah's daughter?
Al-Dhahabi stated that she was eight years younger than Fatimah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0320: According to al-Dhahabi, what title was given to Aishah because of her fair complexion?
Al-Dhahabi described her as a beautiful, fair-complexioned woman, which is why she was called al-Humayra.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0322: Al-Dhahabi stated that no wife was living farther away than Umm Habibah when the Prophet married her. Where was she when the contract was concluded?
Al-Dhahabi explained that she was the most distant of his wives when he married her, since their marriage contract was concluded in Abyssinia.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0324: Where did al-Dhahabi conclude that the Mother of the Believers Umm Habibah was buried?
Al-Dhahabi dismissed the claim that her grave was in Damascus and stated that it was in Madinah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0326: According to al-Dhahabi, how many hadiths from Hafsah are in Baqi ibn Makhlad's Musnad?
Al-Dhahabi stated that her Musnad in Baqi ibn Makhlad's work contains sixty hadiths.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0327: According to al-Dhahabi, how many hadiths did Zaynab bint Jahsh narrate?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Zaynab had eleven hadiths, two of which were included by both al-Bukhari and Muslim.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0328: According to al-Dhahabi, how many hadiths are in Umm Habibah's Musnad?
Al-Dhahabi stated that her Musnad contains sixty-five hadiths.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0329: According to al-Dhahabi's count, how many hadiths in total did the Mother of the Believers Maymunah narrate in the two Sahih collections?
Al-Dhahabi stated that all she narrated amounted to thirteen hadiths.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0330: According to al-Dhahabi, who was Umm al-Fadl Lubabah bint al-Harith's maternal half-sister?
Al-Dhahabi described her as the sister of the Mother of the Believers Maymunah, the maternal aunt of Khalid ibn al-Walid, and the maternal half-sister of Asma bint Umays.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0331: According to al-Dhahabi, how many sons did Umm al-Fadl bear al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib?
Al-Dhahabi described her as the wife of al-Abbas, the Prophet's uncle, and the mother of his six distinguished sons.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0333: According to al-Dhahabi, approximately how many months did Abd Allah ibn Abbas accompany the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him)?
Al-Dhahabi stated that he accompanied the Prophet for about thirty months and narrated a substantial number of reports from him.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0334: What was Abd Allah ibn Abbas's kunyah (parental honorific)?
Al-Dhahabi described Abd Allah ibn Abbas as al-Bahr, Abu al-Abbas al-Hashimi, the great scholar of the community.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0335: With which title did al-Dhahabi describe Abd Allah ibn Abbas in the heading of his biography?
The heading of his biography in al-Dhahabi's work is Abd Allah ibn Abbas al-Bahr, Abu al-Abbas al-Hashimi.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0337: Where is Ali ibn al-Husayn Zayn al-Abidin buried?
Al-Dhahabi stated that his grave is in al-Baqi.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0338: According to his son Abu Jafar al-Baqir, how long did Ali ibn al-Husayn Zayn al-Abidin live?
Abu Jafar al-Baqir stated that his father lived fifty-eight years.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0340: How much produce from Khaybar did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) allot to Aqil ibn Abi Talib each year?
Al-Dhahabi stated that the Messenger of Allah allotted him one hundred and forty wasqs, a measure of produce, from Khaybar annually.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0341: According to Ibn Sad, when did Aqil ibn Abi Talib migrate to Madinah?
Ibn Sad stated that Aqil migrated at the beginning of year eight and participated at Mutah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0345: The Muslims captured Nawfal ibn al-Harith at Badr while he was with the polytheists. Who ransomed him?
Al-Dhahabi stated that Nawfal attended Badr with the polytheists, was captured and ransomed by his uncle al-Abbas, then embraced Islam and migrated in the year of al-Khandaq.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0347: In Muslim's narration, what glad tidings did the Prophet give Fatimah during his illness, making her laugh?
Her two sons would become caliphs
She would live long after him
Her father would recover from his illness
She would be the foremost woman among believing women or the women of this community

He told her: «يا فاطمة، أما ترضين أن تكوني سيدة نساء المؤمنين أو سيدة نساء هذه الأمة؟» [O Fātimah, would it please you to know that you will be the head of the believing women or the head of the women of this Ummah?] (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0348: When the Prophet returned from a journey and was greeted by children of his household, he seated Abd Allah ibn Jafar in front of him. Whom did he seat behind him?
Abd Allah ibn Jafar reported that he was seated in front of the Prophet, then one of Fatimah's two sons was brought and seated behind him.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0352: In the hadith comparing their standing, the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) told Ali: «أنت مني بمنزلة هارون من موسى، إلا أنه ...» [Your standing in relation to me is like Harun's to Musa, except that ...].
You are not my maternal brother
You do not inherit my wealth
There is no prophet after me
He told Ali: «أنت مني بمنزلة هارون من موسى إلا أنه لا نبي بعدي» [Your standing in relation to me is like Harun's to Musa, except that there is no prophet after me].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0353: When «وأنذر عشيرتك الأقربين» [And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.] was revealed, the Prophet told his daughter: «يا فاطمة بنت محمد، سليني ما شئتِ من ...، لا أغني عنك من الله شيئًا» [Fatimah daughter of Muhammad, ask me for whatever you wish of my ..., but I cannot protect you at all against Allah].

He said: «ويا فاطمة بنت محمد سليني ما شئت من مالي، لا أغني عنك من الله شيئًا» [Fatimah daughter of Muhammad, ask me for whatever you wish of my wealth, but I cannot protect you at all against Allah]. Quran 26:214 (QuranEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0355: According to Qatadah and Urwah, how many years before the Hijrah (migration) did Khadijah die?
Qatadah stated that she died three years before the Hijrah (migration), and Urwah gave the same account.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0356: Which Companion said that al-Hasan ibn Ali resembled his grandfather, the Messenger of Allah, as al-Dhahabi mentioned at the start of his biography?
Al-Dhahabi stated that al-Hasan resembled his grandfather, the Messenger of Allah, citing Abu Juhayfah.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0357: Al-Hasan ibn Ali remembered taking a date from charity dates, which the Prophet removed from his mouth. What explanation did the Prophet give?
«إنها من مال اليتيم» [It is from an orphan's property]
«إنا آل محمد لا تحل لنا الصدقة» [Charity is not lawful for us, the family of Muhammad]
«إن الصدقة للعاملين عليها» [Charity is for those who administer it]
«إنها لم تنضج بعد» [It has not ripened yet]
Al-Hasan reported that the Messenger of Allah removed it with his saliva still on it and said: «إنا آل محمد لا تحل لنا الصدقة» [Charity is not lawful for us, the family of Muhammad].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0359: Which daughter of al-Husayn ibn Ali did al-Dhahabi name among those who narrated from him?
Al-Dhahabi listed his children Ali and Fatimah, his daughter Sukaynah, and others among those who narrated from him.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0360: Which grandson of al-Husayn narrated from him without having heard him directly, according to al-Dhahabi?
Al-Dhahabi named his grandson Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir, noting that he had not met him.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0361: Which Companion carried al-Hasan ibn Ali and said that he resembled the Prophet rather than Ali, while Ali laughed?
Uqbah ibn al-Harith reported seeing Abu Bakr carrying al-Hasan and saying, with an expression of affection, that he resembled the Prophet rather than Ali, while Ali laughed.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0362: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) once told Aishah that which angel was greeting her with peace?

Al-Bukhari reports: «يا عائش، هذا جبريل يقرئك السلام» [O ‘Ā'ish, this is Jibrīl greeting you with peace.] She returned the greeting with peace, mercy, and blessings and said that he saw what she could not. Unchanged quoted English (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0363: Fatimah came to ask the Prophet for a servant from the captives but did not find him. Which Mother of the Believers did she tell of her need?

In Ali's narration, Fatimah did not find the Prophet but found Aishah and told her. When he returned, Aishah told him of Fatimah's visit, and he taught Ali and Fatimah a bedtime dhikr (remembrance) better for them than a servant.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0364: Which Mother of the Believers complained of being ill, prompting the Prophet to say: «طوفي من وراء الناس وأنتِ راكبة» [Perform tawaf (circumambulation) behind the people while riding]?

Zaynab bint Abi Salamah narrated from Umm Salamah that she complained to the Messenger of Allah of being ill, and he said: «طوفي من وراء الناس وأنت راكبة» [Perform tawaf (circumambulation) behind the people while riding].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0365: Umm Hani bint Abi Talib reported that the Prophet bathed in her house, then offered a brief prayer while completing its bowing and prostration. How many rakahs (units of prayer) did he pray?

Ibn Abi Layla reported that Umm Hani said the Prophet bathed in her house on the day of Makkah's conquest, then prayed eight rakahs (units of prayer). She had never seen him pray more briefly, although he completed the bowing and prostration.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0367: Anas reported that the Prophet visited Abu Sayf, whose wife nursed his son Ibrahim. What was Abu Sayf's occupation in al-Bukhari's narration?
Anas reported accompanying the Messenger of Allah to Abu Sayf al-Qayn, whose wife nursed Ibrahim. Al-Qayn means blacksmith.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0368: After Aishah completed the Farewell Hajj (pilgrimage), the Prophet sent her with her brother to perform umrah in place of her earlier umrah. Where did she go?

Aishah reported that after Hajj (pilgrimage), the Messenger of Allah sent her with Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Bakr to al-Tanim to perform umrah (lesser pilgrimage), saying: «هذه مكان عمرتك» [This is in place of your earlier umrah].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0369: Which sister of Khadijah sought permission to enter, prompting the Prophet to recognize the manner in which Khadijah used to seek permission?
Aishah reported that Halah bint Khuwaylid, Khadijah's sister, sought permission to enter. Recognizing Khadijah's manner, he said: «اللهم هالة» [O Allah, let it be Halah].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0370: Al-Bara ibn Azib saw the Prophet saying «اللهم إني أحبّه فأحبّه» [O Allah, I love him, so love him] while carrying al-Hasan ibn Ali. Where was al-Hasan?
Al-Bara reported seeing al-Hasan on the Prophet's shoulder as he said: «اللهم إني أحبه فأحبه» [O Allah, I love him, so love him].
mothers-ahlulbayt-0371: When Aishah was ill, which Companion visited and told her that she would meet worthy predecessors, the Messenger of Allah and Abu Bakr?

Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad reported that when Aishah was ill, Ibn Abbas visited and addressed her as Mother of the Believers, saying that she would meet worthy predecessors, the Messenger of Allah and Abu Bakr.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0372: A man asked Ibn Umar about Ali. After praising Ali's deeds, Ibn Umar pointed out his house and described it as what?
The nearest house in Madinah to the mosque
The best house of Banu Hashim
In the middle of the Prophet's houses
The most spacious house of the Muhajirun (migrants)
Sad ibn Ubaydah reported that Ibn Umar praised Ali's deeds, pointed to his house, and said that it was in the middle of the Prophet's houses.
mothers-ahlulbayt-0373: About which wife did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) say: «إني قد رُزقتُ حبَّها» [My love of her has been planted in my heart (by Allah).]?

Aishah reported that when he slaughtered a sheep, he would say: «أرسلوا بها إلى أصدقاء خديجة» [Send some of it to the companions of Khadījah.] When she mentioned Khadijah, he replied: «إني قد رزقت حبها» [My love of her has been planted in my heart (by Allah).] (HadeethEnc)
mothers-ahlulbayt-0374: In Sahih al-Bukhari, Abu Hurayrah said that which member of Banu Hashim was the kindest to the poor and would take them home to feed them whatever he had?
In Sahih al-Bukhari, Abu Hurayrah described Jafar ibn Abi Talib as the kindest to the poor, taking them home and feeding them whatever was in his house.
ghazawat-0002: The Waddan campaign ended without fighting. What did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) return with?
A nonaggression agreement with Banu Damrah
The conversion of the tribe of Juhaynah
During this campaign, the Prophet concluded a nonaggression agreement with Banu Damrah and returned without fighting.
ghazawat-0003: In Hamzah ibn Abd al-Muttalib's expedition to the seacoast, who intervened between the Muslims and polytheists so no fighting occurred?
Majdi ibn Amr al-Juhani had a peace agreement with both sides, so he intervened and they departed without fighting.
ghazawat-0005: Which valley near Badr did the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) reach while pursuing Kurz ibn Jabir before returning?
He reached a valley called Safawan near Badr, but Kurz eluded him and he did not catch him.
ghazawat-0006: When Abu Sufyan learned that the Muslims had set out against his caravan before Badr, whom did he hire to mobilize Quraysh?
Abu Sufyan hired Damdam ibn Amr al-Ghifari and sent him to Makkah to mobilize Quraysh to protect their property.
ghazawat-0008: Which Quraysh clan returned before Badr on al-Akhnas ibn Shariq's advice, so none of its members attended the battle?
Banu Zuhrah returned with al-Akhnas ibn Shariq, so none of them attended Badr.
ghazawat-0009: According to Ibn Ishaq, which Quraysh clan sent no men at all to Badr?
Ibn Ishaq stated that some men went from every Quraysh clan except Banu Adi ibn Kab.
ghazawat-0010: Who first reached Makkah with news of Quraysh's defeat at Badr?
Amr ibn Salim ibn Husayrah al-Khuzai
Ibn Ishaq said that al-Haysuman ibn Abd Allah al-Khuzai was the first to arrive with news of Quraysh's disaster.
ghazawat-0012: According to Ibn Hisham, what battle cry did the Prophet's Companions call out at Badr?
Ha Mim: they will not be granted victory
Ibn Hisham said the Messenger of Allah's Companions' battle cry at Badr was: One! One!
ghazawat-0014: At Badr the Prophet said: «إن يكن في أحد من القوم خير فعند صاحب الجمل الأحمر» [If.]. Who owned that camel?
He said this after seeing Utbah ibn Rabiah among the people on a red camel of his.
ghazawat-0015: The Prophet sent two men to gather news of the caravan at the water of Badr. One was Basbas ibn Amr; who was the other?
He sent the two Juhani men, Basbas ibn Amr and Adi ibn Abi al-Zaghba, to Badr to gather news for him.
ghazawat-0016: During Ubaydah ibn al-Harith's expedition to Thaniyyat al-Murrah, which Companion shot the first arrow fired in Islam?
Sad ibn Abi Waqqas shot an arrow that day, the first arrow fired in Islam.
ghazawat-0017: In his letter, where did the Prophet order Abd Allah ibn Jahsh to go and keep watch on Quraysh?
His letter stated: «فامض حتى تنزل نخلة بين مكة والطائف فترصد بها قريشًا» [Proceed.].
ghazawat-0018: The Prophet gave Abd Allah ibn Jahsh a letter and ordered him not to read it until he had traveled for how long?
After Abd Allah ibn Jahsh had traveled for two days, he opened the letter as ordered.
ghazawat-0019: Which passage in Surat al-Baqarah was revealed concerning Abd Allah ibn Jahsh's expedition?
﴿يسألونك عن الأهلّة﴾ [They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the crescent moons.]
﴿يسألونك عن الخمر والميسر﴾ [They ask you about wine[80] and gambling. [80] The word "khamr" (wine) includes all intoxicants. The final prohibition is given in 5:90-91.]
﴿يسألونك عن الشهر الحرام قتالٍ فيه﴾ [They ask you about the sacred month[78] - about fighting therein. [78] See footnote to 2:194.]
﴿يسألونك ماذا ينفقون﴾ [And they ask you what they should spend.]

Ibn Hisham headed the account: Abd Allah ibn Jahsh's expedition and the revelation of «يسألونك عن الشهر الحرام» [They ask you about the sacred month[78]; [78] See footnote to 2:194.]. English excerpts: Quran 2:189, 2:219, 2:217 and 2:219 (QuranEnc)
ghazawat-0020: Which Companion did the Prophet send back from al-Rawha on the way to Badr, appointing him in charge of Madinah?
Uthman ibn Affan ibn Abi al-As
Ibn Ishaq stated that he sent Abu Lubabah back from al-Rawha and appointed him in charge of Madinah.
ghazawat-0021: To whom did the Prophet give the white standard on his march to Badr?
He gave the standard to Musab ibn Umayr. Ibn Hisham said it was white.
ghazawat-0022: How many camels did the Muslims have on their march to Badr, taking turns riding them?
The Messenger of Allah's Companions had seventy camels that day, which they took turns riding.
ghazawat-0023: The Prophet estimated Quraysh's army at Badr from the number of camels they slaughtered daily. What estimate did he reach?
Between five hundred and six hundred
Between nine hundred and one thousand
Between two thousand and three thousand
Between three hundred and four hundred
The two men said they slaughtered nine one day and ten the next. The Prophet concluded that they numbered between nine hundred and one thousand.
ghazawat-0025: Al-Miqdad ibn Amr stood up and told him to proceed as Allah had shown him: they were with him and would not say what the Children of Israel had said to Musa.
ghazawat-0029: After Badr, the Prophet sent two bearers of good news to Madinah. Whom did he send to the people of al-Aliyah?
Usamah ibn Zayd ibn Harithah al-Kalbi
He sent Abd Allah ibn Rawahah with good news to the people of al-Aliyah, and Zayd ibn Harithah to those of al-Safilah.
ghazawat-0030: What did Zaynab, the Messenger of Allah's daughter, send to ransom her husband Abu al-As ibn al-Rabi after Badr?
A sword that belonged to her father
A coat of armor that belonged to Abu Talib
A necklace Khadijah had given her for her marriage
She sent money and a necklace Khadijah had given her when she married Abu al-As.
ghazawat-0031: Which Quraysh man came to Madinah after Badr with an evil intention agreed upon with Safwan ibn Umayyah, then embraced Islam?
Ibn Ishaq described Umayr ibn Wahb al-Jumahi's conversion after his meeting with Safwan ibn Umayyah in al-Hijr.
ghazawat-0032: Why was Ghazwat al-Sawiq given that name?
Most of the provisions the polytheists discarded were sawiq (roasted grain meal)
The Muslims carried only sawiq as provisions
The Prophet fed the people sawiq during it
It took place near a mountain called al-Sawiq
Ibn Hisham said it was named so because most of the provisions the people discarded were sawiq (roasted grain meal), which the Muslims came upon.
ghazawat-0033: During Ghazwat Dhi Amarr, the Prophet went to Najd against which tribe?
Ibn Ishaq said he then campaigned in Najd against Ghatafan; this was Ghazwat Dhi Amarr.
ghazawat-0034: Which Jewish tribe of Madinah first broke its covenant with the Messenger of Allah?
Ibn Ishaq narrated from Asim ibn Umar ibn Qatadah that Banu Qaynuqa were the first Jews to break their covenant with the Messenger of Allah.
ghazawat-0035: Who pressed the Prophet concerning Banu Qaynuqa, saying: 'Treat my allies well'?
Abd Allah ibn Ubayy ibn Salul
Abu Amir al-Rahib Abd Amr ibn Sayfi
Abd Allah ibn Ubayy ibn Salul approached him and said: 'Muhammad, treat my allies well.' They were allies of al-Khazraj.
ghazawat-0036: After Badr, Quraysh took the Iraq route with its trade caravan. Who commanded the Muslim expedition that intercepted it at the water of al-Qaradah?
It was Zayd ibn Harithah's expedition to al-Qaradah, a watering place in Najd, where he captured Quraysh's caravan.
ghazawat-0037: Whom did Quraysh hire from Banu Bakr ibn Wail to guide its trade caravan along the Iraq route?
They hired a man of Banu Bakr ibn Wail named Furat ibn Hayyan to show them the route.
ghazawat-0038: Before Uhud, the Prophet dreamed that he put his hand inside a strong coat of armor. What did he interpret the armor as representing?
He said: «ورأيت أني أدخلت يدي في درع حصينة فأوّلتها المدينة» [I.].
ghazawat-0039: At which place between Madinah and Uhud did Abd Allah ibn Ubayy withdraw with his followers?
Ibn Ishaq said that when they reached al-Shawt between Madinah and Uhud, Abd Allah ibn Ubayy withdrew from him.
ghazawat-0040: Which man of Banu Amr ibn Awf did the Prophet appoint to command the archers at Uhud?
He appointed Abd Allah ibn Jubayr of Banu Amr ibn Awf over the fifty archers.
ghazawat-0041: How many archers did the Prophet station on the hill at Uhud?
Ibn Ishaq stated that the archers numbered fifty, commanded by Abd Allah ibn Jubayr.
ghazawat-0042: At Uhud the Prophet said: «من يأخذ هذا السيف بحقه؟» [Who.]. To which Ansari did he give it?
Abu Dujanah stood up and said he would take it and fulfill its due, so the Messenger of Allah gave it to him.
ghazawat-0043: The Prophet allowed two fifteen-year-old boys to fight at Uhud. One was Rafi ibn Khadij; who was the other?
He allowed Samurah ibn Jundub al-Fazari and Rafi ibn Khadij to participate that day; both were fifteen years old.
ghazawat-0044: Which Companion was called 'the one washed by the angels' after his martyrdom at Uhud?
Abd Allah ibn Amr ibn Haram
