It was Hanzalah ibn Abi Amir, known as the one washed by the angels.
ghazawat-0046: When Abu Sufyan said at Uhud, 'We have al-Uzza, and you have no Uzza,' what were the Muslims ordered to reply?
Allah is higher and more majestic
There is no god but Allah alone
Our dead are in Paradise and yours in the Fire
Allah is our Protector, and you have no protector
The Prophet said: «قولوا: الله مولانا ولا مولى لكم» [Say:.].
ghazawat-0047: To whom did the Prophet say at Uhud while handing him arrows: «ارمِ فداك أبي وأمي» [Shoot your arrow, may my mother and father be sacrificed for you.; (HadeethEnc)]?
Sad ibn Abi Waqqas said he saw him handing him arrows and saying: «ارمِ فداك أبي وأمي» [Shoot your arrow, may my mother and father be sacrificed for you.; (HadeethEnc)].
ghazawat-0049: Which Khuzai man passed the Prophet at Hamra al-Asad, then met Abu Sufyan and dissuaded him from returning to Madinah?
Al-Haysuman ibn Abd Allah ibn Iyas al-Khuzai
It was Mabad ibn Abi Mabad al-Khuzai. He then went on to meet Abu Sufyan at al-Rawha and dissuaded him from returning.
ghazawat-0050: Which Companion said to Sad ibn Muadh at Uhud: «واهًا لريح الجنة يا سعد، إني أجده دون أُحد» [Ah,.]?
Anas ibn al-Nadr said it to Sad ibn Muadh at Uhud, as reported in the two Sahih collections and books of sirah (the Prophet's biography). HadeethEnc 3855 has a related report with different wording.
ghazawat-0051: Which scholar of the Jewish Banu Thalabah ibn al-Fityawn went out with the Muslims at Uhud?
Ibn Ishaq stated that Mukhayriq of Banu Thalabah ibn al-Fityawn was among those killed with the Muslims at Uhud.
ghazawat-0052: Which severely lame Companion with four sons insisted on going out to Uhud?
Amr ibn al-Jamuh was severely lame and had four sons who took part in the battles.
ghazawat-0053: Whom did Quraysh place in command of its army's right wing at Uhud before he embraced Islam?
Quraysh placed Khalid ibn al-Walid over the right wing; he was then a polytheist.
ghazawat-0054: According to Ibn Hisham, what battle cry did the Prophet's Companions call out at Uhud?
O people of the acacia tree!
Ha Mim: they will not be granted victory
Ibn Hisham said the Messenger of Allah's Companions' battle cry at Uhud was: Slay! Slay!
ghazawat-0055: Concerning Uhud, Allah revealed: ﴿إذ همّت طائفتان منكم أن تفشلا﴾ [When two parties among you were about to lose courage; Quran 3:122 (QuranEnc)]. Which two groups were they?
Banu Abd al-Ashhal and Banu Zafar
Banu Amr ibn Awf and Banu Waqif
They were Banu Salimah of al-Khazraj and Banu Harithah of al-Aws.
ghazawat-0057: What does al-Mundhir ibn Amr's epithet 'al-Muniq li-Yamut' mean?
Al-muniq means one who hastens. He received the epithet because he hastened to martyrdom.
ghazawat-0058: Which Quran surah was revealed in its entirety concerning Banu al-Nadir?
Ibn Ishaq said Surat al-Hashr was revealed in its entirety concerning Banu al-Nadir.
ghazawat-0059: When Banu al-Nadir were expelled from Madinah, where did most of them go?
They loaded as much of their property as their camels could carry and left for Khaybar; some went to al-Sham.
ghazawat-0062: Which prayer does Ibn Ishaq mention the Prophet leading during Ghazwat Dhat al-Riqa?
Ibn Ishaq stated that he led the people in salat al-khawf (prayer in danger), then departed with them.
ghazawat-0065: When the Prophet heard of the confederates' advance, he consulted his Companions. Who suggested digging the trench?
Salman al-Farisi suggested digging a trench separating the enemy from Madinah, and the Prophet ordered it.
ghazawat-0067: During the Battle of the Trench, what did the Prophet consider offering Ghatafan's two leaders to withdraw with their men?
One third of Madinah's fruit harvest
He intended to give them one third of Madinah's fruit harvest if they withdrew with their followers. He then consulted the two Sads, who refused.
ghazawat-0069: Whom did the Prophet send at night during the Battle of the Trench to bring news of Quraysh after the confederates' unity had broken down?
He summoned Hudhayfah ibn al-Yaman and sent him to see what the people were doing that night.
ghazawat-0070: How did the Prophet participate in digging the trench?
He hired Jewish laborers to dig it
He only supervised from his tent
He assigned it solely to the Ansar
He worked on it himself with the Muslims
The trench was dug around Madinah, and the Messenger of Allah worked on it to encourage the Muslims to seek the reward.
ghazawat-0072: Abu Lubabah regretted a gesture he made to Banu Qurayzah. What did he do?
He gave away all his wealth in charity
He stayed home for a month
He tied himself to a pillar in the mosque
He did not come to the Messenger of Allah, but tied himself to a mosque pillar, saying he would not leave until Allah accepted his repentance.
ghazawat-0073: Whom did the Prophet appoint to judge Banu Qurayzah, telling him: «لقد حكمتَ فيهم بحكم الله» [You.]?
They submitted to Sad ibn Muadh's judgment. The Prophet told him: «لقد حكمت فيهم بحكم الله» [You.].
ghazawat-0074: During the expedition against Banu Lihyan, the Prophet reached their settlements. What were they called?
He camped at Ghuran, the settlements of Banu Lihyan, in a valley between Amaj and Usfan.
ghazawat-0076: What did the Prophet say to Salamah ibn al-Akwa during Ghazwat Dhi Qarad when he recovered the milk camels?
«ملكتَ فأسجِح» [You have prevailed, so be lenient]
«لا تثريب عليك» [No blame is on you]
«أحسنتَ فأتمّ» [You have done well, so finish]
«قد كفيتَنا» [You have spared us the trouble]
He told him: «يا ابن الأكوع، ملكت فأسجح» [Ibn.], meaning: having overcome them, act gently.
ghazawat-0078: Who led Banu al-Mustaliq when they assembled to fight the Muslims?
Amir ibn al-Tufayl ibn Malik al-Amiri
The Prophet learned that Banu al-Mustaliq were assembling against him under al-Harith ibn Abi Dirar, Juwayriyah's father.
ghazawat-0079: Aishah described which Mother of the Believers as the woman who brought the greatest blessing to her people, since the Prophet's marriage to her led to a hundred households being freed?
The Prophet's marriage to Juwayriyah bint al-Harith resulted in a hundred households of Banu al-Mustaliq being freed.
ghazawat-0081: Which Quran surah confirmed Zayd ibn Arqam's report of Abd Allah ibn Ubayy's words during the expedition against Banu al-Mustaliq?
Allah revealed confirmation of Zayd's truthfulness in Surat al-Munafiqun.
ghazawat-0082: Al-Qaswa knelt on the way to Makkah in the year of al-Hudaybiyah. The Prophet said: «ما خلأت، ولكن حبسها حابس …» [She.]. Complete the statement.
He said: «ما خلأت وما هو لها بخُلُق، ولكن حبسها حابس الفيل عن مكة» [She.].
ghazawat-0083: Which man of Thaqif was one of Quraysh's emissaries to the Prophet at al-Hudaybiyah?
Abd Yalil ibn Amr ibn Umayr al-Thaqafi
Quraysh sent Urwah ibn Masud al-Thaqafi to the Messenger of Allah.
ghazawat-0085: What news prompted the Prophet to seek his Companions' pledge at al-Hudaybiyah?
Quraysh had set out with a huge army
Uthman ibn Affan had been killed
When told that Uthman had been killed, he said: «لا نبرح حتى نناجز القوم» [We.], then summoned the people to pledge allegiance.
ghazawat-0086: Only one of those present failed to take part in Bayat al-Ridwan (the Pledge of Divine Approval). Who was he?
None of the Muslims present stayed away except al-Jadd ibn Qays of Banu Salimah.
ghazawat-0088: Suhayl ibn Amr objected to writing 'In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Especially Merciful' in the Treaty of al-Hudaybiyah. What did he request instead?
In the name of Allah alone
This is a document from Muhammad
Suhayl said he did not recognize that formula, but asked for 'In Your name, O Allah'; the Prophet ordered it to be written.
ghazawat-0089: Which tribe entered the Prophet's pact and covenant after the Treaty of al-Hudaybiyah?
Banu Bakr entered Quraysh's pact, while Khuzaah entered the Messenger of Allah's pact and covenant.
ghazawat-0090: Which Mother of the Believers advised the Prophet at al-Hudaybiyah to go out, slaughter his sacrificial animals and shave his head without speaking to anyone?
Umm Salamah advised him to go out and speak to none of them until he had slaughtered his sacrificial animals and summoned his barber.
ghazawat-0091: Which Quran surah was revealed to the Prophet between Makkah and Madinah on his return from al-Hudaybiyah?

Between Makkah and Madinah, Surat al-Fath was revealed: ﴿إنا فتحنا لك فتحًا مبينًا﴾ [Indeed, We have given you, [O Muḥammad], a clear conquest[1507]; Quran 48:1 (QuranEnc) [1507] Ibn Masʿūd said, "You [people] consider the conquest to be that of Makkah, but we consider it to be the Treaty of al-Ḥudaybiyyah." Al-Bukhārī reported a similar quotation from al-Barā’ bin ʿĀzib. Although initially regarded by the companions as a setback, the treaty, in effect, served to promote the spread of Islām, which led to the conquest of Makkah two years later.].
ghazawat-0092: After the Treaty of al-Hudaybiyah, oppressed Muslims escaping Makkah gathered around Abu Basir at which place on Quraysh's route to al-Sham?
They went out to Abu Basir at al-Is, where nearly seventy men gathered around him.
ghazawat-0093: What did the Prophet say on approaching Khaybar in the morning and seeing its people coming out with their spades?

«حسبنا الله ونعم الوكيل» [Sufficient for us is Allāh, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs.; Quran 3:173 (QuranEnc); footnote 150: The one entrusted and relied upon; sufficient to manage all matters.]
«هذه خيبر قد أقبلت» [Here is Khaybar before us]
«الله أكبر، خربت خيبر» [Allah is greatest! Khaybar is ruined!]
«اللهم انصرنا عليهم» [O Allah, grant us victory over them]
He said: «الله أكبر خربت خيبر، إنا إذا نزلنا بساحة قوم فساء صباح المنذَرين» [Allah.].
ghazawat-0094: According to Ibn Ishaq, which were the last fortresses of Khaybar to be captured?
The fortress of al-Sab ibn Muadh
They reached the two fortresses of al-Watih and al-Sulalim, the last fortresses of Khaybar's people to be captured.
ghazawat-0095: To whom did al-Qamus, one of Khaybar's fortresses, belong?
Ibn Ishaq stated that al-Qamus was the fortress of Banu Abi al-Huqayq.
ghazawat-0096: At Khaybar, some Muslims ate the meat of which animals before the Prophet forbade it?
The Messenger of Allah forbade eating domestic donkey meat on the day of Khaybar.
ghazawat-0099: Why was the land of Fadak reserved exclusively for the Messenger of Allah rather than those entitled to battle spoils?
It was purchased with charitable funds
It was taken by force after a long siege
Its inhabitants made peace without cavalry or riding camels being deployed against it
It was given to him by the Byzantine emperor

Khaybar was fay (property acquired from the enemy) shared among the Muslims, whereas Fadak belonged exclusively to the Messenger of Allah because no horses or riding camels had been deployed against it.
ghazawat-0100: On what share of the produce did the Prophet entrust Khaybar's land and date palms to its Jewish inhabitants to cultivate?
Ibn al-Qayyim stated that his entrusting them with the land for half its produce demonstrates the permissibility of musaqah (sharing fruit crops for tending trees) and muzaraah (sharecropping).
ghazawat-0104: When the Prophet entered al-Masjid al-Haram during Umrat al-Qada (the make-up minor pilgrimage), what did he do with his upper garment?
He covered his face with it
He left it at the Banu Shaybah gate
He arranged it under his right arm, exposing his right upper arm
He draped it over both shoulders
He entered the mosque with idtiba (passing the upper garment under the right arm), exposing his right upper arm, to show the polytheists his Companions' strength.
ghazawat-0105: Which Mother of the Believers did the Prophet marry on his journey for Umrat al-Qada (the make-up minor pilgrimage)?
Ibn Ishaq narrated from Ibn Abbas that he married Maymunah bint al-Harith on that journey.
ghazawat-0107: On their way to Mutah, the Muslims learned that Heraclius had encamped with Byzantine forces at which place in al-Balqa?
The people learned that Heraclius had encamped at Maab in al-Balqa with a great force of Byzantines and their allies.
ghazawat-0109: By what epithet was Jafar ibn Abi Talib known after his martyrdom at Mutah?
Dhu al-Nurayn (possessor of the two lights)
Dhu al-Shahadatayn (possessor of the two testimonies)
Dhu al-Janahayn (possessor of the two wings)
Dhu al-Aynayn (possessor of the two eyes)
Jafar was known as Dhu al-Janahayn (possessor of the two wings). Poetry about Mutah's martyrs called him 'Jafar, possessor of the two wings.'
ghazawat-0112: The Prophet set out to conquer Makkah while fasting in Ramadan. Where did he break his fast?
He and the people fasted until they reached al-Kadid between Usfan and Amaj, where he broke his fast.
ghazawat-0114: The Muslims camped at Marr al-Zahran at night before the conquest. What astonished Abu Sufyan when he went out to gather news?
The call to prayer in the middle of the night
The multitude of the Muslims' fires and their army
Abu Sufyan said he had never seen fires or an army like those that night.
ghazawat-0115: What animal was al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib riding when he went out on the night at Marr al-Zahran and met Abu Sufyan?
Al-Abbas said he mounted the Messenger of Allah's white mule and rode out on it.
ghazawat-0116: Why did the Prophet order al-Abbas to detain Abu Sufyan at the mountain's projection in the valley's narrow passage?
Only to prevent him from warning Quraysh
To obtain a guarantee of safety for Quraysh from him
Until he could write the peace treaty
So Allah's troops would pass him and he would see them
He said: «يا عباس، احبسه بمضيق الوادي عند خطم الجبل حتى تمر به جنود الله فيراها» [Abbas,.].
ghazawat-0117: On the day of the conquest, what honor did the Prophet grant Abu Sufyan because he liked distinction?
Anyone entering his house would be safe
He said: «من دخل دار أبي سفيان فهو آمن، ومن أغلق بابه فهو آمن» [Whoever.].
ghazawat-0118: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq's father climbed Mount Abu Qubays with his daughter on the day of the conquest, then embraced Islam. What was his kunyah (honorific name)?
It was Abu Quhafah. He asked his youngest daughter to take him up Abu Qubays, and later embraced Islam.
ghazawat-0119: How many idols surrounded the Kabah when the Prophet entered as conqueror?
There were three hundred and sixty idols around the House. He struck them with his bow, saying: ﴿جاء الحق وزهق الباطل﴾ [Truth has come, and falsehood has departed.; Quran 17:81 (QuranEnc)].
ghazawat-0120: From whom did the Prophet take the Kabah's key on the day of the conquest, so it was opened and he entered?
He summoned Uthman ibn Talhah, took the Kabah's key from him, and it was opened for him to enter.
ghazawat-0121: To which female relative did the Prophet say on the day of the conquest: «قد أجرنا من أجرتِ وأمّنّا من أمّنتِ» [We.]?
Fatimah, daughter of the Messenger of Allah
He said it to Umm Hani bint Abi Talib regarding the two men she had granted protection.
ghazawat-0123: After the conquest, the Prophet sent Khalid ibn al-Walid to demolish which idol at Nakhlah, the greatest idol of Quraysh and Kinanah?
He sent Khalid ibn al-Walid to demolish al-Uzza, which stood at Nakhlah and belonged to Quraysh and all Banu Kinanah.
ghazawat-0124: Whom did the Prophet send after the conquest to demolish Suwa, Hudhayl's idol?
In the same month, he sent Amr ibn al-As to Suwa, an idol of Hudhayl, and he demolished it.
ghazawat-0126: Where was the idol Manat, demolished after the conquest of Makkah, located?
Manat was at al-Mushallal near Qudayd and belonged to al-Aws, al-Khazraj, Ghassan and others.
ghazawat-0130: Before Hunayn, Durayd ibn al-Simmah asked his people which valley they were in. What did they answer?
They answered: Awtas. He said it was excellent terrain for horses, neither rough, rugged ground nor soft, yielding plain.
ghazawat-0131: Before Hunayn, from which man, then a polytheist, did the Prophet borrow armor and weapons?
He was told that Safwan ibn Umayyah had armor and weapons, so he sent to him, while he was still a polytheist, asking to borrow his weapons.
ghazawat-0132: On the way to Hunayn, some recent converts requested something like Dhat Anwat. What was Dhat Anwat?
A well whose water they sought blessings from
A mountain where they secluded themselves in worship
A great tree on which they hung their weapons
The polytheists had a great green tree called Dhat Anwat, which they visited annually to hang their weapons on.
ghazawat-0133: At Hunayn, the Prophet ordered al-Abbas to call: «يا معشر الأنصار، يا معشر أصحاب …» [O.]. What did he call out?
He said: «يا عباس، اصرخ: يا معشر الأنصار، يا معشر أصحاب السمرة» [Abbas,.]. They replied: At your service! At your service!
ghazawat-0134: Complete what the Prophet said at Hunayn while on his mule: «أنا النبيّ لا كذب، …» [I.].
I am the son of the Atikahs
I am the son of the two offered for sacrifice
I am the son of Abd al-Muttalib
He said: «أنا النبي لا كذب، أنا ابن عبد المطلب» [I.].
ghazawat-0136: Where were Hunayn's captives and property assembled and held until distribution?
He ordered the captives and property taken to al-Jiranah, where they were held.
ghazawat-0138: The Prophet freed men who came out of al-Taif's fortress to the Muslims. Which Companion among them lowered himself from the fortress using a pulley and received a kunyah (honorific name) from it?
Abu Bakrah was among them. He climbed over al-Taif's fortress and lowered himself with a bakrah (pulley), from which he received his kunyah.
ghazawat-0139: When leaving al-Taif, some Companions asked the Prophet to supplicate against Thaqif. What did he supplicate?
«اللهم اكفناهم بما شئت» [O Allah, protect us from them however You will]
«اللهم اهدِ ثقيفًا وائتِ بهم» [O Allah, guide Thaqif and bring them]
«اللهم شتّت شملهم» [O Allah, scatter their ranks]
«اللهم اغفر لقومي فإنهم لا يعلمون» [O Allah, forgive my people, for they do not know]
He said: «اللهم اهد ثقيفًا وائت بهم» [O.].
ghazawat-0140: After distributing Hunayn's spoils, the Prophet asked the Ansar: «أوجدتم في أنفسكم في … من الدنيا تألّفت بها قومًا ليسلموا؟» [Did.]. Which word fills the gap?
He said: «أوجدتم يا معشر الأنصار في أنفسكم في لعاعة من الدنيا» [Did.]. Luaah means tender green herbage.
ghazawat-0141: Where did Hawazin's delegation come to the Prophet to request the return of their captives and property?
Hawazin's delegation came to him at al-Jiranah after embracing Islam.
ghazawat-0142: Which Companion donated a thousand dinars to the Army of Hardship for the Tabuk expedition?
Ibn Hisham stated that Uthman ibn Affan donated a thousand dinars to the Army of Hardship during the Tabuk expedition.
ghazawat-0144: On the way to Tabuk, at which place did the Prophet forbid his Companions to drink the water or use it for wudu (ablution)?
When he passed al-Hijr and people drew water from its well, he said: «لا تشربوا من مائها شيئًا ولا تتوضؤوا منه للصلاة» [Do.].
ghazawat-0145: What was the name of Aylah's ruler who came to the Prophet at Tabuk, made peace with him and received a written document?
Yuhannah ibn Rubah, ruler of Aylah, came, made peace and paid jizyah (tribute from non-Muslim subjects); the Prophet gave him a written document.
ghazawat-0148: Three Muslims stayed behind from Tabuk without doubt or hypocrisy. One was Kab ibn Malik; who were the other two?
Al-Jadd ibn Qays and Muattib ibn Qushayr al-Amri
Abu Lubabah and Aws ibn Khawli
Murarah ibn al-Rabi and Hilal ibn Umayyah
They were Kab ibn Malik, Murarah ibn al-Rabi and Hilal ibn Umayyah.
ghazawat-0149: While the Muslims were shunning Kab ibn Malik, he received a letter inviting him to join its sender. Who sent it?
Kab said a man came and handed him a letter from the king of Ghassan.
ghazawat-0150: For how many nights were Kab ibn Malik and his two companions boycotted before revelation announced acceptance of their repentance?
Kab said they remained in that state for fifty nights.
ghazawat-0151: Ukashah ibn Mihsan led an expedition to al-Ghamr. To whom did this watering place belong?
Ukashah set out with forty men to al-Ghamr, a watering place of Banu Asad, and the people fled.
ghazawat-0152: Zayd ibn Harithah led an expedition to al-Jamum. What was al-Jamum?
A watering place of Banu Sulaym at Marr al-Zahran
Al-Jamum was a watering place of Banu Sulaym at Marr al-Zahran, to which Zayd ibn Harithah led an expedition.
ghazawat-0154: Why was Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah's force sent to the seacoast called Jaysh al-Khabat?
They struck the ground with their feet while walking
They lost their way and wandered aimlessly
They ate khabat (tree leaves) because of severe hunger
Jabir said they suffered such severe hunger that they ate khabat (tree leaves), so the force was called Jaysh al-Khabat.
ghazawat-0155: The sea cast up a huge animal for Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah's force, which they ate for half a month. What was it called?
Jabir said the sea cast up an animal called al-Anbar, and they ate from it for half a month.
ghazawat-0156: When the men of Jaysh al-Khabat told the Prophet about the animal they had eaten, what did he say?
«هذا من صيد البحر فلا بأس» [This is sea game, so there is no harm]
«لا تأكلوا مما قذف البحر» [Do not eat what the sea casts up]
«هو رزق أخرجه الله لكم» [It is sustenance that Allah brought out for you.]
«كان الأولى أن تتصدقوا به» [It would have been better to give it in charity]

He said: «هو رزق أخرجه الله لكم، فهل معكم من لحمه شيء تطعمونا؟» [It is sustenance that Allah brought out for you. Do you have anything from its meat with you, so that you would feed us?; (HadeethEnc),].
ghazawat-0157: The Prophet sent Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf on an expedition to Banu Kalb's territory. Where was it?
Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf's expedition went to Banu Kalb's territory at Dumat al-Jandal, and the people embraced Islam.
ghazawat-0159: Why did the Prophet send Ali ibn Abi Talib to Banu Sad ibn Bakr at Fadak?
They had raided Madinah's grazing livestock
They had killed the Prophet's envoy
They had assembled a force to reinforce Khaybar's Jews
He learned that a force there intended to reinforce the Jews, so he sent Ali against them.
ghazawat-0160: The first expedition after the confederates and Qurayzah was commanded by Muhammad ibn Maslamah. Where did it go?
Muhammad ibn Maslamah's expedition went to al-Qurata near Dariyyah at al-Bakarat in Najd.
ghazawat-0162: According to Ibn Ishaq, where did the name Dhat al-Salasil come from?
A watering place in Judham territory called al-Salsal
The name of a tribe living there
Chains with which the polytheists bound themselves
They camped at a watering place in Judham territory called al-Salsal, which gave Dhat al-Salasil its name.
ghazawat-0163: Who commanded the Dhat al-Salasil expedition the Prophet sent toward the outskirts of al-Sham?
Ibn Ishaq headed the account: Amr ibn al-As's expedition of Dhat al-Salasil.
ghazawat-0165: The Prophet sent Abu Qatadah on an expedition to Khadirah. What was it?
A watering place of Judham in al-Sham
Banu Ghatafan were gathering at Khadirah in Muharib territory in Najd, so he sent Abu Qatadah against them.
ghazawat-0166: Where did the Prophet send Alqamah ibn Mujazziz al-Mudliji on an expedition?
He sent him with three hundred men against Abyssinian men who had gathered near Jeddah's coasts.
ghazawat-0167: The Prophet sent Ali ibn Abi Talib to demolish al-Fuls. To which tribe did this idol belong?
He sent Ali to demolish al-Fuls, the idol of Tayy.
ghazawat-0168: When Ali's expedition raided the settlement of Hatim al-Tai's family, where did Adi ibn Hatim flee?
Adi ibn Hatim's sister was among the captives, and Adi fled to al-Sham.
ghazawat-0169: The Prophet sent Uyaynah ibn Hisn al-Fazari with fifty horsemen against which tribe that had prevented others from paying what they owed?
Uyaynah ibn Hisn al-Fazari's expedition targeted Banu Tamim because they had incited the tribes and prevented them from paying.
ghazawat-0170: The Prophet sent Qutbah ibn Amir against a clan of Khatham. In which area were they?
Qutbah ibn Amir's expedition targeted a clan of Khatham near Tabalah, close to Turabah.
ghazawat-0171: Umar ibn al-Khattab led an expedition to Turabah in the seventh year. Which tribe was its target?
News reached Hawazin, who fled. Umar reached their settlements, found no one and returned.
ghazawat-0172: Who commanded the Dhat Irq expedition against Banu Hawazin in the eighth year?
He sent Shuja ibn Wahb al-Asadi with twenty-five men. They drove off livestock without encountering resistance.
ghazawat-0173: According to Surat al-Anfal, what did Allah bestow on the Muslims on the night of Badr as security from Him?
Allah says: ﴿إذ يغشّيكم النعاس أمنةً منه﴾ [[Remember] when He overwhelmed you with drowsiness [giving] security from Him; al-Anfal 8:11 (QuranEnc)].
ghazawat-0174: What did the Prophet throw from his hand at the polytheists at Badr, concerning which Allah revealed: ﴿وما رميت إذ رميت ولكن الله رمى﴾ [And you threw not, [O Muḥammad], when you threw, but it was Allāh who threw[441]; Quran 8:17 (QuranEnc) [441] When the Prophet (ﷺ) threw a handful of dust into the faces of the disbelievers, Allāh caused it to fill the eyes and nose of every soldier, preventing their advance.]?
Ibn Ishaq described him throwing pebbles from his hand at them, and the verse being revealed concerning this.
ghazawat-0175: By what name does the Quran call the day of Badr in Surat al-Anfal?

Allah says: ﴿وما أنزلنا على عبدنا يوم الفرقان يوم التقى الجمعان﴾ [and in that which We sent down to Our Servant[451] on the day of criterion [i.e., decisive encounter] - the day when the two armies met [at Badr].; al-Anfal 8:41 (QuranEnc) [451] Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).].
ghazawat-0176: At Badr, Quraysh sent which man to estimate the Prophet's Companions' numbers by riding around their camp?
Al-Nadr ibn al-Harith ibn Alqamah al-Abdari
They sent Umayr ibn Wahb al-Jumahi, asking him to estimate Muhammad's followers' numbers.
ghazawat-0177: Which Ansari was eating dates at Badr and threw them away when he heard the Prophet encourage the pursuit of Paradise?
Umayr ibn al-Humam of Banu Salimah exclaimed 'Excellent! Excellent!' while holding dates he was eating.
ghazawat-0178: Complete the Prophet's supplication at Badr: «اللهم إن تهلك هذه العصابة اليوم …» [O.].
He implored his Lord: «اللهم إن تهلك هذه العصابة اليوم لا تُعبد» [O.].
ghazawat-0179: At Badr, who told the Prophet as he persisted in supplication: 'Prophet of Allah, lessen your entreaty to your Lord, for Allah will fulfill His promise to you'?
Abu Bakr was with him in the shelter, asking him to lessen his entreaty to his Lord.
ghazawat-0181: According to Ibn Ishaq, how many men were in Quraysh's army at Uhud?
Ibn Ishaq said Quraysh arrayed itself with three thousand men and two hundred horses.
ghazawat-0182: According to Ibn Ishaq, after Abd Allah ibn Ubayy's withdrawal, how many men did the Prophet deploy for battle at Uhud?
The Messenger of Allah deployed for battle with seven hundred men.
ghazawat-0183: Where did Quraysh camp when it came to fight at Uhud?
At the foot of Mount Sal
At Aynayn, a hill in the salt flat of Qanah
They advanced and camped at Aynayn, a hill in Qanah's salt flat at the edge of the valley.
ghazawat-0184: Who first recognized the Prophet at Uhud after news of his death had spread?
Ibn Ishaq said Kab ibn Malik was the first to recognize the Messenger of Allah after the defeat.
ghazawat-0185: At the end of Uhud, Abu Sufyan said: 'A day in exchange for the day of ..., and war alternates in fortune.' Complete his words.
He said: 'You have done well! A day in exchange for Badr, and war alternates in fortune.'
ghazawat-0187: At Uhud, the Prophet said: «أوجبَ …» [....] about a Companion who helped him climb a rock. Who was he?
He said that day: «أوجب طلحة» [Talhah.], because of what Talhah had done for the Messenger of Allah.
ghazawat-0188: Returning from a journey, the Prophet looked down on Madinah and said: «هذه طابة، وهذا … جبلٌ يحبّنا ونحبّه» [This.]. Which mountain?
He said: «هذه طابة، وهذا أحد جبل يحبنا ونحبه» [This.].
ghazawat-0190: What did the Prophet repeat while digging the trench with his Companions?
«الله أكبر، خربت خيبر» [Allah is greatest! Khaybar is ruined!]
«أنا النبي لا كذب» [I am the Prophet, no lie]
«اللهم لا عيش إلا عيش الآخرة، فاغفر للمهاجرين والأنصار» [O Allah, there is no true life except the life of the Hereafter, so forgive the Muhajirun and the Ansar]

«حسبنا الله ونعم الوكيل» [Sufficient for us is Allāh, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs.; Quran 3:173 (QuranEnc); footnote 150: The one entrusted and relied upon; sufficient to manage all matters.]
He said: «اللهم لا عيش إلا عيش الآخرة، فاغفر للمهاجرين والأنصار» [O.].
ghazawat-0192: According to Ibn al-Qayyim, which is the 'middle prayer' from which the Muslims were kept occupied during the Battle of the Trench?
Ibn al-Qayyim said it was salat al-asr (afternoon prayer), the middle prayer according to the Messenger of Allah's explicit statement.
ghazawat-0193: Which leader of Banu Qurayzah broke his covenant with the Prophet during the Battle of the Trench after Huyayy ibn Akhtab's insistence?
Huyayy kept pressing Kab ibn Asad until Kab broke his covenant and disavowed his agreement with the Messenger of Allah.
ghazawat-0194: What did the Prophet say when Allah drove the confederates away from Madinah?
Allah has spared the believers fighting
Now we will attack them, and they will not attack us
This is the Day of Criterion
Madinah will never be attacked again
When Allah drove the confederates away, he said: «الآن نغزوهم ولا يغزوننا، نحن نسير إليهم» [Now.].
ghazawat-0195: Where did Ghatafan and its followers from Najd camp during the Battle of the Confederates?
At the confluence of the watercourses near Rumah
Ghatafan and its followers from Najd advanced and camped at Dhanab Naqma beside Uhud.
ghazawat-0197: According to the authentic report cited by Ibn al-Qayyim, how many sacrificial camels did the Muslims slaughter in the year of al-Hudaybiyah?
Ibn al-Qayyim stated that it is authentically reported that they slaughtered seventy camels at al-Hudaybiyah, each on behalf of seven people.
ghazawat-0198: Which Companion asked at al-Hudaybiyah: 'Why should we accept humiliation in our religion?'
Al-Zuhri described Umar ibn al-Khattab questioning Abu Bakr and then the Prophet, asking why they should accept humiliation in their religion.
ghazawat-0199: Under the Treaty of al-Hudaybiyah, what was to happen to someone from Quraysh who came to Muhammad without his guardian's permission?
He would return the person to them
The person would remain with the Muslims
The person would be ransomed for money
The person could choose to stay or return
The document stipulated that anyone from Quraysh who came to Muhammad without his guardian's permission would be returned to them.
ghazawat-0200: Under the Treaty of al-Hudaybiyah, how long could the Muslims stay in Makkah when they came for umrah (minor pilgrimage) the following year?
The document stipulated a three-day stay with travelers' weapons: swords in their sheaths.
ghazawat-0201: When believing women emigrated from Makkah after the Treaty of al-Hudaybiyah, Allah revealed: ﴿إذا جاءكم المؤمنات مهاجرات …﴾ [when the believing women come to you as emigrants, ...; Quran 60:10]. What follows?

Allah says: ﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا إذا جاءكم المؤمنات مهاجرات فامتحنوهن﴾ [O you who have believed, when the believing women come to you as emigrants, examine [i.e., test] them.; al-Mumtahanah 60:10 (QuranEnc)].
ghazawat-0203: On the way to Khaybar, which Companion did the Prophet ask to chant for the travelers, who then recited: 'By Allah, were it not for Allah, we would not have been guided'?
On the way to Khaybar, he told Amir ibn al-Akwa, Salamah's uncle, to dismount and sing some of his verses for them.
ghazawat-0204: What did the Prophet make Safiyyah bint Huyayy's mahr (bridal gift) after Khaybar?
One of his coats of armor
He freed her, made her emancipation her mahr (bridal gift), and consummated the marriage on the journey.
ghazawat-0205: According to Ibn Ishaq, which fortress of Khaybar was captured first?
Ibn Ishaq said Naim was the first of their fortresses captured.
ghazawat-0206: Whom did the Prophet send to Khaybar's people to estimate the fruit harvest for the Muslims and Jews?
Sahl ibn Abi Hathmah al-Ansari al-Awsi
He used to send Abd Allah ibn Rawahah to Khaybar's people to assess the fruit harvest between the Muslims and Jews.
ghazawat-0207: The Jews of which town offered peace after hearing of the surrender of Khaybar, then Fadak and Wadi al-Qura?
When Tayma's Jews heard of the surrender of Khaybar, then Fadak and Wadi al-Qura, they sent an offer of peace to the Messenger of Allah.
ghazawat-0208: At Mutah, the Muslims hesitated because of the enemy's numbers. Which commander encouraged them, saying: 'We do not fight people with numbers, strength or multitude...'?
Jafar ibn Abi Talib al-Hashimi al-Qurashi
Abd Allah ibn Rawahah encouraged them, saying they did not fight with numbers, strength or multitude, but only through this religion.
ghazawat-0210: Where did the Mutah army hold its consultation after learning the size of the Byzantine forces?
Al-Mubarakfuri mentioned the consultation at Maan before the march to Mutah.
ghazawat-0211: On the night the Muslims camped at Marr al-Zahran, Abu Sufyan went out to gather news with which two men?
Safwan ibn Umayyah and Ikrimah ibn Abi Jahl
Hakim ibn Hizam and Budayl ibn Warqa
Abu Sufyan ibn Harb, Hakim ibn Hizam and Budayl ibn Warqa went out to gather news.
ghazawat-0213: At the Kabah's door on the day of the conquest, the Prophet said: «لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، صدق وعده، ونصر عبده، و…» [There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner.].
He said: «لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، صدق وعده، ونصر عبده، وهزم الأحزاب وحده» [There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner.].
ghazawat-0214: How many men from Makkah accompanied the Prophet to Hunayn in addition to his ten thousand Companions?
He set out with two thousand men from Makkah alongside ten thousand of his Companions.
ghazawat-0215: Who headed Hawazin's delegation that came to the Prophet requesting the return of its captives?
Hawazin's delegation consisted of fourteen men headed by Zuhayr ibn Surad.
ghazawat-0216: What did the Prophet promise Malik ibn Awf, Hawazin's commander, if he came to him as a Muslim?
To appoint him leader over Thaqif
To return his family and property and give him a hundred camels
He said: «أخبروا مالكًا أنه إن أتاني مسلمًا رددت عليه أهله وماله وأعطيته مئة من الإبل» [Tell.].
ghazawat-0219: Before Tabuk the hypocrites said: ﴿لا تنفروا في الحرّ﴾ [Do not go forth in the heat.; Quran 9:81]. How did Allah answer them in Surat al-Tawbah?
﴿قل نار جهنم أشدّ حرًّا﴾ [Say, "The fire of Hell is more intense in heat"]
﴿قل متاع الدنيا قليل﴾ [Say, "The enjoyment of this world is little,]
﴿قل لن يصيبنا إلا ما كتب الله لنا﴾ [Say, "Never will we be struck except by what Allāh has decreed for us;]
﴿قل أنفقوا طوعًا أو كرهًا﴾ [Say, "Spend willingly or unwillingly;]

Allah revealed concerning them: ﴿وقالوا لا تنفروا في الحر قل نار جهنم أشد حرًّا﴾ [and said, "Do not go forth in the heat." Say, "The fire of Hell is more intense in heat"; Quran 9:81]. Choice excerpts: 9:81, 4:77, 9:51 and 9:53. All Quran English: (QuranEnc)
ghazawat-0221: Where did the Prophet order Usamah ibn Zayd to advance his cavalry in the last expedition he prepared?
The borders of al-Balqa and al-Darum in Palestine
He dispatched Usamah ibn Zayd and ordered him to advance his cavalry to the borders of al-Balqa and al-Darum in Palestine.
ghazawat-0222: During the siege of Banu al-Nadir, Allah revealed: ﴿ما قطعتم من … أو تركتموها قائمة على أصولها فبإذن الله﴾ [Whatever you have cut down of ... or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh; Quran 59:5]. Which word is omitted?

Allah says: ﴿ما قطعتم من لينة أو تركتموها قائمة على أصولها فبإذن الله﴾ [Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh; al-Hashr 59:5 (QuranEnc)].
ghazawat-0223: According to Ibn Ishaq, how many men of Banu al-Nadir embraced Islam, one of them being Yamin ibn Umayr?
Ibn Ishaq said only two men of Banu al-Nadir embraced Islam: Yamin ibn Umayr and Abu Sad ibn Wahb.
ghazawat-0224: A man of Banu Amir asked the Prophet to send his Companions to the people of Najd, guaranteeing their protection; this led to Bir Maunah. What was his epithet?
Abu Bara Amir ibn Malik ibn Jafar, known as Mulaib al-Asinnah, came to the Messenger of Allah.
ghazawat-0225: What was the Prophet seeking in the expedition against Banu Lihyan?
Banu al-Nadir, who had left Madinah
Vengeance for the men of al-Raji: Khubayb and his companions
He went out against Banu Lihyan seeking vengeance for the men of al-Raji, Khubayb ibn Adi and his companions.
ghazawat-0226: During the expedition against Banu al-Mustaliq, Umar ibn al-Khattab's hired worker and an Ansari crowded at the water, provoking strife. What was Umar's worker called?
Iyad ibn Ghanm ibn Zuhayr al-Fihri
Umar had a hired worker of Banu Ghifar called Jahjah ibn Masud. He and Sinan ibn Wabr crowded at the water.
ghazawat-0227: Where did the Prophet consummate his marriage to Safiyyah bint Huyayy on his return from Khaybar?
At Sadd al-Sahba on his return to Madinah, she became eligible for consummation, and Umm Sulaym prepared her.
ghazawat-0228: To which mountain did the polytheists go during Umrat al-Qada (the make-up minor pilgrimage) to watch the Muslims perform tawaf (circumambulation)?
The polytheists went to Mount Quayqian, north of the Kabah, to watch the Muslims.
ghazawat-0229: After Umrat al-Qada (the make-up minor pilgrimage), Ali, Jafar and Zayd disputed custody of Hamzah's daughter. The Prophet awarded her to her maternal aunt, saying: «الخالة بمنزلة …» [The.]. Complete it.
He awarded custody to her maternal aunt, saying: «الخالة بمنزلة الأم» [The.].
ghazawat-0230: When Umar sought permission regarding Hatib ibn Abi Baltaah before the conquest, the Prophet reminded him that Hatib had participated in which battle?
He said: «إنه قد شهد بدرًا، وما يدريك لعل الله قد اطلع على أهل بدر» [He participated in Badr.].
ghazawat-0232: How many camels from Hunayn's spoils did the Prophet give each of Uyaynah ibn Hisn and al-Aqra ibn Habis to win their hearts?
Someone said that the Messenger of Allah had given Uyaynah ibn Hisn and al-Aqra ibn Habis one hundred each, while leaving out Juayl ibn Suraqah.
ghazawat-0233: Complete the Prophet's words to the Ansar after Hunayn: «ألا ترضون يا معشر الأنصار أن يذهب الناس بالشاء والبعير، وترجعون …» [Are.]?
With the Messenger of Allah to your homes
He said: «ألا ترضون أن يذهب الناس بالشاء والبعير وترجعون برسول الله إلى رحالكم» [Are.].
ghazawat-0234: Whom did the Prophet send after the people of Hawazin who headed toward Awtas after Hunayn?
He sent Abu Amir al-Ashari in pursuit of those who headed toward Awtas.
ghazawat-0235: According to Surat al-Anfal, on which side of Badr's valley were the Muslims?
The top of the sand dune

Allah says: ﴿إذ أنتم بالعدوة الدنيا وهم بالعدوة القصوى والركب أسفل منكم﴾ [[Remember] when you were on the near side of the valley, and they were on the farther side, and the caravan was lower [in position] than you.; Quran 8:42 (QuranEnc)].
ghazawat-0236: Concerning Badr, Allah says: ﴿وتودّون أن غير ذات الشوكة تكون لكم﴾ [and you wished that the unarmed one would be yours.; Quran 8:7 (QuranEnc)]. According to Ibn Ishaq, what did they wish for?
Ibn Ishaq explained it as spoils without war: the caravan.
ghazawat-0237: In Surat al-Anfal, how many angels did Allah promise as reinforcement to the Muslims at Badr?
Allah says: ﴿فاستجاب لكم أني ممدّكم بألف من الملائكة مردفين﴾ [and He answered you, "Indeed, I will reinforce you with a thousand from the angels, following one another."; al-Anfal 8:9 (QuranEnc)].
ghazawat-0238: During the expedition to al-Ushayrah in the Yanbu valley, with which tribe and its Banu Damrah allies did the Prophet make a truce?
He camped at al-Ushayrah in the Yanbu valley and made a truce with Banu Mudlij and their Banu Damrah allies.
ghazawat-0239: During the Buwat expedition, the Prophet reached a place and returned without encountering resistance. Near which mountain was Buwat?
Ibn Ishaq said he reached Buwat near Radwa, then returned to Madinah without encountering resistance.
ghazawat-0240: Which place in al-Hijaz did Sad ibn Abi Waqqas reach on his first expedition before returning without encountering resistance?
Sad ibn Abi Waqqas set out with eight men of the Muhajirun (emigrants) and reached al-Kharrar in al-Hijaz.
ghazawat-0241: During Ubaydah ibn al-Harith's expedition, two Muslims who had gone out with Makkah's army crossed over to the Muslims. One was al-Miqdad ibn Amr; who was the other?
Two men from Makkah's army joined the Muslims: al-Miqdad ibn Amr al-Bahrani and Utbah ibn Ghazwan.
ghazawat-0242: Who carried the standard of Hamzah ibn Abd al-Muttalib's expedition to the seacoast?
Abu Marthad Kannaz ibn Husayn al-Ghanawi
Abd Allah ibn Jahsh ibn Riab al-Asadi, ally of Banu Umayyah
Hamzah's standard was white, and its bearer was Abu Marthad Kannaz ibn Husayn al-Ghanawi.
ghazawat-0243: Who carried the standard of Ubaydah ibn al-Harith's expedition to Batn Rabigh?
Ubaydah's standard was white, and its bearer was Mistah ibn Uthathah ibn al-Muttalib.
ghazawat-0244: After Uhud, the Prophet sent Ali to follow Quraysh and gave him which sign that they intended to go to Makkah?
They would lead their horses alongside and ride their camels
They would ride their horses and drive their camels
He said: «فإن كانوا قد جنبوا الخيل وامتطوا الإبل فإنهم يريدون مكة، وإن ركبوا الخيل وساقوا الإبل فإنهم يريدون المدينة» [If.].
ghazawat-0248: The Prophet sent Ali, al-Zubayr and al-Miqdad to find a woman carrying a letter to Quraysh, saying: «انطلقوا حتى تأتوا …» [Go.]. Where?
He said: «انطلقوا حتى تأتوا روضة خاخ، فإن بها ظعينة ومعها كتاب» [Go.]. Reported in both Sahih collections.
ghazawat-0249: During the Battle of the Trench, which mountain did the Muslims place at their backs with the trench between them and the polytheists?
He went out with three thousand Muslims, who positioned themselves with Mount Sal at their backs, using it for protection.
ghazawat-0250: Where did Quraysh camp when it came to besiege Madinah during the Battle of the Trench?
The confluence of the watercourses near Rumah
Quraysh advanced and camped at the confluence of the watercourses near Rumah, between al-Jurf and Zughbah.
ghazawat-0251: The al-Raji mission followed a request by men of which two tribes for Companions to teach them their religion?
After Uhud, men of Adal and al-Qarah came to the Messenger of Allah requesting Muslims to teach them.
ghazawat-0253: Before Tabuk, the Prophet asked al-Jadd ibn Qays: «هل لك العامَ في جِلاد بني الأصفر؟» [Would.]. Who were Banu al-Asfar?
Banu al-Asfar were the Byzantines. The Tabuk expedition was intended to confront them.
ghazawat-0254: Poor Companions asked the Prophet for mounts to go to Tabuk, but he found none. Concerning them, Allah revealed: ﴿تولّوا وأعينهم …﴾ [They turned back while their eyes ...; Quran 9:92]. What follows?
﴿مطرقة إلى الأرض﴾ [Were cast down toward the ground]
﴿تفيض من الدمع حزنًا﴾ [overflowed with tears out of grief]
﴿شاخصة إلى السماء﴾ [Were staring toward the sky]

Allah says: ﴿قلت لا أجد ما أحملكم عليه تولّوا وأعينهم تفيض من الدمع حزنًا ألا يجدوا ما ينفقون﴾ [you said, "I can find nothing upon which to carry you."[497] They turned back while their eyes overflowed with tears out of grief that they could not find something to spend [for the cause of Allāh].; Quran 9:92 (QuranEnc) [497] No mounts or even shoes were available.].
ghazawat-0255: Which mountain did the caller climb to announce to Kab ibn Malik that Allah had accepted his repentance?
Kab said he heard a caller who had climbed Mount Sal shouting at the top of his voice: Kab ibn Malik, rejoice!
ghazawat-0256: After Thaqif embraced Islam following al-Taif, the Prophet appointed their youngest man over them because of his eagerness to learn religion and the Quran. Who was he?
Urwah ibn Masud ibn Muattib al-Thaqafi
Ibn Ishaq mentioned the appointment of Uthman ibn Abi al-As over Thaqif when they embraced Islam.
ghazawat-0257: In which Hijri year did the Battle of Uhud occur?
Ibn Ishaq said Quraysh attacked him at Uhud in Shawwal of the third year.
ghazawat-0258: In which Hijri month did the Battle of Uhud occur?
Ibn Ishaq said Uhud occurred on a Saturday in the middle of Shawwal.
ghazawat-0260: According to Ibn Ishaq, in which month of the ninth year did the Prophet set out for Tabuk?
Ibn Ishaq headed the account: The Tabuk expedition in Rajab of the ninth year.
ghazawat-0261: In which Hijri year did the Tabuk expedition occur?
The Tabuk expedition took place in Rajab of the ninth year.
ghazawat-0262: In which Hijri year did the Battle of Mutah occur?
Ibn Ishaq headed the account: The Battle of Mutah in Jumada al-Ula of the eighth year.
ghazawat-0263: According to Ibn Ishaq, in which month did the Muslim army set out for Mutah?
The Battle of Mutah took place in Jumada al-Ula of the eighth year.
ghazawat-0265: In which month did the Prophet perform Umrat al-Qada (the make-up minor pilgrimage)?
Ibn Ishaq headed the account: Umrat al-Qada in Dhu al-Qadah of the seventh year.
ghazawat-0266: In which Hijri month was Makkah conquered?
Ibn Ishaq headed the account: The conquest of Makkah in Ramadan of the eighth year.
ghazawat-0267: In which month did the Prophet leave Makkah for Hunayn?
Al-Mubarakfuri stated that he departed Makkah for Hunayn in Shawwal, 8 AH.
ghazawat-0268: In which Hijri year did the Battle of Hunayn occur?
Ibn Ishaq headed the account: The Battle of Hunayn in the eighth year, after the conquest.
ghazawat-0270: How many Muslims set out with the Prophet to Badr?
Three hundred and a little over ten men
Ibn al-Qayyim said he set out swiftly with three hundred and a little over ten men.
ghazawat-0271: Which daughter of the Prophet died while the Muslims were at Badr, with news reaching Madinah alongside the announcement of victory?
Usamah ibn Zayd said the news arrived just as they finished covering Ruqayyah, the Messenger of Allah's daughter, with earth.
ghazawat-0272: At Hamra al-Asad, the Prophet learned that Abu Sufyan threatened to return against the Muslims. What did he say?
«إنا لله وإنا إليه راجعون» [Indeed we belong to Allāh, and indeed to Him we will return.]
«حسبنا الله ونعم الوكيل» [Sufficient for us is Allāh, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs.]
«لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله» [There is no might or power except through Allah]

The travelers passed the Prophet at Hamra al-Asad and reported Abu Sufyan's words. He said: «حسبنا الله ونعم الوكيل» [Sufficient for us is Allāh, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs.]. Quran choice excerpts: 2:156 and 3:173 (QuranEnc) Footnote 150 to 3:173: The one entrusted and relied upon; sufficient to manage all matters.
ghazawat-0273: During the expedition against Banu Lihyan, the Prophet camped at Usfan and sent two horsemen to which place near Makkah?
He camped at Usfan, then sent two Companions on horseback as far as Kura al-Ghamim before returning.
ghazawat-0274: Concerning the umrah (minor pilgrimage) at al-Hudaybiyah, Allah revealed: ﴿لقد صدق الله رسوله … بالحق لتدخلنّ المسجد الحرام﴾ [Certainly has Allāh showed to His Messenger the ... in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Ḥarām; Quran 48:27]. Which word is missing?

Allah says: ﴿لقد صدق الله رسوله الرؤيا بالحق لتدخلن المسجد الحرام إن شاء الله آمنين﴾ [Certainly has Allāh showed to His Messenger the vision [i.e., dream] in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, if Allāh wills, in safety,; al-Fath 48:27 (QuranEnc)].
ghazawat-0275: What did the Prophet order his Companions to say when departing al-Taif?
«سبحان الذي سخّر لنا هذا» [Exalted is He who has subjected this to us,; Quran 43:13 (QuranEnc)]
«الله أكبر، صدق الله وعده» [Allah is greatest; Allah has fulfilled His promise]
«آيبون تائبون عابدون، لربنا حامدون» [We are those who return; those who repent; those who worship; and those who praise our Lord.]
«اللهم لا عيش إلا عيش الآخرة» [O Allah, there is no true life except the life of the Hereafter]
When they departed, he told them to say: «آيبون تائبون عابدون، لربنا حامدون» [We are those who return; those who repent; those who worship; and those who praise our Lord.; (HadeethEnc),].
ghazawat-0277: At a low-flowing spring in Tabuk that gushed after the Prophet washed his face and hands in it, whom did he tell: «يوشك يا … إن طالت بك حياة أن ترى ما هاهنا قد مُلئ جنانًا» [Soon,.]?
He said: «يوشك يا معاذ إن طالت بك حياة أن ترى ما ها هنا قد مُلئ جنانًا» [Soon,.].
ghazawat-0278: By what other name is Ghazwat Dhi Qarad known?
It is called Ghazwat al-Ghabah or Ghazwat Dhi Qarad.
ghazawat-0280: When Thaqif embraced Islam, the Prophet sent two men to demolish its idol al-Taghiyah. One was al-Mughirah ibn Shubah; who was the other?
Ali ibn Abi Talib ibn Abd al-Muttalib
He sent Abu Sufyan ibn Harb and al-Mughirah ibn Shubah to demolish al-Taghiyah.
ghazawat-0281: How did the Prophet divide Banu Qurayzah's spoils between horsemen and foot soldiers?
Three shares per horseman and one per foot soldier
Two shares per horseman and one per foot soldier
Four shares per horseman and two per foot soldier
He first set aside the khums (one-fifth levy). A horseman received three shares: two for the horse and one for its rider. A foot soldier received one share.
ghazawat-0283: At al-Hudaybiyah, when some people shaved their heads and others shortened their hair, for whom did the Prophet repeatedly pray for mercy?
Those who remained in ihram (pilgrimage consecration)
He said: «يرحم الله المحلقين» [May.]. They asked about those who shortened their hair, and he repeated: «يرحم الله المحلقين» [May Allah have mercy on those who shave their heads].
ghazawat-0284: Where did the Prophet camp with his army at Uhud?
In Uhud's ravine on the valley's bank toward the mountain
At Mount Sal north of Madinah
He advanced to Uhud's ravine on the valley's bank toward the mountain, placing himself and his army with their backs to Uhud.
ghazawat-0285: What did the Prophet wear at Uhud that made it difficult to climb the rock?
Two coats of armor, one over the other
A mail helmet and black turban
He wore two coats of armor, one over the other. When he tried to climb, he could not until Talhah helped him up.
ghazawat-0286: Who led Quraysh in the Battle of the Confederates?
Quraysh set out under Abu Sufyan ibn Harb, and Ghatafan under Uyaynah ibn Hisn.
ghazawat-0287: Abu Sufyan ibn al-Harith and Abd Allah ibn Abi Umayyah met the Prophet on his way to conquer Makkah, seeking an audience. Where did they meet him?
Niq al-Uqab between Makkah and Madinah
They met the Messenger of Allah at Niq al-Uqab between Makkah and Madinah.
ghazawat-0289: Before Hunayn, whom did the Prophet send into Hawazin as a scout to learn their plans?
Abd Allah ibn Abi Hadrad al-Aslami
Nuaym ibn Masud ibn Amir al-Ashjai al-Ghatafani
He sent Abd Allah ibn Abi Hadrad al-Aslami, ordering him to mingle with the people and learn their affairs.
ghazawat-0290: The Prophet briefly dozed in the shelter at Badr, then awoke and gave Abu Bakr glad tidings of whose arrival?
An envoy from Madinah with reinforcements
He said: «أبشر يا أبا بكر أتاك نصر الله، هذا جبريل آخذ بعنان فرس يقوده» [Rejoice, Abu Bakr! Allah's victory has come to you.].
ghazawat-0292: Before the conquest, Khalid ibn al-Walid and Amr ibn al-As came to Madinah as Muslims with which third man of Banu Abd al-Dar?
Ibn Ishaq stated that Uthman ibn Talhah ibn Abi Talhah accompanied them when they embraced Islam.
ghazawat-0294: Dihyah al-Kalbi returned from the Byzantine emperor with money and clothing but was waylaid by men of Judham. The Prophet sent Zayd ibn Harithah against them. Where did this happen?
When Dihyah was passing through Hisma, men of Judham met him and robbed him on the road.
ghazawat-0295: According to Ibn al-Qayyim, by which other name is the Battle of Hunayn known, after a place between Makkah and al-Taif?
Ibn al-Qayyim said the Battle of Hunayn is also called the Battle of Awtas; both are places between Makkah and al-Taif.
ghazawat-0298: After Uhud, the Prophet learned that Tulayhah and Salamah, sons of Khuwaylid, were summoning their people to fight him. Whom did he send to command an expedition against them?
Muhammad ibn Maslamah ibn Salamah al-Ansari al-Harithi
He dispatched Abu Salamah, gave him a standard and sent a hundred and fifty men with him against Banu Asad.
ghazawat-0300: On the al-Hudaybiyah journey, where did the Prophet garland and mark the sacrificial animals and enter ihram (pilgrimage consecration) for umrah (minor pilgrimage)?
At Dhu al-Hulayfah, the Messenger of Allah garlanded and marked the sacrificial animals and entered ihram (pilgrimage consecration) for umrah (minor pilgrimage).
ghazawat-0301: When the Muhajirun (emigrants) acquired property and date palms in Khaybar, what did they return to the Ansar (helpers)?
The houses they had occupied at the start of the emigration
Debts they had borrowed from them
The date palms they had been allowed to benefit from
The camels that had carried them to Khaybar
When the Muhajirun (emigrants) acquired property at Khaybar, they returned the date palms whose use the Ansar (helpers) had granted them.
ghazawat-0302: Where is Mutah, the site of the famous battle?
In the nearer part of al-Balqa in al-Sham
Between Tabuk and Aylah on the al-Sham route
Ibn al-Qayyim said Mutah lies in the nearer part of al-Balqa in al-Sham.
ghazawat-0303: During which expedition did Muadh ibn Jabal report that, if the Prophet departed before the sun passed its zenith, he delayed zuhr (noon prayer) to combine it with asr (afternoon prayer)?
Abu Dawud narrated from Muadh that during the Tabuk expedition, if the Prophet departed before the sun passed its zenith, he delayed zuhr (noon prayer) to combine it with asr (afternoon prayer).
ghazawat-0304: What did Kab ibn Malik do when he heard the caller announce that Allah had accepted his repentance?
He immediately gave away all his wealth
Kab said he fell in prostration and knew relief had come.
ghazawat-0305: On the day of the conquest, the Prophet forbade cutting Makkah's trees and grass, but at al-Abbas's request exempted which plant used by smiths and in houses?
Al-Abbas asked him to exempt idhkhir, needed by their smiths and for their houses. He replied: «إلا الإذخر» [Except.].
ghazawat-0306: What color was the turban the Prophet wore when entering Makkah on the day of the conquest?
Ibn al-Qayyim said the account states that he entered Makkah wearing a black turban, demonstrating that wearing black is permissible.
ghazawat-0308: During the Tabuk expedition, the people awoke without water and complained to the Prophet. What happened?
They bought water from Aylah's inhabitants
He supplicated, and Allah sent a cloud that rained until they had enough
They dug a new well that began to flow
He ordered them to return to Madinah
Ibn Ishaq said the Messenger of Allah supplicated, and Allah sent a cloud that rained until the people had enough water.
ghazawat-0309: After Quraysh's caravan escaped, some suggested returning. Which leader said: 'By Allah, we will not return until we reach Badr'?
Al-Akhnas ibn Shariq ibn Amr al-Thaqafi
Abu Jahl ibn Hisham said they would not return until they reached Badr and stayed there for three days.
ghazawat-0310: Whom did the Prophet send to Badr's water on the eve of the battle to seek information?
Ali, al-Zubayr and Sad ibn Abi Waqqas
Sad ibn Muadh, Usayd ibn Hudayr and al-Hubab ibn al-Mundhir
In the evening, he sent Ali ibn Abi Talib, al-Zubayr ibn al-Awwam and Sad ibn Abi Waqqas with others to Badr's water.
ghazawat-0311: To whom did the Prophet give the standard at Uhud?
He wore two coats of armor and gave the standard to Musab ibn Umayr of Banu Abd al-Dar.
ghazawat-0312: Before Uhud, the Prophet favored remaining in Madinah. Which man mentioned by Ibn Ishaq agreed with him?
Abd Allah ibn Ubayy ibn Salul
Al-Numan ibn Malik ibn Thalabah al-Ansari
Ibn Ishaq said Abd Allah ibn Ubayy ibn Salul shared the Messenger of Allah's view that they should not go out against the enemy.
ghazawat-0313: After the Prophet donned his armor for Uhud, some who had urged going out regretted it. What did he say?
«امضوا فإن الله ناصركم» [Proceed, for Allah will grant you victory]
«ما ينبغي لنبيٍّ إذا لبس لأمته أن يضعها حتى يقاتل» [It is not fitting for a prophet who has donned his armor to remove it until he fights]
«الرأي ما رأيتم فاخرجوا على بركة الله» [Your view stands; go out with Allah's blessing]
«لا أخرج حتى يأتيني الوحي» [I will not go out until revelation comes to me]
He said: «ما ينبغي لنبي إذا لبس لأمته أن يضعها حتى يقاتل» [It.].
ghazawat-0314: On what terms were Banu al-Nadir expelled from Madinah?
They had to leave all their property
They would pay jizyah (tribute) and remain
They could take whatever property their camels carried, except weapons
They could leave in person without their camels
He expelled them on condition that they could take whatever property their camels carried, except al-halqah, meaning weapons.
ghazawat-0315: According to Ibn Hisham, what was the Prophet's Companions' battle cry during the campaigns of the Trench and Banu Qurayzah?
Ha Mim: they will not be granted victory
Ibn Hisham said their battle cry during the campaigns of the Trench and Banu Qurayzah was: Ha Mim: they will not be granted victory.
ghazawat-0316: During the Banu al-Mustaliq expedition, two men used partisan calls of jahiliyyah (pre-Islamic ignorance): 'O Ansar!' and 'O Muhajirun!' The Prophet said: «دعوها فإنها …» [Leave.]. Complete it.
Hearing it, he said: «دعوها فإنها منتنة» [Leave.], meaning it was an offensive expression.
ghazawat-0317: On the way to al-Hudaybiyah, the Muslims learned that Quraysh's cavalry was stationed at Kura al-Ghamim. Who commanded it?
Quraysh's cavalry, under Khalid ibn al-Walid, was stationed at Kura al-Ghamim on the main road to Makkah.
ghazawat-0321: By what name were the Companions known who asked the Prophet for mounts to Tabuk when he could find none?
Ibn Ishaq headed the account 'The affair of the weepers': those who turned away with eyes overflowing with tears.
ghazawat-0322: For which trades were the Jews of Banu Qaynuqa in Madinah known?
They lived within Madinah in a neighborhood bearing their name and worked as goldsmiths, ironworkers and makers of containers and vessels.
ghazawat-0325: From where did Ali ibn Abi Talib fill his shield with water at Uhud and bring it to the Prophet?
Ali went and filled his shield with water from al-Mihras, then brought it to the Messenger of Allah.
ghazawat-0326: The Prophet's caller announced that only those who attended Uhud the previous day could go to Hamra al-Asad. Which one Companion was exempted because his father had left him with his sisters?
Al-Bara ibn Azib ibn al-Harith al-Ansari
Jabir ibn Abd Allah explained that his father had left him to care for seven sisters, so the Prophet allowed him to go.
ghazawat-0327: Why did the Prophet camp in a valley called al-Raji on the way to Khaybar?
To lead his Companions in salat al-khawf (prayer in danger)
To prevent Ghatafan from reinforcing Khaybar's inhabitants
It was the valley nearest water
He camped at al-Raji between Khaybar's people and Ghatafan to prevent Ghatafan from reinforcing them.
ghazawat-0328: After Khaybar, where did the Prophet go and besiege its inhabitants for several nights?
After finishing at Khaybar, he went to Wadi al-Qura, besieged its inhabitants for several nights and then departed.
ghazawat-0329: Some hypocrites mocked on the way to Tabuk, then excused themselves by saying they were only conversing and playing. In which surah was this mentioned?
Allah revealed: ﴿ولئن سألتهم ليقولن إنما كنا نخوض ونلعب﴾ [And if you ask them, they will surely say, "We were only conversing and playing."; al-Tawbah 9:65 (QuranEnc)].
ghazawat-0330: What did the Prophet do with Ukaydir, ruler of Dumat al-Jandal, when Khalid ibn al-Walid brought him?
He imprisoned him in Madinah until he embraced Islam
He spared his life, made a treaty for jizyah, then released him
Khalid brought Ukaydir to the Messenger of Allah, who spared his life, agreed on jizyah (tribute from non-Muslim subjects), and released him.
ghazawat-0331: In Jaysh al-Khabat, Abu Ubaydah took a rib from the animal cast up by the sea. What did he do with it?
He put the tallest man on the tallest camel and had him pass underneath
He used it as a tent pole
He sent it to Madinah as a gift
He buried it on the coast
He found the army's tallest man and tallest camel, mounted the man on it, and had him pass beneath the rib.
ghazawat-0332: What did the Prophet order the archers' commander at Uhud to do regarding the polytheists' horses?
Pursue them as far as Makkah
Keep them away from the Muslims with arrows
Capture them and bring them back
He told Abd Allah ibn Jubayr: «انضح الخيل عنا بالنبل، لا يأتونا من خلفنا» [Keep.].
ghazawat-0333: Whom did the Prophet leave in charge of Makkah when returning to Madinah after the umrah (minor pilgrimage) from al-Jiranah?
After completing his umrah (minor pilgrimage), he returned to Madinah and left Attab ibn Asid in charge of Makkah.
ghazawat-0334: Which Companion did the Prophet leave with Attab ibn Asid in Makkah to teach people religion and the Quran?
He appointed Attab ibn Asid over Makkah and left Muadh ibn Jabal with him to instruct people in religion.
ghazawat-0336: On his way to Khaybar, the Prophet passed which place where a mosque was built for him?
Ibn Ishaq said he passed Asar, where a mosque was built for him, then al-Sahba.
ghazawat-0338: How many nights did the Prophet remain at Badr during the later Badr expedition, waiting for Abu Sufyan?
Ibn Ishaq said he remained there eight nights awaiting Abu Sufyan.
ghazawat-0339: According to Ibn Hisham, what were the first spoils acquired by the Muslims?
The spoils of the major Battle of Badr
Quraysh's caravan in Abd Allah ibn Jahsh's expedition
Ibn Hisham said the spoils from Abd Allah ibn Jahsh's expedition were the Muslims' first spoils.
ghazawat-0341: According to Kab ibn Malik's account of the return from Tabuk, what did the Prophet do first when returning from a journey?
He went to the mosque and prayed two rakahs
He addressed people from the pulpit
On returning from a journey he first went to the mosque, prayed two rakahs (prayer units), then sat to meet the people.
ghazawat-0342: On the way to Tabuk, how much fruit did the Prophet estimate in a woman's orchard at Wadi al-Qura?
Ibn al-Qayyim stated that on that journey he estimated the woman's orchard at ten wasqs (a measure of produce).
ghazawat-0343: Who prepared Safiyyah bint Huyayy for the Prophet on the return from Khaybar?
Asma bint Umays ibn Madd al-Khathamiyyah
Umm Sulaym bint Milhan, the mother of Anas ibn Malik, prepared her.
ghazawat-0344: What feature of Badr before Islam made Abu Jahl want to stay there for three days?
It was a residence of Ghassan's kings
It housed an idol revered by Quraysh
It was the northern boundary of the sanctuary
It was a seasonal Arab gathering with a market
Ibn Ishaq said Badr was one of the Arabs' seasonal gatherings, where they held a market every year.
ghazawat-0346: Complete the Prophet's words to the Ansar after Hunayn: «ألم آتكم ضُلّالًا فهداكم الله، وعالةً …» [Did.]?
He said: «ألم آتكم ضلّالًا فهداكم الله، وعالة فأغناكم الله، وأعداء فألّف الله بين قلوبكم» [Did.].
ghazawat-0348: Watching the Muslim troops pass on the day of the conquest, Abu Sufyan told al-Abbas that his nephew's kingship had become great. How did al-Abbas reply?
Al-Abbas told Abu Sufyan it was prophethood. He replied: Then yes, indeed.
ghazawat-0349: When Uthman ibn Affan was the Prophet's envoy at al-Hudaybiyah, Quraysh offered to let him circumambulate the House. What did he say?
I would not do so until the Messenger of Allah circumambulates it
I will only do so in ihram (pilgrimage consecration)
I will circumambulate, then return with the news
I will circumambulate if you allow my companions
Uthman said he would not do so until the Messenger of Allah circumambulated it.
ghazawat-0350: The Prophet personally set out against Banu Sulaym, reached one of their watering places and stayed three nights. What was it called?
Ibn Ishaq said he reached a watering place of theirs called al-Kudr and remained there three nights.
ghazawat-0351: According to Ibn Ishaq, what was Buhran, which the Prophet reached during an early expedition?
A watering place of Banu Sulaym in Najd
A mine in al-Hijaz near al-Furu
A valley between Makkah and al-Taif
Ibn Ishaq said he reached Buhran, a mine in al-Hijaz near al-Furu.
ghazawat-0352: During Ghazwat al-Sawiq, Abu Sufyan's men raided which area of Madinah?
They reached an area called al-Urayd and burned date palms in some of its enclosed groves.
ghazawat-0353: What did the Prophet tell Abu Jandal when he was returned to Quraysh under the Treaty of al-Hudaybiyah?
«اكتم إيمانك حتى يأتي الفتح» [Conceal your faith until the conquest comes]
«ارجع إلى أبيك فبِرّه» [Return to your father and treat him dutifully]
«يا أبا جندل اصبر واحتسب، فإن الله جاعل لك فرجًا ومخرجًا» [Abu Jandal, be patient and seek Allah's reward; Allah will give you relief and a way out]
«الحق بالحبشة ففيها النجاة» [Go to Abyssinia, where there is deliverance]
He said: «يا أبا جندل اصبر واحتسب، فإن الله جاعل لك ولمن معك من المستضعفين فرجًا ومخرجًا» [Abu.].
ghazawat-0355: When the Prophet let Hawazin's delegation choose between their children and women or their property, and they chose the children and women, what did he say?
«قد رددت عليكم الأموال دون السبي» [I have returned your property, but not the captives]
«اذهبوا فأنتم أحرار بلا فداء» [Go, you are free without ransom]
«أما ما كان لي ولبني عبد المطلب فهو لكم» [Whatever belongs to me and Banu Abd al-Muttalib is yours]
«خذوا نصفهم وادفعوا فداء نصفهم» [Take half of them and pay ransom for the other half]
He said: «أما ما كان لي ولبني عبد المطلب فهو لكم» [Whatever.].
ghazawat-0356: After the Prophet left for Tabuk, Abu Khaythamah returned home on a hot day. What sight prompted him to join the Prophet?
His two wives in shelters they had sprinkled with water, with water and food prepared for him
He found his two wives in shelters in his garden. Each had sprinkled her shelter, cooled water and prepared food. He reflected that the Messenger of Allah was out in the sun, wind and heat.
ghazawat-0357: When the emigrants from Abyssinia arrived during Khaybar, the Prophet told the people of the ship: «لكم أنتم أهلَ السفينة …» [You.]. Complete it.
He said: «لكم أنتم أهل السفينة هجرتان» [You.].
ghazawat-0361: Which angel asked the Prophet: 'How do you rate the people who participated in the battle of Badr among you?' He answered: 'They are from the best of Muslims.'

In Sahih al-Bukhari, Rifaah ibn Rafi reported that Jibril came to the Prophet and asked: 'How do you rate the people who participated in the battle of Badr among you?' He said: 'They are from the best of Muslims.' English quoted (HadeethEnc),
ghazawat-0362: Al-Bara ibn Azib said they considered the number at Badr equal to the number of whose followers who crossed the river with him?
Al-Bukhari narrated from al-Bara that they considered Badr's participants equal in number to Talut's followers who crossed the river with him; only believers crossed with him.
ghazawat-0363: Al-Bara ibn Azib said: 'I and ... were considered too young at Badr.' Whom did he name?
In Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Bara said he and Ibn Umar were considered too young at Badr, meaning they were not permitted to go because of their youth.
ghazawat-0364: After the Prophet earnestly supplicated at Badr and Abu Bakr took his hand, which verse did he recite as he came out?
﴿سيُهزم الجمع ويولّون الدبر﴾ [[Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].[1587] [1587] This foretold event took place on the day of Badr.]
﴿إن ينصركم الله فلا غالب لكم﴾ [If Allāh should aid you, no one can overcome you;]
﴿إنا فتحنا لك فتحًا مبينًا﴾ [Indeed, We have given you, [O Muḥammad], a clear conquest[1507]]
﴿ألا إن نصر الله قريب﴾ [Unquestionably, the help of Allāh is near.]

In Sahih al-Bukhari, Ibn Abbas reported that he came out at Badr reciting: ﴿سيهزم الجمع ويولون الدبر﴾ [[Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].[1587]]. [1587] This foretold event took place on the day of Badr. Choice excerpts: Quran 54:45, 3:160, 48:1 and 2:214 (QuranEnc) [1507] Ibn Masʿūd said, "You [people] consider the conquest to be that of Makkah, but we consider it to be the Treaty of al-Ḥudaybiyyah." Al-Bukhārī reported a similar quotation from al-Barā’ bin ʿĀzib. Although initially regarded by the companions as a setback, the treaty, in effect, served to promote the spread of Islām, which led to the conquest of Makkah two years later.
ghazawat-0365: Abu Dharr swore that Allah's words ﴿هذان خصمان اختصموا في ربهم﴾ [These[921] are two adversaries who have disputed over their Lord.; Quran 22:19 (QuranEnc) [921] i.e., the believers and the disbelievers.] concerned the men who fought in single combat during which battle?
Al-Bukhari narrated from Abu Dharr that the verse concerned those who came forward at Badr: Hamzah, Ali, Ubaydah ibn al-Harith and their Quraysh opponents.
ghazawat-0366: What was the location of Banu al-Nadir's date palms that Hassan ibn Thabit mentioned in his poetry?
In Sahih al-Bukhari, Ibn Umar reported that the Prophet burned and cut Banu al-Nadir's date palms at al-Buwayrah. Hassan described a fire spreading at al-Buwayrah.
ghazawat-0367: The Companions encountered hard rock while digging the trench. The Prophet rose to deal with it with what tied to his stomach from severe hunger?
In Sahih al-Bukhari, Jabir said he rose with a stone tied to his stomach, and they had gone three days without tasting food.
ghazawat-0368: Al-Bukhari narrated in the chapter on the Trench: «نُصرتُ بـ…، وأُهلكت عادٌ بالدَّبور» [I.]. Which wind aided him?
In Sahih al-Bukhari, Ibn Abbas reported that the Prophet said: «نصرت بالصبا، وأهلكت عاد بالدبور» [I.].
ghazawat-0369: During the Battle of the Confederates, the Prophet asked who would bring news of the enemy. A Companion volunteered three times, and he said: «إن لكل نبي حواريًّا، وإن حواريّ …» [Every.]. Who?
In Sahih al-Bukhari, Jabir reported that al-Zubayr volunteered three times. The Prophet said: «إن لكل نبي حواريًّا، وإن حواريّ الزبير» [Every.].
ghazawat-0370: After the Prophet returned from the Trench, put down his weapons and bathed, who told him: 'Have you laid down your weapons? By Allah, we have not laid ours down. Go out to them'?
In Sahih al-Bukhari, Aishah reported that Jibril came after the Prophet returned from the Trench, laid down his weapons and bathed. Jibril said those words and indicated Banu Qurayzah.
ghazawat-0371: Under which other name did al-Bukhari list the expedition against Banu al-Mustaliq of Khuzaah?
Al-Bukhari headed the chapter: The expedition against Banu al-Mustaliq of Khuzaah, also called al-Muraysi. Al-Muraysi is a watering place.
ghazawat-0372: Al-Bara ibn Azib said: 'You consider the conquest to mean Makkah's conquest ... but we consider the conquest to be ...'. What did they consider the conquest?
In Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Bara said they considered the conquest to be Bayat al-Ridwan (the Pledge of Divine Approval) at al-Hudaybiyah.
ghazawat-0373: On which day did the Prophet tell his Companions: «أنتم خيرُ أهل الأرض» [You.]?
In Sahih al-Bukhari, Jabir reported that the Messenger of Allah told them at al-Hudaybiyah: «أنتم خير أهل الأرض» [You.]. They numbered one thousand four hundred.
ghazawat-0374: When the Prophet and his Companions came to Makkah for umrah (minor pilgrimage), the polytheists said a delegation was coming weakened by what?

In Sahih al-Bukhari, Ibn Abbas reported that the polytheists said a delegation weakened by Yathrib's fever was coming. The Prophet ordered the Muslims to perform ramal (brisk walking) during the first three circuits.
ghazawat-0377: According to Jabir, how many riders were in the force the Prophet sent under Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah to watch Quraysh's caravan on the coast?
In Sahih al-Bukhari, Jabir said the Messenger of Allah sent them, three hundred riders under Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah, to watch Quraysh's caravan.
ghazawat-0378: To which Companion did the Prophet say: «ألا تريحني من ذي الخلصة؟» [Will.], whereupon he set out with a hundred and fifty horsemen of Ahmas?
In Sahih al-Bukhari, Jarir reported that the Messenger of Allah told him: «ألا تريحني من ذي الخلصة» [Will.]. He set out with a hundred and fifty horsemen of Ahmas.
ghazawat-0379: The commander of Dhat al-Salasil asked the Prophet whom he loved most. He answered Aishah. When asked about men, whom did he name first?

In Sahih al-Bukhari, Abu Uthman narrated from Amr ibn al-As that the Prophet appointed him over Dhat al-Salasil. He asked whom he loved most. He said: «عائشة» [Aishah]. Asked about men, he said: «أبوها» [Her father], then: «ثم عمر بن الخطاب» [Then.].
ghazawat-0380: On the day of Makkah's conquest, the Prophet bathed, then offered salat al-duha (forenoon prayer). How many rakahs (prayer units) did he pray?
In Sahih al-Bukhari, Umm Hani reported that on the day of Makkah's conquest he bathed in her house, then prayed eight rakahs (prayer units).
ghazawat-0381: When the Prophet entered Makkah as conqueror, he struck the idols around the House with a stick while reciting which verse?
﴿إذا جاء نصر الله والفتح﴾ [When the victory of Allāh has come and the conquest,[2005] [2005] The conquest of Makkah.]
﴿جاء الحق وزهق الباطل﴾ [Truth has come, and falsehood has departed.]
﴿إنا فتحنا لك فتحًا مبينًا﴾ [Indeed, We have given you, [O Muḥammad], a clear conquest[1507]]
﴿ألا إن نصر الله قريب﴾ [Unquestionably, the help of Allāh is near.]

In Sahih al-Bukhari, Ibn Masud reported that he struck them with a stick in his hand, saying: ﴿جاء الحق وزهق الباطل﴾ [Truth has come, and falsehood has departed.]. Choice excerpts: Quran 110:1, 17:81, 48:1 and 2:214 (QuranEnc) [1507] Ibn Masʿūd said, "You [people] consider the conquest to be that of Makkah, but we consider it to be the Treaty of al-Ḥudaybiyyah." Al-Bukhārī reported a similar quotation from al-Barā’ bin ʿĀzib. Although initially regarded by the companions as a setback, the treaty, in effect, served to promote the spread of Islām, which led to the conquest of Makkah two years later.
ghazawat-0382: Complete the Prophet's words to the Ansar after Hunayn's spoils were divided: «الأنصارُ شِعار، والناسُ …» [The.].
In Sahih al-Bukhari, Abd Allah ibn Zayd reported that the Prophet said: «الأنصار شعار والناس دثار» [The.]. The shiar is the garment directly against the body.
ghazawat-0383: When leaving for Tabuk, the Prophet left Ali in charge and told him: «ألا ترضى أن تكون مني بمنزلة … من موسى» [Are.]. Who was named?
In Sahih al-Bukhari, Sad ibn Abi Waqqas reported that the Prophet told Ali at Tabuk: «ألا ترضى أن تكون مني بمنزلة هارون من موسى؟» [Are.].
ghazawat-0385: In which Quran surah is the Battle of Hunayn mentioned by name?

Allah says in Surat al-Tawbah: ﴿لقد نصركم الله في مواطن كثيرة ويوم حنين إذ أعجبتكم كثرتكم﴾ [Allāh has already given you victory in many regions and [even] on the day of Ḥunayn, when your great number pleased you,; al-Tawbah 9:25 (QuranEnc)].
ghazawat-0386: Badr is explicitly named in Allah's words: ﴿ولقد نصركم الله ببدر وأنتم أذلة﴾ [And already had Allāh given you victory at [the battle of] Badr while you were weak [i.e., few in number].; Quran 3:123 (QuranEnc)]. In which surah is this verse?
It is verse 123 of Surat Al Imran, the passage explicitly naming Badr.
ghazawat-0387: Cavalry sent by the Prophet toward Najd brought back which man of Banu Hanifah, who was tied to a mosque pillar, then released, after which he bathed and embraced Islam?

In Sahih al-Bukhari, Abu Hurayrah reported that cavalry sent toward Najd brought a Banu Hanifah man named Thumamah ibn Uthal. They tied him to a mosque pillar; he was later released and embraced Islam.
ghazawat-0388: The Prophet appointed an Ansari over an expedition. Angered, he ordered the men to light a fire and enter it, but they refused. The Prophet said: «لو دخلوها ما خرجوا منها إلى يوم القيامة، الطاعة في …» [Had.]. Complete it.
In Sahih al-Bukhari, Ali narrated in the chapter on Abd Allah ibn Hudhafah al-Sahmi's expedition that the Prophet said: «لو دخلوها ما خرجوا منها إلى يوم القيامة، الطاعة في المعروف» [Had.].
ghazawat-0389: Of which expedition did Yala ibn Umayyah say: 'That expedition is the deed in which I place the greatest confidence'?

In Sahih al-Bukhari, under the chapter on Tabuk, the Expedition of Hardship, Yala reported participating in the hardship expedition with the Prophet and described it as the deed in which he placed the greatest confidence.
tajweed-0001: How many rules govern nun sakinah (unvowelled nun) and tanwin (nunation) before the alphabet's letters, as al-Jamzuri versified in Tuhfat al-Atfal?
Al-Jamzuri says: 'For nun when unvowelled and for tanwin there are four rules; take my explanation': izhar (clear pronunciation), idgham (assimilation), iqlab (conversion), and ikhfa (concealment).
tajweed-0002: How many letters trigger izhar halqi (clear throat-letter pronunciation) of nun sakinah (unvowelled nun) and tanwin (nunation)?
The six izhar letters are the throat letters: hamzah, ha, 'ayn, ha (the voiceless pharyngeal letter), ghayn, and kha.
tajweed-0003: What reason do tajweed (Quranic recitation) scholars give for clearly pronouncing nun sakinah (unvowelled nun) before throat letters?
Its articulation point is far from theirs
They share nun's quality of breath flow
They are close to nun in complete sound blockage
Nun has the same articulation point as they do
Nun is pronounced clearly before throat letters because its articulation point, the tongue tip, is far from theirs.
tajweed-0008: Which single letter causes nun sakinah (unvowelled nun) or tanwin (nunation) to be converted into mim?
Al-Jamzuri says: 'The third is iqlab (conversion) before ba: into a mim with ghunnah (nasal resonance) and concealment.'
tajweed-0009: How is nun sakinah (unvowelled nun) pronounced when followed by ba?
Clearly from the tongue tip without nasal resonance
Converted into a concealed mim with nasal resonance
Concealed as a pure nun without conversion
Iqlab (conversion) changes nun sakinah into mim before ba. This mim is then concealed before ba while ghunnah (nasal resonance) is sounded.
tajweed-0010: How many letters trigger ikhfa haqiqi (true concealment) of nun sakinah (unvowelled nun) and tanwin (nunation)?
Tuhfat al-Atfal says: 'At five after ten; I have included their symbols in the words of this verse.'
tajweed-0012: In tajweed (Quranic recitation) terminology, ikhfa (concealment) is an intermediate state between which two processes?
Ikhfa conceals the first letter before the second while retaining ghunnah (nasal resonance). It is intermediate between izhar (clear pronunciation) and idgham (assimilation).
tajweed-0022: Why is assimilating nun sakinah (unvowelled nun) into waw or ya considered incomplete idgham (assimilation)?
Because nasal resonance, a quality of nun, remains
Because their articulation points are far from nun's
Because nun is first converted into mim
Because they are among the six throat letters
The assimilation of nun into waw or ya is incomplete because ghunnah (nasal resonance), a quality of nun, remains.
tajweed-0023: Some tajweed (Quranic recitation) scholars describe assimilation into lam and ra without nasal resonance as what kind of idgham (assimilation)?
It is called complete because both the assimilated letter and its quality, ghunnah (nasal resonance), disappear.
tajweed-0025: What does al-Jamzuri call both doubled mim and doubled nun in his Tuhfah?
